overview: An Oxfordian salamandroid genus represented by one holotype and five referred articulated specimens, including material with larval structures.

ecology.diet: Undetermined
ecology.habitat: Tiaojishan Formation depositional setting; niche unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Aquatic or semiaquatic inference remains specimen-dependent
ecology.bodySize: Small articulated salamanders

traits: Salamandroid character combination
Articulated skeletons
Larval structures in referred material
evidenceSummary: PKUP V0601–V0606 support salamandroid placement and a neoteny interpretation, but the zircon age comes from overlying rock and both placement and development remain analysis-sensitive.

overview: A Norian stem gymnophionomorph represented by isolated three-dimensional bones from at least seventy-six individuals in one dated bonebed.

ecology.diet: Small-prey feeding inferred, not directly observed
ecology.habitat: Bonebed depositional context; burrowing and niche remain inferential
ecology.bodySize: Small-bodied individuals represented by isolated elements

traits: Gymnophionomorph jaw characters
Three-dimensional jaws and vertebrae
Dissorophoid-like cranial character combination
evidenceSummary: The large disarticulated sample and U–Pb-bracketed locality support a caecilian total-group record and one dissorophoid-origin analysis without dating crown Gymnophiona or settling all lissamphibian-origin models.

geography: Tiaojishan Formation, western Liaoning, China (Beiyanerpeton sample)
Living salamander lineages sampled by Shen et al.
overview: Caudata is represented by a 102-nuclear-marker phylogeny and the articulated Beiyanerpeton sample; these complementary data sets remain bounded and do not form a complete salamander history.

ecology.diet: Not assigned by the cited marker and fossil studies
ecology.habitat: The Tiaojishan depositional setting and living samples provide context, not a complete habitat distribution
ecology.locomotion: Skeletal anatomy is described, but locomotor performance is not measured
ecology.bodySize: Not assigned as a complete comparative body-size dataset
ecology.guild: No order-wide ecological guild is assigned from the cited evidence

traits: 102 nuclear markers used in a sampled salamander topology
Articulated cranial and postcranial Beiyanerpeton skeletons
Bony gill structures near the cheek region
evidenceSummary: Shen et al. test higher-level salamander relationships with nuclear markers, while Gao et al. provide a Jurassic salamandroid sample; taxonomy, ecology and range remain study-limited.

geography: Archer City, Mount Barry, Briar Creek, Rattlesnake Canyon and Craddock bonebed
Texas and New Mexico, United States
overview: Named Early Permian Dimetrodon and cf. Dimetrodon teeth document diverse carina and cusp anatomy in a sphenacodontid matrix; neither the sample nor its topology identifies a direct mammalian ancestor.

ecology.diet: Predatory feeding inferred from sphenacodontid tooth anatomy; individual prey is not preserved
ecology.habitat: Fully terrestrial apex-predator interpretation for the sampled sphenacodontids; habitat breadth is unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Not measured by the dental sample
ecology.bodySize: The profile does not infer a genus-wide mass or body-length range
ecology.guild: Terrestrial predator inference bounded to the source's sampled ecological interpretation

traits: MCZ 2779 snout with enlarged anterior maxillary tooth
MCZ 2028 and UMMP 9722 dentary teeth with lingual cusp variation
Carina and denticle character changes optimized in the sampled phylogeny
evidenceSummary: Figures 1–4 and the methods tie named teeth to Early Permian Texas and New Mexico localities; tooth form supports a bounded ecological interpretation, while species attribution of isolated material, performance and ancestry remain unresolved.

commonNameZh: 达善沟基干兽孔类标本
overview: Holotype IVPP V15424 is a fragmentary Middle Permian snout tested in a 71-character morphology matrix; its basal-therapsid position is an analytical result, not direct ancestry.

ecology.diet: Carnivorous diet inferred from cranial and dental morphology
ecology.habitat: Continental Xidagou depositional setting; exact life habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Not preserved by the partial snout
ecology.bodySize: Known from an approximately 100 mm partial snout
ecology.guild: Small terrestrial predator inferred from dentition

traits: Partial snout with cranial and dental character combination
Double canine condition discussed in the diagnosis
Matrix-defined sister position to sampled therapsids
evidenceSummary: The named holotype and published matrix support a bounded basal-therapsid test, while the formation lacks a reliable direct radiometric date and the fossil is not treated as an ancestor.

overview: CT scans and occlusal reconstruction of named Haramiyavia jaws document a Late Triassic haramiyidan whose placement outside crown Mammalia is specific to the cited character matrix.

ecology.diet: Plant processing inferred from complex teeth and wear facets
ecology.habitat: Fleming Fjord continental depositional setting
ecology.locomotion: Not preserved by the profiled jaw material
ecology.bodySize: Small mammaliaform; profile does not infer whole-body mass
ecology.guild: Small terrestrial plant processor inferred from dentition

traits: Dentary condyle and postdentary trough
Complex multi-row postcanine dentition
Reconstructed palinal jaw movement from wear geometry
evidenceSummary: MCZ7/95A–B and MCZ10/G95 support jaw, tooth-wear and matrix claims; auditory ossicles are not preserved in articulation and the matrix result is not a universal crown-boundary statement.

commonNameZh: 摩尔根兽类颅骨标本组
overview: Morganucodon watsoni from Wales and M. oehleri from China anchor a Lower Jurassic skull comparison with both a squamosal–dentary contact and retained articular–quadrate joint; the anatomy is not a linear transition or direct ancestry claim.

ecology.diet: Tooth classes are functionally differentiated, but direct diet is not observed
ecology.habitat: Lower Jurassic source context; life habitat is unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Not established by the skull study
ecology.bodySize: M. watsoni skull is reported as 26 mm long; no order-wide body-size envelope is inferred
ecology.guild: A whole-order ecological guild is not assigned

traits: 26 mm M. watsoni skull and slightly larger M. oehleri skull
Differentiated incisors, canines, premolars and molars
Squamosal–dentary contact with retained articular–quadrate joint
evidenceSummary: Kermack, Mussett and Rigney's pages 1–158 directly describe the two named Lower Jurassic skull samples; the profile keeps locality, taxonomic scope, diet, functional interpretation and crown placement separate.

overview: Near-complete holotype IVPP V16051 preserves a detached ectotympanic and malleus linked to the dentary by ossified Meckel’s cartilage, documenting one anatomical mosaic rather than a universal transition stage.

ecology.diet: Animal-feeding diet inferred from eutriconodont dentition
ecology.habitat: Jiufotang lacustrine depositional setting; exact life habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial locomotion inferred; performance not measured
ecology.bodySize: Small-bodied mammal known from a near-complete skeleton
ecology.guild: Small terrestrial faunivore inferred from dentition

traits: Detached ectotympanic and malleus
Ossified Meckel’s cartilage linking ear and dentary
Near-complete articulated postcranial skeleton
evidenceSummary: The holotype directly supports the anatomical observations, but the stabilizing function of the ossified cartilage and its evolutionary significance remain interpretations rather than observed performance or ancestry.

overview: An early Eocene radiation whose initially similar branches diverged into horses, tapirs, rhinoceroses and many extinct groups; the profile treats that history as a branching record, not a ladder.

ecology.diet: Terrestrial herbivory across sampled lineages
ecology.habitat: Lineage-specific terrestrial habitats; no single order-wide habitat
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial, with strongly divergent limb specializations
ecology.bodySize: Small early forms to giant rhinocerotoids
ecology.guild: Browsers, mixed feeders and grazers in separate lineages

traits: Early branches distinguished by subtle dental and cranial characters
Strong lineage-specific divergence of skull, dentition and limbs
evidenceSummary: Tissier and Smith constrain the earliest sampled radiation and dispersal; Prothero synthesizes the broader fossil branching pattern. Neither source supplies an exact origin date or one ecology for the whole order.

overview: An Eocene perissodactyl family revised at species level, with shared cranial and molar traits but substantial variation in size and cranial appendages.

ecology.diet: Herbivorous; folivory supported for sampled teeth
ecology.habitat: Terrestrial Eocene localities; family-wide habitat not generalized
ecology.bodySize: Small early forms to rhinoceros-sized taxa
ecology.guild: Leaf-browser signal in sampled dental evidence

traits: Anteroposteriorly shortened face
Elongate postorbital cranium
Bunoselenodont upper molars with a W-shaped ectoloph
Frontonasal appendages in some, not all, species
evidenceSummary: Mihlbachler’s monograph supplies the taxonomy, morphology and distribution. Dispersal direction and deeper placement remain inferred, and neither giant size nor horns define every species.

geography: Western Europe (French and British study records)
overview: A western European palaeothere represented here by dental-wear evidence from Palaeotherium medium and regional terminal records near the Grande Coupure.

ecology.diet: Leaf browsing with a smaller fruit or abrasive-seed component in sampled P. medium
ecology.habitat: Late Eocene terrestrial locality; habitat not inferred from wear alone
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial; gait not evaluated in the cited wear study
ecology.bodySize: P. medium sample; genus-wide size not generalized
ecology.guild: Leaf browser in the sampled population

traits: High molar occlusal relief
Mixed sharp and rounded worn cusps
Wear facets consistent with shearing and grinding plant foods
evidenceSummary: Joomun and colleagues directly analyze one species and locality; Hooker and colleagues provide a separate British regional range chart. The profile does not generalize limb form, diet or extinction instant to every species.

geography: Badlands National Park, South Dakota (sampled M. planifrons)
overview: An amynodontid represented by a comparative anatomical test of semi-aquatic locomotion in Metamynodon planifrons, not by a family-wide “swamp rhino” label.

ecology.diet: Herbivorous; diet not tested in the locomotor study
ecology.habitat: Associated with Orellan channel sandstones
ecology.locomotion: Semi-aquatic inference from comparative anatomy and deposits
ecology.bodySize: Large M. planifrons sample; genus-wide mass not generalized
ecology.guild: No feeding guild assigned beyond the bounded locomotor inference

traits: High-positioned orbits
Reduced thoracic neural spines
Limb-lever proportions differing from more terrestrial amynodontids
evidenceSummary: Wall and Heinbaugh compare orbital, axial and limb characters with other amynodontids. Anatomy and sedimentary association support but do not directly observe behavior.

overview: An Oligocene Asian paraceratheriid genus whose 26.5 Ma Linxia skull and vertebrae refine species relationships and a Tibetan-region dispersal hypothesis.

ecology.diet: Large terrestrial herbivore; feeding height inferred from neck and body form
ecology.habitat: Oligocene Asian woodland–grassland mosaics; locality dependent
ecology.locomotion: Long-limbed terrestrial giant, not elephant-like graviportal
ecology.bodySize: Giant-bodied
ecology.guild: Large browser inference; direct diet was not measured

traits: Giant skull and body size
Long, flexible neck supported by cervical anatomy
Long rather than stubby graviportal limbs
Species-level cranial and dental diagnoses
evidenceSummary: Deng and colleagues provide the dated specimen, diagnosis, 155-character analysis and occurrence map. Dispersal route, palaeoelevation and feeding height remain inferences.

overview: A genus-level profile bounded to dental-wear samples labelled Chalicotherium goldfussi and the historical combination Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande.

ecology.diet: Browse-dominated feeding with abrasive bark or twig components
ecology.habitat: Sampled Miocene southern German localities; habitat not inferred from diet alone
ecology.locomotion: Posture reconstructed from limb anatomy, not observed behavior
ecology.bodySize: Large chalicotheriine; no genus-wide mass estimate

traits: Large ungual phalanges interpreted as claws
Short hind limbs in sampled chalicotheriines
Posture and claw function remain functional reconstructions
evidenceSummary: The primary study combines mesowear and microwear and states its historical taxonomy. Dietary evidence is direct; posture and claw use remain interpretations.

geography: Central and western Europe (MN3–MN9 record discussed)
overview: A Miocene equid represented here by A. aurelianense at Sandelzhausen and the regional European MN3–MN9 record, not a single global genus ecology.

ecology.diet: Browse-dominated mixed feeding at Sandelzhausen
ecology.habitat: Warm-temperate woodland context; one-locality dietary sample
ecology.locomotion: Tridactyl terrestrial; cursorial performance not tested
ecology.bodySize: Larger than preceding equids; no single genus-wide mass
ecology.guild: “Dirty browser” or mixed feeder in the sampled population

traits: Low-crowned lophodont cheek teeth
Tridactyl manus with reduced fifth metacarpal
Dental wear more abrasive than a pure-browser model predicts
evidenceSummary: Kaiser analyzes 35 cheek teeth and provides the diagnosis and European biochronology. The profile keeps diet at the sampled species and locality level.

regionalRanges.label: North American tribe-level range
regionalRanges.basis: The North American review and its tribe-level figure place the represented hipparionin record from approximately 17 to 2 Ma; this remains a regional review-matrix envelope.

regionalRanges.label: Old World first dispersal
regionalRanges.basis: The oldest well-supported Old World dispersal window is represented by early Hippotherium records in the Vienna Basin.

regionalRanges.label: Latest Old World regional records
regionalRanges.basis: Terminal records vary by lineage and region; the review places the latest Chinese and African hipparionins around or below 1 Ma rather than at the Holocene boundary.

overview: A persistently tridactyl equine tribe whose Old World radiation comprised multiple genus-rank clades rather than a single broadly defined Hipparion.

ecology.diet: Browse-dominated, mixed-feeding and grazing lineages
ecology.habitat: Forest, woodland and open settings depending on lineage and time
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial equine locomotion with persistent side toes
ecology.bodySize: Small to large lineage-level variation

traits: Persistent tridactyly
Hypsodont teeth in many lineages
Substantial body-size and dietary variation
evidenceSummary: McHorse and colleagues synthesize foot evolution and North American context; Bernor and colleagues resolve Old World genus-rank ranges, geography, body mass and diet.

overview: A North American rhinoceros with locality-dependent isotope evidence: principally terrestrial Florida populations contrast with limited-mobility, wet-habitat T. major at Ashfall.

ecology.diet: Grazing or mixed feeding depending on locality
ecology.habitat: Open Florida settings and the Ashfall watering-hole landscape
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial to locally semi-aquatic; genus-wide behavior unresolved
ecology.bodySize: Large; Ashfall estimates near 785–1110 kg

traits: Shortened limb and foot bones
Barrel-bodied T. major at Ashfall
Hypsodont molars
Sexually dimorphic lower second incisors
evidenceSummary: Florida and Ashfall primary studies differ in ecological signal. Body shape alone is not used to choose one genus-wide behavior, and the strongest Ashfall result remains species- and locality-bounded.

overview: A rhinoceros genus with species- and region-specific paleoecology, from Tibetan and East Asian forms to the northern Eurasian woolly rhinoceros C. antiquitatis.

ecology.diet: Typical grazing in C. antiquitatis; mixed feeding in some C. nihowanensis samples
ecology.habitat: Cold dry steppe for C. antiquitatis; other species and regions vary
ecology.bodySize: Large; about 2900 kg reviewed for C. antiquitatis
ecology.guild: Cold-steppe grazer in C. antiquitatis, not a genus-wide constant

traits: Long hair and dense underwool in C. antiquitatis
Low head posture and long nasal horn in C. antiquitatis
High-crowned teeth associated with abrasive grazing
evidenceSummary: Ma and colleagues synthesize isotopic and morphological evidence across species. The 14.4 ka genome constrains one late C. antiquitatis individual and is not used to support morphology, ecology or an exact global extinction boundary.

overview: Separately catalogued skulls, limb bones and teeth support an aquatic-wading interpretation and a raoellid sister placement to Cetacea in the published analysis.

ecology.diet: Diet unresolved; stable isotopes constrain water use more directly than food choice
ecology.habitat: Aquatic or riparian use inferred from bone density and isotopes
ecology.locomotion: Wading interpretation inferred; no associated skeleton preserves a complete gait
ecology.bodySize: Small artiodactyl-sized raoellid
ecology.guild: Aquatic-wading ecological interpretation with diet unresolved

traits: Cetacean-like involucrum in skull material
Dense long-bone sections
Stable-isotope sample from multiple teeth
evidenceSummary: The material is a disarticulated bone-bed sample, not one skeleton; aquatic ecology and sister placement are inferences, and Indohyus is neither crown Cetacea nor a demonstrated ancestor.

overview: Partial skeleton H-GSP 18507 combines large weight-bearing limbs with vertebral and hind-limb anatomy used to model amphibious swimming.

ecology.diet: Aquatic predation inferred from teeth and skull; prey not directly observed
ecology.habitat: Amphibious use inferred from anatomy and formation context
ecology.locomotion: Dorsoventral swimming and land movement are functional models
ecology.bodySize: Large-bodied early cetacean represented by a partial skeleton

traits: Partial skull and vertebral column
Substantial weight-bearing fore- and hind limbs
Vertebral and limb mosaic used in locomotor comparison
evidenceSummary: The holotype directly records an amphibious anatomical mosaic; otter-like swimming and sea-lion-like land movement are analogue-based models, not observed behaviour or ancestry.

overview: Holotype CGM 60584 combines a long posterior trunk, unfused sacrals, no weight-bearing sacroiliac joint and reduced limbs in a model of increasing tail propulsion.

ecology.diet: Marine predation inferred from cetacean dentition; prey not directly preserved
ecology.habitat: Marine lower Gehannam depositional setting
ecology.locomotion: Mid-body and tail undulation inferred; tail fluke not preserved
ecology.bodySize: Large protocetid represented by substantial associated remains

traits: Elongate posterior trunk
Unfused sacrals without a weight-bearing sacroiliac joint
Reduced limbs and no securely preserved tail fluke
evidenceSummary: Associated material documents the locomotor anatomy, but age placement straddles competing stratigraphic interpretations and tail-driven swimming remains a model rather than observed performance.

commonNameZh: 地点组合的陆生早期鲸
geography: H-GSP Locality 62, Ganda Kas, Kala Chitta Hills, Punjab, Pakistan
overview: Thewissen et al. report a wolf-sized Pakicetus attocki reconstruction from separately catalogued early-Eocene material at one Pakistani site; cranial and postcranial anatomy supports a terrestrial locomotor interpretation.

ecology.diet: Diet is unresolved from the described skeleton and teeth; the study does not attribute prey remains to the sample
ecology.habitat: Terrestrial use is inferred from the locomotor skeleton; the locality and formation do not prove a shoreline microhabitat
ecology.locomotion: Running and terrestrial locomotion are inferred from limb proportions and osteology; performance was not observed
ecology.bodySize: Wolf-sized pakicetid in the authors' comparison
ecology.guild: Terrestrial early-cetacean interpretation with ecological guild bounded to the named sample

traits: Cetacean-like basicranial ear region in skull H-GSP 96231
Weight-bearing limbs and running adaptations in separately catalogued postcrania
Locality-composite reconstruction combining multiple individuals
evidenceSummary: Skull H-GSP 96231 and separately catalogued vertebrae and limb bones from H-GSP Locality 62 support a terrestrial body plan, but the reconstruction is not one associated skeleton and Pakicetus is not presented as a direct ancestor.

geography: Lowest Yumaque Member, Paracas Formation, Playa Media Luna, Pisco Basin, Peru
overview: Holotype MUSM 3580 is a partial skeleton from the middle Eocene Yumaque Member of coastal Peru; its sacral attachment, robust limbs and hoof-like phalanges document a quadrupedal whale with both aquatic and weight-bearing anatomical signals.

ecology.diet: Carnivory is inferred from cetacean dentition; prey and feeding behaviour are not preserved
ecology.habitat: Marine depositional context is documented, while amphibious habitat use is inferred from the skeleton
ecology.locomotion: Quadrupedal swimming and terrestrial weight bearing are functional reconstructions; no gait or swimming performance was observed
ecology.bodySize: Approximately 4 m long according to the reported skeletal dimensions
ecology.guild: Amphibious quadrupedal cetacean interpretation with route and behaviour unresolved

traits: Partial articulated holotype MUSM 3580 preserving mandibles and most major postcranial regions
Two fused sacrals, defined femoral head and hoof-like distal phalanges
Functional hind limbs alongside aquatic cetacean adaptations
evidenceSummary: MUSM 3580 fixes an approximately 42.6 Ma Peruvian protocetid occurrence and preserves anatomy consistent with weight bearing and aquatic locomotion; walking, swimming and westward dispersal remain analytical interpretations, not direct ancestry.

overview: Isolated late Puercan astragali and calcanea attributed to Purgatorius preserve mobile-ankle features used to test arboreality and a primate-side placement.

ecology.diet: Diet not tested by the isolated tarsals
ecology.habitat: Arboreal use inferred from ankle mobility; depositional setting alone is not habitat
ecology.locomotion: Mobile ankle and inverted-foot capability inferred from tarsal form
ecology.bodySize: Small-bodied mammal; mass estimated comparatively, not measured
ecology.guild: Arboreal locomotor interpretation with diet unresolved

traits: Mobile upper ankle joint
Inverted-foot capability
Isolated astragalus and calcaneus attribution
evidenceSummary: UCMP 197509 and UCMP 197517 are isolated bones attributed by comparative regressions and matrices; they are not associated with teeth and do not establish crown-Primate membership or direct ancestry.

title.en: Small bones from a brief window
title.zh: 短暂时间窗中的小型骨骼

text.en: The Garbani Channel fauna in Montana preserves isolated ankle bones assigned to Purgatorius. Two named specimens, UCMP 197509 and UCMP 197517, are astragali and calcanei rather than parts of a skeleton found with teeth. Their late-Puercan setting places the sample near the beginning of the Paleocene, but the locality window is not a direct date on an animal.
text.zh: 蒙大拿州 Garbani Channel 动物群中发现了被归入 Purgatorius 的孤立踝骨。两件具名标本 UCMP 197509 和 UCMP 197517 是距骨与跟骨，并非与牙齿相连的完整骨架。它们来自晚 Puercan 期地层，时间接近古新世早期；这个地点的年代窗口并不是对某只动物的直接测年。

title.en: An ankle built for mobility
title.zh: 具有活动能力的踝关节

text.en: Comparisons of the joint surfaces and measurements place these bones near the mobile end of the mammal sample examined by the authors. The form supports an interpretation that the foot could invert and the animal may have used branches. This is a functional reading of ankle anatomy, not a direct observation of climbing or a complete reconstruction of the animal’s daily life.
text.zh: 作者比较关节面与测量值后，发现这些踝骨在所比较的哺乳动物中偏向活动度较高的一端。其形态支持足部能够内翻、动物可能利用树枝的解释。这是对踝部结构的功能推断，并非攀爬行为的直接观察，也不能据此完整复原动物的日常生活。

title.en: Attribution is not ancestry
title.zh: 标本归属不等于祖先关系

text.en: The bones were attributed to Purgatorius through comparative size and anatomical analyses. Because they are isolated and lack associated teeth, the study does not demonstrate that they belong to a named dental species, establish membership in crown Primates, or identify a direct ancestor. The result is a useful early locomotor test with a deliberately narrow specimen base.
text.zh: 研究依据体型比较与解剖分析将这些骨骼归入 Purgatorius。由于标本彼此孤立，且没有相连的牙齿，论文并未证明它们属于某个具名的牙齿物种，也未确立其属于现代灵长类总群或是某一现生类群的直接祖先。它提供了早期运动方式的重要线索，但标本基础刻意保持在有限范围内。

title.en: Chester et al. (2015). Oldest known euarchontan tarsals and affinities of Paleocene Purgatorius to Primates.
title.zh: Chester 等（2015）：已知最早的灵长总目踝骨及古新世 Purgatorius 与灵长类的亲缘关系。

scope.en: Isolated Garbani Channel tarsals and comparative functional and taxonomic analyses; no associated dental skeleton.
scope.zh: 研究对象为 Garbani Channel 孤立跗骨及其比较功能、分类分析；没有与牙齿相连的骨架。

readerLimitations.en: This is a specimen-focused guide to two isolated tarsals, not a complete species account. Their taxonomic attribution and locomotor meaning are comparative inferences; diet, population ecology and a direct place in primate ancestry are not established by this sample.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文聚焦两件孤立跗骨，不是完整的物种综述。标本归属与运动方式解释都来自比较推断；这组材料不能确定其饮食、种群生态或在灵长类祖先关系中的直接位置。

overview: Part and counterpart of one juvenile skeleton preserve unusually complete anatomy, soft-tissue outline and gut contents, while preparation history and phylogenetic placement require explicit qualification.

ecology.diet: Plant material inferred from preserved gut contents
ecology.habitat: Messel lake ecosystem; habitual microhabitat remains inferred
ecology.locomotion: Arboreal quadrupedal interpretation from hands, feet and limbs
ecology.bodySize: Juvenile individual; adult body size cannot be read directly
ecology.guild: Small arboreal plant-eater inferred from one juvenile

traits: Complete tail and articulated limbs
Hands and right foot preserved
Soft-tissue outline and gut contents
evidenceSummary: PMO 214.214 and WDC-MG-210 are opposite slabs of one skeleton. Fabricated portions of plate B were disclosed, and no feature makes the specimen a demonstrated anthropoid ancestor.

title.en: One animal preserved on two slabs
title.zh: 一只动物保存在两块石板上

text.en: The Messel specimen known as Ida is a part-and-counterpart fossil: PMO 214.214 and WDC-MG-210 are the opposing surfaces of one juvenile skeleton, not two individuals. The skeleton preserves an unusually continuous body outline, limbs, hands, feet and tail. Reading the two slabs together helps separate the animal’s preserved anatomy from the gaps and distortions introduced during burial and preparation.
text.zh: 俗称 Ida 的梅塞尔标本是一件正反模化石：PMO 214.214 与 WDC-MG-210 是同一只幼年个体的两面石板，不是两只动物。骨架保留了较连续的身体轮廓、四肢、手、足和尾部。对照两块石板，有助于区分实际保存的解剖结构与埋藏、制备造成的缺损和变形。

title.en: A juvenile with unusual soft-tissue clues
title.zh: 带有特殊软组织线索的幼体

text.en: The authors described a soft-tissue outline and plant material in the gut region, alongside the skeleton’s teeth and limbs. Those remains make the fossil unusually informative, but its juvenile age matters: adult size and some adult proportions cannot be read directly from this individual. The gut contents support a limited dietary interpretation for this animal, not a complete menu for every member of the species.
text.zh: 作者在骨骼、牙齿和四肢之外，还描述了软组织轮廓及腹部区域的植物残留。这些保存让化石格外有信息量，但其幼年阶段很重要：不能直接从这一个体读出成体体型及所有成体比例。肠道内容物只支持对这只动物饮食的有限解释，不能代表整个物种的完整食谱。

title.en: Completeness does not settle placement
title.zh: 保存完整并不能决定分类位置

text.en: The original description documents that part of the counterplate contains fabricated preparation material. The fossil’s combination of features has been used in debates about adapiforms and anthropoid relationships, but one striking skeleton cannot by itself settle a branching history or make Darwinius a demonstrated human ancestor. Specimen completeness, preparation history and phylogenetic placement are separate questions.
text.zh: 原始描述说明，反板的一部分含有人工制备材料。该化石的特征组合参与了关于适应猴类与拟人猿类关系的讨论，但一具引人注目的骨架不能独自确定分支历史，也不能证明 Darwinius 是人类祖先。化石的完整程度、制备过程与系统发育位置是彼此独立的问题。

title.en: Franzen et al. (2009). Complete Primate Skeleton from the Middle Eocene of Messel in Germany: Morphology and Paleobiology.
title.zh: Franzen 等（2009）：德国梅塞尔中始新世的完整灵长类骨架：形态与古生物学。

scope.en: The Messel juvenile part-and-counterpart holotype, its described anatomy, preparation disclosure and proposed paleobiology.
scope.zh: 梅塞尔幼体正反模正模及其解剖描述、制备说明和古生物学解释。

readerLimitations.en: This guide follows one juvenile holotype and its original description. It does not provide a population-level account, a direct adult body-size estimate, or a settled phylogenetic position; preparation details and interpretations should be read with the specimen record.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文围绕一件幼年正模及其原始描述展开，不是种群层面的综述，也不提供直接的成体体型估计或无争议的系统发育位置；解读其形态时应同时注意标本与制备记录。

commonNameZh: 狭鼻猴干群萨达猴标本
overview: Holotype SGS-UM 2009-002 is a partial cranium combining crown-catarrhine features with no diagnostic ape or Old World monkey specialization in the published matrix.

ecology.diet: Diet inferred from preserved dentition; direct feeding evidence absent
ecology.habitat: Shumaysi depositional setting; habitual habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Not preserved by the partial cranium
ecology.bodySize: Known from a partial adult cranium; body mass is model dependent
ecology.guild: Dietary guild unresolved beyond dental inference

traits: Partial face, palate and dentition
Tubular ectotympanic
Matrix-defined stem-catarrhine character combination
evidenceSummary: The holotype and a 36-character matrix support a stem-catarrhine test, but the 29–28 Ma age is biochronological and does not directly date the crown split or identify an ancestor.

title.en: A partial cranium from western Arabia
title.zh: 来自阿拉伯西部的部分头骨

text.en: Saadanius is known from a partial adult cranium, holotype SGS-UM 2009-002, found in the middle Shumaysi Formation of western Saudi Arabia. The preserved face, palate, teeth and ear-region anatomy make this specimen a rare window into an Oligocene catarrhine-grade primate. Its discovery extended the known record of this part of the primate tree into a region with few comparable fossils.
text.zh: Saadanius 目前以一件成年个体的部分头骨为代表，正模编号 SGS-UM 2009-002，发现于沙特阿拉伯西部 Shumaysi 组中部。保存下来的面部、腭部、牙齿与耳区结构，为渐新世狭鼻猴类灵长动物提供了少见的观察窗口。它的发现把这支灵长类的已知记录扩展到同类化石较少的地区。

title.en: A character combination, not a miniature modern ape
title.zh: 特征组合，而非缩小版现代类人猿

text.en: The authors compared the cranium with living and fossil catarrhines using a character matrix. Saadanius combines features associated with catarrhines, including a tubular ectotympanic, without the diagnostic specializations used to identify crown apes or Old World monkeys. In that analysis it falls on the stem side of the catarrhine split, a placement that depends on the sampled characters and comparison set.
text.zh: 作者用特征矩阵将头骨与现生及化石狭鼻猴类比较。Saadanius 具有狭鼻猴类相关特征，包括管状骨性外耳道，但缺少用于识别现代类人猿或旧世界猴的诊断性特化。在该分析中，它位于狭鼻猴分化的干群一侧；这一位置取决于纳入分析的特征与比较对象。

title.en: A time window is not a dated split
title.zh: 年代窗口不是分化事件的测年

text.en: The paper places the fossil at roughly 29–28 million years ago using the formation’s biochronology. That age helps frame a possible interval for catarrhine evolution, but it is not a direct measurement of when apes and Old World monkeys diverged. A stem-group position also does not show that this individual or species was their direct ancestor.
text.zh: 论文根据地层生物年代学将化石置于约 2900 万至 2800 万年前。这个年代有助于讨论狭鼻猴类演化可能发生的时间范围，但不是对类人猿与旧世界猴分化时间的直接测量。干群位置也不能证明该个体或物种是这两支的直接祖先。

title.en: Zalmout et al. (2010). New Oligocene primate from Saudi Arabia and the divergence of apes and Old World monkeys.
title.zh: Zalmout 等（2010）：沙特阿拉伯新发现的渐新世灵长类与类人猿、旧世界猴的分化。

scope.en: Partial Shumaysi Formation cranium, the paper’s character matrix and biochronological placement.
scope.zh: Shumaysi 组部分头骨、论文中的特征矩阵及生物年代学定位。

readerLimitations.en: The account rests on one partial cranium and one published character analysis. Biochronological age is not a direct date for a divergence, and the proposed stem-catarrhine position does not establish direct ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文依据一件部分头骨和一项已发表的特征分析。生物年代学年龄不是分化事件的直接测年；提出的狭鼻猴干群位置也不能证明直接祖先关系。

overview: Separately catalogued Teilhardina dental samples from three correlated PETM sections document a short Asia-to-Europe-to-North-America appearance sequence, not one tracked population or an ancestor chain.

ecology.diet: Dental samples do not directly record diet
ecology.habitat: Section and carbon-isotope context, not habitual habitat
ecology.locomotion: Not preserved by the dental samples
ecology.bodySize: Body mass is not directly estimated from the reported sequence
ecology.guild: Ecological guild remains unresolved from these samples

traits: Separately catalogued dental samples
Dental comparisons across three PETM sections
No associated postcranial skeleton
evidenceSummary: Smith, Rose and Gingerich document the samples, section correlations and dental comparisons on pp. 11223–11227 (Figures 1–3 and Supporting Tables). Species assignments and correlation underpin the sequence, so it is not a direct record of migration, crown membership or a global first appearance.

title.en: Teeth from three distant regions
title.zh: 来自三个遥远地区的牙齿

text.en: The paper compares small Teilhardina dental samples from the Hengyang Basin in China, Dormaal in Belgium and the Bighorn Basin in Wyoming. The fossils come from separate sections rather than one migrating group. Their identification and the correlation of the rock layers are essential parts of the argument, so the geographic sequence is a reconstruction from several local records.
text.zh: 论文比较了来自中国衡阳盆地、比利时 Dormaal 和美国怀俄明州 Bighorn 盆地的少量 Teilhardina 牙齿化石。这些化石出自不同地层剖面，并非同一群体一路迁徙留下的记录。标本鉴定和地层对比都是论证的关键，因此地理序列是从多处地方性记录重建出来的。

title.en: A rapid appearance sequence around the PETM
title.zh: 古新世—始新世极热事件前后的快速出现序列

text.en: Smith, Rose and Gingerich compared the teeth and dated sections against the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum, a major global warming event near 56 million years ago. Their correlations place sampled Teilhardina records first in Asia, then Europe and North America over a short interval. The sequence documents where the sampled fossils occur in correlated strata; it does not follow a single population through time.
text.zh: Smith、Rose 与 Gingerich 将牙齿比较和地层年代与约 5600 万年前的古新世—始新世极热事件（一次全球显著升温事件）联系起来。其对比结果显示，所采样的 Teilhardina 化石在短时间窗内先见于亚洲，随后见于欧洲和北美。这个序列记录的是对比地层中的化石出现位置，并未追踪同一个种群随时间迁移。

title.en: Dispersal is an interpretation of the sequence
title.zh: 扩散是对序列的解释

text.en: The authors interpret the ordered records as evidence of rapid geographic dispersal, but the route is not a direct track of animals crossing continents. Species assignments, fossil sampling and age correlation all contribute uncertainty. These dental samples do not preserve locomotion, habitat use or a complete body, and their first sampled appearances should not be mistaken for a global origin date.
text.zh: 作者把有先后的化石记录解释为快速地理扩散的证据，但这条路线并不是动物跨越大陆的直接轨迹。物种鉴定、化石采样和年代对比都会带来不确定性。这些牙齿样本没有保存运动方式、栖地利用或完整身体；最早采样出现记录也不能当作全球起源日期。

title.en: Smith, Rose & Gingerich (2006). Rapid Asia–Europe–North America geographic dispersal of earliest Eocene primate Teilhardina during the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum.
title.zh: Smith、Rose 与 Gingerich（2006）：古新世—始新世极热事件期间最早始新世灵长类 Teilhardina 在亚洲—欧洲—北美的快速地理扩散。

scope.en: Dental samples from three correlated sections and the paper’s PETM age and dispersal interpretation.
scope.zh: 三个对比地层剖面的牙齿样本，以及论文的 PETM 年代与扩散解释。

readerLimitations.en: This is a guide to a small, section-based dental sample and its correlation model. It is not a continuous migration record, a complete species ecology, or a direct global first-occurrence date.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文介绍的是少量、按地层剖面分组的牙齿样本及其对比模型，不是连续迁徙记录、完整物种生态综述或全球首次出现的直接测年。

commonNameZh: 莫罗古猿姿势骨骼样本
overview: Separate shoulder and femoral specimens MUZM 60 and MUZM 80 from Moroto I and II provide a comparative test of early-Miocene hominoid locomotion; they are not an associated skeleton or demonstrated crown-ape ancestor.

ecology.diet: No direct dietary evidence from the two postcranial specimens
ecology.habitat: Moroto locality context; habitual habitat is not directly established
ecology.locomotion: Mixed arboreal repertoire inferred by comparative functional analysis
ecology.bodySize: Postcranial size estimates are comparative and specimen bounded
ecology.guild: Ecological guild remains unresolved beyond locomotor interpretation

traits: Shoulder morphology in the Moroto sample
Femoral morphology in the Moroto sample
Separate MUZM 60 and MUZM 80 specimens
evidenceSummary: MacLatchy and colleagues describe and compare MUZM 60 and MUZM 80 across pp. 159–183 (Figures 1–12; Tables 1–10). Their locality attribution, functional reconstruction and hominoid implications are distinct inference steps and do not establish observed behaviour or a direct ancestor.

title.en: Shoulder and thigh from separate finds
title.zh: 来自不同标本的肩部与大腿骨

text.en: The Moroto sample discussed in the paper is built from separate fossils: shoulder material MUZM 60 from Moroto I and a femur, MUZM 80, from Moroto II in Uganda. They were not found as one associated skeleton. The authors compare each bone with other primates and use the locality record to frame their interpretation, keeping specimen identity distinct from the broader species name Morotopithecus bishopi.
text.zh: 论文讨论的 Moroto 样本由不同化石组成：肩部材料 MUZM 60 来自 Moroto I，大腿骨 MUZM 80 来自乌干达 Moroto II。它们并非作为同一具关联骨架发现。作者分别把每件骨骼与其他灵长类比较，再结合地点记录进行解释；标本身份与较广义的 Morotopithecus bishopi 物种名称需要区分。

title.en: What the postcranial bones suggest
title.zh: 附肢骨骼提示了什么

text.en: The study uses shoulder and femoral form to test how Morotopithecus may have moved. Its comparative functional analysis supports a mixed arboreal repertoire rather than a simple label based on one bone. This is a reconstruction from preserved anatomy and comparison with living and fossil primates; no one observed the extinct animal moving, and the bones do not directly record its day-to-day behavior.
text.zh: 研究利用肩部与股骨形态，检验 Morotopithecus 可能采用的运动方式。比较功能分析支持其具有多样的树栖运动能力，而不是依据一块骨头贴上单一标签。这是从保存下来的解剖结构并与现生、化石灵长类比较所得的重建；没有人直接观察过这种已灭绝动物活动，这些骨骼也不直接记录其日常行为。

title.en: Function does not supply a family tree
title.zh: 功能解释不能单独给出谱系树

text.en: A locomotor interpretation answers a different question from phylogenetic placement. The two postcranial specimens do not form a complete skeleton, directly establish diet or habitat, or show that Morotopithecus was a direct ancestor of living apes. The paper’s conclusions should be read as a functional model for a bounded fossil sample, with missing anatomy left open.
text.zh: 运动方式解释与系统发育位置回答的是不同问题。这两件附肢骨骼既不构成完整骨架，也不能直接确定饮食或栖地，更不能证明 Morotopithecus 是现生类人猿的直接祖先。论文结论应理解为针对有限化石样本提出的功能模型；缺失的解剖信息仍未解决。

title.en: MacLatchy et al. (2000). Postcranial functional morphology of Morotopithecus bishopi, with implications for the evolution of modern ape locomotion.
title.zh: MacLatchy 等（2000）：Morotopithecus bishopi 的附肢功能形态及其对现代类人猿运动演化的启示。

scope.en: Comparative analysis of separate shoulder and femoral specimens from Moroto I and II; functional reconstruction is specimen bounded.
scope.zh: 比较 Moroto I、II 的分离肩部与股骨标本；功能重建受具体标本范围限制。

readerLimitations.en: This guide summarizes a functional study of two separate postcranial specimens. It is not a complete skeleton, observed behavior, species-wide ecological account, or demonstration of direct ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文概述的是基于两件分离附肢骨骼的功能研究，不是完整骨架、行为观察、物种层面的生态综述或直接祖先关系证明。

commonNameZh: 布里杰组北猴足部样本
overview: A semi-articulated Notharctus foot represented by AMNH 143612 and AMNH 143640 preserves ray-specific phalanges used to test the identity and function of a digit-two grooming claw; the specimen comparison is not a crown-primate or direct-ancestor claim.

ecology.diet: Diet is not directly recorded by the cited foot material
ecology.habitat: Bridger Formation provenance does not establish habitual microhabitat
ecology.locomotion: Foot proportions permit functional comparison, but locomotor behaviour was not observed
ecology.bodySize: The cited study does not establish a population-wide body-size estimate
ecology.guild: Ecological guild remains unresolved from the foot anatomy

traits: Semi-articulated AMNH 143612 and AMNH 143640 foot
Ray-specific proximal and intermediate phalanges
Digit-two grooming-claw functional inference
evidenceSummary: Maiolino and colleagues document the specimen association and phalangeal comparisons in e29135, Figures 3–10 and Table 2. The grooming-claw interpretation is a functional inference bounded to the named foot, not observed grooming behaviour or a universal primate condition.

title.en: A foot preserved across two museum numbers
title.zh: 分列两个馆藏编号的足部标本

text.en: The study examines a semi-articulated foot of Notharctus from Wyoming’s Bridger Formation, catalogued as AMNH 143612 and AMNH 143640. The bones preserve the positions of several toe elements well enough for the authors to compare individual rays. Treating them as a named, bounded foot sample matters: the paper is not describing every Notharctus foot or a complete skeleton.
text.zh: 研究考察了来自怀俄明州 Bridger 组的一只半连接 Notharctus 足部，馆藏编号为 AMNH 143612 和 AMNH 143640。部分趾骨位置保存得较好，作者因此能够比较不同趾列。把它视为有明确编号和边界的足部样本很重要：论文讨论的不是所有 Notharctus 足部，也不是完整骨架。

title.en: Which toe carried the grooming claw?
title.zh: 哪一趾可能具有梳理爪？

text.en: Comparisons of the proximal and middle phalanges led the authors to identify a digit-two grooming claw rather than the digit-one arrangement often assumed for adapiforms. The inference rests on ray-specific bone shape and joint relationships. It is a functional interpretation of preserved phalanges, not an observation of Notharctus grooming itself.
text.zh: 作者比较近节与中节指骨后，认为梳理爪位于第二趾，而非过去常对适应猴类假定的第一趾。这个判断依据不同趾列的骨形和关节关系。它是对保存指骨的功能解释，不是对 Notharctus 实际梳理行为的观察。

title.en: A functional clue, not a behavior record
title.zh: 功能线索，而不是行为记录

text.en: The proposed claw identity helps compare adapiform feet with other primates and evaluate competing evolutionary explanations. But the anatomy does not reveal how often the animal groomed, which social contexts it used, or whether the same condition characterized every individual. A single foot can test a functional hypothesis without settling broader behavior or ancestry.
text.zh: 提出的梳理爪位置有助于比较适应猴类与其他灵长类的足部，并评估不同演化解释。但解剖结构无法告诉我们动物多常梳理、在何种社交情境中梳理，也不能确定所有个体都具有相同状态。单只足部可以检验功能假说，却不能决定更广泛的行为或祖先关系。

title.en: Maiolino et al. (2012). Evidence for a Grooming Claw in a North American Adapiform Primate: Implications for Anthropoid Origins.
title.zh: Maiolino 等（2012）：北美适应猴类梳理爪的证据及其对拟人猿类起源的意义。

scope.en: Ray-specific comparisons of the named Notharctus foot material AMNH 143612/143640; functional interpretation, not observed grooming.
scope.zh: 针对具名 Notharctus 足部标本 AMNH 143612/143640 的分趾比较；结论属于功能解释，不是梳理行为观察。

readerLimitations.en: This is a guide to one semi-articulated foot sample and a proposed grooming-claw interpretation. It does not establish observed behavior, the frequency of grooming, population variation or a direct role in anthropoid ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文介绍一组半连接足部标本及其梳理爪解释，不证明实际行为、梳理频率、种群变异或其在拟人猿祖先关系中的直接作用。

commonNameZh: 中始新世曙猿孤立跗骨样本
overview: Isolated calcanei and tali from Shanghuang and Yuanqu were attributed to Eosimias and compared in a character matrix testing anthropoid affinity; they are not dentally associated skeletons, a direct ancestor, or a complete record of Eosimias anatomy.

ecology.diet: Diet is not directly recorded by the isolated tarsals
ecology.habitat: Fissure-fill and basin provenance do not establish habitual habitat
ecology.locomotion: Tarsal form supports comparative locomotor interpretation, not observed behaviour
ecology.bodySize: Body-size reconstruction from isolated tarsals remains comparative
ecology.guild: Ecological guild is unresolved from the sampled ankle bones

traits: Isolated calcanei and tali
Shanghuang and Yuanqu locality sample
Mosaic of tarsal characters used in an anthropoid-affinity test
evidenceSummary: Gebo and colleagues report the isolated tarsals and their sampled character comparisons on pp. 276–278, Figure 1 and Supplementary Tables 1–2. Attribution and stem-anthropoid placement are matrix-dependent inferences; the bones are not directly associated with the dental hypodigm.

title.en: An ankle assembled from scattered finds
title.zh: 由零散化石组成的踝部样本

text.en: Gebo and colleagues describe isolated calcanei and tali from fissure fillings at Shanghuang and from the Yuanqu Basin in China. The fossils are small pieces of the ankle rather than a foot preserved with teeth or a skull. Their attribution to Eosimias relies on comparisons with the taxon’s known anatomy, so the locality and specimen records should be kept visible when reading the conclusions.
text.zh: Gebo 等人描述了来自中国 Shanghuang 裂隙充填物和垣曲盆地的孤立跟骨与距骨。这些化石只是踝部的小块骨骼，并非与牙齿或头骨相连的整只足部。其归入 Eosimias 依赖与该类群已知解剖结构的比较，因此阅读结论时应同时保留地点和标本记录。

title.en: Testing early anthropoid anatomy
title.zh: 检验早期拟人猿类的解剖特征

text.en: The authors scored ankle characters in a comparative matrix to ask whether the fossils fit an early anthropoid pattern. The bones show a mixture of features rather than a simple checklist, and the resulting placement depends on which characters and fossil comparisons enter the analysis. The paper therefore offers a test of anthropoid affinity, not an uncontested label read directly from one bone.
text.zh: 作者把踝部特征录入比较矩阵，检验这些化石是否符合早期拟人猿类模式。骨骼呈现的是混合特征，而非一份简单的诊断清单；分类位置也取决于纳入分析的特征与化石比较对象。因此论文检验的是拟人猿亲缘假说，不是从单块骨头直接读出的无争议标签。

title.en: An ankle is not the whole animal
title.zh: 踝骨并不能代表整只动物

text.en: The studied tarsals are not dentally associated with the Eosimias fossils that define the genus, and they do not reveal a complete locomotor repertoire, diet or habitual habitat. Attribution and evolutionary position are separate inference steps. This small postcranial sample adds a useful anatomical test while leaving much of the animal’s body and ecology unknown.
text.zh: 这些跗骨并未与界定 Eosimias 属的牙齿化石直接关联，也不能揭示完整运动方式、饮食或惯常栖地。标本归属和演化位置是两个不同的推断步骤。这组小型附肢骨骼样本增加了一项有用的解剖检验，同时也让动物身体其他部分与生态的大多数信息仍然未知。

title.en: Gebo et al. (2000). The oldest known anthropoid postcranial fossils and the early evolution of higher primates.
title.zh: Gebo 等（2000）：已知最早的拟人猿类附肢化石与高等灵长类早期演化。

scope.en: Isolated Shanghuang and Yuanqu tarsals and their comparative character-matrix test; not a dentally associated skeleton.
scope.zh: Shanghuang 与垣曲孤立跗骨及其比较特征矩阵检验；没有与牙齿相连的骨架。

readerLimitations.en: This account is limited to isolated ankle bones and their comparative attribution. It is not a complete anatomical or ecological description of Eosimias, and the fossils do not directly establish a species-wide locomotor pattern or direct ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文限于孤立踝骨及其比较归属，不是 Eosimias 的完整解剖或生态描述；这些化石也不能直接确立物种层面的运动模式或直接祖先关系。

overview: COL26.8 usage 4C92G is the accepted species record for Pan troglodytes; the selected biological evidence is bounded to one wild community at Bossou.

ecology.diet: The selected study records feeding locations but does not provide a species-wide diet synthesis.
ecology.habitat: At Bossou, mature forest was the most selected habitat overall in the sampled wild community; this is a site-level result.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected habitat-use study.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed in the selected habitat-use study.
ecology.guild: Not established by the selected one-site habitat-use study.

evidenceSummary: A year of daily follows at Bossou sampled one local community, including 10 adult focal individuals. These observations do not establish species-wide habitat use or a current range-wide synthesis.

context.en: Continue with another featured primate introduction.
context.zh: 继续阅读另一篇精选灵长类物种介绍。

title.en: A range account with a date attached
title.zh: 有年代边界的分布记录

text.en: The 2016 IUCN assessment described a discontinuous range of more than 2.6 million km², from southern Senegal across the forest belt north of the Congo River to western Tanzania and western Uganda. It described four subspecies ranges. This is a dated assessment account, not a current range map.
text.zh: IUCN 2016 年评估记载，黑猩猩分布区不连续，面积超过 260 万平方公里，从塞内加尔南部沿刚果河以北的森林带延伸至坦桑尼亚西部和乌干达西部，并分别描述四个亚种的分布。这是一份有明确年代的评估记录，不是当前分布图。

title.en: What one forest-edge study found
title.zh: 一项森林边缘研究的发现

text.en: At Bossou, Guinea, researchers followed one wild western chimpanzee community for up to six hours a day from April 2012 to March 2013, including 10 adult focal individuals. Mature forest was the most selected habitat overall. Among feeding events in uncultivated habitat, records more than 200 m from fields exceeded chance expectations, while the 0–200 m bands fell below them. The authors suggested field-associated risks may shape feeding locations; this is a local result, not a species-wide habitat rule.
text.zh: 在几内亚 Bossou，研究者于 2012 年 4 月至 2013 年 3 月跟踪一个野生西部黑猩猩群体，每天至多观察 6 小时，焦点样本包括 10 只成年个体。总体上，成熟林是选择比例最高的栖地。在非耕地栖地记录的取食事件中，距耕地超过 200 米的次数高于随机预期，0–200 米范围内则低于预期。作者提出耕地相关风险可能影响取食地点；这是当地群体的结果，不是全物种的栖地规律。

title.en: A task-specific view of learning stick use
title.zh: 从特定任务观察棍棒使用

text.en: At Taï National Park in Côte d’Ivoire, a cross-sectional video study recorded 1,460 stick-use events from 70 wild western chimpanzees in three neighboring communities. In a model of grips used to insert sticks, the multi-digit grip became predominant at about 5.2 years, with a 98% predicted probability of use by age 15. Only three females from one community contributed observations above 45 years. The pattern describes this extractive-foraging task and sample; it is not a universal developmental curve or proof of a cognitive cause.
text.zh: 在科特迪瓦 Taï 国家公园，横断面视频研究记录了三个相邻野生西部黑猩猩群体中 70 只个体的 1,460 次棍棒使用事件。针对棍棒插入动作的握法模型估计，多指握法约在 5.2 岁成为主导，到 15 岁时预测使用概率为 98%。45 岁以上的观察仅来自一个群体的 3 只雌性。这一模式只描述所研究的取食任务与样本，不能当作普遍发育曲线，也不能证明认知成因。

title.en: Growing up and first births at Gombe
title.zh: 贡贝种群的成熟与首次生育

text.en: Long-term records at Gombe National Park in western Tanzania covered 36 known-age wild females. Their mean age at sexual maturity was 11.5 years; mean age at first birth was 14.9 years. First-birth estimates came from a smaller, censored subset in which non-dispersing females were overrepresented, so they may be biased low. These are estimates for one population, not fixed values for every chimpanzee.
text.zh: 坦桑尼亚西部贡贝国家公园的长期记录纳入 36 只已知年龄的野生雌性黑猩猩。其性成熟平均年龄为 11.5 岁，首次生育平均年龄为 14.9 岁。首次生育估计来自更小且包含删失记录的子样本，其中未迁出的雌性比例偏高，因此估计值可能偏低。这些是一个种群的估计，不是每只黑猩猩都遵循的固定数值。

title.en: Why captive body-mass comparisons need context
title.zh: 圈养体重比较需要什么背景

text.en: A study compared 298 chimpanzees in African sanctuaries, 1,030 in zoos and 442 in research facilities. After age adjustment, adult animals in zoos and research facilities had greater body mass than sanctuary animals in both sexes; estimated growth was slower in the sanctuary cohort. The groups included mixed or unknown subspecies and different care settings, so this comparison cannot stand in for wild morphology or a subspecies comparison.
text.zh: 一项研究比较了非洲救护中心的 298 只黑猩猩、动物园的 1,030 只和研究机构的 442 只。校正年龄后，动物园与研究机构的成年个体在雌雄中体重都高于救护中心个体；救护中心队列的估计生长速度较慢。各组包含不同或未知亚种，照护环境也不同，因此不能把该比较当作野生形态或亚种间差异。

title.en: A model of deep population history
title.zh: 关于深层种群史的模型

text.en: A whole-genome site-pattern study sampled four chimpanzee lineages—central, eastern, Nigeria–Cameroon and western—alongside bonobos. Its best-fitting model estimated gene flow from western into eastern chimpanzees and placed the shared ancestor of the four sampled chimpanzee lineages at about 987,000 years ago. These are model-based population-history estimates with competing histories discussed by the authors, not dates from fossils.
text.zh: 一项全基因组位点模式研究在倭黑猩猩之外，还采样了中部、东部、尼日利亚—喀麦隆和西部四个黑猩猩谱系。拟合最佳的模型估计西部向东部黑猩猩发生过基因流动，并将四个受采样黑猩猩谱系的共同祖先时间估为约 987,000 年前。这些是种群史模型估计，作者也讨论了其他可能历史；它们不是化石定年结果。

title.en: A regional conservation estimate, not a current census
title.zh: 区域保育模型不是当前普查

text.en: A spatial model estimated 128,760 weaned central chimpanzees in Western Equatorial Africa in 2013 (95% CI 114,208–317,039); it estimated that 80.7% of this subspecies in the modeled region was outside the protected-area network. The result concerns one subspecies and a historical model period. The IUCN assessment linked above is version 2016-2, with errata published in 2018; its Endangered category is not presented as a verified current status.
text.zh: 一项空间模型估算，2013 年西赤道非洲的中部黑猩猩亚种有 128,760 只已断奶个体（95% 置信区间：114,208–317,039）；模型还估计该区域内 80.7% 的这一亚种个体位于保护区网络之外。结果只针对一个亚种和历史模型时期。上文所引 IUCN 评估为 2016-2 版，2018 年发布勘误；其中的“濒危”类别并未被当作经核实的当前状态。

title.en: Humle et al. (2016). Pan troglodytes. The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species, version 2016-2.
title.zh: Humle 等（2016）：Pan troglodytes，《IUCN 受威胁物种红色名录》2016-2 版。

scope.en: Dated species-level assessment with a 2016 range account and status; errata were published in 2018. It is not verified here as the current Red List assessment.
scope.zh: 有年代的物种级评估，分布记述与状态来自 2016 版，2018 年发布勘误；此处未将其核实为当前红色名录评估。

title.en: Bryson-Morrison et al. (2017). Activity and habitat use at Bossou, Guinea.
title.zh: Bryson-Morrison 等（2017）：几内亚 Bossou 的活动与栖地利用研究。

scope.en: One wild P. t. verus community at Bossou, followed from April 2012 to March 2013; 10 adult focal individuals.
scope.zh: 2012 年 4 月至 2013 年 3 月在 Bossou 跟踪一个野生 P. t. verus 群体，焦点样本为 10 只成年个体。

title.en: Malherbe et al. (2024). Protracted development of stick tool use skills in wild western chimpanzees.
title.zh: Malherbe 等（2024）：野生西部黑猩猩棍棒工具使用技能的延长发育。

scope.en: Cross-sectional video study of three neighboring Taï communities, November 2013–April 2020; stick-based extractive-foraging tasks.
scope.zh: 2013 年 11 月至 2020 年 4 月对 Taï 三个相邻群体开展的横断面视频研究，观察棍棒取食任务。

title.en: Walker et al. (2018). Maturation is prolonged and variable in female chimpanzees.
title.zh: Walker 等（2018）：雌性黑猩猩的成熟期延长且存在差异。

scope.en: Long-term life-history records for known-age wild females at Gombe, western Tanzania; 36 females in the maturation analysis.
scope.zh: 坦桑尼亚西部贡贝的野生雌性长期生活史记录；成熟分析纳入 36 只已知年龄个体。

title.en: Curry et al. (2023). Body mass and growth rates in captive chimpanzees across care settings.
title.zh: Curry 等（2023）：不同照护环境下圈养黑猩猩的体重与生长速度。

scope.en: Comparison of sanctuary, zoo and research cohorts with mixed or unavailable subspecies; not a wild body-size estimate.
scope.zh: 比较救护中心、动物园与研究机构队列；亚种混合或未知，不是野生体型估计。

title.en: Brand et al. (2022). Estimating bonobo and chimpanzee evolutionary history from nucleotide site patterns.
title.zh: Brand 等（2022）：从核苷酸位点模式估计倭黑猩猩与黑猩猩的演化史。

scope.en: Whole-genome site-pattern analysis across the five extant Pan lineages; history and dates are model estimates.
scope.zh: 覆盖现生 Pan 五个谱系的全基因组位点模式分析；历史与年代均为模型估计。

title.en: Strindberg et al. (2018). Guns, germs, and trees determine density and distribution of gorillas and chimpanzees in Western Equatorial Africa.
title.zh: Strindberg 等（2018）：武器、病原与森林影响西赤道非洲大猩猩和黑猩猩的密度与分布。

scope.en: Historical 2013 model estimate for central chimpanzees in Western Equatorial Africa, not the whole species.
scope.zh: 对西赤道非洲中部黑猩猩亚种的 2013 年历史模型估计，不代表整个物种。

readerLimitations.en: This reader draft brings together selected studies, not a complete species review. The available sources do not provide a current range or conservation assessment, or a broad wild diet, locomotion and morphology synthesis. The scientific dossier remains incomplete.
readerLimitations.zh: 这篇读者初稿串联的是若干研究，不是完整物种综述。现有来源没有提供当前分布或保育评估，也不足以综合野外饮食、运动方式与形态。科学档案仍未完成。

geography: Buxa Tiger Reserve, West Bengal, India (one troop study site)
Cayo Santiago, Puerto Rico (managed free-ranging morphology study population)
overview: COL26.8 usage 3WWNQ is the accepted species record for Macaca mulatta. This reader brings together Chinese genetic samples and bounded studies in India and Cayo Santiago; none alone defines the species-wide ecology or population trend.

ecology.diet: At Buxa, fruit accounted for 70.8% of recorded diet in the study-defined May–September non-provisioning period and 28.8% in the October–April provisioning period for one 64-individual troop.
ecology.habitat: The selected Buxa troop home range included patches of natural forest, mixed-species plantations and residential settlements; this is one local study setting, not a full habitat account.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected studies.
ecology.bodySize: The Buxa ecology study did not estimate species-wide body size; see the separate Cayo Santiago morphology claim for its measured cohort.
ecology.guild: Not assessed in the selected studies.

traits: In one 2015 Cayo Santiago pedigree sample, most measured male morphometric traits were heritable under the study’s pooled models; this cohort result is not species-wide.
evidenceSummary: Selected evidence spans Chinese population genomics, one Buxa troop, managed Cayo Santiago cohorts and one NH-7 road segment. The 54 road deaths recorded in 2009–2010 are a local count, not a population mortality estimate or current conservation assessment.

title.en: One species, several study populations
title.zh: 同一物种，不同研究群体

text.en: The pinned COL26.8 checklist accepts Macaca mulatta. The studies brought together here sampled wild macaques in China and India, plus managed free-ranging groups at Cayo Santiago, Puerto Rico. These settings answer different questions and should not be combined into one range-wide ecological portrait.
text.zh: 固定版本 COL26.8 接受名为 Macaca mulatta。本文选取的研究分别采样了中国与印度的野生恒河猴，以及波多黎各圣地亚哥岛受管理的自由活动群体。这些地点回答的是不同问题，不能拼成一幅覆盖全分布区的生态画像。

title.en: Genetic lineages in Chinese samples
title.zh: 中国样本中的遗传谱系

text.en: A population-genomic study sampled 81 wild rhesus macaques at 17 sites across China, representing five subspecies. The analysis identified five genetic lineages and reported evidence of recent gene flow. These results describe the sampled Chinese populations and the study’s models, not a complete global species tree or range map.
text.zh: 一项群体基因组研究在中国 17 个地点采集了 81 只野生恒河猴，涵盖五个亚种。分析识别出五个遗传谱系，并报告近期基因流动的证据。结果限于受采样的中国种群及论文所用模型，不是完整的全球物种树或分布图。

title.en: Seasonal feeding at Buxa
title.zh: 布克萨群体的季节性取食

text.en: Researchers followed one 64-member troop near Buxa Tiger Reserve from October 2013 to September 2014. Fruit made up 70.8% of recorded diet during the study-defined May–September non-provisioning period and 28.8% during the October–April provisioning period. Mean daily travel was 4.72 km and 2.58 km respectively; the comparison does not separate every seasonal influence.
text.zh: 研究者于 2013 年 10 月至 2014 年 9 月跟踪了布克萨虎保护区附近一个 64 只群体。按该研究定义，5–9 月非投喂期的记录饮食中水果占 70.8%，10–4 月投喂期占 28.8%；两期平均日活动距离分别为 4.72 公里和 2.58 公里。这个比较不能排除所有季节因素。

title.en: What a Cayo Santiago pedigree measured
title.zh: 圣地亚哥岛谱系样本测量了什么

text.en: A 2015 Cayo Santiago sample measured 125 adult males and 21 female relatives. Under the study’s pooled pedigree models, several male traits—including body mass, crown–rump length and canine length—met the authors’ heritability criterion; testicular volume did not, and its estimate was imprecise. This managed population is not a morphology survey of macaques throughout their native range.
text.zh: 2015 年圣地亚哥岛样本测量了 125 只成年雄性和 21 只雌性亲属。在论文合并谱系模型中，体重、头臀长和犬齿长等若干雄性特征达到作者设定的遗传率标准；睾丸体积未达到，且估计区间较宽。这一受管理群体不能代表原生分布区的整体形态调查。

title.en: Mating-season records at Cayo Santiago
title.zh: 圣地亚哥岛的交配季记录

text.en: During the 2013 mating season, a study followed 21 high-ranking males aged 7–21 years across nine provisioned, semi-free-ranging groups. Older males were associated with fewer offspring recorded by the study. Paternity was sampled when offspring reached one year, so infants that died earlier were not assigned to sires; the result is not lifetime reproductive success.
text.zh: 一项研究在 2013 年交配季跟踪了来自九个补饲半自由活动群体的 21 只高等级雄性，年龄为 7–21 岁。研究记录中，年龄较大的雄性对应较少后代。亲子鉴定在幼体满一岁时进行，采样前死亡的幼体没有归属父亲，因此结果不是终生繁殖成功率。

title.en: Road deaths on one Indian highway
title.zh: 印度一段公路上的死亡记录

text.en: From August 2009 to July 2010, observers recorded 54 rhesus macaques killed along an 11-km section of National Highway 7 near Pench: 27 in summer, 19 in winter and eight in the monsoon. Associations with traffic and roadside feeding are local observations, not a population mortality rate or a current threat assessment.
text.zh: 2009 年 8 月至 2010 年 7 月，观察者在潘奇附近国家公路 7 号一段 11 公里路段记录到 54 只恒河猴死亡：夏季 27 只、冬季 19 只、季风期 8 只。与车流和路边投喂的关联是局地观察，不是种群死亡率或当前受威胁评估。

title.en: Catalogue of Life COL26.8, usage 3WWNQ
title.zh: Catalogue of Life COL26.8，usage 3WWNQ

scope.en: Pinned accepted-name record only; it does not substantiate the biological summaries.
scope.zh: 仅用于固定版本的接受名记录，不作为生物学概述的依据。

title.en: Liu et al. (2018), population genomics of wild Chinese rhesus macaques
title.zh: Liu 等（2018）：中国野生恒河猴群体基因组研究

scope.en: 81 wild macaques from 17 Chinese sites across five subspecies; lineage and gene-flow results are sample- and model-bounded.
scope.zh: 五个亚种的 81 只野生个体，来自中国 17 个地点；谱系与基因流结果限于该样本和模型。

title.en: Sengupta et al. (2015), provisioning and primate ecological functions
title.zh: Sengupta 等（2015）：投喂与灵长类生态功能

scope.en: One 64-member Buxa troop observed October 2013–September 2014; periods were classified by provisioning.
scope.zh: 2013 年 10 月至 2014 年 9 月观察布克萨一个 64 只群体；研究按是否投喂划分时期。

title.en: Kimock et al. (2019), male morphology at Cayo Santiago
title.zh: Kimock 等（2019）：圣地亚哥岛雄性形态测量

scope.en: A 2015 pedigree sample of managed free-ranging macaques, not wild-origin populations across the species range.
scope.zh: 2015 年受管理自由活动群体的谱系样本，不代表全分布区野生来源种群。

title.en: Sobral et al. (2024), ornamentation and reproductive output in high-ranking males
title.zh: Sobral 等（2024）：高等级雄性的装饰与繁殖结果

scope.en: 21 males in nine Cayo Santiago groups during the 2013 mating season; paternity sampling began at the yearling stage.
scope.zh: 2013 年交配季圣地亚哥岛九群体中的 21 只雄性；亲子鉴定从幼体一岁时开始。

title.en: Pragatheesh (2011), rhesus macaque road mortality on National Highway 7
title.zh: Pragatheesh（2011）：国家公路 7 号的恒河猴道路死亡

scope.en: An 11-km road segment near Pench monitored for one year; observed deaths are not a population rate.
scope.zh: 潘奇附近一段 11 公里道路的一年监测；观察到的死亡数不是种群死亡率。

context.en: Compare another Macaca species page.
context.zh: 对照另一篇猕猴属物种页。

context.en: Compare another Macaca species page.
context.zh: 对照另一篇猕猴属物种页。

readerLimitations.en: This bilingual reader draft combines selected studies, not a complete species review. It does not establish a current global range or conservation category, a wild species-wide diet and life-history synthesis, or population-wide mortality. The scientific dossier remains incomplete.
readerLimitations.zh: 这篇双语读者初稿汇集若干研究，不是完整物种综述。现有材料不能确定当前全球分布或保育类别，也未形成野外全物种饮食、生活史或种群整体死亡率综合。科学档案仍未完成。

geography: Lake Manyara National Park, Tanzania (wild road-transect study, 2011–2019)
Gombe National Park, Tanzania (wild reproductive records, 1972–2002)
CNRS Primatology Station, Rousset-sur-Arc, France (captive longitudinal cohort)
overview: COL26.8 accepted usage 6TM9B identifies Papio anubis. Selected studies describe captive growth, Gombe reproductive records, Lake Manyara survey methods and a small comparative genomic panel; these distinct samples do not form a species-wide synthesis.

ecology.diet: Not assessed in the selected core studies.
ecology.habitat: The Lake Manyara paper compares road-transect estimates with a sleeping-site-based upper limit; roads are a possible source of sampling bias, not a full habitat account.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected core studies.
ecology.bodySize: A seven-year captive cohort study measured segmental morphometrics from infancy to adulthood; its growth pattern is not a species-wide body-size estimate.
ecology.guild: Not assessed in the selected core studies.

traits: In one seven-year captive cohort, measured size and shape were similar at birth; later differences in growth rate and duration produced substantial size differences while measured body shape remained similar.
evidenceSummary: The selected profile links captive growth, Gombe reproductive records, a Lake Manyara survey-method comparison and a 12-individual Papio genomic panel. Global distribution, fossil record and formal conservation status remain unassessed; the dossier is incomplete.

title.en: A name is not a range assessment
title.zh: 分类名不是分布评估

text.en: The pinned COL26.8 checklist accepts Papio anubis. The studies selected here come from a captive research station in France, wild long-term records at Gombe and a survey-method study at Lake Manyara. They illuminate different parts of baboon biology but do not describe every population.
text.zh: 固定版本 COL26.8 接受名为 Papio anubis。本文选取的研究分别来自法国圈养研究站、贡贝的野生长期记录，以及曼雅拉湖的调查方法研究。它们照亮狒狒生物学的不同侧面，但不代表所有种群。

title.en: Growth from infancy in a captive cohort
title.zh: 圈养队列从幼年到成年的生长

text.en: A seven-year longitudinal study at the CNRS primatology station followed 14 females and 16 males from at least two months of age to adulthood. Measured size and shape were similar at birth; later differences in growth rate and duration produced substantial size differences while the measured body-shape pattern remained similar. This is a captive cohort, not a wild growth curve.
text.zh: 法国国家科学研究中心灵长类研究站的一项七年纵向研究，跟踪了 14 只雌性和 16 只雄性，从至少两月龄观察到成年。出生时测量的体型和形状相近；之后生长速度和持续时间不同，形成明显体型差异，而测量到的身体形状模式仍相近。这是圈养队列，不是野外生长曲线。

title.en: Miscarriage records at Gombe
title.zh: 贡贝的流产记录

text.en: Gombe records from 1972–2002 covered 732 pregnancies among 175 females of known rank; 65 pregnancies ended in miscarriage. The study found that rank-related patterns varied with rainfall and the immigration of males that rose rapidly to the highest rank. When mean rainfall over two years fell below about 1,100 mm, the rank-linked pattern largely disappeared. These observational associations are not a species-wide miscarriage rate or proof of cause.
text.zh: 贡贝 1972–2002 年记录涵盖 175 只已知等级雌性的 732 次妊娠，其中 65 次以流产告终。研究发现，等级相关模式会随降雨和快速升至最高等级的移入雄性而变化；当两年平均降雨低于约 1,100 毫米时，等级关联模式大体消失。这些观察性关联不是全物种流产率，也不能证明因果。

title.en: Why road surveys can overestimate density
title.zh: 为什么道路调查可能高估密度

text.en: At Lake Manyara, Tanzania, road-transect surveys from 2011–2019 produced density estimates more than three times an upper limit derived from sleeping-site counts and average group size. The authors pointed to baboons’ use of roads as a possible source of bias. This is a warning about one survey method at one site, not an estimate of the park’s total population or its trend.
text.zh: 坦桑尼亚曼雅拉湖 2011–2019 年道路样线调查得出的密度估计，超过根据夜宿点计数和平均群体大小推算上限的三倍。作者指出狒狒使用道路可能造成偏差。这是对一个地点一种调查方法的警示，不是公园总种群或其变化趋势的估计。

title.en: A 12-animal comparative genomic panel
title.zh: 由 12 只个体组成的比较基因组面板

text.en: A Papio phylogeny study sampled two animals from each of six extant baboon species, 12 individuals in total. Within that panel, the authors identified 4,645 Alu insertion sites as P. anubis indicator loci under their method. This result describes a comparative sample and a particular marker system; it does not summarize genetic variation within the species or settle its complete evolutionary history.
text.zh: 一项 Papio 系统发育研究按其设计为六个现生狒狒种各采样两只，共 12 只个体。在这一面板中，作者按其方法将 4,645 个 Alu 插入位点识别为 P. anubis 指示位点。结果描述的是特定比较样本和标记系统，不能概括该物种内部的遗传变异，也不能定论其完整演化史。

title.en: What remains outside these studies
title.zh: 这些研究尚未覆盖什么

text.en: The selected sources do not establish the species’ current distribution, formal conservation status, a wild species-wide diet or locomotion synthesis, or a complete fossil and evolutionary history. The dossier remains incomplete.
text.zh: 所选来源没有确定该物种的当前分布、正式保育状态、野外全物种饮食或运动方式综合，也没有提供完整化石记录和演化史。科学档案仍未完成。

readerLimitations.en: This bilingual reader draft connects selected captive, wild and comparative-genomic studies; it is not a complete species review. Current distribution, formal conservation status, a broad wild ecology synthesis and complete evolutionary history remain unassessed. The scientific dossier is incomplete.
readerLimitations.zh: 这篇双语读者初稿串联若干圈养、野外和比较基因组研究，不是完整物种综述。当前分布、正式保育状态、野外生态综合和完整演化史仍未评估。科学档案尚未完成。

geography: Mysore-connected roadside transects, Karnataka, India (comparative counts, 2003 and 2015; study site)
Parambikulam landscape, Kerala, India (one forest occupancy survey)
Southern Indian temple/tourist locations (historical site-status comparison)
Southern India (82 fecal-derived host mtDNA D-loop sequences from 16 sampled locations; collected 2014–15; study sampling frame, not a range boundary)
overview: COL26.8 accepted usage 3WWP2 identifies Macaca radiata. Local forest, roadside and temple-site records from southern India, together with one cross-species museum comparison, describe selected questions rather than a current range or species-wide population trend. The 2018 host mtDNA D-loop analysis provides a separate sample-bounded evolutionary result.

ecology.diet: Not assessed in the selected study.
ecology.habitat: At Parambikulam, 54 groups were detected in 33 of 64 grid cells and modelled mean occupancy was 0.51 ± 0.08 (SE); this is one forest survey, not a complete habitat account.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected study.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed in the selected study.
ecology.guild: Not assessed as a broader species-level ecological guild.

evidenceSummary: Selected evidence includes a 2017 southern India survey and one 2018 interspecific craniodental comparison with 79 bonnet-macaque specimens. The latter does not establish within-species diagnostic variation; life history, species-range limits and current formal conservation status remain unassessed, and this profile. A separate 2018 study analyzed 82 fecal-derived mitochondrial D-loop sequences from 16 southern Indian locations; it does not establish nuclear or genome-wide structure or a human-translocation cause.

title.en: Local records, not a range-wide census
title.zh: 地方记录不是全分布区普查

text.en: The COL26.8 checklist accepts Macaca radiata. The evidence summarized here comes from selected southern Indian forests, roads and human-use sites, plus museum specimens used in a comparison across macaque species. It does not provide a current map or a complete population trend.
text.zh: COL26.8 接受名为 Macaca radiata。本文概述的证据来自印度南部若干森林、道路和人类活动地点，另有用于猕猴属种间比较的博物馆标本。这些材料没有给出当前分布图或完整种群趋势。

title.en: A forest occupancy estimate at Parambikulam
title.zh: Parambikulam 的森林占域估计

text.en: In one survey of the Parambikulam landscape in Kerala, observers detected 54 groups in 33 of 64 grid cells. The fitted mean cell-occupancy estimate was 0.51 ± 0.08 (SE), with detection probability 0.25 ± 0.05. These estimates belong to that forest survey and its sampling design.
text.zh: 喀拉拉邦 Parambikulam 景观的一次调查中，研究者在 64 个网格中的 33 个记录到 54 个群体。模型估计平均网格占域率为 0.51 ± 0.08（标准误），检测概率为 0.25 ± 0.05。这些估计只适用于该次森林调查及其抽样设计。

title.en: Roadside counts connected to Mysore
title.zh: 连接迈索尔的路边计数

text.en: The study’s roadside counts fell from 889 in 2003 to 407 in 2015 on roads connected to Mysore. The 2015 resurvey covered 464 km and used a 15-m strip on each side of the road centreline. A roadside count measures animals visible within a defined survey band; the change is not a census of the species across southern India.
text.zh: 该研究在连接迈索尔的道路上记录的路边数量，从 2003 年的 889 只降至 2015 年的 407 只。2015 年复查覆盖 464 公里，调查带为道路中心线两侧各 15 米。路边计数反映的是规定调查带内可见的个体变化，不是对印度南部全物种的普查。

title.en: Temple and tourist-site histories
title.zh: 寺庙与旅游地点的历史记录

text.en: The same paper compared selected southern Indian temple and tourist locations over historical records and follow-up surveys from 2009–2015. About 31% of assessed locations recorded bonnet macaques; among reported translocation cases, roughly one fifth were followed by reappearance, while more than 48% were recorded as disappearance or removal. These site histories do not describe present-day occupancy across the full range.
text.zh: 同一论文比较了印度南部部分寺庙和旅游地点的历史记录及 2009–2015 年复查。约 31% 的受评地点记录到冠猕猴；在报告的迁移案例中，约五分之一随后有重新出现记录，超过 48% 被记录为消失或清除。这些地点史不能代表当前全分布区的占域情况。

title.en: Bonnet macaques in a museum comparison
title.zh: 种间博物馆比较中的冠猕猴标本

text.en: A 2018 comparison covered 711 museum specimens from 12 macaque species, including 79 M. radiata specimens (46 male and 33 female) attributed to southern and western India; subadults were also included. The paper reported a weak interspecific latitudinal pattern. Its mixed specimen origins and cross-species design do not establish diagnostic traits or variation within bonnet macaques.
text.zh: 一项 2018 年比较研究纳入 12 种猕猴的 711 件博物馆标本，其中 79 件冠猕猴标本（雄性 46 件、雌性 33 件）标注来自印度南部和西部，也包括亚成体。论文报告了较弱的种间纬度模式。标本来源不一且研究设计针对种间比较，不能据此确定冠猕猴的诊断性状或种内变异。

title.en: What these studies leave open
title.zh: 这些研究仍未回答什么

text.en: The selected sources do not synthesize the species’ life history, diet, locomotion, full distribution or current formal conservation category. A local recommendation in the 2017 article is not a statutory designation or an independently verified current status.
text.zh: 所选来源尚未综合该物种的生活史、饮食、运动方式、完整分布或当前正式保育类别。2017 年论文提出的地方性建议不是法定指定，也不是独立核实的当前状态。

title.en: Catalogue of Life COL26.8, usage 3WWP2
title.zh: Catalogue of Life COL26.8，usage 3WWP2

scope.en: Pinned accepted-name record only; not evidence for current distribution or status.
scope.zh: 仅为固定版本接受名记录，不作为当前分布或保育状态的证据。

title.en: Erinjery et al. (2017), roadside, forest and human-use sites in southern India
title.zh: Erinjery 等（2017）：印度南部道路、森林与人类活动地点

scope.en: Bounded local surveys and historical site comparisons; not a species-wide current census.
scope.zh: 范围有限的地方调查与历史地点比较，不是全物种当前普查。

title.en: Grunstra et al. (2018), macaque craniodental variation
title.zh: Grunstra 等（2018）：猕猴属颅齿变异比较

scope.en: Interspecific comparison of 711 museum specimens across 12 species; 79 were M. radiata.
scope.zh: 12 种猕猴 711 件博物馆标本的种间比较；其中 79 件为 M. radiata。
