readerLimitations.en: This bilingual reader draft summarizes selected local surveys and one interspecific museum comparison; it is not a complete species review. Current range-wide population trend, life history, species-level ecology and formal conservation status remain unresolved here. The dossier is incomplete.
readerLimitations.zh: 这篇双语读者初稿概述若干地方调查和一项种间博物馆比较，不是完整物种综述。当前全分布区种群趋势、生活史、物种层面生态和正式保育状态仍未在此解决。科学档案尚未完成。

geography: Western Ghats, Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu, India (15 named sampling sites, 2010–2012; wild fecal samples)
Puthuthottam forest fragment, Valparai plateau, Tamil Nadu, India (one troop; February–May 2016 study site)
overview: COL26.8 accepted species usage 3WWP6 identifies Macaca silenus (Linnaeus, 1758).

ecology.diet: At Puthuthottam, the studied troop consumed plant parts from 19 plant species and other non-plant foods; plant feeding was greater in the forest interior than at the forest edge, while invertebrate feeding was greater in the open patch than in the interior. This is a single-troop dry-season result.
ecology.habitat: During over 480 follow-hours in one habituated troop, active foraging was higher in the open forest patch and forest edge, and lower in the human settlement than in the forest interior; the activity budget differed between interior and settlement. One troop was observed from February to May 2016.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected studies.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed in the selected studies.
ecology.guild: Not assessed as a broader species-level ecological guild.

evidenceSummary: The ecological observations come from one habituated troop during the 2016 dry season; genetic sampling and a separate four-group preprint have different scopes. Together these sources remain incomplete and do not provide a range-wide or annual ecological synthesis.

title.en: Sampling across the Western Ghats
title.zh: 西高止山脉的采样记录

text.en: The COL26.8 checklist accepts Macaca silenus. A 2010–2012 genetic study collected wild fecal samples at 15 sites in Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu; it also analyzed separately identified captive blood samples. These records document sampled places, not the complete present-day range.
text.zh: COL26.8 接受名为 Macaca silenus。一项 2010–2012 年遗传研究在卡纳塔克邦、喀拉拉邦和泰米尔纳德邦的 15 个地点采集野生粪便样本，另有单独标注的圈养血液样本。地点记录描述的是采样范围，不是完整的当前分布区。

title.en: Activity in a forest-fragment matrix
title.zh: 森林碎片景观中的活动

text.en: From February to May 2016, researchers logged more than 480 follow-hours for one habituated group at Puthuthottam, Tamil Nadu, across forest interior, edge, an open patch and a human settlement. Active foraging was higher in the open patch and at the edge, and lower in the settlement than in the interior. This is one group in one dry-season study.
text.zh: 2016 年 2–5 月，研究者在泰米尔纳德邦 Puthuthottam 跟踪一个习惯化群体，累计超过 480 小时，观察地点包括森林内部、边缘、开阔斑块和人类聚居地。开阔斑块和林缘的主动觅食较多；聚居地低于森林内部。这是一项单群体、旱季研究。

title.en: Foods recorded in the same troop
title.zh: 同一群体记录到的食物

text.en: The Puthuthottam troop ate parts from 19 plant species as well as non-plant foods. In the study’s habitat comparisons, invertebrate feeding was more frequent in the open patch than in forest interior, while plant feeding was greater in the interior than at the edge. These observations should not be read as a complete species diet.
text.zh: Puthuthottam 群体取食了 19 种植物的不同部分，也摄食非植物食物。按该研究的栖地比较，无脊椎动物取食在开阔斑块多于森林内部；植物取食在森林内部多于林缘。这些观察不能当作全物种的完整食谱。

title.en: A four-group seed-dispersal preprint
title.zh: 四个群体的种子传播预印本

text.en: A 2024 bioRxiv version-one preprint reports 375.9 hours of focal observations across four groups in a 92-ha Puduthottam fragment. Subadults consumed a greater variety of native and non-native fruits than adult males or females, and dispersed fewer Ficus seeds than adult females. The sampling year was not reported; this result has not been certified by peer review.
text.zh: 一篇 2024 年 bioRxiv 第一版预印本报告，在 Puduthottam 一处 92 公顷森林碎片中，对四个群体开展了 375.9 小时焦点观察。亚成体取食的本地与非本地水果种类多于成年雄性或雌性，传播的 Ficus 种子少于成年雌性。论文未报告采样年份；结果尚未经同行评审。

title.en: Mitochondrial lineages around the Palghat Gap
title.zh: Palghat 缺口两侧的线粒体谱系

text.en: The Western Ghats study distinguished sampled lineages north and south of the Palghat Gap. A fossil-calibrated model using 893 mitochondrial bases estimated a mean most-recent common ancestor at 2.11 million years. That model is not a nuclear-genome species tree or a direct fossil date for the origin of M. silenus.
text.zh: 西高止山脉研究区分了 Palghat 缺口南北受采样的线粒体谱系。一个以 893 个线粒体碱基为基础、经化石校准的模型，将最近共同祖先时间均值估为 211 万年前。这不是核基因组物种树，也不是 M. silenus 起源的直接化石年代。

title.en: Genetic diversity in forest fragments
title.zh: 森林碎片中的遗传多样性

text.en: A separate comparison of HVR-I mitochondrial samples from eight Anamalai forest fragments found lower diversity than in nearby continuous-forest samples. This comparison describes those samples and markers; it does not directly measure current population viability or predict extinction risk.
text.zh: 另一项研究比较了阿纳马莱八个森林碎片的 HVR-I 线粒体样本，发现其多样性低于邻近连续森林样本。该比较描述的是这些样本和标记，不能直接测量当前种群存续能力或预测灭绝风险。

title.en: What remains to be assessed
title.zh: 仍待评估的内容

text.en: The selected studies do not synthesize body size, life history, a complete range, annual ecology or current formal conservation status. The ecological findings come from one group and season; the seed-dispersal result remains a preprint. The scientific dossier is incomplete.
text.zh: 所选研究尚未综合体型、生活史、完整分布区、全年生态或当前正式保育状态。生态发现来自一个群体和一个季节；种子传播结果仍为预印本。科学档案尚未完成。

title.en: Catalogue of Life COL26.8, usage 3WWP6
title.zh: Catalogue of Life COL26.8，usage 3WWP6

scope.en: Pinned accepted-name record only; not evidence for a complete range or conservation status.
scope.zh: 仅为固定版本接受名记录，不作为完整分布或保育状态的证据。

title.en: Ram et al. (2015), genetic structure of lion-tailed macaques in the Western Ghats
title.zh: Ram 等（2015）：西高止山脉狮尾猕猴遗传结构

scope.en: Wild fecal samples from 15 named sites during 2010–2012 plus separately identified captive samples; mitochondrial analyses are marker-bounded.
scope.zh: 2010–2012 年 15 个具名地点的野生粪便样本，另含单独标注的圈养样本；线粒体分析受标记范围限制。

title.en: Dhawale et al. (2020), habitat and behaviour at Puthuthottam
title.zh: Dhawale 等（2020）：Puthuthottam 的栖地与行为

scope.en: One habituated troop followed February–May 2016 across a local habitat matrix; not an annual or species-wide study.
scope.zh: 2016 年 2–5 月跟踪一个习惯化群体，调查当地栖地组合；不是全年或全物种研究。

title.en: Bindu et al. (2024), seed dispersal by age and sex (bioRxiv v1 preprint)
title.zh: Bindu 等（2024）：年龄、性别与种子传播（bioRxiv v1 预印本）

scope.zh: 一处 92 公顷森林碎片内的四个群体；未报告采样年份；第一版尚未经同行评审。

geography: Brazil: northeastern coastal and inland records described by the selected study as native; southern records in São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais described as introductions. Presence-only study compilation, not exhaustive range limits.
overview: COL26.8 accepted usage 697NS identifies Callithrix jacchus (Linnaeus, 1758). Selected evidence covers one captive-colony offspring study, Brazilian passive rabies surveillance and sampled mitochondrial lineages; this is not a complete species review.

ecology.diet: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.
ecology.habitat: The selected studies do not establish a species-wide habitat profile. Observed localities and modeled habitat suitability in the rabies study are distinct evidence.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.
ecology.guild: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.

evidenceSummary: The core profile links a captive-colony association between paternal responsiveness and infant outcomes, Brazilian passive rabies reports, and a model-based mitochondrial-lineage estimate. These sources do not establish wild life history, species-wide ecology, complete distribution, a nuclear-genome divergence date or formal conservation status.

title.en: A coat pattern described from adult samples
title.zh: 来自成体样本的毛色描述

text.en: A Brazilian study sampled 30 adult C. jacchus among 209 adult Callithrix specimens collected from mixed wild and captive sources during 2015–2019. It described grey-tipped crown hairs, a grey chin, white ear tufts and a prominent forehead star, with dark or grey dorsal bands over orange underfur. In the sampled adult comparison, mean values for 13 measured traits did not differ significantly from C. penicillata. These are comparative sample descriptions, not a stand-alone field diagnosis; hybrids may show overlapping pelage.
text.zh: 一项巴西研究在 2015–2019 年采集的 209 只成年柽柳猴中纳入 30 只普通狨，样本来源混有野生与圈养个体。论文描述其额顶部前半部毛尖多为灰色、颏部灰色、耳周有蓬松白色耳簇、额头有明显白色星斑，背部黑色或灰白色上毛覆盖橙色底毛。在该成体比较样本中，13 项测量的均值与黑耳狨（C. penicillata）没有显著差异。这些是样本中的比较性描述，不是单独的野外确诊标准；杂交个体的毛色可能重叠。

title.en: Native and introduced records in Brazil
title.zh: 巴西的原生与引入记录

text.en: The study’s occurrence-only compilation treated coastal and inland records in northeastern Brazil as native, and records in São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais as introductions. Observed locations, modeled habitat suitability and a complete range are different kinds of evidence. The compiled records do not set exhaustive range limits or prove absence elsewhere.
text.zh: 该研究仅含出现记录的资料汇编，将巴西东北部沿海与内陆记录列为原生区域，将圣保罗、巴拉那、里约热内卢和米纳斯吉拉斯的记录列为引入区域。实际出现地点、模型预测的栖地适宜性和完整分布范围是不同类型的证据；这份汇编不能确定完整边界，也不能证明其他地区没有分布。

title.en: A captive study of fathers and infant outcomes
title.zh: 圈养研究中的父亲照料与幼体结果

text.en: At one Wisconsin research colony, 24 experienced fathers and 62 offspring were included in a study of responses to infant distress calls. Offspring of fathers classified as responsive had higher survival beyond one month (p = 0.002); the paper also reported group weight differences at weeks 28 and 30. This is an association from one captive-colony study, not a wild survival estimate or proof that the response caused the outcome.
text.zh: 威斯康星一处研究圈养群体中，研究纳入 24 位有育幼经验的父亲及 62 只幼体，比较父亲对幼体求救叫声的反应。被归为会回应的父亲，其幼体超过一个月后的存活率较高（p = 0.002）；论文还报告第 28 和 30 周两组体重有差异。这是单一圈养群体中的关联，不是野外存活率估计，也不能证明父亲的反应造成了该结果。

title.en: What Brazilian rabies surveillance can show
title.zh: 巴西狂犬病监测能说明什么

text.en: Brazilian Ministry of Health passive surveillance recorded 67 rabies outbreaks affecting common marmosets, with 91 cases across 41 municipalities from January 2008 through October 2020. The study reported spillover of a Desmodus rotundus antigenic variant to C. jacchus in northern and southern reporting areas. These records describe reported outbreaks and an identified pathogen interaction; they do not measure disease prevalence throughout the species’ range.
text.zh: 巴西卫生部被动监测资料记录，2008 年 1 月至 2020 年 10 月，41 个市镇报告了影响普通狨的 67 起狂犬病疫情，共 91 例。研究还报告在北部和南部报告区域出现了吸血蝠（Desmodus rotundus）抗原变异株向普通狨的溢出。这些记录说明的是报告疫情和已识别的病原相互作用，不是该物种全分布区的患病率测量。

title.en: A conservation question involving introduced relatives
title.zh: 引入近缘种带来的保育问题

text.en: In a sample of 18 free-living marmosets with putative hybrid appearance from four southeastern Brazilian localities, five carried a C. jacchus maternal COX2 haplotype. The study discusses hybridization between native threatened C. aurita and introduced congeners, including the common marmoset, as a conservation concern. The sample does not estimate hybridization frequency in C. jacchus, measure population effects or establish the common marmoset’s conservation status.
text.zh: 一项研究在巴西东南部四个地点采集的 18 只自由活动、外形疑似杂交的绒猴中，检出 5 只带有普通狨母系 COX2 单倍型。论文将原生受威胁种 C. aurita 与包括普通狨在内的引入近缘种之间的杂交列为保育关注。该样本没有估计普通狨种群中的杂交频率或种群影响，也不能确定普通狨自身的保育状态。

title.en: A mitochondrial lineage estimate, not a species origin date
title.zh: 线粒体谱系估计不是物种起源日期

text.en: A study combining 49 newly sequenced Callithrix mitogenomes with published sequences estimated that sampled C. jacchus and the Caatinga lineage of C. penicillata were sister lineages that diverged about 0.51 million years ago. The estimate depends on the sampled mitochondrial lineages and model. It is not a nuclear-genome species tree or a definitive date for the origin of C. jacchus.
text.zh: 一项研究将 49 个新测序的柽柳猴属线粒体基因组与已发表序列合并，估计该研究采样的普通狨与黑耳狨卡廷加支系互为姐妹谱系，约在 51 万年前分化。这个估计受线粒体谱系采样和模型限制，不是核基因组物种树，也不是普通狨确定的起源日期。

title.en: Malukiewicz et al. (2024). Pelage variation and morphometrics of closely related Callithrix marmoset species and their hybrids.
title.zh: Malukiewicz 等（2024）：近缘柽柳猴属物种及其杂交个体的毛色变异与形态测量。

scope.en: Adult phenotyping and morphometric comparison from mixed wild and captive sources in Brazil during 2015–2019; not a complete life-stage morphology review.
scope.zh: 2015–2019 年巴西野生与圈养混合来源的成体表型和形态测量比较，不是完整的全生活史形态综述。

title.en: Benavides et al. (2022). Spatio-temporal dynamics of rabies and habitat suitability of the common marmoset in Brazil.
title.zh: Benavides 等（2022）：巴西普通狨狂犬病时空动态与栖地适宜性。

scope.en: Brazilian passive surveillance from 2008–2020 plus occurrence records and a habitat-suitability model; reported cases and predictions are distinct.
scope.zh: 巴西 2008–2020 年被动监测、出现记录及栖地适宜性模型；报告病例与模型预测分开解释。

title.en: Ziegler, Sosa & Colman (2017). Fathering style influences health outcome in common marmoset offspring.
title.zh: Ziegler、Sosa 与 Colman（2017）：父亲照料方式与普通狨幼体健康结果。

scope.en: One captive Wisconsin research colony; the analyzed design does not estimate wild behavior or survival.
scope.zh: 威斯康星一处圈养研究群体；该研究设计不估计野外行为或存活率。

title.en: Nogueira et al. (2022). Uniparental genetic markers to investigate hybridization in wild-born marmosets.
title.zh: Nogueira 等（2022）：用单亲遗传标记研究野生出生绒猴的杂交。

scope.en: Eighteen free-living putative hybrids from four southeastern Brazilian localities during 2004–2013; five carried the C. jacchus maternal haplotype.
scope.zh: 2004–2013 年巴西东南部四地的 18 只自由活动疑似杂交个体；其中 5 只带有普通狨母系单倍型。

title.en: Malukiewicz et al. (2021). Mitogenomic phylogeny of Callithrix with special focus on human transferred taxa.
title.zh: Malukiewicz 等（2021）：重点讨论人为转移类群的柽柳猴属线粒体基因组系统发育。

scope.en: Mitochondrial lineage and divergence-time analysis of sampled Callithrix; not a nuclear-genome species tree.
scope.zh: 对采样的柽柳猴属线粒体谱系与分化时间进行分析，不是核基因组物种树。

readerLimitations.en: This bilingual reader draft summarizes selected source-backed topics rather than a complete species review. The current evidence does not provide a wild diet, habitat-use, locomotion, body-size or lifespan synthesis, nor a current conservation assessment or population trend. The scientific dossier remains incomplete.
readerLimitations.zh: 这篇双语读者初稿概述的是有来源支持的若干主题，不是完整物种综述。当前材料不足以综合野外饮食、栖地利用、运动方式、体型或寿命，也没有当前保育评估或种群趋势。科学档案仍未完成。

geography: Archaeological sample sites south of the Limpopo River across central and southern South Africa; 28 sampled individuals date to 10,200–150 calibrated years before present.
Tam Pà Ling cave, northern Laos; TPL 6 and TPL 7 are associated with sediment-age models, not direct fossil dates.
Ilsenhöhle at Ranis, Germany; a cave diet study analyzed 10 human remains alongside 52 animal remains.
Ust’-Ishim, western Siberia; one directly dated femur and its genome do not delimit the species range.
overview: COL26.8 accepted species usage 6MB3T identifies Homo sapiens (Linnaeus, 1758). This reader connects selected ancient human fossils, isotope evidence and genomic samples from several sites; it is not a complete species or migration history.

ecology.diet: At Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, collagen isotopes from 10 human remains, interpreted with 52 animal remains, indicated a large-terrestrial-mammal diet in a cold steppe–tundra setting. This single cave sample does not describe Homo sapiens generally.
ecology.habitat: The selected genomic study does not establish a species-wide habitat profile.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.
ecology.guild: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.

evidenceSummary: Selected ancient evidence includes two Tam Pà Ling fossils, a Ranis isotope sample, Ust’-Ishim 1 and a 28-person southern African genomic study. Their dates and sample designs differ; together they do not form a complete modern range, origin date or migration history.

title.en: A species page built from selected ancient samples
title.zh: 从若干古代样本组织的物种页

text.en: The COL26.8 checklist accepts Homo sapiens. The studies below examine particular fossils, archaeological contexts and population-genomic samples. They address different questions and cannot be combined into a single complete account of human origins, present-day diversity or migration.
text.zh: COL26.8 接受名为 Homo sapiens。下列研究考察特定化石、考古环境和群体基因组样本，各自回答不同问题，不能拼成一套完整的人类起源、当代多样性或迁徙叙事。

title.en: Two fossils at Tam Pà Ling
title.zh: Tam Pà Ling 的两件化石

text.en: At Tam Pà Ling cave in northern Laos, TPL 6 is a left frontal-bone fragment and TPL 7 a proximal left tibia, both attributed to H. sapiens by the study. Sediment models gave ages of 70 ± 3 ka for TPL 6 and as old as 77 ± 9 ka for TPL 7; these are contextual sediment estimates, not direct fossil dates. The authors note that TPL 7 may be older than the model’s oldest estimate, and taphonomic alteration limits its measurement.
text.zh: 老挝北部 Tam Pà Ling 洞穴的 TPL 6 是左额骨碎片，TPL 7 是左侧胫骨近端，论文将两者归为 H. sapiens。沉积年代模型给出 TPL 6 为 70 ± 3 千年、TPL 7 最早可达 77 ± 9 千年；这是周边沉积物的背景估计，不是化石直接测年。作者指出 TPL 7 可能早于模型最老估计，埋藏改造也限制了其骨骼测量。

title.en: Diet evidence from one cave at Ranis
title.zh: Ranis 一处洞穴提供的饮食证据

text.en: At Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, Germany, researchers analyzed collagen isotopes from 10 human remains with 52 animal remains from the same archaeological setting. The signal points to a diet dominated by large terrestrial mammals in a cold steppe–tundra environment. Layer dates are about 47,500–45,770 and 46,820–43,260 calibrated years before present; they are not direct dates for each human bone. One cave sample cannot define human diets generally.
text.zh: 德国 Ranis 的 Ilsenhöhle 洞穴中，研究者分析了 10 份人类遗骸的胶原同位素，并结合相同考古环境的 52 份动物遗骸。信号指向寒冷草原—苔原环境中以大型陆生哺乳动物为主的饮食。相关地层年代约为距今 47,500–45,770 年和 46,820–43,260 年（校正值），不是每块人骨的直接年代。一处洞穴样本不能定义一般人类饮食。

title.en: Ancient genomes south of the Limpopo
title.zh: 林波波河以南的古基因组

text.en: A whole-genome study analyzed 28 individuals from archaeological sites south of the Limpopo River in central and southern Africa, dated from 10,200 to 150 calibrated years before present. In the study’s comparison panel, samples older than 1,400 years fell outside the range of genetic variation represented by its modern-human samples and carried many variants the authors classified as H. sapiens-specific. This result depends on the sampled individuals, comparison panel and variant definitions.
text.zh: 一项全基因组研究分析了林波波河以南中部和南部非洲考古地点的 28 名个体，年代为距今 10,200 至 150 年（校正值）。在该研究的比较面板中，早于 1,400 年的样本落在其现代人样本所代表遗传变异范围之外，并带有许多作者归类为 H. sapiens 特异的变异。结果取决于受采样个体、比较面板和变异定义。

title.en: The directly dated Ust’-Ishim individual
title.zh: 直接测年的 Ust’-Ishim 个体

text.en: The Ust’-Ishim 1 femur from western Siberia was directly radiocarbon dated to 46,880–43,210 calibrated years before present at 95.4% probability. Its genome belongs to this one dated individual. The result is not a date for the origin of H. sapiens or a first-and-last occurrence interval for the species.
text.zh: 来自西西伯利亚的 Ust’-Ishim 1 股骨经直接放射性碳测年，95.4% 概率区间为距今 46,880–43,210 年（校正值）。其基因组对应这一名受测个体。该结果不是 H. sapiens 的起源年代，也不是物种首末出现时间范围。

title.en: Keep the sites and questions separate
title.zh: 让不同地点与问题保持区分

text.en: The Laos fossils, Ranis dietary signal, Siberian individual and southern African genomes differ in place, age model and research question. Together they offer several windows into ancient H. sapiens, but they do not trace one continuous migration route or provide a current geographic range.
text.zh: 老挝化石、Ranis 饮食信号、西伯利亚个体和南部非洲古基因组，在地点、年代模型和研究问题上都不同。它们提供了观察古代 H. sapiens 的若干窗口，但不能构成一条连续迁徙路线，也不提供当前地理分布区。

title.en: Catalogue of Life COL26.8, usage 6MB3T
title.zh: Catalogue of Life COL26.8，usage 6MB3T

scope.en: Accepted-name and classification metadata only; it does not substantiate the ancient biological evidence.
scope.zh: 仅用于接受名和分类元数据，不作为古代生物学证据的来源。

title.zh: Freidline 等（2023）：老挝北部 Tam Pà Ling 化石

scope.en: TPL 6 and TPL 7 morphology and sediment-age context; the fossil remains were not directly dated by the reported model.
scope.zh: TPL 6、TPL 7 的形态与沉积年代背景；论文所述模型并未直接测定化石本身。

title.en: Smith et al. (2024), diet at Ilsenhöhle in Ranis
title.zh: Smith 等（2024）：Ranis Ilsenhöhle 的饮食研究

scope.en: One cave assemblage: 10 human and 52 animal remains; layer ages are contextual, not individual direct dates.
scope.zh: 一处洞穴组合：10 份人类与 52 份动物遗骸；地层年代是背景年龄，不是个体直接测年。

title.en: Jakobsson et al. (2025; 2026 issue), ancient southern African genomes
title.zh: Jakobsson 等（在线发表于 2025；2026 期刊卷期）：南部非洲古基因组

scope.en: 28 ancient individuals and a study-defined modern comparison panel; conclusions are sample- and model-bounded.
scope.zh: 28 名古代个体与研究定义的现代比较面板；结论受样本和模型范围限制。

title.en: Fu et al. (2014), genome of the Ust’-Ishim individual
title.zh: Fu 等（2014）：Ust’-Ishim 个体基因组

scope.en: One directly dated western Siberian femur and its genome; not a species origin or range boundary.
scope.zh: 一根经直接测年的西西伯利亚股骨及其基因组，不代表物种起源或分布边界。

readerLimitations.en: This bilingual reader draft selects ancient evidence from four sites and studies; it is not a complete account of living human populations, life history, present-day geographic range or human origins. Site ages, fossil dates and model-based genomic comparisons remain distinct. The dossier is incomplete.

regionalRanges.label: Dallasaurus middle Turonian occurrence
regionalRanges.basis: The stage envelope captures the middle Turonian Dallasaurus skeletons without treating them as a globally complete family range.

overview: Bell and Polcyn's sampled Mosasauridae includes both plesiopedal Dallasaurus and more derived hydropedal members; limb grade alone is not treated as a family diagnosis.

ecology.diet: Marine carnivore; diet varied among sampled taxa
ecology.habitat: Marine; sampled foraging habitat varied by taxon
ecology.locomotion: Plesiopedal to hydropedal limb adaptations across sampled lineages
ecology.bodySize: Small plesiopedal to much larger hydropedal forms
ecology.guild: Marine carnivores with resource partitioning in the sampled Maastrichtian fauna

traits: Mosasauridae includes plesiopedal as well as hydropedal members in the cited analysis
Dallasaurus preserves cranial, axial and limb characters in two incomplete skeletons
Plesiopedal and hydropedal limb conditions occur in separate sampled lineages
evidenceSummary: The Dallasaurus skeletons, a 144-character phylogenetic analysis, a five-taxon isotope sample and a latest-Maastrichtian skull separately constrain morphology, limb-grade evolution, sampled ecology and the displayed occurrence envelope.

geography: Late Triassic marine deposits of southwestern China (Odontochelys sample)
Middle Triassic Vellberg deposits, Germany (Pappochelys sample)
overview: The turtle-line route is anchored by a shell mosaic: Odontochelys has a developed plastron and incomplete dorsal carapace, while Pappochelys retains broadened ribs and paired gastralia. These are sampled stem-turtle observations and comparative hypotheses, not a direct ancestor sequence or a crown-origin date.

ecology.diet: No taxon-wide diet is established by the cited shell studies; this field remains unresolved beyond the named specimens.
ecology.habitat: Sample-specific only: the marine deposits yielding Odontochelys were interpreted as marginal sea or river-delta settings; this is not a global turtle habitat claim.
ecology.locomotion: No taxon-wide locomotor mode is assigned; rib, gastralia and shell evidence is anatomical rather than a behavioural observation.
ecology.bodySize: No taxon-wide body-size estimate is assigned from the cited shell specimens.
ecology.guild: No ecological guild is assigned; the package preserves shell anatomy and depositional context without inferring a community role.

traits: Odontochelys preserves a fully developed plastron, expanded ribs and neural plates without a complete carapace
Pappochelys preserves broadened ribs and robust paired gastralia rather than a fused plastron
The shell sequence is a comparative homology model across named samples, not direct ancestry
evidenceSummary: Li et al. document three named Odontochelys specimens from southwestern China, while Schoch and Sues document complementary Vellberg Pappochelys anatomy. Their shell sequence and topology are retained as bounded interpretations with specimen, formation and analysis limits.

geography: Middle Triassic Italian Alps (Megachirella specimen PZO 628)
Late Triassic Ischigualasto Formation, Argentina (Taytalura holotype PVSJ 698)
Middle Jurassic Kilmaluag Formation, Isle of Skye, Scotland (Bellairsia specimen NMS G.2022.1.1)
overview: The lepidosaur route links CT-resolved specimens that illuminate early lepidosauriform and squamate anatomy: Megachirella is recovered on the squamate stem, Taytalura as an early-diverging stem lepidosauromorph, and Bellairsia on the squamate stem in the cited analyses. Each placement is matrix- and specimen-bounded.

ecology.diet: No taxon-wide diet is established by the cited skull and skeleton studies; this field remains unresolved.
ecology.habitat: The cited studies document fossil localities and anatomy but do not establish a single habitat for Lepidosauria; no broader habitat is inferred here.
ecology.locomotion: No taxon-wide locomotor mode is assigned from the CT-resolved skull and skeletal characters.
ecology.bodySize: No taxon-wide body-size estimate is assigned from the single or partial specimens used in the cited analyses.
ecology.guild: No ecological guild is assigned; analytical stem placement is not an ecological observation.

traits: Megachirella PZO 628 contributes CT-resolved cranial, wrist and shoulder characters to a combined-evidence analysis
Taytalura PVSJ 698 preserves a three-dimensionally exposed skull with CT-resolved early lepidosauromorph characters
Bellairsia NMS G.2022.1.1 was examined with synchrotron tomography and tested as a stem squamate
evidenceSummary: Simões et al., Martínez et al. and Tałanda et al. provide named specimens, imaging methods and explicit analytical placements across the lepidosaur route. The profile does not convert any stem specimen into a direct ancestor, crown FAD or global ecological history.

geography: Middle Turonian Arcadia Park Shale, north-central Texas (Dallasaurus sample)
Maastrichtian type area, the Netherlands (sampled Mosasaurus occurrence)
overview: Mosasauroidea is retained as a broader branch-defined mosasauroid route, distinct from node-defined Mosasauridae. Dallasaurus preserves a plesiopedal limb condition in the middle Turonian sample, while the nomenclatural analysis separates clade definitions from any single basal topology.

ecology.diet: Sample-bounded: tooth-enamel isotopes and associated body-size data support resource-partitioning interpretations among five type-Maastrichtian mosasaur taxa, not one diet for all Mosasauroidea.
ecology.habitat: The cited samples are marine; habitat interpretation is limited to the documented Texas and Maastrichtian study contexts.
ecology.locomotion: Dallasaurus is described with plesiopedal limbs, while the cited family analysis distinguishes plesiopedal and hydropedal grades among sampled mosasauroids.
ecology.bodySize: Body-size comparisons are available for the five named taxa in the type-Maastrichtian isotope sample; they are not a global size distribution.
ecology.guild: The five-taxon Maastrichtian sample supports a local resource-partitioning interpretation, not a universal mosasauroid guild assignment.

traits: Mosasauroidea and Mosasauridae have distinct branch- and node-based definitions in the cited nomenclatural analysis
Dallasaurus preserves cranial, axial and plesiopedal limb anatomy in two incomplete skeletons
Plesiopedal and hydropedal limb grades are separated from family membership in the sampled analysis
evidenceSummary: Madzia and Cau define the clade-boundary distinction, Bell and Polcyn document the Dallasaurus skeletons and limb grades, and Schulp et al. provide a five-taxon isotope and body-size sample. All ecological and geographic statements remain study- and specimen-bounded.

regionalRanges.label: Somerset Hettangian sample
regionalRanges.basis: The Hettangian envelope is a regional sample for diagnosed Somerset species and is not substituted for the global genus range.

overview: A Lower Jurassic ichthyosaur genus represented in this profile by diagnosable Hettangian Somerset specimens rather than an undifferentiated global occurrence set.

ecology.diet: Probable fish remains in one I. communis individual's gullet contents
ecology.habitat: Marine; habitat breadth is not resolved by the cited specimens
ecology.locomotion: Caudal-fluke propulsion inferred from comparative vertebral anatomy
ecology.bodySize: A genus-wide body-size envelope is not inferred from the cited specimens
ecology.guild: Predatory ecology documented for one I. communis individual

traits: Streamlined body
Large orbit and elongate rostrum
Paddle-like limbs
evidenceSummary: Primary species descriptions support diagnosis and a regional Hettangian sample; the broader global range and detailed performance remain provisional composites or inferences.

overview: A marine sauropterygian radiation with a diagnostic Rhaetian record; older Bobosaurus is displayed as an uncertain candidate and does not set the Plesiosauria range.

ecology.diet: Marine predator
ecology.habitat: Coastal to open marine
ecology.bodySize: Small to very large

traits: Four hydrofoil-like flippers
Compact trunk
Neck and skull proportions vary widely
evidenceSummary: Rhaeticosaurus provides articulated diagnostic anatomy and histology; Bobosaurus is older but phylogenetically less secure, and hydrodynamic performance remains model-based.

geography: Every continent; fossil record extremely patchy
overview: An archosaur flying-reptile radiation usually placed within Ornithodira near dinosaurs, while its precise origin remains analysis-dependent; package evidence spans eggs, soft tissues and bounded launch models.

ecology.diet: Varied by lineage
ecology.habitat: Aerial, terrestrial and coastal settings
ecology.bodySize: Very small to giant

traits: Membranous wing supported mainly by digit IV
Pneumatized skeleton in many forms
Quadrupedal launch is a tested biomechanical model
evidenceSummary: Named fossils directly document eggs and integument; flight and launch performance derive from explicit models and are not generalized across every pterosaur.

title.en: An archosaur branch near dinosaurs
title.zh: 主龙类中接近恐龙的一支

text.en: Expanded anatomical analyses place pterosaurs within Ornithodira, on the archosaur branch close to dinosaurs. Their exact origin and closest relatives remain dependent on the characters and analyses used; this placement does not identify a direct dinosaur ancestor.
text.zh: 扩展解剖特征的系统分析将翼龙置于鸟跖类，属于接近恐龙的主龙类支系。但其确切起源和最近亲仍随所选特征与分析方法而变化；这种位置判断并未指出某个恐龙是翼龙的直接祖先。

title.en: A worldwide record with large gaps
title.zh: 全球都有记录，但缺口很大

text.en: The redescription of Carniadactylus documents a Norian pterosaur sample from the Late Triassic, but one dated locality does not establish the group’s first global appearance. A separate analysis of 108 pterosaur taxa reported remains from every continent while emphasizing severe gaps in where and when fossils are known. Geographic patterns therefore depend on an uneven, time-sensitive record.
text.zh: Carniadactylus 的重新描述记录了晚三叠世诺利期的翼龙材料，但一个有年代依据的地点不能确定翼龙类在全球的最早出现。另一项包含 108 个翼龙分类单元的分析报告称各大洲均有化石，同时强调已知记录在空间与时间上都有严重缺口。因此，地理格局解释受不均匀且随时间变化的化石记录影响。

title.en: What particular fossils preserve
title.zh: 特定化石究竟保存了什么

text.en: One Hamipterus block preserves many eggs, including embryo-bearing eggs, giving a direct fossil record of reproduction in that deposit. In a separate Crato Formation specimen, melanosome geometry in preserved integument was used to assess a possible signalling role. These are specific fossil cases; behavioral readings and feather-homology claims remain interpretations, not observations of living pterosaurs.
text.zh: 一块 Hamipterus 化石板保存了多枚卵，其中有些含胚胎，为该沉积地点提供了直接的翼龙繁殖化石记录。另一件来自 Crato 组的标本，其保存体表组织中的黑素体形态被用于评估可能的信号展示功能。这些结论属于特定化石案例；行为解释和“羽毛”同源判断仍是研究者的解释，不是对活体翼龙的直接观察。

title.en: Testing flight with explicit assumptions
title.zh: 用明确假设检验飞行能力

text.en: Biomechanical studies use reconstructed body mass, wing dimensions, muscle power and launch kinematics to test whether giant pterosaurs could fly and launch quadrupedally. Their outputs are feasibility results conditioned on those inputs, not preserved motions or measurements that apply uniformly across the pterosaur radiation.
text.zh: 生物力学研究以重建的体重、翼部尺寸、肌肉功率和起飞运动学为输入，检验巨型翼龙能否飞行及以四足方式起飞。其结论是在这些输入条件下得到的可行性结果，不是保存下来的动作，也不能一概推广到所有翼龙类群。

title.zh: Haliskia：骨骼观察与重建的界线
title.en: Haliskia: observations and reconstruction

text.zh: Haliskia peterseni 的 KK F1426 部分骨架提供一个比较入口：先看地层与保存部位，再看牙列和细长舌骨；约 4.6 米翼展是比较估计，摄食解释缺少直接内容物证据。属级导读把这些证据类型分开。它可与本页既有卵、体表和飞行模型研究对读，但不能把其他翼龙的观察移作 Haliskia 的事实；PBDB 补充目录路径也不代表唯一系统树。
text.en: Partial skeleton KK F1426 of Haliskia peterseni offers a comparison route: read the horizon and preserved elements before the teeth and elongated hyoid bones. Its approximately 4.6 m span is estimated comparatively, while feeding interpretations lack direct preserved contents. The genus guide separates these evidence types. Compare them with the egg, integument and flight-model studies already introduced here, retaining taxon-specific observations. A supplementary PBDB directory path does not represent a uniquely resolved phylogeny.

title.en: Organize fossil records by source classification
title.zh: 按来源分类组织化石记录

text.zh: Pterosauria 是本批 PBDB 路径中的 order 分类名称。其下本批可读 252 个固定工作名录物种的出现导读；这里使用数据库记录的父级路径编排资料，不以资料条目数量评定类群演化重要性，也不把这一路径视为唯一系统发育方案。
text.en: Pterosauria is recorded at rank order in this batch’s PBDB path. This route offers occurrence guides for 252 species in the fixed working roster. Recorded database parents organize the material; entry counts do not establish evolutionary importance, and this path is not treated as the only phylogenetic scheme.

title.en: Compare collections, strata and age brackets
title.zh: 从采集地、地层和年代对读

text.zh: 可以从 Seazzadactylus venieri、Kunpengopterus sinensis、Kunpengopterus antipollicatus、Eotephradactylus mcintireae、Ikrandraco avatar 开始，对照各页具名采集记录和原引文。本路线所含的全部本批物种合计有 405 条所选出现记录、277 个采集记录，地层名示例为 Dolomia di Forni、Tiaojishan、Chinle、Jiufotang。先读每个采集地自己的年代区间和鉴定限定，再看不同地点之间是否可比；出现、采集和物种数量不能混用为古种群规模。
text.en: Start with Seazzadactylus venieri, Kunpengopterus sinensis, Kunpengopterus antipollicatus, Eotephradactylus mcintireae, Ikrandraco avatar and compare each page’s named collections and original reference links. Across all species included in this group’s guide, there are 405 selected occurrences from 277 collections; example stratum names are Dolomia di Forni, Tiaojishan, Chinle, Jiufotang. Read each collection’s age bracket and identification qualifications before comparing sites. Occurrence, collection and species counts cannot be exchanged for ancient population size.

title.en: Baron (2021), The origin of Pterosaurs
title.zh: Baron（2021），翼龙的起源

scope.en: Systematic review and expanded anatomical phylogenetic analyses; supports an ornithodiran placement while retaining uncertainty over pterosaur origins and closest relatives.
scope.zh: 系统综述与扩展解剖系统分析支持将翼龙置于鸟跖类，同时保留其起源和最近亲的不确定性。

title.zh: Dalla Vecchia（2009），Carniadactylus 的解剖与系统分类

scope.en: Detailed redescription and phylogenetic analysis of Norian pterosaur holotype MFSN 1797 and referred specimen MPUM 6009; this locality does not establish a global first appearance.
scope.zh: 对诺利期翼龙正模 MFSN 1797 与归入标本 MPUM 6009 的详细再描述和系统分析；该地点不能确定全球最早出现时间。

title.en: Upchurch et al. (2015), pterosaurian biogeography
title.zh: Upchurch 等（2015），翼龙地理分布分析

scope.en: Quantitative analysis of 108 pterosaur taxa; reports an every-continent record while emphasizing severe spatial and temporal patchiness and sampling-sensitive biogeographic inference.
scope.zh: 对 108 个翼龙分类单元进行定量分析；报告各大洲均有记录，同时指出时空分布极不均匀，地理推断受采样影响。

title.en: Wang et al. (2017), Hamipterus eggs and embryos
title.zh: Wang 等（2017），Hamipterus 的卵与胚胎

scope.en: Reports exposed Hamipterus eggs and embryo-bearing specimens from one fossil block; behavioral and hatchling-flight interpretations remain distinct from preserved evidence.

title.en: Cincotta et al. (2022), pterosaur melanosomes and signalling
title.zh: Cincotta 等（2022），翼龙黑素体与信号展示

scope.en: Analyzes preserved integument and melanosome geometry in a Crato Formation pterosaur specimen; signalling function and exact colour are interpretive conclusions.

readerLimitations.en:
This is a selective route through studies of relationships, fossils, geography and biomechanics. The fossil record is patchy; the cited locality and specimen results do not establish a complete global range, life history, diet or uniform flight capability. The profile is.
This route introduces occurrence records for species authored in this batch, not a complete descendant catalogue or a common ecological summary. Record counts are not comparable measurements of specimens, individuals, populations or sampling intensity; outer age bounds are not actual origin and extinction times. PBDB classification paths organize the material while remaining distinct from COL and other phylogenetic schemes.
readerLimitations.zh:
本页精选了亲缘关系、化石、地理分布和生物力学研究作为阅读路径。翼龙化石记录存在明显缺口；所引地点与标本结果不能构成完整全球分布、生活史、食性或适用于所有翼龙的飞行能力总结。。
此路线只介绍本批已写物种出现记录，不是完整后代名册或统一生态总结。记录数不是标本、个体、种群或采样强度的可比测量；年代外包区间不是实际起源与灭绝时间。PBDB 分类路径用于资料编排，与 COL 和其他系统发育方案保持来源区分；。

geography: South Majiashan Quarry, Chaohu, Anhui, China
overview: An Early Triassic ichthyosauromorph genus represented by maternal specimen AGM I-1; delayed ossification, dental morphology, vertebral count and hypophalangeal flippers support the assignment, while species-level taxonomy remains revisable.

ecology.diet: Diet is not directly preserved by maternal specimen AGM I-1 and remains unresolved
ecology.habitat: Marine ichthyosauromorph from the Majiashan depositional setting; habitual habitat is not directly resolved
ecology.locomotion: Paddle-like flippers are preserved, but gait and swimming performance were not measured
ecology.bodySize: AGM I-1 records an adult with embryos; a genus-wide body-size envelope is not inferred
ecology.guild: Predatory guild is not directly observed in the maternal specimen

traits: Maternal skeleton with two embryos and an adjacent neonate
Delayed ossification of carpals and tarsals relative to metacarpals, metatarsals and phalanges
Hypophalangeal flippers and the dental and vertebral characters used for genus assignment
evidenceSummary: Primary study Motani et al. documents AGM I-1 from south Majiashan Quarry in the Spathian Nanlinghu Formation and records two embryos plus a neonate. Embryo orientation and a terrestrial origin of viviparity are comparative interpretations, not directly observed behaviour or an ancestral state for all ichthyosaurs.

geography: Clay pit #3 of Lücking brick company, 1 km north of Bonenburg, Warburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
Rhaetian dark marine mudstones of the Exter Formation
overview: A small-bodied Late Triassic plesiosaurian represented by holotype LWL-MFN P 64047; its articulated anatomy and phylogenetic analysis extend the sampled plesiosaurian record into the Rhaetian without making the specimen a direct ancestor.

ecology.diet: Diet and prey are not directly preserved by the partial holotype
ecology.habitat: Marine mudstone depositional setting in the Rhaetian Exter Formation; habitual microhabitat remains unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Four similar flippers and a short tail support plesiosaurian hydrofoil and paraxial-locomotion comparisons, not a measured gait
ecology.bodySize: The subadult holotype has an estimated total length of 237 cm; a genus-wide size range is not inferred
ecology.guild: Marine predatory ecology is a broad plesiosaurian interpretation, not a directly observed feeding record

traits: Partial articulated skeleton preserving occiput, lower jaw, vertebral column, girdles and left limbs
Ventrally concave V-shaped neurocentral sutures in anterior and middle cervical vertebrae
Foreshortened zeugopodials and highly vascularized humeral and femoral bone tissue
evidenceSummary: Wintrich et al. describe holotype LWL-MFN P 64047 from a defined bed in the Exter Formation at Bonenburg, 21 m below the Triassic–Jurassic boundary. Figures and supplementary sections document the skeleton and histology; basal pliosaurid placement, fast growth and physiological implications remain topology- and interpretation-dependent.

overview: The 2024 description names Haliskia peterseni from holotype KK F1426, permanently housed at Kronosaurus Korner in Richmond, Queensland. It preserves the front of the skull, mandible, both ceratobranchials of the hyoid apparatus and parts of the vertebral column, ribs and limbs; the description lists 43 teeth. This is a partial skeleton, lacking major upper-arm and forearm bones. Measurements and functional interpretations first describe this individual, rather than the species’ full variation. The species epithet honors Kevin Petersen, who recovered and prepared the specimen.

ecology.diet: Not assessed as a complete taxon diet; see specimen-level interpretations.
ecology.habitat: Locality context is described in the reader sections.
ecology.bodySize: Specimen-based estimates are discussed where available.

evidenceSummary:
This page draws on one holotype description and its comparative analyses, rather than a complete species monograph. Wingspan, soft-tissue function, diet and finer relationships remain interpretations limited by specimen and method. The locality context does not establish reproduction, sociality, migration or population size. PBDB and COL concepts remain separate. This is source-bounded editorial prose.
This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

title.en: A species anchored by a partial skeleton
title.zh: 一件部分骨架固定的物种

text.zh: Haliskia peterseni 的原始描述发表于 2024 年，依据正模 KK F1426；标本永久保存在澳大利亚昆士兰州 Richmond 的 Kronosaurus Korner。保存内容包括头骨前部、下颌、两根舌骨角鳃骨及部分脊柱、肋骨和四肢，论文共列出 43 枚牙齿。它不是一具完整骨架；上臂与前臂的主要长骨缺失。描述、尺寸与功能解释首先属于这一件标本，不能当作物种的完整个体变异范围。种加词纪念发现并清修标本的 Kevin Petersen。
text.en: The 2024 description names Haliskia peterseni from holotype KK F1426, permanently housed at Kronosaurus Korner in Richmond, Queensland. It preserves the front of the skull, mandible, both ceratobranchials of the hyoid apparatus and parts of the vertebral column, ribs and limbs; the description lists 43 teeth. This is a partial skeleton, lacking major upper-arm and forearm bones. Measurements and functional interpretations first describe this individual, rather than the species’ full variation. The species epithet honors Kevin Petersen, who recovered and prepared the specimen.

title.en: The marine context of the Toolebuc Formation
title.zh: Toolebuc 组的海相背景

text.zh: 标本于 2021 年 11 月在 Richmond 西北的 Dig Site 3 采集，来自 Toolebuc 组的阿尔布期地层。论文用孢粉生物地层约束其层位；这里不把地层年龄转换成骨骼的直接测年。该组属于 Eromanga 盆地，石灰岩与油页岩记录海侵背景；本标本附近还见双壳类和未定种辐鳍鱼遗骸。海相沉积环境说明保存背景，不能单独证明这只翼龙终生在海上活动、迁徙路线或完整分布区。
text.en: The specimen was collected in November 2021 at Dig Site 3 northwest of Richmond, from Albian strata of the Toolebuc Formation. The paper constrains the horizon through spore and pollen biostratigraphy; this is not direct dating of the bones. Limestone and oil shale in this Eromanga Basin unit record a marine-transgression setting. Associated remains include bivalves and indeterminate ray-finned fishes. The depositional setting explains preservation context without establishing lifelong marine activity, migration routes or the species’ complete range.

title.en: Teeth, crests and elongated hyoid bones
title.zh: 牙列、头冠和细长舌骨

text.zh: 描述区分本种的牙列组合：第四、第五对牙齿小于第三、第六对；第二、第五对齿槽小于第三至第四及第六至第八对。前颌骨与下颌带冠，但头冠形态单独不足以区别近缘分类单元，部分骨骼也受死后挤压或发掘损伤。完整左角鳃骨长 280 mm，下颌长 400 mm，二者比值为 0.70。论文部分表述称它为舌骨／头骨比，本页明确采用实际列出的角鳃骨与下颌测量，避免将缺损头骨当作完整长度。该比例不直接给出软组织舌长。
text.en: The diagnostic dental combination includes fourth and fifth tooth pairs smaller than the third and sixth, and second and fifth alveolar pairs smaller than pairs three–four and six–eight. Premaxillary and mandibular crests are present, but crest shape alone does not distinguish related taxa; crushing and excavation damage affect some structures. The complete left ceratobranchial measures 280 mm and the mandible 400 mm, giving a ratio of 0.70. Although parts of the paper call this a hyoid-to-skull ratio, this account identifies the actual ceratobranchial and mandibular measurements, avoiding an assumed complete skull length. The ratio does not directly measure the soft-tissue tongue.

title.en: How the approximately 4.6 m wingspan was estimated
title.zh: 约 4.6 米翼展如何得出

text.zh: 论文以喙骨、第四掌骨及第一翼指节等长度同骨骼成熟的近缘翼龙比较，估计翼展约 4.60 m。肱骨、尺骨和桡骨缺失，后续翼指节也不完整，因此这不是直接量出的完整翼展，更不是所有个体的最大体型或物种范围。作者还提醒，仅凭部分下颌推算其他澳大利亚翼龙的巨大翼展，比较对象与比例关系都会影响结果。读者应把保存的骨长、补配的部件和最终尺度估计分开。
text.en: The paper estimates a wingspan of approximately 4.60 m by comparing coracoid, fourth metacarpal and first wing-finger phalanx lengths with osteologically mature relatives. The humerus, ulna and radius are absent, and later wing-finger phalanges are incomplete. This is therefore a comparative reconstruction, rather than a directly measured complete span, a maximum individual size or a species-wide range. The authors also caution that large spans inferred for other Australian pterosaurs from partial mandibles depend on comparator choice and proportions. Preserved lengths, reconstructed elements and final scale estimates should be read separately.

title.en: Relationships depend on matrices and unstable taxa
title.zh: 近缘关系受矩阵和不稳定分类单元影响

text.zh: 研究将标本加入两套性状矩阵，分别可编码约 30.7% 和 27.6% 的性状。两套分析支持其位于 Anhangueria，但更细的关系不同，并涉及剔除不稳定分类单元后的结果；讨论将其与 Ferrodraco 的接近关系表现为姐妹群或与 Mythunga 的多分支关系。这里不从某一棵树指定直接祖先，也不把目录父链当作系统树。PBDB 2026-10-02 名册把本种接入 Haliskia 与 Anhangueridae；这是补充目录的分类路径，不与固定 COL26.8 概念自动等同。
text.en: The specimen was added to two character matrices, with approximately 30.7% and 27.6% of characters scorable. Both support placement within Anhangueria, but finer relationships differ and some results follow exclusion of unstable taxa. The discussion expresses proximity to Ferrodraco through either a sister relationship or a polytomy including Mythunga. No direct ancestor is identified from a tree, and a catalogue parent chain is not a phylogeny. The PBDB snapshot of 2 October 2026 connects the species to Haliskia and Anhangueridae. This is a supplementary catalogue path, without automatic equivalence to pinned COL26.8 concepts.

title.en: Feeding hypotheses derived from anatomy
title.zh: 从骨骼提出的摄食假说

text.zh: 标本没有保存可直接说明摄食的喉部或胸腔内容物。作者根据细长舌骨、弯曲牙齿和腭部形态，提出较强舌部或有助于控制滑溜猎物；较少磨耗面又被用于讨论软体猎物，包括头足类的可能性。这些是功能与食性的假说，不能写成已经观察到的捕鱼、捕食比例或专食行为。论文明确指出舌骨形态单独不能确定食物偏好；与同时期翼龙的生态位分化也需要更好的时间约束和独立证据。
text.en: No throat or thoracic contents provide direct feeding evidence. Elongated hyoid bones, curved teeth and palatal morphology led the authors to propose that a strong tongue might help restrain slippery prey. Limited wear facets also inform a hypothesis of soft-bodied prey, possibly cephalopods. These remain functional and dietary interpretations, not observed fishing, prey proportions or specialization. The paper explicitly warns that hyoid morphology alone cannot establish food preference, and proposed niche partitioning with contemporaneous pterosaurs requires better temporal constraints and independent evidence.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Haliskia peterseni 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Haliskia。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Haliskia peterseni is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Haliskia. This guide uses 1 eligible species-level occurrence record from 1 collection and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Dig Site Three, NW of Richmond（Queensland），地区代码 AU，地层名称 Toolebuc；数据库年代范围 106.3–100.5 Ma，早端地质时段 Late Albian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Dig Site Three, NW of Richmond (Queensland), region code AU, stratum name Toolebuc; database age bracket 106.3–100.5 Ma, early interval Late Albian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 106.3–100.5 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 106.3–100.5 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Dig Site Three, NW of Richmond 的采集环境标签为 离岸沉积环境（offshore）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Dig Site Three, NW of Richmond has collection-environment label offshore; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Dig Site Three, NW of Richmond 的数据库引文署名为 Pentland et al.（2024），编号 ref:88687。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Dig Site Three, NW of Richmond carries database reference attribution Pentland et al. (2024), identifier ref:88687. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

text.zh: 先读 Haliskia peterseni 的标本与地层，再比较牙列和舌骨测量，最后读翼展估计、系统分析及食性假说。骨长是标本观察，完整翼展是比较重建，猎物控制和生态位分化则是待检验解释。可回到 Pterosauria 的卵、体表与飞行模型导读，比较不同材料回答问题的方式；那些类群的繁殖、体表或飞行结论不能直接转给 Haliskia。
text.en: Begin with the specimen and stratigraphy on the Haliskia peterseni page, then compare teeth and hyoid measurements, followed by wingspan estimates, phylogenetic analyses and feeding hypotheses. Bone lengths are observations, complete span is a comparative reconstruction, and prey control or niche partitioning remain interpretations. Return to the Pterosauria guide for eggs, integument and flight models to compare evidence types; those taxa’s reproductive, integumentary or flight conclusions cannot simply be transferred to Haliskia.

evidenceSummary:
This is a reading account of the 2019 holotype description and related comparisons, not a complete species monograph. The skeleton is incomplete, span is estimated and the type horizon lacks a refined age. No feeding observation, reproductive record or population dataset is attributed directly to this individual. Taxonomic names retain their publication-specific scope; PBDB and COL concepts are not merged. .
This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

title.en: AODF 876: a partial skeleton in ironstone
title.zh: AODF 876：铁质岩中的部分骨架

text.zh: Ferrodraco lentoni 的正模为澳大利亚恐龙时代博物馆收藏的 AODF 876，昵称 Butch。2019 年原始描述记录头骨与下颌前部、五件不完整颈椎、部分肩带及翼肢材料；不是一具完整骨架。若干相邻骨骼的包裹岩石仍能拼接，说明化石形成后曾保持连接，但侵蚀和土壤扰动在发掘前使其碎裂。属名中的 ferrum 指铁，说明铁质岩保存背景；种名纪念支持 Winton 社区与博物馆的 Graham Thomas “Butch” Lenton。
text.en: The holotype of Ferrodraco lentoni is AODF 876, nicknamed Butch, held by the Australian Age of Dinosaurs museum. The 2019 description records the front of the skull and mandible, five incomplete cervical vertebrae, and partial shoulder and wing elements. It is not a complete skeleton. Matching matrix around adjacent bones indicates articulation after fossilization, followed by fragmentation through erosion and soil disturbance before excavation. The genus name’s ferrum refers to ironstone preservation; the species honors Graham Thomas “Butch” Lenton’s support for Winton and the museum.

title.en: The Winton horizon and a possible late survival
title.zh: Winton 组层位与晚存续解释

text.zh: 标本于 2017 年 4 月发现于昆士兰州 Winton 的 Belmont Station，模式地点为 AODL 245。描述将其归入 Winton 组的森诺曼期至早土仑期范围。作者据区域碎屑锆石研究讨论该组北部可能晚至早土仑期的沉积，但同时明确本种模式地点仍缺少精细年龄约束。因此，可能较晚存续是待进一步约束的解释，不是正模直接测得的精确年龄，也不足以单独确认澳大利亚是这一支翼龙的避难所。
text.en: The specimen was found in April 2017 at Belmont Station near Winton, Queensland; the type locality is AODL 245. The description assigns it to the Cenomanian–early Turonian range of the Winton Formation. Regional detrital-zircon studies motivate discussion of potentially early Turonian deposition in the northern formation, but the authors explicitly note that this type locality lacks refined age constraints. Possible late survival remains an interpretation requiring better stratigraphy, rather than a precise date measured directly from the holotype or proof of an Australian refugium.

title.en: Tooth-size combinations and incomplete crests
title.zh: 牙齿大小组合与保存不全的冠

text.zh: 描述的两项主要鉴别特征是：前颌骨与下颌的第一对牙齿小于其他前部牙齿；第四至第七对小于第三与第八对。保存材料还显示头冠、下颌冠的残部以及相对突起的齿槽边缘。头冠后部不完整，下颌冠的完整高度也不能由残部直接量出。CT 数据帮助识别腭脊、下颌沟和位于功能牙远端及舌侧的替换牙；这些观察属于 AODF 876，不能仅凭冠形或单枚离散牙给所有未定种材料重新命名。
text.en: The two principal diagnostic features are first premaxillary and mandibular tooth pairs smaller than the other anterior teeth, and fourth through seventh pairs smaller than the third and eighth. Preserved material also shows a cranial crest, remnants of a mandibular crest and raised alveolar margins. The cranial crest is incomplete posteriorly, and the complete mandibular-crest height cannot be measured from its remnant. CT data reveal a palatal ridge, mandibular groove and replacement teeth distal and lingual to functional teeth. These observations concern AODF 876; a crest or isolated tooth alone cannot rename all indeterminate material.

title.en: The approximately four-metre span is estimated
title.zh: 约四米翼展是比较估计

text.zh: 2019 年论文根据正模测量与其他 Anhangueria 翼龙比较，估计翼展约 4 m。许多表列骨长标有不完整保存符号；部分尺骨、桡骨、第四掌骨和第一翼指节还受挤压或变形。骨架复原的缺失部分依据比较对象补配，因此约四米不是完整翼膜或整翼的直接测量。它也不建立本种最大体型、年龄范围或飞行性能；与其他论文的翼展数字比较时，应先比较保存材料和重建方法。
text.en: The 2019 paper estimates a wingspan of approximately 4 m from holotype measurements and comparison with other anhanguerians. Many tabulated lengths are marked as incomplete; parts of the ulna, radius, fourth metacarpal and first wing phalanx are crushed or distorted. Missing portions in the skeletal reconstruction rely on comparators, so the span is not a direct measurement of a complete wing or membrane. It does not establish maximum species size, an age range or flight performance. Comparisons with estimates in other papers should begin with preservation and reconstruction methods.

title.en: Evidence for skeletal maturity
title.zh: 骨骼成熟判断及其边界

text.zh: 作者依据肩胛骨与喙骨融合，以及第一翼指节伸肌腱突骨化，认为正模个体骨骼发育已成熟；但 CT 显示腕骨尚未缝合。两类状态均保留在描述中，不将某一融合状态转换成精确年龄、性别或繁殖阶段。标本没有覆盖幼体至成体的成长序列，因此也不能用这一件骨架推断本种的发育速度或寿命。
text.en: Fusion of the scapulocoracoid and ossification of the extensor tendon process on the first wing phalanx led the authors to interpret the individual as ontogenetically mature. CT scans nevertheless show unsutured carpals. Both observations remain part of the account; neither is converted into an exact age, sex or reproductive stage. A single skeleton supplies no juvenile-to-adult series from which to infer species growth rate or lifespan.

title.en: Two 2019 analyses and later catalogue names
title.zh: 2019 年两套分析与后来的目录名

text.zh: 2019 年研究采用两套矩阵：一套将 Ferrodraco 与 Mythunga 配成姐妹群，另一套则将 Ferrodraco 放在含 Anhanguera、Coloborhynchus 和 Ornithocheirus 的多分支之外，并因不稳定性剪除 Mythunga。论文沿用 Ornithocheiridae 等名称；本页 PBDB 2026-10-02 目录父链为 Anhangueridae—Tropeognathinae—Ferrodraco。Haliskia 的 2024 年研究另行比较 Ferrodraco，不能把这些有不同样本和定义的结果拼成唯一祖先序列。目录路径用来存放与导航，保留各论文原有分类范围。
text.en: The 2019 study uses two matrices: one pairs Ferrodraco with Mythunga, whereas the other places Ferrodraco outside a polytomy containing Anhanguera, Coloborhynchus and Ornithocheirus, pruning Mythunga because of instability. The paper uses names including Ornithocheiridae; the PBDB directory chain recorded on 2 October 2026 is Anhangueridae–Tropeognathinae–Ferrodraco. The 2024 Haliskia study compares Ferrodraco separately. Results based on different samples and definitions cannot be assembled into a unique ancestor sequence. The directory supports storage and navigation while retaining each publication’s taxonomic scope.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Ferrodraco lentoni 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Ferrodraco。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Ferrodraco lentoni is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Ferrodraco. This guide uses 1 eligible species-level occurrence record from 1 collection and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Pterosaur site, Belmont Station (AODL 0245)（Queensland），地区代码 AU，地层名称 Winton；数据库年代范围 100.5–89.8 Ma，早端地质时段 Middle Cenomanian、晚端时段 Early Turonian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Pterosaur site, Belmont Station (AODL 0245) (Queensland), region code AU, stratum name Winton; database age bracket 100.5–89.8 Ma, early interval Middle Cenomanian and late interval Early Turonian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 100.5–89.8 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 100.5–89.8 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Pterosaur site, Belmont Station (AODL 0245) 的采集环境标签为 "floodplain"；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、concretion（body,concretion）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Pterosaur site, Belmont Station (AODL 0245) has collection-environment label "floodplain"; collection preservation-mode label body,concretion. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Pterosaur site, Belmont Station (AODL 0245) 的数据库引文署名为 Pentland et al.（2019），编号 ref:71099。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Pterosaur site, Belmont Station (AODL 0245) carries database reference attribution Pentland et al. (2019), identifier ref:71099. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

title.en: Read Ferrodraco through its type species
title.zh: 从模式种读 Ferrodraco

text.zh: Ferrodraco 属以 F. lentoni 为模式种；核心材料为 AODF 876 部分骨架。属名联系铁质岩保存，种名联系纪念对象；名称来源不直接说明食性或行为。当前 PBDB 父链将本属置于 Tropeognathinae，原始论文的分类用法与后来的研究需要按日期对读。属级导读单独计数，不增加固定 PBDB 种级分母。
text.en: Ferrodraco has F. lentoni as its type species, based on partial skeleton AODF 876. The genus name refers to ironstone preservation, and the species name honors an individual; etymology does not establish diet or behavior. The current PBDB parent chain places the genus in Tropeognathinae. Read the original nomenclature alongside later studies with their dates retained. This genus guide is counted separately from the fixed PBDB species denominator.

title.en: Compare preserved material before Haliskia estimates
title.zh: 与 Haliskia 对读时先比较材料

text.zh: 先读 Ferrodraco lentoni 的保存、层位和牙列，再读约四米翼展的估计。随后对读 Haliskia peterseni：两件正模保存的骨骼不同，翼展数字均为比较重建，不能只按数字排列完整体型。2019 年和 2024 年系统分析的矩阵、分类定义和不稳定分类单元也不同；接近关系不是直接祖先关系。这条路线用于比较证据，不能用一个物种的舌骨或食性假说替另一物种填空。
text.en: Read preservation, horizon and dentition on the Ferrodraco lentoni page before its approximately four-metre span estimate. Then compare Haliskia peterseni: their holotypes preserve different elements, and both spans are comparative reconstructions, so the numbers alone cannot rank complete body size. The 2019 and 2024 analyses also differ in matrices, definitions and unstable taxa. Proximity does not identify direct ancestry. This route compares evidence without transferring one species’ hyoid anatomy or feeding hypotheses to the other.

Recorded database parents organize the material; entry counts do not establish evolutionary importance, and this path is not treated as the only phylogenetic scheme.

Across all species included in this group’s guide, there are 1 selected occurrence from 1 collection; example stratum names are Winton. Read each collection’s age bracket and identification qualifications before comparing sites. Occurrence, collection and species counts cannot be exchanged for ancient population size.

evidenceSummary:
This is a selected route through two holotype studies and large comparative material. Family membership, definitions and biological information remain incomplete; neither a complete family synthesis. PBDB and COL concepts remain separate.
This route introduces occurrence records for species authored in this batch, not a complete descendant catalogue or a common ecological summary. Record counts are not comparable measurements of specimens, individuals, populations or sampling intensity; outer age bounds are not actual origin and extinction times. PBDB classification paths organize the material while remaining distinct from COL and other phylogenetic schemes. Figures 1–3 and their captions were inspected here, distinguishing preserved regions from reconstructed outlines; all images, the whole paper and specimens have not been audited.

title.zh: 从模式标本扩展到比较身体与孤立翼骨
title.en: Extend holotype reading to comparative bodies and isolated wing bones

text.zh: 既有澳大利亚正模路线之外，可读 [Tropeognathus 的大型比较标本](Tropeognathinae/Tropeognathus/Tropeognathus_mesembrinus/page.zh.md)：MN 6594-V 关联保存头部与身体，MCT 1838-R 只有孤立肱骨远端，MPSC R 1395 为部分翼。这些材料的鉴定层级与保存完整度不同；后两件保留科级未定身份，不能当作三个同种个体统计。先辨材料身份，再比较体型与发育。
text.en: Alongside the existing Australian holotype route, read the [large comparative Tropeognathus specimen](Tropeognathinae/Tropeognathus/Tropeognathus_mesembrinus/page.en.md). MN 6594-V associates cranial and body material; MCT 1838-R is only a distal humerus and MPSC R 1395 a partial wing. Identification levels and completeness differ, with the latter two indeterminate at family level rather than three individuals of one species. Read material identity before comparing size and growth.

title.zh: 重建图、组织切片与翼展回答不同问题
title.en: Reconstructions, histology and span estimates answer different questions

text.zh: 同一研究的颅部照片记录保存骨块，轮廓重建以灰色指明实存部分；局部翼指组织学提供生长解释，翼展则用比较骨骼补全缺失骨段。三类资料不互相替代：图像中的完整轮廓不证明完整头骨，生长接近停止不确定全种最大尺寸，翼展估算也不直接给出食谱或飞行性能。此路线选取材料例子，不把其限制推广为所有科级成员的共同特征。
text.en: In the same study, cranial photographs show retained fragments and the outline reconstruction marks preserved regions in grey. Sampled wing-phalanx histology informs growth interpretation, while span estimates reconstruct missing segments using comparative skeletons. An intact outline does not establish an intact skull, near cessation of growth does not establish a species maximum, and estimated span does not directly supply diet or flight performance. This selected material route does not generalize specimen limits into traits shared by every family member.

title.en: Read taxonomic names with definitions and dates
title.zh: 分类名称需要带着定义和日期读

text.zh: 当前 PBDB 补充目录将 Haliskia 与 Ferrodraco 接入 Anhangueridae；后者还经 Tropeognathinae。2019 年 Ferrodraco 原始描述使用 Ornithocheiridae 等名称，2024 年 Haliskia 研究讨论不同的矩阵和支系定义。这些名称不能只按字面互换，也不能把两个论文和目录拼成一棵无争议的系统树。这里保留目录父链用于存放页面，论文解释仍按各自的材料和分析范围阅读。
text.en: The supplementary PBDB directory places Haliskia and Ferrodraco within Anhangueridae, the latter through Tropeognathinae. The 2019 Ferrodraco description uses names including Ornithocheiridae, while the 2024 Haliskia study discusses different matrices and clade definitions. Names cannot be interchanged solely by spelling, nor can the papers and catalogue be merged into an undisputed tree. Directory ancestry supports page storage; publication results retain their own material and analytical scope.

title.en: A route through two Australian holotypes
title.zh: 两件澳大利亚正模的比较路线

text.zh: 本页精选两件材料：Ferrodraco lentoni 的 AODF 876 与 Haliskia peterseni 的 KK F1426。先比较保存部位和采集层位，再比较牙列、成熟度线索及翼展重建；最后读系统分析。Haliskia 的舌骨与摄食假说不能移作 Ferrodraco 的直接证据，海相或其他沉积背景也不等于完整生活史。两页是部分分类单元的阅读例子，不是本目录科级接受种的完整索引，更不构成所有 Anhangueridae 的统一食性或行为概括。
text.en: This guide selects two specimens: AODF 876 of Ferrodraco lentoni and KK F1426 of Haliskia peterseni. Compare preserved elements and horizons first, then dentition, maturity evidence and span reconstructions, followed by phylogenetic analyses. Haliskia’s hyoid and feeding hypotheses cannot become direct evidence for Ferrodraco, and depositional context does not supply a complete life history. These pages are selected taxon examples, not a complete accepted-species index for the family or a uniform dietary or behavioral account for all Anhangueridae.

title.en: Organize fossil records by source classification
title.zh: 按来源分类组织化石记录

text.zh: Anhangueridae 是本批 PBDB 路径中的 family 分类名称。其下本批可读 14 个固定工作名录物种的出现导读；这里使用数据库记录的父级路径编排资料，不以资料条目数量评定类群演化重要性，也不把这一路径视为唯一系统发育方案。
text.en: Anhangueridae is recorded at rank family in this batch’s PBDB path. This route offers occurrence guides for 14 species in the fixed working roster. Recorded database parents organize the material; entry counts do not establish evolutionary importance, and this path is not treated as the only phylogenetic scheme.

title.en: Compare collections, strata and age brackets
title.zh: 从采集地、地层和年代对读

text.zh: 可以从 Haliskia peterseni、Thapunngaka shawi、Mythunga camara、Tropeognathus mesembrinus、Ferrodraco lentoni 开始，对照各页具名采集记录和原引文。本路线所含的全部本批物种合计有 18 条所选出现记录、15 个采集记录，地层名示例为 Toolebuc、Romualdo、Winton、Ifezouane。先读每个采集地自己的年代区间和鉴定限定，再看不同地点之间是否可比；出现、采集和物种数量不能混用为古种群规模。
text.en: Start with Haliskia peterseni, Thapunngaka shawi, Mythunga camara, Tropeognathus mesembrinus, Ferrodraco lentoni and compare each page’s named collections and original reference links. Across all species included in this group’s guide, there are 18 selected occurrences from 15 collections; example stratum names are Toolebuc, Romualdo, Winton, Ifezouane. Read each collection’s age bracket and identification qualifications before comparing sites. Occurrence, collection and species counts cannot be exchanged for ancient population size.

overview: Holotype KKF494 in the 2021 description is the front of a crested mandible, with alveoli but no in-place teeth. It is housed at Kronosaurus Korner in Richmond.

ecology.diet: Not assessed as a complete taxon diet.
ecology.habitat: Locality evidence is described in reader sections.
ecology.bodySize: Size estimates and their limitations are discussed in reader sections.

evidenceSummary:
This page covers the holotype, horizon, size-estimation debate and second-specimen referral dispute. The 2021 description was read through its public author transcription without visual inspection of its measurement tables. For the later study, relevant description, comparison and analysis sections of the accepted pre-proof PDF were read, with the referral passage visually inspected. This is not a complete review of the final published version; measurement-table values are not expanded. Diet, reproduction, behavior, complete range and abundance remain insufficient. Neither a complete species monograph.
This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

title.en: The holotype preserves part of a mandible
title.zh: 正模保存的是部分下颌

text.zh: 2021 年描述的正模 KKF494 为带冠下颌前部，保存齿槽，没有原位牙齿；标本藏于 Richmond 的 Kronosaurus Korner。
text.en: Holotype KKF494 in the 2021 description is the front of a crested mandible, with alveoli but no in-place teeth. It is housed at Kronosaurus Korner in Richmond.

title.en: Formation assignment and exact horizon
title.zh: 地层范围与精确层位

text.zh: 模式地点位于 Richmond 西北的 Wanamara Country，归入 Toolebuc 组上阿尔布期；组内精确层位尚不清楚。
text.en: The type locality is on Wanamara Country northwest of Richmond, in the upper Albian Toolebuc Formation. Its exact position within the formation remains unclear.

title.en: Why a large span is not a direct measurement
title.zh: 为何不把巨大翼展当作直接测量

text.zh: Haliskia 的 2024 年原始研究重新讨论 Thapunngaka 的尺度估计：较大的翼展数字来自部分下颌的比例外推，比较对象的选择和下颌联合部占头长的比例会影响结果。作者指出，按当时可用材料不能支持“澳大利亚最大已知翼龙”的结论。本页保留这一明确日期的批评，不给正模补上一副未保存的完整翅膀，也不把有争议的估计转换为典型体型或最大物种体型。旧论文的重建仍应按其假设阅读；这项批评也不是对后续所有新标本作出的结论。
text.en: The 2024 Haliskia description revisits Thapunngaka size estimates. Large span values are extrapolated from partial mandibular material, with outcomes sensitive to comparator choice and symphysis-to-skull proportions. Its authors argue that the evidence then available does not support the claim of Australia’s largest known pterosaur. This account retains that dated criticism without supplying unpreserved complete wings or turning a disputed estimate into typical or maximum species size. The earlier reconstruction should be read with its assumptions; the criticism does not adjudicate every subsequently reported specimen.

title.en: What the second specimen preserves
title.zh: 第二件标本保存了什么

text.zh: 后续论文描述 KKF600（文中也写作 KKF0600）：两块不完整上颌吻部材料，来自 Richmond 西北的 Cambridge Quarry、上阿尔布期 Toolebuc 组。它补充的是上颌材料，并非同一个体的完整头骨或翅膀。
text.en: The later paper describes KKF600, also written KKF0600: two incomplete upper-jaw rostral pieces from Cambridge Quarry northwest of Richmond, in the upper Albian Toolebuc Formation. These are additional upper-jaw material, not a complete skull or wings of the holotype individual.

title.en: Referral evidence and the later objection
title.zh: 归属依据与质疑分别是什么

text.zh: Richards 等依据齿槽形态与排列、上下颌咬合面的对应关系，将 KKF600 归入 Thapunngaka shawi，同时承认两件标本没有解剖部位重叠。Haliskia 的 2024 年研究质疑这一归属，理由包括缺乏重叠、Toolebuc 组至少存在三个翼龙分类单元，以及其他产地的古魔翼龙类多样性。这里保留两方依据，不把归入标本当作无争议的种级特征。
text.en: Richards and colleagues refer KKF600 to Thapunngaka shawi using alveolar morphology and arrangement and complementary occlusal surfaces, while acknowledging no anatomical overlap. The 2024 Haliskia study questions the referral because of that absence, at least three pterosaur taxa in the Toolebuc Formation, and anhanguerian diversity elsewhere. Both arguments remain explicit; referred material is not treated as undisputed species evidence.

title.en: Mythungini as a phylogenetic hypothesis
title.zh: Mythungini 是分析提出的关系假说

text.zh: 后续论文的严格共识树将 Thapunngaka、Mythunga 与 Ferrodraco 置于一个未解析的三分支，并命名 Mythungini。此处记录该研究结果，不将它自动改写为当前存储树的确定直接亲缘关系。
text.en: The later study’s strict consensus places Thapunngaka, Mythunga and Ferrodraco in an unresolved trichotomy named Mythungini. This records that analysis without converting it into a settled immediate relationship in the storage tree.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Thapunngaka shawi 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Thapunngaka。本页导读 2 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 2 个采集记录和 2 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Thapunngaka shawi is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Thapunngaka. This guide uses 2 eligible species-level occurrence records from 2 collections and 2 reference identifiers. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Cambridge Quarry, Morungle Station（Queensland），地区代码 AU，地层名称 Toolebuc；数据库年代范围 113.2–100.5 Ma，早端地质时段 Albian。采集记录 Free Fossil Hunting Site 1（Queensland），地区代码 AU，地层名称 Toolebuc；数据库年代范围 106.3–100.5 Ma，早端地质时段 Late Albian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Cambridge Quarry, Morungle Station (Queensland), region code AU, stratum name Toolebuc; database age bracket 113.2–100.5 Ma, early interval Albian. Collection Free Fossil Hunting Site 1 (Queensland), region code AU, stratum name Toolebuc; database age bracket 106.3–100.5 Ma, early interval Late Albian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 113.2–100.5 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 113.2–100.5 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

text.zh: Cambridge Quarry, Morungle Station 的采集环境标签为 陆相沉积环境，类型未定（terrestrial indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。Free Fossil Hunting Site 1 的采集环境标签为 海洋沉积环境，类型未定（marine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。

Free Fossil Hunting Site 1 has collection-environment label marine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.
