evidenceSummary:
This page uses the original description, the public reappraisal abstract, and comparison and analysis passages read in later studies. The original article pages were extracted from the scanned journal, with holotype and locality pages visually inspected; measurement tables are not expanded, and PDF or figures are not redistributed. The complete reappraisal remains unavailable, so its full revised diagnosis is not claimed reviewed. Original span, maturity and diet interpretations are not treated as direct measurements or established life history. Reproduction, behavior, complete range and abundance remain insufficient;
This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

title.en: Start with the holotype and locality
title.zh: 从正模与产地开始

text.zh: 正模 QM F18896 是不完整吻部及相贴的下颌。Phillip Gilmore 于 1991 年在 Hughenden 附近的 Dunluce Station 发现它，材料来自 Toolebuc 组的钙质结核；2007 年论文将该产地归为晚阿尔布期。
text.en: Holotype QM F18896 preserves an incomplete snout with an adherent mandible. Phillip Gilmore found it in 1991 at Dunluce Station near Hughenden, within a calcareous nodule from the Toolebuc Formation, assigned to the late Albian in the 2007 paper.

title.en: Internal chambers do not supply a complete head
title.zh: 空腔结构不等于完整头部

text.zh: 2007 年作者观察到吻部内部的空腔、薄骨壁和支撑结构。吻端及背缘存在缺损，不能仅凭保存片段确定完整头形或骨冠。
text.en: The 2007 authors describe internal chambers, thin bone walls and supports in the snout. Missing anterior and dorsal portions constrain reconstruction of the complete head and any crest.

title.en: The preserved anterior teeth were reinterpreted
title.zh: 前部牙齿的解释后来改变

text.zh: 重描述论文的公开摘要将前部保存结构解释为一颗上颌牙的牙根及其替换牙，而不是左右对应的一对牙。因此不能继续把它们当作吻端最前一对牙。摘要还将鼻眶前孔内的骨块识别为右夹板骨。本批只使用摘要可支持的修订，未取得该论文完整正文。
text.en: The public reappraisal abstract identifies the anterior preserved structures as a maxillary tooth root and its replacement, rather than contralateral teeth. They therefore cannot establish the anteriormost tooth pair. It also identifies the bone in the nasoantorbital fenestra as the right splenial. These are abstract-supported revisions; the complete article was not obtained in this batch.

title.en: Relationships depend on material and matrices
title.zh: 关系假说随材料与矩阵变化

text.zh: 重描述摘要把 Mythunga 置于 Anhangueria，但该支系多数关系未解析。Thapunngaka 第二件标本研究将 Mythunga、Thapunngaka 与 Ferrodraco 置于名为 Mythungini 的未解析三分支。Haliskia 的 2024 年研究在一套分析中把 Mythunga 与 Thapunngaka 识别为不稳定单元并在分析后排除。因此，本页分别记录研究结果，不给 Mythunga 指定一个已获一致确认的最近姐妹群，也不把数据库存储位置当作这些争论的裁决。
text.en: The reappraisal abstract places Mythunga in Anhangueria with much of that clade unresolved. The second-specimen Thapunngaka study groups Mythunga, Thapunngaka and Ferrodraco in an unresolved trichotomy named Mythungini. One analysis in the 2024 Haliskia study identifies Mythunga and Thapunngaka as unstable and excludes them a posteriori. These results are recorded separately; no agreed nearest sister group is assigned, and database storage placement does not adjudicate the debate.

readerLimitations.zh:
本页使用原始描述、重描述公开摘要及已读取后续研究中的比较和分析段落。原始期刊扫描的文章页已提取，正模与产地页经视觉核对；不扩写测量表，图像和 PDF 不再分发。重描述完整正文仍未取得，不能按摘要宣称已审阅完整修订诊断。原始翼展、个体成熟度和食性解释不当作直接测量或确认生活史。生殖、行为、完整分布与数量资料仍不足，不计完整物种专论。
本批是 2026-10-02 PBDB 出现记录导读，不是完整物种专论。只纳入固定 276 项翼龙工作名录中，当前名称一致、父链可追到已记录 Pterosauria 存储锚点、且有可用无疑问限定种级出现记录的条目。数据库接受名可能连接旧组合；这种数据库对应关系不裁决实际标本鉴定或所有分类争议，也不与 COL 同名概念合并。采集地点、地层区间、沉积环境和集合保存方式各有不同含义：它们不能直接推出完整分布、起源或灭绝时刻、该物种的固定生态、生物数量或每件标本的保存状态。原始描述、重描述、形态、食性和行为材料尚未逐项补齐；。
readerLimitations.en:
This page uses the original description, the public reappraisal abstract, and comparison and analysis passages read in later studies. The original article pages were extracted from the scanned journal, with holotype and locality pages visually inspected; measurement tables are not expanded, and PDF or figures are not redistributed. The complete reappraisal remains unavailable, so its full revised diagnosis is not claimed reviewed. Original span, maturity and diet interpretations are not treated as direct measurements or established life history. Reproduction, behavior, complete range and abundance remain insufficient;
This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

The 2014 study supplies anatomical descriptions and feeding hypotheses; the 2020 correction addresses nomenclatural availability of the electronic work and ZooBank registration. These are different kinds of evidence. This genus route retains database identity and ancestry while leading to both sources.

text.en: Open [I. avatar](Ikrandraco_avatar/page.en.md) and read specimen completeness, unknown exact horizons, mandibular crest and teeth before maturity, phylogeny and temporary-skimming/throat-pouch hypotheses. Two specimens do not represent a complete population and skeletal structures are not observed behavior. Other formation-level pterosaurs provide comparative context rather than measured ecological partitioning.

title.zh: 从繁殖材料进入成长争论
title.en: Enter developmental debate through reproductive material

text.zh: Hamipterus 当前有 H. tianshanensis 阅读入口。种页新增胚胎分期、早期飞行与亲代照料争论，并另列腭部扫描。原始描述、蛋骨床材料和后续模型各有范围；属级导读不把模型支持当作完整行为史。
text.en: The current Hamipterus route leads to H. tianshanensis, with embryonic staging, early-flight and parental-care debate alongside a separate palatal-scan account. Original descriptions, egg-bed material and later models retain different scopes rather than supplying a complete behavioral history.

title.zh: 先辨材料阶段，再辨研究对象
title.en: Identify developmental stage, then model subject

text.zh: 先核对材料是胚胎还是出壳幼体，再确认定量模型采用哪个类群，最后区分骨形、飞行推断和照料行为。当前数据库的两条出现记录仍只是采集导读，不等于蛋数、巢数或育幼群体大小。
text.en: First distinguish embryos from hatchlings, identify which taxa enter a quantitative model, and separate bone shape, flight inference and care. The two selected database occurrence rows remain collection guides rather than egg counts, nest counts or breeding-group size.

title.zh: 先读过滤牙齿，再读成长与飞行
title.en: Read filtering teeth before growth and flight

text.zh: 沿 [P. guinazui](Pterodaustro_guinazui/page.zh.md) 先读细丝牙齿、MIC-V55 的薄片与附着限制，再读 2008 年多骨生长研究，最后接到已有的 2021 年幼体飞行模型。下颌薄片、生长周期和跨标本飞行输入分别回答不同问题；它们没有直接串成同一只动物从孵化到死亡的记录。
text.en: Follow [P. guinazui](Pterodaustro_guinazui/page.en.md) through filamentous teeth, MIC-V55 sections and attachment limits, then the 2008 multi-bone growth study and existing 2021 hatchling-flight models. Jaw sections, growth cycles and composite flight inputs address different questions; they do not form a record of one animal from hatching to death.

title.zh: 按各研究的材料范围比较
title.en: Compare the material scope of each study

text.zh: 本属入口仍只有固定名录中的 P. guinazui 种页。2023 年一件下颌的十一张薄片、2008 年多骨多大小样本，与下方两条数据库出现记录分别保留各自单位。牙齿的特殊组织结构不能推广为所有翼龙的共同特征；生长研究的性成熟推断也不替代直接繁殖证据。
text.en: This genus route retains one species entry, P. guinazui, in the fixed roster. Eleven sections of one jaw in 2023, multiple bones and sizes in 2008, and the two database occurrences below retain their separate units. Specialized dental histology does not describe all pterosaurs, and inferred sexual maturity does not replace direct reproductive evidence.

title.zh: 用一个物种入口分开读幼体与成体

text.zh: Pterodaustro 当前有 P. guinazui 阅读入口。种页从胚胎、幼体标本与组合测量进入飞行模型，再区分成长生态和照料假说。属级路线不把模型中的成体尺寸或数据库出现数当作全属生物学测量。
text.en: The current Pterodaustro route leads to P. guinazui. Its page moves from embryos, hatchlings and composite measurements to flight models, then distinguishes growth ecology and care hypotheses. Adult model sizes and database occurrence counts are not whole-genus biological measurements.

text.en: Use [Pterodaustro guinazui](Pterodaustro_guinazui/page.en.md) to check specimens, estimated wingspans and bending assumptions, then compare embryonic staging in [Hamipterus tianshanensis](../../Pteranodontoidea/Hamipterus/Hamipterus_tianshanensis/page.en.md). The two occurrence rows remain collection guides, not counts of hatchlings, nests or all model specimens.

All images, supplements, specimens, matrices and subsequent studies have not been inspected, and no reidentification, remeasurement or classification adjudication occurred. title.zh: 按年份对读正模与归入材料
title.en: Read type interpretations and referrals by year

text.zh: 先读 [A. saharica](Alanqa_saharica/page.zh.md) 新增的 2023 年解释，再回看 2010 年下颌与 2020 年上颌的段落。正模编号保持不变；成对骨突、单个中央突起、归入颌骨和未定身体骨骼分别比较，才能理解哪些判断依赖孤立材料。分类讨论保留作者与年份，不把一次修订写成已确认的完整动物复原。
text.en: Read the new 2023 interpretation in [A. saharica](Alanqa_saharica/page.en.md), then return to the 2010 lower-jaw and 2020 upper-jaw passages. The type number stays the same. Compare paired projections, a single median boss, referred jaws and indeterminate body bones separately to understand which conclusions rely on isolated material. Classification arguments retain their authors and dates rather than becoming a confirmed reconstruction of the complete animal.

title.zh: 从一个正模进入两种解剖解释
title.en: Start with two interpretations of one type

text.zh: 沿 [Alanqa saharica](Alanqa_saharica/page.zh.md) 先读 2010 年命名论文，再读 2020 年正模改释。FSAC-KK 26 的标本身份不变，但下颌联合与上颌吻部的解释影响颌部复原和比较比例。然后分别阅读具名颌部材料、未定种颈椎和保留的数据库出现记录，避免把它们拼成一件完整骨架。
text.en: Follow [Alanqa saharica](Alanqa_saharica/page.en.md) from the 2010 naming paper to the 2020 reinterpretation. FSAC-KK 26 retains its specimen identity, while lower-jaw versus rostral interpretation affects jaw reconstruction and proportional comparisons. Read named jaw material, indeterminate cervical remains and retained database occurrences separately rather than combining them into one complete skeleton.

title.zh: 更多颌部材料仍不等于完整生物学
title.en: Additional jaw material does not complete the biology

text.zh: 本属导读加入历史颌部描述与后来的解剖修订；无齿、笔直颌缘和腭面突起是形态观察，不能单独确定完整食谱、飞行性能或属级种群大小。2020 年提出的 Xericeps 异名可能性及类群位置差异保留未决，未定种身体材料不作本属的确定记录。
text.en: This guide adds historical jaw descriptions and a later anatomical revision. Toothlessness, straight margins and a palatal boss are morphological observations that do not establish a complete diet, flight performance or genus population size. The 2020 possibility of synonymy with Xericeps and differing clade interpretations remain unresolved; indeterminate body material is not treated as a confirmed genus record.

text.zh: 先读 [B. galaczi](Bakonydraco_galaczi/page.zh.md) 的正模与馆藏号对应，再看下颌横嵴、2011 年上颌和未知角质喙鞘。随后读分离骨骼的归属、翼展估算与食性假说。2005、2011 年作者将它置于 Azhdarchidae；这条阅读线呈现两篇论文的年代与材料，不代表已核齐后续分类修订或独立重跑亲缘分析。
text.en: Start with the type and collection-number correspondences in [B. galaczi](Bakonydraco_galaczi/page.en.md), then the mandibular ridge, the upper jaw added in 2011 and the unknown keratinous covering. Continue to isolated-bone referrals, wingspan estimates and feeding hypotheses. The 2005 and 2011 authors place it in Azhdarchidae. This route records those papers’ dates and material, without a complete later taxonomic review or independent phylogenetic rerun.

title.zh: 山名、类型产地与搬运后的化石
title.en: The mountain name, type locality and transported fossils

text.zh: Bakonydraco 的属名取自 Bakony 山地与拉丁语 draco；galaczi 纪念 András Galácz。2005 年类型产地是匈牙利西部 Iharkút 的 Csehbánya Formation，论文据孢粉研究采用 Santonian。作者描述河流洪泛平原沉积，并指出骨骼曾被流水搬运、集中保存。下方数据库 85.7–83.6 Ma 与一条采集记录分别保留其来源范围；沉积标签不是本种全部生活环境，出现记录数不等于论文的碎片或个体数。
text.en: Bakonydraco combines the Bakony mountain name with Latin draco; galaczi honors András Galácz. The 2005 type locality is the Csehbánya Formation at Iharkút, western Hungary, assigned to the Santonian from palynological work cited in the paper. The authors describe fluvial floodplain deposits and bones transported by flowing water into fossil pockets. The database bracket of 85.7–83.6 Ma and one collection record below retain their source scope. Depositional labels do not describe the entire living habitat, and occurrence counts are not the paper’s fragment or individual counts.

title.zh: 从本属入口进入共同骨床的比较
title.en: Enter shared-bonebed comparisons from this genus

text.zh: 先从关联正模进入长颌、气腔骨骼与两件组织样本，再对照骨床中更常见的翼龙。从 [Keresdrakon vilsoni](Keresdrakon_vilsoni/page.zh.md) 继续到 [Caiuajara dobruskii](../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Tapejarinae/Caiuajara/Caiuajara_dobruskii/page.zh.md) 与 [Vespersaurus paranaensis](../../../../../../Dinosauromorpha/Dinosauriformes/Dinosauria/Theropoda/Neotheropoda/Averostra/Ceratosauria/Noasauridae/Noasaurinae/Vespersaurus/Vespersaurus_paranaensis/page.zh.md)。三者重复同层关联的解释由 2019 年研究支撑；这些横向阅读链接不改变分类父链，也不把三者写成一个统一形态或食性类群。
text.en: Begin with the associated holotype, long jaws, pneumatic anatomy and two tissue samples, then compare the more abundant pterosaur material. Continue from [Keresdrakon vilsoni](Keresdrakon_vilsoni/page.en.md) to [Caiuajara dobruskii](../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Tapejarinae/Caiuajara/Caiuajara_dobruskii/page.en.md) and [Vespersaurus paranaensis](../../../../../../Dinosauromorpha/Dinosauriformes/Dinosauria/Theropoda/Neotheropoda/Averostra/Ceratosauria/Noasauridae/Noasaurinae/Vespersaurus/Vespersaurus_paranaensis/page.en.md). The 2019 study supports an interpretation of repeated same-bed association. These comparative links do not change classification parents or assign one common morphology or diet to the three taxa.

title.zh: 先对齐材料，再选成长或生态问题
title.en: Align material before choosing growth or ecology

text.zh: 比较时依次问：材料是否关联到一个体、成长判断用了什么组织或形态、行为是否仅为推测。两种翼龙与恐龙没有共同的一套完整成长样本，三条所选数据库出现行也不是三个个体。若要比较年龄，先读 Vespersaurus 的反推前提与两种后肢骨的分歧；若要比较生态，先保留共同保存与具体捕食之间的证据距离。
text.en: Ask in order whether material belongs to one individual, which tissue or morphology supports development, and whether behavior is inferred. The pterosaurs and dinosaur do not share one complete growth sample, and three selected database occurrence rows do not count three individuals. For age comparisons, begin with Vespersaurus retrocalculation assumptions and the disagreement between hind-limb elements. For ecology, retain the difference between shared preservation and evidence of specific predation.

title.zh: 从关联骨架读到成长与共存
title.en: Read from an associated skeleton to growth and coexistence

text.zh: 进入 [K. vilsoni](Keresdrakon_vilsoni/page.zh.md)，先看正模与孤立材料，再读长无齿颌、气腔骨骼、发育融合及两件骨组织样本。现有一条数据库出现行承载多件原研究材料的引文入口，不能据出现行数量代替骨骼或个体数。
text.en: Open [K. vilsoni](Keresdrakon_vilsoni/page.en.md), begin with the holotype and isolated material, then read long toothless jaws, pneumatic anatomy, skeletal fusion and two histological samples. One database occurrence row links to research describing multiple specimens; the row count does not count bones or individuals.

title.zh: 共同骨床不等于确定食物网
title.en: A shared bonebed does not establish a food web

text.zh: 种页把重复同层关联与作者的生态模型分开：共存解释有具体层位与材料支持，食腐、捕食和独居仍为假说。随后对读蔡氏翼龙与 Vespersaurus 的材料导读时，保留各原研究的个体归属与采样范围；一个遗址也不自动给出最接近亲缘关系。
text.en: The species page separates repeated same-bed association from the ecological model: coexistence has specific stratigraphic and material support, while scavenging, predation and solitary behavior remain hypotheses. In comparisons with Caiuajara and Vespersaurus, retain each study’s specimen-association and sampling limits. Shared locality also does not establish closest relationships.

evidenceSummary: This page adds the original-description author manuscript and the 2023 Leptostomia account. Figures 2 and 7 and table 1 were inspected; other images, supplemental matrices, raw XCT and specimens remain incomplete. Upper/lower-jaw species referral, maturity, relationships, probing and sensory ability retain their separate inference limits; missing lengths are not measurements of complete jaws. Database counts, ages, parent chains and review states remain, without remeasurement, independent reruns. Complete biology and reader delivery remain pending.

title.zh: 从两段颌骨读到探食假说
title.en: Read from two jaws to the probing hypothesis

text.zh: 从 [L. begaaensis](Leptostomia_begaaensis/page.zh.md) 的正模与副模开始：先区分保存段和推算缺失段，再比较上颌中央嵴与下颌沟、截面和骨孔。随后阅读成熟推断、亲缘分析与探食假说；喙尖缺失使远距触觉仍待检验。两件归入同种的材料不等于一个关联个体，也没有提供完整动物复原。
text.en: Start with the holotype and paratype in [L. begaaensis](Leptostomia_begaaensis/page.en.md): distinguish preserved fragments from estimated missing tips, then compare the upper-jaw ridge, lower-jaw groove, cross sections and foramina. Continue to maturity, relationships and the probing hypothesis. Missing bill tips leave remote touch open to testing. Two fragments referred to one species are not one associated individual or a complete animal reconstruction.

title.zh: 产层、假说与数据库计数分别阅读
title.en: Read horizons, hypotheses and database counts separately

text.zh: 原始描述把材料来源记为摩洛哥 Aferdou N’Chaft 的上部 Ifezouane Formation，并保留 ?Albian—lower Cenomanian；2023 年介绍仍保留存疑的 Albian—Cenomanian 表述。下方数据库的 100.5–93.9 Ma 是固定采集行的宽范围，不把它当作对正模的精确测年。河流沉积标签与探食假说分别阅读；一条数据库出现记录不能替代文献中的两件类型标本或种群数量。
text.en: The original description records Aferdou N’Chaft, Morocco, upper Ifezouane Formation, retaining ?Albian–lower Cenomanian. The 2023 account likewise retains an uncertain Albian–Cenomanian formulation. The 100.5–93.9 Ma bracket below belongs to the fixed database collection row rather than precise dating of the type. Read the fluvial setting separately from the probing hypothesis; one database occurrence is neither the two type specimens described in the paper nor a population count.

evidenceSummary: This route adds a guide to the T. navigans associated-skeleton study, without a complete genus synthesis. The sexual-dimorphism hypothesis, genus-level material and exact specimen provenance retain their unresolved status. This batch adds girdles, forearm, wrist/metacarpus, pelvis, legs/feet and measurement tables without independent scan inspection or remeasurement. The Table 4 wing-phalanx side discrepancy remains unresolved; reader-facing delivery is pending. This batch inspects selected headers, relevant taxon rows, character definitions and commands in the two official supplemental matrices. A complete matrix audit, tree rerun and raw CT inspection remain pending; unresolved branching and missing scores do not establish resolved species relationships.

title.zh: 把骨骼观察与亲缘分析分开读
title.en: Read skeletal observations and relationship analyses separately

text.zh: 先在 [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.zh.md) 阅读关联骨架，再看 64／65 单元矩阵、多棵最简树与严格共识。两套分析都留下 Tapejarinae 内部的未解分叉；[T. imperator](Tupandactylus_imperator/page.zh.md) 的缺失身体编码不能由 navigans 补齐，也不能用来证实性二型。CT 模型帮助观察隐埋骨骼，亲缘树则来自性状矩阵，两者的证据范围不同。
text.en: Start with the associated skeleton in [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.en.md), then read the 64/65-unit matrices, multiple shortest trees and strict consensus. Both analyses retain unresolved branching within Tapejarinae. Missing body scores for [T. imperator](Tupandactylus_imperator/page.en.md) cannot be supplied from navigans or used to confirm sexual dimorphism. CT models help reveal embedded bones; relationship trees derive from character matrices and answer a different question.

title.zh: 先读身体比例，再比较头部估计
title.en: Read body proportions before skull-based estimates

text.zh: [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.zh.md) 现补入肩带、骨盆和后肢，连接关联骨架尺寸与保存分歧；对读 [Europejara](../../../../Europejara/Europejara_olcadesorum/page.zh.md) 的头部比例估计。T. imperator 的具名出现和属级未定材料继续分别阅读，不把 navigans 身体移给另一种。
text.en: The [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.en.md) guide now adds shoulder, pelvic and hindlimb anatomy, linking associated-skeleton dimensions with preservation discrepancies. Compare skull-based estimates in [Europejara](../../../../Europejara/Europejara_olcadesorum/page.en.md). Read T. imperator occurrences and genus-level material separately without transferring the navigans body to another species.

title.zh: 从一件关联骨架进入 Tupandactylus
title.en: Enter Tupandactylus through an associated skeleton

text.zh: [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.zh.md) 现有 2021 年关联骨架导读，把头冠、喙鞘、颈背骨骼和翼指连接起来。先看保存与标本归属，再读功能假说；[T. imperator](Tupandactylus_imperator/page.zh.md) 的出现记录仍可对照，但不能把 navigans 的整副身体材料直接移给另一种。
text.en: The [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.en.md) page now connects the crest, beak sheath, neck and back anatomy, and wing finger through a 2021 associated-skeleton study. Start with preservation and attribution, then read functional hypotheses. Compare the retained [T. imperator](Tupandactylus_imperator/page.en.md) occurrence guide without transferring the entire navigans skeleton to that species.

title.zh: 两种入口与属级材料分别阅读
title.en: Read the two species and genus-level material separately

text.zh: 论文提出但未解决两种的性二型解释；MN 6588-V 也只归属到 Tupandactylus sp.。当前两种目录入口继续沿固定数据库保存，关联骨架、旧出现行和未定种材料不混成一个标本计数。精确出处未知的 GP/2E 9266 更不能由既有采集地行补出具体坐标。
text.en: The paper raises but does not resolve a sexual-dimorphism explanation for the two species; MN 6588-V is assigned only to Tupandactylus sp. The two directory entries retain their fixed database identities. Associated skeletons, older occurrence rows and genus-level material are not pooled into a specimen count, and existing collection records cannot supply exact coordinates for GP/2E 9266.

readerLimitations.zh: 本路线新增 T. navigans 关联骨架研究导读，仍未完成整个属的全部材料与生物学综合。两种性二型假说、属级未定种材料和标本精确出处各保留未决状态；没有重算亲缘矩阵。 本批新增肩带、前臂、腕掌、骨盆、腿足与尺寸表导读，未独立检查扫描或复量；表 4 翼指侧别与正文差异保留，读者端交付尚未完成。 本批选读两套官方补充矩阵的表头、相关分类行、部分性状定义与命令；未审计全部矩阵、复算树或检查原始 CT，不能把未解分叉及缺失编码改写为已确定的种间关系。
readerLimitations.en: This route adds a guide to the T. navigans associated-skeleton study, without a complete genus synthesis. The sexual-dimorphism hypothesis, genus-level material and exact specimen provenance retain their unresolved status. This batch adds girdles, forearm, wrist/metacarpus, pelvis, legs/feet and measurement tables without independent scan inspection or remeasurement. The Table 4 wing-phalanx side discrepancy remains unresolved; reader-facing delivery is pending. This batch inspects selected headers, relevant taxon rows, character definitions and commands in the two official supplemental matrices. A complete matrix audit, tree rerun and raw CT inspection remain pending; unresolved branching and missing scores do not establish resolved species relationships.

title.zh: 头冠、取食与标本归属依次阅读
title.en: Read crest, feeding and specimen referrals in sequence

text.zh: 从 [T. sethi](Thalassodromeus_sethi/page.zh.md) 的正模保存长度和头冠构造开始，再对读 2002 年功能假说、2007 年掠水模型与 2018 年重描述。尤其留意旧模型颌骨的归属历史。本路线只包含当前工作名录中的一个种页；2018 年提出 T. oberlii 是另一种，是论文的分类解释，不据此修改固定数据库名单或把两种材料合并。
text.en: Begin with the holotype measurements and crest in [T. sethi](Thalassodromeus_sethi/page.en.md), then compare the 2002 functional hypotheses, 2007 skimming models and 2018 redescription. Pay particular attention to the older model jaw’s referral history. This route includes one species page from the fixed roster. The 2018 proposal of a separate T. oberlii records that paper’s interpretation without changing the fixed database roster or combining species material.

title.zh: 地层名称与亲缘框架各有年代
title.en: Stratigraphic names and relationships have dated frameworks

text.zh: 2002 年论文把类型产地记为 Santana Formation 的 Romualdo Member、Albian；2018 年采用 Santana Group 的 Romualdo Formation，并指出不同亲缘框架仍有争议，其分析使用 Thalassodrominae 与 Tapejarinae 为姐妹群的方案。下方固定 PBDB 采集行仍保留 119.57–113.2 Ma、Late Aptian 和 Thalassodromidae 父链。地层术语、年代与分类框架的差异分别呈现，不用某篇旧论文替代数据库范围或宣称统一最新共识。
text.en: The 2002 paper records the type horizon as the Romualdo Member of the Santana Formation, Albian; the 2018 paper uses Romualdo Formation within the Santana Group. It explicitly notes disputed relationships and uses a framework with Thalassodrominae and Tapejarinae as sisters. The fixed PBDB collection row below retains 119.57–113.2 Ma, Late Aptian and the Thalassodromidae parent chain. Stratigraphic terminology, dating and classification differences remain distinct, without replacing database scope from one older paper or claiming a unified latest consensus.

title.zh: 把新增下颌、产层分歧与亲缘假说分开
title.en: Separate a new jaw referral, horizon disagreement and relationships

text.zh: 从 [X. curvirostris](Xericeps_curvirostris/page.zh.md) 的 2018 年正模开始，对读 2020、2023 年的来源。2023 年新增下颌归属，且正模产层记录与 2020 年不同；这两件事分别阅读。再看未知上颌的备选解释与细分亲缘，保留形态型和未定归属，不把数据库的一条出现记录直接等同于文献提及的全部标本。
text.en: Begin with the 2018 type in [X. curvirostris](Xericeps_curvirostris/page.en.md) and compare the 2020 and 2023 sources. The 2023 paper adds a lower-jaw referral and differs from 2020 on the type horizon; read those as separate issues. Then consider alternatives for the unknown upper jaw and finer relationships, retaining morphotypes and indeterminate attributions. One database occurrence is not all specimens mentioned in the literature.

title.zh: 从下颌正模到分类假说
title.en: From a lower-jaw type to taxonomic hypotheses

text.zh: 从 [X. curvirostris](Xericeps_curvirostris/page.zh.md) 的 FSAC-KK 10700 开始：先区分保存长度与延长颌缘的复原，再读弯曲、腹侧沟及骨表面。随后对读 [Alanqa](../../Azhdarchidae/Alanqa/Alanqa_saharica/page.zh.md) 的正模解释与可能异名，保留归属层次和未决问题；两件正模没有被证实是一个关联个体。
text.en: Start with FSAC-KK 10700 in [X. curvirostris](Xericeps_curvirostris/page.en.md): separate preserved length from projected jaw reconstruction, then read curvature, the ventral groove and bone surface. Compare the type interpretation and possible synonymy of [Alanqa](../../Azhdarchidae/Alanqa/Alanqa_saharica/page.en.md) while retaining attribution levels and unresolved questions. The two type specimens are not demonstrated parts of one associated individual.

title.zh: 一段无齿颌部的证据范围

text.zh: 本属阅读路线补入原始描述与后续比较，不代表完整生物学。无齿、颌沟与骨孔可参与形态比较，尺寸类别和保存环境则不能确定本属的最大体型、固定食谱或古种群数量。更细类群位置与 Alanqa 的异名可能性保留来源之间的限定。
text.en: This route adds the original description and later comparison without claiming complete biology. Toothlessness, jaw grooves and foramina inform morphological comparison. Size categories and preservation settings do not establish maximum genus size, a fixed diet or ancient population size. Finer relationships and possible synonymy with Alanqa retain their source qualifications.

text.en: The current Dsungaripterus route leads to D. weii. Its skull material supports reading the upturned toothless tips, posterior dentition and palatal boundaries, with the 2020 description and 2024 scans retaining their methodological scopes.

title.zh: 按标本、修订和功能阅读
title.en: Read specimens, revisions and function in sequence

text.zh: 先确认头骨与碎片分别保存了什么，再比较 CT 引出的骨归属修订，最后阅读齿面磨耗与取食硬物假说。已保存结构、重建结果和行为解释各有证据范围，属级导读不把它们合成一套确定生活史。
text.en: First distinguish what skulls and fragments preserve, then compare CT-based changes in element identity, and finally read tooth wear and the hard-food hypothesis. Preserved structures, reconstructions and behavioral interpretations retain distinct evidence scopes rather than forming a fixed life history.

title.en: Compare collections, strata and age brackets

text.zh: 本目录按记录父链把 Tropeognathus 放在 Tropeognathinae 下；进入 [T. mesembrinus](Tropeognathus/Tropeognathus_mesembrinus/page.zh.md) 可读 2013 年 MN 6594-V 的 cf. 鉴定、头部破损、局部组织学和翼展重建。论文的科级鉴定与目录的亚科路径各保留来源，不能用存放位置证明这一标本已无疑问归入某个亚科，或已经解决所有支系定义。

The [T. mesembrinus guide](Tropeognathus/Tropeognathus_mesembrinus/page.en.md) presents the 2013 cf. identification, cranial damage, sampled histology and span reconstruction for MN 6594-V. The paper’s family identification and catalogue subfamily route retain separate provenance; storage position does not prove an unqualified specimen-level subfamily assignment or resolve all clade definitions.

title.zh: 成熟度与大小需要保留标本身份
title.en: Keep specimen identity when comparing maturity and size

text.zh: MN 6594-V 的局部组织学支持生长停止或接近停止，部分轴向融合仍不完整；同文 MPSC 翼指伸肌突未融合，作者讨论其未成熟状态。这些观察属于不同标本，后者也未确定属于本亚科。比较应保留取样骨段、鉴定与估算方法，而不能把大、小材料排成已经测得的 Tropeognathinae 生长曲线。
text.en: Sampled histology of MN 6594-V supports ceased or nearly ceased growth despite incomplete fusion in some axial structures. The unfused wing-finger extensor process in MPSC material informs the authors’ discussion of immaturity. These concern different specimens, and the latter is not established as a member of this subfamily. Comparisons retain sampled elements, identities and reconstruction methods rather than forming a measured Tropeognathinae growth curve.

text.zh: Tropeognathus 的阅读入口现在同时呈现数据库所录具名种材料与 2013 年较完整的大型身体标本。MN 6594-V 的鉴定保留 cf.，地点未知，翼展依赖缺失骨段的比较补全；这三项限制决定它能支持哪些形态和尺寸判断。属级介绍不把同文科级未定的其他翼骨移入本属。
text.en: This Tropeognathus guide now pairs database-recorded named species material with the more extensive large body specimen described in 2013. MN 6594-V retains a cf. identification, an unknown exact site and a wingspan reconstructed with missing segments. These limits govern its anatomical and size interpretation. Other indeterminate anhanguerid wing bones in the study are not assigned to this genus.

readerLimitations.en: Existing classification, named occurrences and age brackets retain their database-source limits. A full monograph and reader-facing delivery remain pending.

title.zh: 先读保存的头骨，再读叶片解释
title.en: Read the preserved skull before the leaf interpretation

text.zh: 从 [L. sibbicki](Ludodactylus_sibbicki/page.zh.md) 的 SMNK PAL 3828 开始，依次区分头骨与下颌、压扁与头冠切损、产地来源和形态比较。随后读叶片位置、植物类比及误吞死亡假说，再看 2018 年舌骨比较。不同证据不能合成一个已经确定的完整生活史；数据库采集记录与正模标本也分别计数。
text.en: Start with SMNK PAL 3828 in [L. sibbicki](Ludodactylus_sibbicki/page.en.md), separating skull and mandible, compression and crest cutting, provenance and morphology. Continue to leaf position, botanical analogies and the accidental-ingestion hypothesis, then the 2018 hyoid comparison. These different lines of evidence do not combine into a settled complete life history. The database collection record and the type specimen also retain their different counting units.

title.zh: 命名背景与有年份的分类归属
title.en: Naming history and dated classification

text.zh: 2003 年作者用 ludus（游戏、玩耍）与 dactylus（指）解释属名，呼应带牙而又有后方向头冠的玩具形象；种加词纪念画家 John Sibbick。原始描述把该属归入当时使用的 Ornithocheiridae 体系；本页保留这个有年份的归属和固定数据库父链，尚未核齐全部后续分类修订。
text.en: The 2003 authors explain the genus name through ludus, game or play, and dactylus, finger, referring to toy forms combining teeth with a posterior crest. The species name honors artist John Sibbick. The original description places the genus in its dated Ornithocheiridae framework. That historical attribution and the fixed database parent chain remain; all subsequent taxonomic revisions have not been inspected.

title.zh: 从斯凯岛三维骨架认识 Dearc
title.en: Meet Dearc through a three-dimensional Skye skeleton

text.zh: Dearc 的资料核心是一件三维保存的关联正模。2025 年研究扩展了其骨骼诊断，并利用骨面痕迹讨论肌肉和功能。属级名称提供阅读入口，保存缺口、单件材料与推断范围仍应在种页查看；本属不因此获得一套已实测的共同生态。
text.en: The central Dearc material is one associated holotype preserved in three dimensions. A 2025 study expands its skeletal diagnosis and uses bone landmarks to discuss muscles and function. The genus provides a reading entry; preservation gaps, single-specimen scope and inference limits remain on the species page, without establishing a measured shared ecology.

title.zh: 按保存、牙齿与飞行骨骼连续阅读
title.en: Read preservation, teeth and flight bones in sequence

text.zh: 进入 [D. sgiathanach 解剖导读](Dearc_sgiathanach/page.zh.md)，先读骨板与 CT 限制，再看牙齿、胸骨和肱骨，最后读肌肉及手爪功能解释。固定出现记录提供地点与宽年代，不能替代原始骨骼观察；目录父链也不能代替亲缘分析。
text.en: Open the [D. sgiathanach osteological guide](Dearc_sgiathanach/page.en.md), beginning with slab and CT limits, then teeth, sternum and humerus, followed by muscle and hand-claw interpretations. Fixed occurrences supply locality and broad age context without replacing anatomical observations; a stored parent chain does not replace phylogenetic analysis.

evidenceSummary: This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Seazzadactylus venieri 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Seazzadactylus。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Seazza Brook（Friuli Venezia Giulia），地区代码 IT，地层名称 Dolomia di Forni；数据库年代范围 227.3–205.7 Ma，早端地质时段 Norian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Seazza Brook (Friuli Venezia Giulia), region code IT, stratum name Dolomia di Forni; database age bracket 227.3–205.7 Ma, early interval Norian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 227.3–205.7 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 227.3–205.7 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Seazza Brook 的采集环境标签为 陆相沉积环境，类型未定（terrestrial indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Seazza Brook has collection-environment label terrestrial indet.; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

text.en: Seazza Brook carries database reference attribution Dalla Vecchia (2019), identifier ref:70608. This pass reads the 2014 anatomy, discussion, methods and tables and the 2020 name correction. Skimming, horny covering, throat pouch and air-sac function retain their hypothetical status. Captions give V18046 where the account gives V18406; material follows the account and correction with the mismatch unresolved. Specimens, figure pixels, supplementary matrices and later research have not been fully inspected. A full monograph and reader-facing delivery remain incomplete.

title.zh: 2014 年形态描述与 2020 年名称更正
title.en: The 2014 anatomical account and 2020 name correction

text.zh: 2014 年论文描述了 Ikrandraco avatar 的骨骼；2020 年作者更正指出，该电子论文未在文内提供规定的 ZooBank 注册证据，因此属名与种名不能从那篇作品取得命名可用性。更正补充注册并重述模式材料与诊断。这里将形态研究与名称可用性来源分别引用，沿用记录目录的页面身份，不自行改写分类树或署名年份。
text.en: The 2014 paper describes Ikrandraco avatar anatomy. The 2020 correction states that the electronic work lacked required evidence of ZooBank registration within the publication, so the genus- and species-group names were not available from that work. The correction supplies registration and restates type material and diagnosis. Anatomical research and nomenclatural availability are cited separately while retaining catalogue page identity without independently revising the tree or authorship year.

title.zh: 两件标本保存的身体范围不同
title.en: The two specimens preserve different parts of the body

text.zh: 正模 IVPP V18199 来自辽宁建昌喇嘛洞，保留头颌、部分颈椎、胸骨板、肋骨、双翼和足部；归入标本 IVPP V18406 来自凌源四合当，主要保存头颌与前部颈椎。两者存于北京中国科学院古脊椎动物与古人类研究所。第二件没有与第一件同样的肢骨资料，不能将两者拼成一个测量完整的理想个体。
text.en: Holotype IVPP V18199 from Lamadong, Jianchang, preserves cranial and mandibular material, part of the neck, sternum, ribs, both wings and foot material. Referred specimen IVPP V18406 from Sihedang, Lingyuan, principally preserves the head and anterior cervical vertebrae. Both are housed at the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology in Beijing. The second does not supply the same limb data as the first, so they cannot be combined into one wholly measured ideal individual.

title.zh: 侧向压扁与未知层位限制比较
title.en: Lateral flattening and unknown horizons limit comparison

text.zh: 两件化石均侧向压扁，正模有裂缝造成头端和部分翼指节错位，第二件部分皮质骨缺失。两个地点相距约 20–25 千米，确切层位未知；论文用九佛堂组约 120 Ma 的地层背景，不能据此确定两件同时死亡。头骨高度与下颌高度的差异部分被作者归因于压缩，尺寸不同也不足以单独证明不同种、性别或生长阶段。
text.en: Both fossils are laterally flattened. Fracturing displaced the cranial tip and some wing phalanges of the holotype; parts of the referred specimen’s cortical bone are missing. Sites are about 20–25 km apart and exact horizons are unknown. The paper’s approximately 120 Ma Jiufotang context does not establish simultaneous deaths. The authors attribute some differences in cranial and jaw height to compression; size differences alone do not establish distinct species, sexes or growth stages.

title.zh: 低长头部与深下颌骨冠
title.en: A low elongated head and deep mandibular crest

text.zh: 头部低而长，没有前上颌骨正中冠，牙骨腹侧却有薄而深、刀片状的骨冠。两件标本都保留骨冠后缘的钩状突起，作者认为并非保存伪影；最深处约在第九与第十下颌牙槽之间。骨冠可能覆角质鞘，但并未直接保存其完整外形或颜色；两件个体也不能证明这一结构只有一种功能。
text.en: The skull is low and elongated without a median premaxillary crest, while the ventral dentary bears a thin, deep blade-shaped crest. Both specimens preserve its posterior hook-like process, interpreted by the authors as genuine rather than an artifact, with greatest depth near the ninth and tenth lower alveoli. A horny covering is possible without a directly preserved complete contour or color; two individuals do not establish a single function for the structure.

title.zh: 小牙列支持比较，不直接记录食谱
title.en: Small teeth support comparisons without recording a diet

text.zh: 论文记每侧上颌至少二十一枚牙、下颌至少十九枚，牙槽小而椭圆，前部排列较紧。牙冠比同地层讨论的 Guidraco 和 Liaoningopterus 小，形状也不同于典型三角形、侧扁的帆翼龙科牙齿。牙列可以比较抓取猎物的假说，却没有胃内容物或直接摄食观察；不能仅以“小牙”确定唯一猎物种类。
text.en: The paper records at least twenty-one teeth per upper-jaw side and nineteen in the lower jaw, with small oval alveoli more closely spaced anteriorly. Crowns are smaller than those of Guidraco and Liaoningopterus discussed from the same formation, and differ from typical triangular, compressed istiodactylid teeth. Dentition informs prey-capture hypotheses without stomach contents or direct feeding observations; small teeth do not establish a unique prey species.

title.zh: 关联双翼与气孔提供骨骼线索
title.en: Associated wings and foramina provide skeletal evidence

text.zh: 正模的双翼虽未完全关节连接，仍紧密关联。肱骨有扭转的三角胸肌嵴，腕骨融合，第二与第三翼指节有气孔；气囊系统参与骨骼气化是作者的解释。部分前臂骨缺失，后肢只有不完整跖骨；不能据现存骨链直接恢复完整翼展、翼膜或腿部功能，更不能把骨孔当作完整软组织气囊的保存。
text.en: The holotype’s wings are closely associated despite incomplete articulation. The humerus has a warped deltopectoral crest, carpals are fused, and wing phalanges two and three have pneumatic foramina. Involvement of an air-sac system in skeletal pneumatization is the authors’ interpretation. Some forearm elements are incomplete and hindlimb material consists only of incomplete metatarsals; these do not directly restore complete span, membrane or leg function, and bone openings do not preserve whole soft-tissue air sacs.

title.zh: 融合支持成体解释，测量仍属于个体
title.en: Fusion supports adult interpretation while measurements remain individual

text.zh: 作者以正模第一翼指节伸肌腱突融合判断其为成体。表 1 记其头骨长 286.5 毫米、肱骨长 78.7 毫米；归入标本头骨长度则以大于 268.3 毫米记录，保留不完整测量的下限。表 2 的肱骨／头骨比例用于跨标本比较，不是全种固定比例或飞行能力指标。成体判断不提供确切年龄、性别或成体最大尺寸。
text.en: The authors infer adulthood from fused extensor tendon processes of the holotype’s first wing phalanges. Table 1 gives skull length as 286.5 mm and humerus length as 78.7 mm; the referred skull is recorded as greater than 268.3 mm, retaining a lower-bound measurement. Table 2 compares humerus/skull proportions across specimens rather than establishing an invariant species ratio or flight-performance measure. Adult interpretation supplies no exact age, sex or maximum adult size.

title.zh: 临时掠水与喉囊都是摄食假说
title.en: Temporary skimming and a throat pouch are feeding hypotheses

text.zh: 作者提出，低长头部和薄下颌骨冠或有利于贴近水面飞行，发现猎物后短暂将下颌浸入水中。后缘钩状突起可能锚定可伸展皮肤，形成类似喉囊的结构。这些是形态功能解释，文中没有保存本种完整喉囊或记录掠水行为；作者也指出其缺少现代剪嘴鸥的广泛适应，不把假说写成持续掠水或已验证的阻力模型。
text.en: The authors propose low flight over water, with brief mandibular immersion after detecting prey, potentially aided by the low head and thin dentary crest. The posterior hook could anchor extensible skin in a throat-pouch-like structure. These are functional interpretations without a preserved complete pouch in this species or recorded skimming behavior. The paper notes the absence of extensive modern skimmer adaptations; the proposal is neither continuous skimming nor a validated drag model.

title.zh: 系统树是 2014 年矩阵的分析结果
title.en: The tree is a result from the 2014 matrix

text.zh: 2014 年研究使用修改后的形态矩阵，将性状设为无序、等权，获得十八棵同等简约树并取严格共识。其结果把 Ikrandraco 放在 Pteranodontoidea 内、Anhangueria 外而近缘。单个下颌或头冠特征不能替代整个矩阵，本文也未重跑分析、读齐补充矩阵或核对所有后续分类意见；目录父链不因此成为唯一系统发育方案。
text.en: The 2014 study uses a modified morphological matrix with unordered, equally weighted characters, recovering eighteen equally parsimonious trees and their strict consensus. It places Ikrandraco within Pteranodontoidea, outside but close to Anhangueria. One jaw or crest feature cannot substitute for the matrix. This guide has not rerun the analysis, assembled the supplementary matrix or checked all later classifications, and the catalogue ancestry is not made the sole phylogenetic scheme.

title.zh: 对读下颌骨冠与大型比较头部
title.en: Compare mandibular crests with a large comparative skull

text.zh: 返回 [Ikrandraco 属](../page.zh.md)，先辨 2014 年骨骼研究和 2020 年名称更正，再对读 [Tropeognathus 比较标本](../../../Pteranodontia/Ornithocheiroidea/Anhangueridae/Tropeognathinae/Tropeognathus/Tropeognathus_mesembrinus/page.zh.md) 的头部保存与功能假说。头冠位置不同，相关材料的完整度与鉴定限定也不同，不能只凭近缘或沉积环境互相移用食谱、体型或行为。原图、补充资料、实物和所有后续研究仍待补齐。
text.en: Return to [Ikrandraco](../page.en.md) to distinguish the 2014 anatomical study from the 2020 nomenclatural correction, then compare cranial preservation and functional hypotheses in the [Tropeognathus comparative specimen](../../../Pteranodontia/Ornithocheiroidea/Anhangueridae/Tropeognathinae/Tropeognathus/Tropeognathus_mesembrinus/page.en.md). Crest positions, completeness and identification qualifiers differ; relatedness or depositional context does not transfer diet, size or behavior between them. Figure pixels, supplements, specimens and all later research remain incompletely assembled.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Ikrandraco avatar 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Ikrandraco。本页导读 2 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 2 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Ikrandraco avatar is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Ikrandraco. This guide uses 2 eligible species-level occurrence records from 2 collections and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Lamadong, Jianchang（Liaoning），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Jiufotang；数据库年代范围 121.4–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Aptian。采集记录 Sihedang, Lingyuan（Liaoning），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Jiufotang；数据库年代范围 121.4–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Aptian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Lamadong, Jianchang (Liaoning), region code CN, stratum name Jiufotang; database age bracket 121.4–113.2 Ma, early interval Aptian. Collection Sihedang, Lingyuan (Liaoning), region code CN, stratum name Jiufotang; database age bracket 121.4–113.2 Ma, early interval Aptian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 121.4–113.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 121.4–113.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Lamadong, Jianchang 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存、软组织（body,adpression,soft parts）。Sihedang, Lingyuan 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存、软组织（body,adpression,soft parts）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Lamadong, Jianchang has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression,soft parts. Sihedang, Lingyuan has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression,soft parts. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: 既有采集行保留 Wang et al.（2014）、ref:59181 的数据库署名；本批另补五位作者的 2014 年形态研究与 2020 年命名更正共享引文。两份原文分别限定形态和名称可用性，不把数据库接受身份当作已复核所有标本或分类意见。
text.en: Retained collection rows keep the database attribution Wang et al. (2014), ref:59181. This pass adds complete five-author shared citations for the 2014 anatomical study and 2020 nomenclatural correction, with their distinct scopes. Database acceptance is not an audit of every specimen or later classification.

evidenceSummary: The four main sections of the 2019 study, five scientific main sections of the 2021 study and the complete author correction were read; the 2024 palatal main text was also read. The 2019 page retains copyright and is used only in a short independent summary; 2021/2024 sources record CC BY 4.0. The 2014 original description, full 2017 egg-and-embryo study, supplemental data, specimens, images and model recalculation remain incomplete. Staging, flight timing, care, complete development and diet retain unresolved scope; Selected 2023 Sinopterus revision passages on holotypes, methods, statistics, crests and juvenile identification support the added species-assignment comparison; all specimen accounts, images and supplementary data were not read.

title.zh: 比较飞行模型时保留幼体鉴定分歧
title.en: Retain juvenile-identification differences when comparing flight models

text.zh: 2021 年模型使用的 IVPP V-14377 被当作 S. dongi 幼体，2023 年修订却认为它不能可靠归到该种或 H. corollatus，保留为 Sinopterinae 未定。见 [Sinopterus dongi](../../../Azhdarchoidea/Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Sinopterus/Sinopterus_dongi/page.zh.md) 的研究对读。这项后续鉴定限制模型的种级解释，没有直接重算或推翻全部力学结果，也不会把模型数值变成 Hamipterus 测量。
text.en: The 2021 models treat IVPP V-14377 as young S. dongi, whereas the 2023 revision cannot confidently refer it to that species or H. corollatus and retains it as indeterminate Sinopterinae. See the study comparison in [Sinopterus dongi](../../../Azhdarchoidea/Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Sinopterus/Sinopterus_dongi/page.en.md). This later identification limits species-specific interpretation without directly recalculating or overturning every mechanical result, and does not make model values Hamipterus measurements.

title.zh: 回到实际采用的幼体模型
title.en: Return to the hatchlings actually modeled

text.zh: 本页的飞行争论可与 [Pterodaustro guinazui](../../../Lophocratia/Pterodaustro/Pterodaustro_guinazui/page.zh.md) 对读。后者列出 2021 年模型的标本组合、翼面积缩放与肱骨负荷假设；先辨研究对象再比较论证，不能把其速度或抗弯数值改写为 Hamipterus 的性能。
text.en: Compare the flight debate here with [Pterodaustro guinazui](../../../Lophocratia/Pterodaustro/Pterodaustro_guinazui/page.en.md), which sets out the 2021 model’s specimen composites, wing-area scaling and humeral loading assumptions. Identify the modeled subject before comparing arguments; its speeds and bending values do not measure Hamipterus performance.

title.zh: 蛋与胚胎让成长问题可以分开提问
title.en: Eggs and embryos separate developmental questions

text.zh: Hamipterus 的蛋、胚胎与幼体材料，使出壳阶段成为可研究的问题。蛋内个体并不都接近出壳，后续论文因而重新讨论早期飞行能力；本页原始材料描述仍未齐。
text.en: Hamipterus eggs, embryos and young material permit developmental questions. Embryos need not all be near hatching, prompting later reassessment of early flight. Original material descriptions remain incompletely assembled here.

title.zh: 胚胎分期改变对弱骨化的解释
title.en: Embryonic staging changes the meaning of poor ossification

text.zh: 2019 年研究将胚胎 11–13 解释为较早发育阶段，区别于临近出壳材料。骨化不完全因而不能直接代表出壳幼体的状态；分期为比较推断，不是本种实际孵化日数。
text.en: The 2019 study interprets embryos 11–13 as an earlier developmental stage than near-term material. Incomplete ossification need not describe hatchlings. Comparative staging does not establish actual incubation days for this species.

title.zh: 肱骨冠小不能单独证明幼体不会飞
title.en: A small humeral crest alone does not prove flightlessness

text.zh: 2021 年作者反对以 Hamipterus 胚胎较小的三角胸肌嵴直接推出飞行肌肉不足。他们指出其形态与其他胚胎相近，而且小体型需要的肌肉绝对体积也较小。骨嵴、肌肉体积与飞行能力之间仍隔着推断；这项反驳没有直接记录本种幼体飞行，也没有确定出壳后第几小时起飞。
text.en: The 2021 authors reject inferring inadequate flight musculature solely from smaller deltopectoral crests in Hamipterus embryos. Comparable embryonic morphology and smaller absolute muscle requirements at small size weaken that inference. Crest form, muscle volume and flight ability remain separated by inference: this rebuttal neither observes Hamipterus flying nor identifies the hour after hatching when flight began.

title.zh: 定量飞行模型主要采用另外两个类群
title.en: The quantitative models primarily use two other taxa

text.zh: 2021 年研究用 Pterodaustro 与 Sinopterus 的近出壳或幼体材料建立滑翔与肱骨弯曲强度模型。翼面积由现生鸟类回归估计，体重从翼展关系估计，骨干近似为空心圆管。Hamipterus 是讨论对象，却不是这些定量模型中的本种样本；模型的速度、翼载和相对破坏力数值不能移植为本种测量。
text.en: The 2021 study models gliding and humeral bending using near-hatching or young Pterodaustro and Sinopterus material. Wing area comes from a living-bird regression, mass from wingspan scaling and shafts from hollow circular-tube approximations. Hamipterus is discussed but is not the species represented in those quantitative models. Their speeds, wing loadings and relative failure forces are not Hamipterus measurements.

title.zh: 骨强度模型仍依赖材料与保存假设
title.en: Bone-strength models retain material and preservation assumptions

text.zh: 模型以肱骨尺度与皮质厚度比较负荷承受能力，作者承认圆形截面简化了真实形状，也假定幼体与成体具有相同材料性质。部分输入跨标本组合，缺损和压扁影响可测参数。本页实际读了方法与结果，未重算模型或检查原骨切片；得到的支持是模型证据，不能标为本种飞行性能已实测。
text.en: The models compare loading capacity from humeral dimensions and cortical thickness. Circular sections simplify real shapes, and hatchlings and adults are assumed to share material properties. Some inputs combine specimens, with breakage and compression limiting measurements. Methods and results were read here without recalculation or inspection of original sections. Model support is not a measured flight-performance result for this species.

title.zh: 能早飞与接受亲代照料可以同时成立
title.en: Early flight and parental care can coexist

text.zh: 2021 年讨论明确指出，早成性不必意味着缺少亲代照料：能移动的幼体仍可能跟随亲代、接受保护或协助取食。对 Hamipterus 来说，蛋与不同成长阶段共同埋藏没有直接展示喂食或护幼。本页保留照料为未确定行为，也不把缺少直接证据反写成已经证明完全独立生活。
text.en: The 2021 discussion explicitly distinguishes precociality from an absence of parental care. Mobile offspring may still follow parents or receive protection or feeding assistance. Eggs and different growth stages buried together do not directly show Hamipterus feeding or guarding young. Care remains unresolved, and missing direct evidence does not prove wholly independent life.

title.zh: 成长中的飞行差异不是已知的完整生态史
title.en: Flight changes during growth do not establish a complete ecology

text.zh: 2021 年模型提出小幼体与大成体可能有不同速度、机动性和活动范围，从而可能利用不同环境。作者把生态位分化明确列为需要其他食性与运动资料支持的假说。这里不能据跨类群缩放，给 Hamipterus 幼体指定森林、成体指定开阔区，或列出随年龄改变的确定食谱。
text.en: The 2021 models suggest that size-related differences in speed, maneuverability and travel capacity could permit different ecological roles. The authors identify niche shifts as hypotheses requiring dietary and locomotor support. Cross-taxon scaling does not assign Hamipterus hatchlings to forests, adults to open spaces or establish a known age-dependent menu.

title.zh: 腭部扫描揭示的是融合后的骨结构
title.en: Palatal scans examine fused bone architecture

text.zh: 2024 年研究扫描 IVPP V 18943.3，并比较 V 18943.1 的腭部。扫描未揭示清晰骨缝，作者将其解释为腭骨块融合；背面结构仍提供与其他翼龙比较的线索。没有看到骨缝并不表示腭部只有一块原始骨。本页未查看原始 CT 或图像，也不由腭骨融合确定整件材料的确切岁数、性别或幼体飞行状态。
text.en: The 2024 study scans IVPP V 18943.3 and compares the palate of V 18943.1. No clear sutures were revealed, interpreted as fusion of the palatal elements; dorsal structure still supports comparison. Unseen sutures do not imply a single original palatal bone. Raw CT and images were not examined here, and fusion does not establish exact age, sex or hatchling flight status.

title.zh: 按胚胎、模型和独立腭部材料对读
title.en: Read embryos, models and separate palatal material

text.zh: 先读胚胎阶段争论，再查飞行模型真正使用的类群，最后把腭部扫描作为另一类身体证据。[Dsungaripterus weii](../../../Azhdarchoidea/Dsungaripteridae/Dsungaripterus/Dsungaripterus_weii/page.zh.md) 页可对读 CT 如何识别骨缝与重新归属腭骨。2021 年论文的作者更正仅修复两处参考文献编号；本页读的是已更正主文，未把更正写成模型数值的变动。
text.en: Begin with embryonic-stage debate, identify the taxa actually modeled, and treat palatal scans as a separate anatomical evidence class. [Dsungaripterus weii](../../../Azhdarchoidea/Dsungaripteridae/Dsungaripterus/Dsungaripterus_weii/page.en.md) provides a comparison of CT suture identification and palatal reassignment. The 2021 author correction fixes two reference numbers; the corrected main text was read here, without presenting the correction as a numerical model change.

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 137.05–132.6 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。

It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

Hami (Silutitan type locality) has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

readerLimitations.zh:
本批是 2026-10-02 PBDB 出现记录导读，不是完整物种专论。只纳入固定 276 项翼龙工作名录中，当前名称一致、父链可追到已记录 Pterosauria 存储锚点、且有可用无疑问限定种级出现记录的条目。数据库接受名可能连接旧组合；这种数据库对应关系不裁决实际标本鉴定或所有分类争议，也不与 COL 同名概念合并。采集地点、地层区间、沉积环境和集合保存方式各有不同含义：它们不能直接推出完整分布、起源或灭绝时刻、该物种的固定生态、生物数量或每件标本的保存状态。原始描述、重描述、形态、食性和行为材料尚未逐项补齐；。
新增段落依据 Zhou 等 2017 年原文全部主要科学段落（摘要、介绍、方法、系统描述与讨论）和图 1–3 图注；未查看图像像素、补充材料／矩阵或实物，未重算系统树和统计分析。头骨测量、地层测年、梳状齿列的滤食解释、食性类别与实际摄食分别处理；“最早”限定为作者 2017 年判断。类群比较另沿用 P5-139 实际阅读的 2023 年 Balaenognathus 选段，不把其泵吸模型移到本种。无完整种志。
readerLimitations.en:
This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;
New paragraphs use all main scientific sections of Zhou et al. (2017): abstract, introduction, methods, systematic description and discussion, with captions 1–3. Figure pixels, supplements/matrices and specimens were not examined, and trees/statistical analyses were not rerun. Skull measurements, stratigraphic dates, comb-dentition filtering interpretations, dietary categories and observed feeding remain separate; “earliest” is bounded to the authors’ 2017 judgment. Group comparisons also use the 2023 Balaenognathus selections actually read in P5-139 without transferring its pumping model to this species.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Zhangjiagou, Sihetun (IVPP)（Liaoning），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Yixian；数据库年代范围 125.77–119.57 Ma，早端地质时段 Late Barremian、晚端时段 Early Aptian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Zhangjiagou, Sihetun (IVPP) (Liaoning), region code CN, stratum name Yixian; database age bracket 125.77–119.57 Ma, early interval Late Barremian and late interval Early Aptian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 125.77–119.57 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 125.77–119.57 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Zhangjiagou, Sihetun (IVPP) 的采集环境标签为 陆相沉积环境，类型未定（terrestrial indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存（body,adpression）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Zhangjiagou, Sihetun (IVPP) has collection-environment label terrestrial indet.; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Zhangjiagou, Sihetun (IVPP) 的数据库引文署名为 Jiang and Wang（2011），编号 ref:55593。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Zhangjiagou, Sihetun (IVPP) carries database reference attribution Jiang and Wang (2011), identifier ref:55593. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

evidenceSummary: This page retains the fixed database occurrence scope and the material, assumptions and correction of the 2021 hatchling-flight models, adding text, table and captions from the 2008 growth and 2023 jaw-histology studies. Eleven MIC-V55 sections belong to one specimen. Attachment, tooth generations, diet and sexual maturity retain inferential limits. Images, specimens, sections and raw data were not independently examined, and models were not rerun. Original descriptions and subsequent literature remain incomplete. Database counts, ages, parent chains and maturity states remain; full reader delivery is pending.

title.zh: 细丝牙齿构成紧密的过滤结构
title.en: Filamentous teeth form a close filtering structure

text.zh: Pterodaustro 的长头骨向上弯曲，下颌的细丝状牙齿与上颌短小、冠部呈匙状的牙齿形成鲜明差异。2023 年论文观察到牙本质、牙髓腔和薄釉质层，支持细丝是真正牙齿。它们的牙根紧贴排列在同一沟内；作者认为这种排列有助于闭颌时保留食物颗粒。过滤功能来自形态与组织学解释，这项研究没有测量过滤效率或直接确定食物种类。
text.en: The long skull curves upward, with filamentous lower teeth differing from short upper teeth with spatulate crowns. The 2023 study records dentine, pulp cavities and thin enamel, supporting their identity as true teeth. Closely packed roots share a groove; the authors interpret this arrangement as helping retain food particles during jaw closure. Morphology and histology support filtering, while this study neither measures filtering efficiency nor identifies actual food items.

title.zh: 十一张薄片来自一件下颌材料
title.en: Eleven sections come from one jaw specimen

text.zh: 2023 年采样对象 MIC-V55 是阿根廷 San Luis 省 Loma del Pterodaustro、Lagarcito Formation 层状页岩中的一件部分骨架。作者从含左右下颌及牙齿的一块材料制作四张横切片与七张冠状切片，用偏光显微镜观察。十一张薄片增加的是同一件材料的观察方向；它们不是十一只动物，也不能直接覆盖全部年龄与上颌牙齿。
text.en: MIC-V55 is a partial skeleton from laminated shales of the Lagarcito Formation at Loma del Pterodaustro, San Luis, Argentina. Four transverse and seven coronal sections were made from one block containing left and right lower jaws and teeth, then examined with a polarizing microscope. Eleven sections provide different views of one specimen; they do not represent eleven animals or cover every age and the upper dentition.

title.zh: 沟内排列与牙齿附着分别判断
title.en: Groove geometry and tooth attachment require separate evidence

text.zh: 细丝牙齿所在区域没有把相邻牙根分开的骨隔，支持作者的沟植齿解释。2023 年论文引言另注明最前七颗较粗的下颌牙齿有独立齿槽，因此不能把所切区域推广成整副牙列的统一结构。薄片未显示典型牙骨质、Sharpey 纤维或牙周韧带附着痕迹；牙根与沟壁接触紧密，却可能受化石压扁影响。作者仍无法确定牙齿是否与颌骨骨性融合。
text.en: No bony partitions separate neighboring roots in the filamentous region, supporting the authors’ aulacodont, or groove-set, interpretation. Their introduction separately notes individual sockets for the first seven thicker lower teeth, so the sampled region does not define the entire dentition. Typical cementum, Sharpey’s fibres and ligament attachment traces are absent. Tight root-to-wall contact could reflect fossil compression, leaving fusion of teeth to jaw bone unresolved.

title.zh: 缺少替换牙仍留下一生换牙次数的疑问
title.en: Missing replacement teeth leave lifetime tooth generations unresolved

text.zh: MIC-V55 的薄片没有替换牙，少数重叠牙齿被作者解释为破裂或移位。作者据此反对细丝牙齿反复替换的解释，但不能区分一生只有一代牙，还是曾有一次替换。牙本质中也没有辨认出可用于计时的 von Ebner 生长线；其缺失可能与保存或生长方式有关，无法据此计算牙齿形成及替换速率。这些限制针对本次材料，未解决所有牙齿与全部生长阶段。
text.en: The MIC-V55 sections lack replacement teeth; occasional overlaps are interpreted as breakage or displacement. The authors argue against repeated replacement of the filamentous teeth but cannot distinguish one lifetime generation from two. No von Ebner growth lines were identified in dentine, with preservation and formation patterns still possible explanations. Tooth formation and replacement rates therefore remain unavailable, and this material does not resolve every tooth or developmental stage.

title.zh: 从多种长骨拼出生长证据
title.en: Growth evidence combines several long bones

text.zh: 2008 年研究对不同大小个体的肱骨、股骨、胫骨等取样，也比较同一骨架中的不同骨。作者按各骨长度相对最大已知同类骨的比例组织样本；这个比例不是实测体重比例。股骨、胫骨和桡骨较适合保留生长记录，肱骨早期重塑会削弱年龄判读。薄片中的快慢生长区和生长停滞线，需要在比较骨种、取样位置与保存质量后阅读。
text.en: The 2008 study samples humeri, femora, tibiae and other bones across differently sized individuals and compares bones within skeletons. Relative size uses each element’s length against the largest known corresponding element, rather than measured body mass. Femora, tibiae and radii better preserve growth records; early humeral remodeling limits age inference. Fast and slow deposition zones and arrested-growth lines require attention to bone identity, section position and preservation.

title.zh: 骨组织支持分阶段生长与最终停止
title.en: Bone tissue supports phased growth and eventual cessation

text.zh: 2008 年作者把年轻个体的纤维板层骨解释为快速生长，较大个体中更紧密的停滞线和骨端变化支持生长减慢与最终停止。把周期当作每年一轮，是与其他爬行动物比较后的假设。作者提出约两年、约最大参照骨长度的 53% 时开始性成熟，此后仍继续长大数年；性成熟来自生长变化解释，没有直接观察繁殖。论文对后续生长年数的摘要与讨论表述不同，因此这里保留“数年”，不把整条生长曲线当作已精确测定的寿命。
text.en: The 2008 authors interpret young individuals’ fibrolamellar bone as rapid growth, with closer growth marks and changes at bone ends supporting later slowing and cessation. Annual cycles are assumed by comparison with other reptiles. They propose sexual maturity at about two years and approximately 53% of the largest reference bone length, followed by several more years of growth. Maturity is inferred from changing deposition, not observed reproduction. Later-growth durations differ between abstract and discussion, so the curve does not establish a precisely measured lifespan.

title.zh: 近出壳骨骼让飞行问题可以量化
title.en: Near-hatching skeletons make flight questions quantifiable

text.zh: 2021 年研究用 Pterodaustro guinazui 的胚胎与幼体材料检验早期飞行，结合滑翔预测与肱骨抗弯模型。它支持作者的早期主动飞行解释，但化石没有记录起飞动作；本页也不由一项模型补成完整生活史。
text.en: The 2021 study uses embryonic and hatchling Pterodaustro guinazui material to investigate early flight through glide predictions and humeral bending models. These support the authors’ early powered-flight interpretation, while fossils do not record takeoff itself and one model does not supply a complete life history.

title.zh: 三个标本提供两组幼体模型
title.en: Three specimens supply two hatchling models

text.zh: 作者使用 MHIN-UNSL-GEO-V 237、MHIN-UNSL-GEO-V 241 和胚胎 MMP 1168 的资料，构建约 0.244 与 0.290 米翼展的两组幼体模型。MMP 1168 的切片提供皮质厚度，另外两件提供骨干尺度，因为没有一件幼体肱骨同时具备全部所需参数。模型组合不是两个完整个体的全部直接测量，固定数据库的两条出现行也不与这三件标本强行对应。
text.en: Data from MHIN-UNSL-GEO-V 237, MHIN-UNSL-GEO-V 241 and embryo MMP 1168 supply two hatchling models with wingspans of about 0.244 and 0.290 m. A section from MMP 1168 supplies cortical thickness, while the other specimens supply shaft dimensions: no hatchling humerus provides all required inputs. The composites are not complete direct measurements of two individuals, and the two fixed database occurrence rows are not forcibly matched to these specimens.

title.zh: 翼面积与质量从缩放关系估计
title.en: Wing area and mass are estimated from scaling

text.zh: 体重由翼展缩放关系估计，翼面积借用 90 种现生鸟类的回归，滑翔再用飞行软件预测。作者承认鸟类回归可能遗漏翼龙翼膜的具体差异，并设置了翼展收缩及最大升力系数等输入。因此翼面积、质量与速度是模型量，不是从本种化石直接测得的软组织和飞行记录。
text.en: Mass is estimated from wingspan scaling, wing area from a regression of 90 living bird species, and gliding from flight software. The authors acknowledge that the bird regression may miss details of pterosaur membranes, and set inputs such as span reduction and maximum lift coefficient. Area, mass and speed are model quantities rather than directly preserved soft tissues or recorded flights.

title.zh: 滑翔距离与速度各有模型条件
title.en: Glide distance and speed have model conditions

text.zh: 表 2 的两组 Pterodaustro 幼体在最佳滑翔条件下，预测速度约 6.8 与 7.2 米每秒，滑翔比约 13.2 与 13.1；滑翔比表示前进距离与下降高度的比值。这些不是实测最高速度，也不证明会从树上起飞。与作者设定的成体模型比较时，幼体预测速度较低、长距离滑翔效率较低；成体输入不代表已经测定全种最大体型。
text.en: For the two Pterodaustro hatchling models, Table 2 predicts best-glide speeds of about 6.8 and 7.2 m/s and glide ratios of about 13.2 and 13.1. The ratio compares forward travel with height lost. These are neither measured maximum speeds nor proof of tree launching. Compared with the study’s adult model, hatchlings have lower predicted speeds and poorer long-distance glide performance; adult inputs do not establish the species’ maximum size.

title.zh: 抗弯强度支持飞行解释但依赖材料假设
title.en: Bending strength supports flight inference under material assumptions

text.zh: 表 1 的两组幼体肱骨相对破坏力约为体重的 14.32 与 12.91 倍。模型把骨干近似为空心圆管，采用悬臂负荷，并借鸟骨材料参数，假定幼体与成体具有相同材料性质。这支持作者关于幼体能承受起飞和飞行负荷的解释，却没有直接测量拍翼肌肉、真实起飞负荷或疲劳损伤；本页未复算或重新检查切片。
text.en: Table 1 gives relative failure forces of about 14.32 and 12.91 times body weight for the two hatchling humeral models. Shafts are approximated as hollow circular tubes under cantilever loading, with bird-bone material parameters and shared hatchling/adult material properties. This supports the authors’ interpretation of capacity for launch and flight loading, without directly measuring flapping muscles, actual launch loads or fatigue damage. Models and sections were not independently reexamined here.

title.zh: 成长中的生态变化仍是假说
title.en: Ecological changes during growth remain hypotheses

text.zh: 作者提出体型增加可能改变速度、机动性和长距离移动能力，让幼体与成体利用不同机会；论文同时要求食性和地面运动研究提供支持。不能据模型给本种幼体指定森林、成体指定开阔地或确定年龄食谱。能早飞也不排除亲代保护或喂养，本项研究没有直接观察本种照料。
text.en: The authors propose that growth changes speed, maneuverability and long-distance travel, potentially creating different opportunities for young and adults. They also require dietary and terrestrial-locomotion evidence. The models do not assign this species’ young to forests, adults to open land or establish an age-specific diet. Early flight does not exclude parental protection or feeding, which this study does not directly observe.

title.zh: 对照真正建模的材料与胚胎争论
title.en: Compare modeled material with embryonic debate

text.zh: 先查三个标本怎样组合输入，再读模型预测和推断范围。[Hamipterus tianshanensis](../../../Pteranodontoidea/Hamipterus/Hamipterus_tianshanensis/page.zh.md) 提供胚胎分期、肌肉骨嵴与照料争论的对读入口：它在论文中被讨论，但上述 Pterodaustro 数值不能移植为 Hamipterus 的测量。2021 年作者更正只修复两处引用编号，没有报告这些模型数值变化。
text.en: Begin with how three specimens supply model inputs, then read predictions and their inferential scope. [Hamipterus tianshanensis](../../../Pteranodontoidea/Hamipterus/Hamipterus_tianshanensis/page.en.md) offers a route through embryonic staging, muscle crests and care: it is discussed in the paper, but these Pterodaustro values cannot become Hamipterus measurements. The 2021 author correction fixes two citation numbers without reporting changes to these model values.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Pterodaustro guinazui 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Pterodaustro。本页导读 2 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 2 个采集记录和 2 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Pterodaustro guinazui is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Pterodaustro. This guide uses 2 eligible species-level occurrence records from 2 collections and 2 reference identifiers. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Loma del Pterodaustro，地区代码 AR，地层名称 Lagarcito；数据库年代范围 113.2–100.5 Ma，早端地质时段 Albian。采集记录 Hualtarán, Quebrada Larga（San Luis），地区代码 AR，地层名称 La Cruz；数据库年代范围 121.4–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Aptian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Loma del Pterodaustro, region code AR, stratum name Lagarcito; database age bracket 113.2–100.5 Ma, early interval Albian. Collection Hualtarán, Quebrada Larga (San Luis), region code AR, stratum name La Cruz; database age bracket 121.4–113.2 Ma, early interval Aptian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 121.4–100.5 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 121.4–100.5 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Loma del Pterodaustro 的采集环境标签为 alluvial fan；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。Hualtarán, Quebrada Larga 的采集环境标签为 alluvial fan；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Loma del Pterodaustro has collection-environment label alluvial fan; collection preservation-mode label body. Hualtarán, Quebrada Larga has collection-environment label alluvial fan; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Loma del Pterodaustro 的数据库引文署名为 Fox（1997），编号 ref:5800。Hualtarán, Quebrada Larga 的数据库引文署名为 Bonaparte and Sánchez（1975），编号 ref:29145。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Loma del Pterodaustro carries database reference attribution Fox (1997), identifier ref:5800. Hualtarán, Quebrada Larga carries database reference attribution Bonaparte and Sánchez (1975), identifier ref:29145. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

readerLimitations.zh: 本页保留固定数据库出现记录和 2021 年幼体飞行模型的材料、假设及修正范围，补入 2008 年骨组织生长与 2023 年下颌牙齿研究的正文、表格和图说。MIC-V55 的十一张薄片属于一件标本；牙齿附着、换牙次数、食物种类和性成熟仍有推断限制。未独立检查图像、实物、薄片、原始数据或重跑模型，未读齐命名描述及后续文献。数据库计数、年代、父链和成熟度不变；完整读者交付仍未完成
readerLimitations.en: This page retains the fixed database occurrence scope and the material, assumptions and correction of the 2021 hatchling-flight models, adding text, table and captions from the 2008 growth and 2023 jaw-histology studies. Eleven MIC-V55 sections belong to one specimen. Attachment, tooth generations, diet and sexual maturity retain inferential limits. Images, specimens, sections and raw data were not independently examined, and models were not rerun. Original descriptions and subsequent literature remain incomplete. Database counts, ages, parent chains and maturity states remain; full reader delivery is pending.

evidenceSummary: This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

text.zh: 采集记录 Huanhe River, Sanshilipu（Gansu），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Huachi-Huanhe；数据库年代范围 137.05–100.5 Ma，早端地质时段 Valanginian、晚端时段 Albian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。

scope.zh: PBDB 接受名、外部 OID 和记录父链；不与 COL 概念等同，不裁决系统发育。
scope.en: PBDB accepted name, external OID and recorded parent chain; no equivalence with COL or phylogenetic adjudication.

readerLimitations.zh: 本批是 2026-10-02 PBDB 出现记录导读，不是完整物种专论。只纳入固定 276 项翼龙工作名录中，当前名称一致、父链可追到已记录 Pterosauria 存储锚点、且有可用无疑问限定种级出现记录的条目。数据库接受名可能连接旧组合；这种数据库对应关系不裁决实际标本鉴定或所有分类争议，也不与 COL 同名概念合并。采集地点、地层区间、沉积环境和集合保存方式各有不同含义：它们不能直接推出完整分布、起源或灭绝时刻、该物种的固定生态、生物数量或每件标本的保存状态。原始描述、重描述、形态、食性和行为材料尚未逐项补齐；。
readerLimitations.en: This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;
