title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Feilongus youngi 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Feilongus。本页导读 2 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 2 个采集记录和 2 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Feilongus youngi is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Feilongus. This guide uses 2 eligible species-level occurrence records from 2 collections and 2 reference identifiers. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Heitizigou（Liaoning），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Yixian；数据库年代范围 125.77–119.57 Ma，早端地质时段 Late Barremian、晚端时段 Early Aptian。采集记录 Gonggao, Chaoyang（Liaoning），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Jiufotang；数据库年代范围 121.4–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Aptian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Heitizigou (Liaoning), region code CN, stratum name Yixian; database age bracket 125.77–119.57 Ma, early interval Late Barremian and late interval Early Aptian. Collection Gonggao, Chaoyang (Liaoning), region code CN, stratum name Jiufotang; database age bracket 121.4–113.2 Ma, early interval Aptian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 125.77–113.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 125.77–113.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Heitizigou 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存、软组织（body,adpression,soft parts）。Gonggao, Chaoyang 的采集环境标签为 陆相沉积环境，类型未定（terrestrial indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存（body,adpression）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Heitizigou has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression,soft parts. Gonggao, Chaoyang has collection-environment label terrestrial indet.; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Heitizigou 的数据库引文署名为 Wang et al.（2005），编号 ref:26685。Gonggao, Chaoyang 的数据库引文署名为 Wang et al.（2014），编号 ref:50279。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Heitizigou carries database reference attribution Wang et al. (2005), identifier ref:26685. Gonggao, Chaoyang carries database reference attribution Wang et al. (2014), identifier ref:50279. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

evidenceSummary: Selected 2023 passages on jaw identity, material and classification are added alongside dated earlier descriptions. Sources disagree over upper/lower-jaw interpretation, treatment in an earlier analysis and the Xericeps type horizon; those differences remain visible. All images, supplements, specimens, matrices and subsequent studies have not been inspected, and no reidentification, remeasurement or classification adjudication occurred. Fixed database counts, ages and parent chains remain;

title.zh: 2023 年再次把同一正模解释为下颌
title.en: The 2023 study returns to a lower-jaw interpretation

text.zh: FSAC-KK 26 的标本身份没有改变：2010 年命名论文把它视为下颌，2020 年解释为上颌吻部，2023 年 Smith 等又暂定为下颌。新比较把正模后部的结构解释为一对前方不相接的骨突，并把有单个中央突起的 FSAC-KK 5204、5205 归作上颌吻部。作者结合横截面、骨孔分布与侧面夹角区分上下颌。这里保留三次解释的年份；2023 年的暂定判断不等于重新鉴定实物，也没有产生第二件正模。
text.en: FSAC-KK 26 retains its specimen identity: the 2010 naming paper interprets it as a lower jaw, the 2020 study as a rostrum, and Smith and colleagues in 2023 tentatively return to a lower jaw. Their comparison interprets the posterior modification as paired projections that do not meet anteriorly, while referring FSAC-KK 5204 and 5205, with a single median boss, as upper jaws. Cross sections, foramina and lateral angles contribute to that distinction. The three dated interpretations remain visible; the tentative 2023 interpretation is not a new specimen identification made here or a second holotype.

title.zh: 颌骨修订与孤立身体骨骼分开阅读
title.en: Separate revised jaw referrals from isolated body bones

text.zh: 2023 年介绍扩大了归入 Alanqa 的颌部比较材料，并重新处理部分历史归属。它把 FSAC-KK 28 记为 Azhdarchoidea 未定的颌部形态型 A；讨论指出旧文归入 Alanqa 的颈椎 CMN 50801、LINHM 014、FSAC-KK 5077 应保留为 Azhdarchidae 未定，肱骨 CMN 50814 为 Azhdarchoidea 未定。没有关联材料时，这些孤立身体骨骼不能确定归入某个凭颌骨命名的属或种。文中 UOP-PAL KK 0006 与 FSAC-KK 5213 是同一私人收藏标本的两个三维打印模型，不能按两个原始个体计数。
text.en: The 2023 account expands jaw comparisons referred to Alanqa and revisits historical referrals. It identifies FSAC-KK 28 as indeterminate Azhdarchoidea jaw morphotype A. Cervicals CMN 50801, LINHM 014 and FSAC-KK 5077, previously referred to Alanqa in earlier work, remain indeterminate Azhdarchidae in this discussion; humerus CMN 50814 is indeterminate Azhdarchoidea. Without associated material, isolated body bones cannot be assigned with certainty to a genus or species named from jaws. UOP-PAL KK 0006 and FSAC-KK 5213 are two three-dimensional print models of one privately held specimen, not two original individuals.

title.zh: 成对骨突影响分类比较，但不裁定亲缘树
title.en: Paired projections affect comparison without resolving the tree

text.zh: 2023 年作者认为，Alanqa 正模后部的两条骨突不在前方相接，因而反对把它们当成单个 V 形嵴来支持某些既有亲缘解释；他们仍把 Alanqa 放在 Azhdarchidae。文章也讨论不同分析对正模上下颌身份的处理。2020 与 2023 年对一项较早分析采用哪种身份的叙述并不一致，不能把这些转述直接当成已重查的矩阵编码。这里呈现 2023 年的论证和分歧，不重跑系统发育分析，也不宣称已核齐后续研究或确定统一分类。
text.en: The 2023 authors argue that the two posterior projections on the Alanqa type do not meet anteriorly, questioning comparisons that treat them as one V-shaped ridge in earlier relationship hypotheses. They retain Alanqa in Azhdarchidae and discuss how analyses treated its upper- or lower-jaw identity. The 2020 and 2023 accounts differ in describing the identity used by one earlier analysis; those reports cannot stand in for inspection of its matrix coding. This guide presents the 2023 argument and disagreement without rerunning phylogenetic analyses or claiming a complete review of subsequent studies or a settled classification.

title.zh: 同一正模，两个年代的解剖解释
title.en: One type specimen, two dated anatomical interpretations

text.zh: Alanqa saharica 的正模为 FSAC-KK 26，保存在摩洛哥卡萨布兰卡 Université Hassan II 的 Faculté des Sciences Ain Chock。2010 年命名论文将其视为近完整的下颌联合；2020 年 Kem Kem 综合研究把同一件材料改释为上颌吻部，并记为 2008 年在 Aferdou N’Chaft 原位采集。这里保留同一正模身份，按年代区分解剖解释，不把重新解释当作第二件标本或新的出现记录。
text.en: The holotype of Alanqa saharica is FSAC-KK 26, housed at the Faculté des Sciences Ain Chock, Université Hassan II, Casablanca, Morocco. The 2010 naming paper interprets it as an almost complete mandibular symphysis. The 2020 Kem Kem study reinterprets the same material as a rostrum and records in-situ collection at Aferdou N’Chaft in 2008. The type identity is retained while anatomical interpretations are separated by date; reinterpretation does not create a second specimen or occurrence.

title.zh: 三块相接颌部碎片仍有缺损
title.en: Three adjoining jaw fragments retain missing portions

text.zh: 2010 年描述的正模由三块相接的橙褐色碎片组成，合计保存长度 344 毫米；前端缺失，中段腹侧也有损坏。作者据边缘延长及近缘比较估计缺失前端可能达 80 毫米，这不是实测保存长度。材料保留立体形态与细薄骨壁，有助于比较横截面；它仍不是完整头骨，更不是头部与身体保持连接的骨架。
text.en: The 2010 description records three adjoining orange-brown fragments with a combined preserved length of 344 mm, missing the anterior tip and part of the ventral intermediate fragment. Extending the margins and comparing related forms suggests up to 80 mm of missing tip; that is reconstruction, not preserved length. Three-dimensional form and thin bone walls help compare cross sections, but the material is neither a complete skull nor an associated head-and-body skeleton.

title.zh: 笔直无齿颌缘与突起的解释
title.en: Straight toothless margins and interpretations of the boss

text.zh: 2010 年作者据所归入的五件颌部材料没有齿槽，将本种描述为无齿，并强调笔直颌缘、细长形态及由近三角形变为 Y 形的横截面。正模后部明显突起当时被解释为下颌联合上的 V 形中线结构；2020 年改释为上颌吻部后，讨论的是腭面突起与下颌咬合面的对应。骨孔和沟槽被用于讨论喙鞘的血管神经供应，不是保存的完整喙鞘或确定食谱的证据。
text.en: The 2010 authors describe the taxon as toothless from absent alveoli in the five assigned jaw specimens, emphasizing straight margins, slender form and a cross section changing from near-triangular to Y-shaped. A posterior prominence on the type was interpreted as a V-shaped midline structure of the mandibular symphysis. After the 2020 rostral reinterpretation, the discussion concerns a palatal boss and corresponding mandibular occlusal surfaces. Foramina and grooves inform a proposed vascular and neural supply to a beak sheath; they do not preserve a complete sheath or establish a diet.

title.zh: 历史归入材料不是一件配套头骨
title.en: Historically referred pieces are not one associated skull

text.zh: 2010 年论文另归入 BSP 1996 I 36、FSAC-KK 31、BSP 1993 IX 338 和 FSAC-KK 27。FSAC-KK 31 来自 Boumerade，FSAC-KK 27 来自 Aferdou N’Chaft；两件 BSP 材料的出处原文仅写“可能近 Taouz”。作者按形态与尺寸比较归属这些碎片；图中把正模与另一件吻部材料拼作颌部复原，不表示它们来自同一个体。后来的正模解剖改释，也要求按来源审读旧的上下颌配对。
text.en: The 2010 paper additionally refers BSP 1996 I 36, FSAC-KK 31, BSP 1993 IX 338 and FSAC-KK 27. FSAC-KK 31 comes from Boumerade and FSAC-KK 27 from Aferdou N’Chaft, whereas the BSP provenance is only “possibly near Taouz.” Attribution compares morphology and size. A figure matches the type with another rostral specimen for jaw reconstruction, not as demonstrated parts of one individual. The later anatomical reinterpretation of the type also requires reading those historical upper/lower-jaw matches in their source context.

title.zh: 颈椎归属保留未定种限定
title.en: The cervical fragment retains indeterminate attribution

text.zh: FSAC-KK 34 是一段颈椎后端，2010 年系统描述列为 Azhdarchidae gen. et sp. indet.，并未正式归入 Alanqa saharica。横跨突起的保存宽度为 83 毫米；与 Quetzalcoatlus 材料比较让作者推测较大翼展，但不是本种完整翼骨的测量。2020 年研究指出，Kem Kem 已有另一命名类群 Xericeps，因此不能再默认当地所有这类头后材料都属于 Alanqa。
text.en: FSAC-KK 34 is a posterior cervical fragment listed in the 2010 systematic account as Azhdarchidae gen. et sp. indet., without formal assignment to Alanqa saharica. Its preserved width across the projections is 83 mm. Comparison with Quetzalcoatlus material suggests a larger wingspan to the authors, not a measurement from complete wings of this species. The 2020 study notes another named Kem Kem taxon, Xericeps, so local postcranial remains cannot automatically be assigned to Alanqa.

title.zh: 翼展与颌长都依赖比较假设
title.en: Wingspan and jaw length depend on comparisons

text.zh: 2010 年作者以 Quetzalcoatlus 的下颌联合比例推算正模下颌约 0.675 米；这依赖正模为下颌联合的原解释及借用比例。2010 年摘要和 2020 年讨论给正模个体约 3–4 米翼展，也是比较估计，不是直接量得的完整翼展。常见的约 6 米说法涉及未正式归种的较大颈椎材料，不能作本种已确认的最大值；上颌改释也不能自动变成新的颌长或翼展复算。
text.en: The 2010 authors use a Quetzalcoatlus symphyseal proportion to estimate a mandibular length near 0.675 m for the type, depending on its original lower-jaw interpretation and borrowed proportions. The 2010 abstract and 2020 discussion give roughly 3–4 m wingspan for the type individual as a comparative estimate, not a measured complete span. The often cited approximately 6 m estimate concerns larger cervical material without formal species attribution and cannot establish a confirmed maximum for Alanqa. Reinterpreting the type as a rostrum does not itself recalculate jaw length or wingspan.

title.zh: 类群位置与可能异名仍需更多材料
title.en: Relationships and possible synonymy need more material

text.zh: 2020 年研究讨论此前把 Alanqa 放入 thalassodromid 的分析，同时指出该分析使用了正模为下颌联合的假设；该文自己的比较则支持 Azhdarchidae。它还提出 Alanqa 与 Xericeps 可能相关、甚至可能为异名，但明确需要更完整材料来确认或否定。这些是具名研究的解释与假说，不在本页裁决；固定 PBDB 身份、父链和出现记录继续保留，后续分类文献仍待补齐。
text.en: The 2020 study discusses an earlier analysis placing Alanqa among thalassodromids and notes its assumption that the type was a mandibular symphysis; its own comparisons support Azhdarchidae. It also raises a possible relationship or synonymy with Xericeps, explicitly requiring more complete remains to demonstrate or reject synonymy. These are dated interpretations and hypotheses rather than decisions made here. Fixed PBDB identities, parent chains and occurrences are retained, with later classification literature still incomplete.

title.zh: 从正模改释读到材料归属
title.en: Read from type reinterpretation to specimen attribution

text.zh: 先读正模的 2010／2020 年解剖解释，再分开比较颌部碎片与未定种颈椎；最后回到采集记录查看地点和年代。对照关联骨架的研究时，尤其区分直接肢骨比例与孤立颌部依赖的比较估计；两类资料都不直接观察飞行或食性。
text.en: Start with the 2010/2020 interpretations of the type, then separate jaw fragments from the indeterminate cervical material before returning to locality and age records. In comparison with an associated skeleton, isolated jaw material depends more heavily on borrowed proportions; neither kind of material directly observes flight or feeding.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 100.5–93.9 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 100.5–93.9 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 72.2–66 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 72.2–66 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.zh: 正模下颌与后来更新的馆藏号
title.en: The type mandible and its updated collection number

text.zh: 2005 年命名 Bakonydraco galaczi 时，正模 MTM Gyn/3 是近完整、无齿的下颌；副模 MTM Gyn/4 包含 21 段齿骨联合碎片，收藏于布达佩斯的匈牙利自然历史博物馆。2011 年把正模号对应为 MTM 2007.110.1、副模号对应为 MTM 2007.111.1，并另外归入 22 段下颌联合碎片 MTM V 2010.74.1–22。这些更新号不是额外发现的正模，碎片数也不是已确定的个体数。
text.en: When Bakonydraco galaczi was named in 2005, holotype MTM Gyn/3 was a nearly complete toothless mandible; paratype MTM Gyn/4 comprised 21 dentary symphyseal fragments, held at the Hungarian Natural History Museum, Budapest. The 2011 paper maps the holotype to MTM 2007.110.1 and the paratype to MTM 2007.111.1, and refers another 22 symphyseal fragments, MTM V 2010.74.1–22. Updated numbers do not represent an additional holotype, and fragment counts are not established individual counts.

title.zh: 约 29 厘米的下颌保留哪些形状
title.en: What the approximately 29 cm mandible preserves

text.zh: 原始描述记录下颌长约 29 厘米，前部联合约占下颌支长度的一半。俯视轮廓呈三角形，联合前部尖而侧向压扁；其背面向后上方弯起，在后方结束于一条横嵴，并带两列裂隙状骨孔。作者还描述未分成内外两窝的关节窝。下颌支有轻度背腹压缩，侧壁破碎、骨缝不可辨；骨形描述不能消除这些保存限制。
text.en: The original description records a mandible about 29 cm long, with the symphysis extending approximately half the ramus length. Its dorsal outline is triangular, and the anterior symphysis is pointed and laterally compressed. The dorsal surface curves posterodorsally to a transverse ridge and bears two rows of slit-like foramina. The authors also describe a glenoid fossa not divided into medial and lateral cotyles. Slight dorsoventral compression has crushed ramus walls and obscured sutures; anatomical descriptions retain these preservation limits.

title.zh: 2011 年补入的上颌吻部
title.en: The upper-jaw rostrum added in 2011

text.zh: 2011 年归入本种的 MTM V 2010.80.1 是保存长 114 毫米的无齿前上颌片段。作者根据较钝的侧缘、背侧骨脊而非头冠、尖端侧面夹角、单一中央通道和骨孔分布，将它与下颌联合区分。保存段没有矢状冠迹象，后部受压，鼻眶前孔前缘位置不清。114 毫米是片段长度；没有完整头骨或同一个体上下颌连接的证据。
text.en: The 2011 paper refers MTM V 2010.80.1, a toothless premaxillary fragment preserving 114 mm, to this species. The authors distinguish it from mandibular symphyses using blunter lateral edges, a dorsal keel rather than a crest, tip angle, a single median canal and foraminal distribution. The preserved portion shows no sagittal crest; posterior crushing leaves the anterior margin of the nasoantorbital fenestra uncertain. The 114 mm measurement is a fragment length, without a complete skull or evidence joining both jaws in one individual.

title.zh: 骨质上下颌之间的空隙与未知的角质喙鞘
title.en: Bony jaw gaps and the unknown keratinous covering

text.zh: 2011 年将上颌片段与下颌对比复原时，发现较直的上颌咬合面与带弯曲和横嵴的下颌前部不能严密相合。作者认为表面营养孔间接支持角质喙鞘，但喙鞘的厚度、切缘结构、前伸长度和准确范围未知。因此，骨质表面间的不规则接触不能直接给出活体闭嘴形状、咬合效率或某一种取食动作；这种复原仍依赖分离材料的比较。
text.en: Matching the upper-jaw fragment to the mandible in the 2011 reconstruction reveals that the straighter upper occlusal surface does not closely fit the curved, transversely ridged anterior mandible. The authors interpret nutritive foramina as indirect support for a keratinous rhamphotheca, but its thickness, cutting edges, anterior extension and exact extent remain unknown. Irregular contact between bony surfaces therefore establishes neither the living closed-beak outline nor biting efficiency or one feeding action. This reconstruction relies on comparison of isolated material.

title.zh: 同地颈椎和翼骨保留未定种归属
title.en: Local neck and wing bones retain indeterminate species referrals

text.zh: 2005 年把分离颈椎与若干肢骨放在 Azhdarchidae indet. 下，并明确没有直接证据将它们归入 B. galaczi。作者认为同地可能属于本种，但没有关联骨架。2011 年新增材料继续区分本种颌部、Azhdarchidae indet. 和 Pterodactyloidea indet.；多数新增颅后骨的科级归属也依靠比较，而非独有诊断。原先暂作第二或第三翼指骨的 MTM Gyn/453，在 2011 年改释为尺骨远端，号为 MTM V 2010.75.1。同地来源与相近尺寸不足以把这些骨拼成一只完整动物。
text.en: The 2005 paper places isolated cervicals and several limb elements under Azhdarchidae indet., explicitly finding no direct evidence that they belong to B. galaczi. The authors consider a local referral possible, without an associated skeleton. The 2011 material continues to separate species-level jaws, Azhdarchidae indet. and Pterodactyloidea indet.; most new postcranial family referrals likewise rely on comparison rather than unique diagnostic features. MTM Gyn/453, tentatively a second or third wing phalanx in 2005, is reinterpreted in 2011 as a distal ulna, MTM V 2010.75.1. Shared locality and similar size do not assemble these bones into one complete animal.

title.zh: 3.5–4 米翼展来自颌长比较
title.en: The 3.5–4 m wingspan comes from jaw-length comparison

text.zh: 2005 年作者把下颌长度与 Quetzalcoatlus、Zhejiangopterus 作比较，估计本种翼展约 3.5–4 米。另据同地未定种颈椎得到约 3–3.5 米的估计。两者接近是作者讨论骨骼可能同种的线索，不是同一骨架实测翼展，也不能证明颈椎属于本种。本页保留方法与材料区分，不把估计变成固定成年尺寸。
text.en: The 2005 authors compare mandibular length with Quetzalcoatlus and Zhejiangopterus to estimate a wingspan of about 3.5–4 m. Separately, they estimate about 3–3.5 m from local cervicals of indeterminate species. Similar estimates inform their discussion of a possible common taxon; they are neither a measured wingspan from one skeleton nor proof of cervical referral. Methods and material remain separate, without turning an estimate into a fixed adult size.

title.zh: 鱼、果实与小动物都是讨论中的可能食物
title.en: Fish, fruit and small animals remain possible foods

text.zh: 2005 年根据尖而无齿的下颌，讨论抓取小鱼、食果与多样食物的可能性，并反对把它解释为掠水取食。2011 年加入上颌后强调咬合和喙鞘的不确定性，讨论类似鹳或地犀鸟的泛食，以及食果等不同策略。这些是形态比较与功能假说，没有本种胃内容物或直接取食证据；不能据此确认鱼食、食果或具体菜单。原论文中排除掠水取食的判断也保留为当时作者的解释。
text.en: The 2005 paper uses the pointed toothless mandible to discuss small-fish capture, frugivory and varied foods, while arguing against skim feeding. With an upper jaw added, the 2011 paper emphasizes uncertain occlusion and keratinous covering and discusses alternatives including stork-like or ground-hornbill-like generalism and frugivory. These are morphological comparisons and functional hypotheses, without stomach contents or direct feeding evidence for this species. They establish neither piscivory, frugivory nor a specific menu. The original rejection of skimming likewise remains the authors’ dated interpretation.

Wingspan, upper crest, diet and geographic origin retain their reconstruction or hypothesis conditions; reader-facing delivery remains unfinished.

title.zh: 欧洲记录从一件不完整头骨开始
title.en: The European record begins with an incomplete skull

text.zh: 2012 年原始描述以西班牙 Las Hoyas 的 MCCM-LH 9413 建立 Europejara olcadesorum，报告当时欧洲首个古神翼龙科成员。它把这个类群的具名记录扩展到伊比利亚，不证明所有早白垩世欧洲地点都有本种。“最早已知”无齿翼龙和欧亚起源论述按该研究当时取样阅读，未改称已核对全部后续发现的现行结论。
text.en: The 2012 description names Europejara olcadesorum from MCCM-LH 9413 at Las Hoyas, Spain, reporting the first European tapejarid then known. It extends the named record to Iberia without establishing presence at every Early Cretaceous European site. Claims of the oldest known toothless pterosaur and Eurasian origin retain the study’s dated sampling context, without a comprehensive check of later discoveries.

title.zh: 主板与对板保存头部，没有完整身体
title.en: Part and counterpart preserve cranial material rather than a whole body

text.zh: 正模包含上下颌和后眶头骨元素，保存于主板、对板；上颌及头骨不完整、压碎且背腹向压扁，下颌侧向保存。后眶骨移位，一些小骨在酸处理时移出基质。没有保存皮肤或角质喙，遗址集合的软组织标签不能移植给这件正模；本页未独立检查图像或实物。
text.en: The holotype comprises jaws and postorbital skull elements on part and counterpart slabs. The upper jaw and skull are incomplete, crushed and dorsoventrally flattened, while the mandible lies in lateral view. Postorbital bones are displaced and some small elements were removed during acid preparation. No integument or keratinous beak is preserved; a site-level soft-tissue label does not apply automatically to this specimen, and images or specimens were not independently inspected here.

title.zh: 向后弯曲的下颌冠参与鉴别
title.en: A backward-curving mandibular crest informs diagnosis

text.zh: 作者鉴别的组合包括向后弯曲、背腹方向较深的齿骨骨冠，冠高与下颌支高比约四，以及内侧背缘的隆起和浅凹。骨冠估高约 90 毫米、下颌支高 22 毫米，都是这件材料的描述或估计。大冠的功能没有确定，不用它单独指认性别、求偶方式或全种成长阶段。
text.en: Diagnosis combines a backward-curving, dorsoventrally deep dentary crest, a crest-height/mandibular-ramus-height ratio near four, and a medial dorsal bulge with shallow depressions. An estimated crest height near 90 mm and a 22 mm ramus height describe this material. Crest function remains uncertain; size alone does not establish sex, courtship or a species-wide growth stage.

title.zh: 无齿下颌与保存的腭部各有边界
title.en: Toothless jaws and the preserved palate have separate limits

text.zh: 下颌保存长约 230 毫米，完整长度估约 255 毫米；联合部背缘呈阶梯状、略 S 形，切缘无齿。腭部背面可见两条狭长内鼻孔与薄犁骨，其他骨缝不清。舌骨器保存细长棒状骨，却不是舌头软组织。原文的骨骼名称按 2012 年解释保留，未当作后续 CT 骨缝重评。
text.en: The mandible preserves about 230 mm, with total length estimated near 255 mm. Its symphyseal dorsal edge is step-like and slightly sigmoid, with toothless cutting edges. Dorsal palatal exposure shows two narrow choanae and a thin vomer, while other sutures are poorly visible. Slender hyoid rods are preserved rather than tongue soft tissue. Bone names retain the 2012 interpretation without implying a later CT-based reassessment.

title.zh: 两米翼展和上颌冠是不同层次的复原
title.en: Two-metre wingspan and an upper crest are different reconstructions

text.zh: 论文约两米翼展来自其他古神翼龙亚科成员的比例，正模没有可直接量翼展的完整翼骨。较高前上颌冠及可能后弯的轮廓，则由下颌冠和近亲比较推断；头部复原部分借用 Tapejara。它们不是保存完整的上颌冠或实测全翼，也不是本种成体最大值、确定体重或飞行速度。
text.en: A roughly two-metre wingspan is scaled from other tapejarines; the holotype lacks complete wing elements for direct span measurement. A high premaxillary crest and possibly backward-curving outline are inferred from the mandibular crest and relatives, with parts of the head reconstruction based on Tapejara. These are not an intact preserved upper crest or measured complete wing, nor maximum adult size, established mass or flight speed.

title.zh: Las Hoyas 的环境不等于本种全部生活史
title.en: Las Hoyas context does not define the species’ entire life history

text.zh: 正模来自 La Huérguina 地层上巴列姆阶纹层石灰岩。作者描述低起伏喀斯特背景中的亚热带湿润、森林和水域环境，遗址有大量水生生物；翼龙材料较少。这是保存地环境与集合背景，不把本种确定为水生、只住森林或以遗址某种植物为唯一食物；数据库宽年代也不是个体寿命。
text.en: The holotype comes from upper Barremian laminated limestone of the La Huérguina Formation. The authors describe subtropical wet, forested and aquatic settings over low-relief karst, with abundant aquatic organisms and rare pterosaur material. This is depositional and assemblage context, without establishing aquatic habits, exclusive forest residence or one local plant as its sole food; the database age bracket is not an individual lifespan.

title.zh: 早期亲缘结果不能确定地理起点
title.en: An early phylogenetic result does not establish geographic origin

text.zh: 2012 年等权、无序性状分析得到 135 棵同等简约树，严格共识支持古神翼龙亚科归属，但其内部位置仍分辨不足。欧亚起源与随后向巴西扩展是作者把地层先后、分布与亲缘合读的提议；他们也指出取样不均会造成表面缺席。本页没有复算矩阵，不从最早保存地点直接确定真正起源。
text.en: The 2012 analysis uses equal-weight, unordered characters and obtains 135 equally parsimonious trees. Strict consensus supports tapejarine affinity but leaves relationships within that group poorly resolved. Eurasian origin and later expansion to Brazil are proposals combining stratigraphic succession, distribution and phylogeny; uneven sampling can also produce apparent absences. The matrix was not rerun here, and the earliest preserved locality does not directly establish true origin.

title.zh: 果实与种子传播仍缺直接食性证据
title.en: Fruit feeding and seed dispersal lack direct dietary evidence

text.zh: 无齿喙形及类比促使作者讨论食果、食种子或杂食，以及传播早期被子植物种子的可能。论文明确缺少胃内容等直接证据，地理和时间重合也不足以确认相互作用或共同演化。本种没有在此获得确定菜单、某种果实关系或已证传播行为；无齿本身不等于已经证实植食。
text.en: Toothless jaw form and analogies motivate discussion of fruit, seed or mixed feeding and possible early-angiosperm seed dispersal. The paper explicitly lacks direct evidence such as gut contents; temporal and geographic congruence does not establish interaction or coevolution. No definitive menu, particular fruit association or demonstrated dispersal behavior is assigned here, and toothlessness alone does not prove herbivory.

title.zh: 把欧洲下颌与中国材料对读
title.en: Compare the European mandible with Chinese material

text.zh: 先读 [Eopteranodon lii](../../Eopteranodon/Eopteranodon_lii/page.zh.md) 的上下颌重识别，再读 [Sinopterus dongi](../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Sinopterus/Sinopterus_dongi/page.zh.md) 的成长、冠饰和分类比较。2012 年欧洲记录与 2023 年中国材料重评分别保留年份；正文不把它们拼成统一确定祖先链。后续欧洲材料、完整成长、直接食性和补充矩阵仍待汇齐。
text.en: Read revised jaw identification in [Eopteranodon lii](../../Eopteranodon/Eopteranodon_lii/page.en.md), then growth, crests and taxonomy in [Sinopterus dongi](../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Sinopterus/Sinopterus_dongi/page.en.md). Retain the dates of the 2012 European description and 2023 Chinese reassessment without combining them into an established ancestor chain. Later European material, complete growth, direct diet evidence and supplementary matrices remain to be assembled.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Europejara olcadesorum 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Europejara。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Europejara olcadesorum is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Europejara. This guide uses 1 eligible species-level occurrence record from 1 collection and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Las Hoyas (MCCM collection)（Castilla-La Mancha），地区代码 ES，地层名称 La Huérguina；数据库年代范围 125.77–121.4 Ma，早端地质时段 Late Barremian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Las Hoyas (MCCM collection) (Castilla-La Mancha), region code ES, stratum name La Huérguina; database age bracket 125.77–121.4 Ma, early interval Late Barremian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 125.77–121.4 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 125.77–121.4 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Las Hoyas (MCCM collection) 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，源标注 large（lacustrine - large）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存、trace、软组织（body,adpression,trace,soft parts）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Las Hoyas (MCCM collection) has collection-environment label lacustrine - large; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression,trace,soft parts. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: 旧出现导读保存数据库 Vullo et al.（2012）、ref:42229 的简略录入；新增正文另绑定已读原始描述与完整七位作者共享引文。出现行、采集 ID、旧引文 ID 与标本复核范围分别保留，不把新读论文改称已检查实物。
text.en: The older occurrence guide retains the abbreviated Vullo et al. (2012), ref:42229 database attribution; added prose separately binds the read original description and shared citation with all seven authors. Occurrence rows, collection IDs, older reference IDs and specimen-inspection scope retain separate provenance; reading the paper does not imply inspecting specimens.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: 仅来源所述材料和数据库记录范围。
scope.en: Only material and database-record scope described by this source.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: 所选有引文、年代和地点的无疑问限定种级记录；不是全种生态或形态综合。
scope.en: Selected cited species-level records without uncertain qualifiers, with ages and locality context; not whole-species ecology or morphology.

title.en: Paleobiology Database Data Service 1.2 — occurrence field documentation
title.zh: Paleobiology Database Data Service 1.2 — occurrence field documentation

scope.zh: 解释数据库出现、采集、年代与层位字段，不替代原论文或标本复核。
scope.en: Interpret database occurrence, collection, age and strata fields; not a substitute for original papers or specimen review.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: PBDB 接受名、外部 OID 和记录父链；不与 COL 概念等同，不裁决系统发育。
scope.en: PBDB accepted name, external OID and recorded parent chain; no equivalence with COL or phylogenetic adjudication.

title.zh: A New Crested Pterosaur from the Early Cretaceous of Spain: The First European Tapejarid (Pterodactyloidea: Azhdarchoidea)
title.en: A New Crested Pterosaur from the Early Cretaceous of Spain: The First European Tapejarid (Pterodactyloidea: Azhdarchoidea)

scope.zh: MCCM-LH 9413 的保存、下颌冠、比例估计与 2012 年亲缘、食性和地理假说。
scope.en: Preservation, mandibular crest and proportional estimates for MCCM-LH 9413, with dated 2012 phylogenetic, feeding and geographic hypotheses.

readerLimitations.zh: 既有章节是 2026-10-02 PBDB 出现导读，新增正文读取 2012 年原始描述，完整物种专论仍未完成。只纳入固定 276 项翼龙工作名录中，当前名称一致、父链可追到已记录 Pterosauria 存储锚点、且有可用无疑问限定种级出现记录的条目。数据库接受名可能连接旧组合；这种数据库对应关系不裁决实际标本鉴定或所有分类争议，也不与 COL 同名概念合并。采集地点、地层区间、沉积环境和集合保存方式各有不同含义：它们不能直接推出完整分布、起源或灭绝时刻、该物种的固定生态、生物数量或每件标本的保存状态。原始描述、重描述、形态、食性和行为材料尚未逐项补齐；。 本批已读 2012 年全部四个科学主文章节与文字图注；图像、标本、补充矩阵和全部后续研究尚未独立检查或汇齐。翼展、上颌冠、食性及地理起源各保留复原或假说条件，未完成外审与读者端交付。
readerLimitations.en: Existing sections guide PBDB occurrences dated 2026-10-02; added prose reads the 2012 description, while a complete monograph remains unfinished. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled; All four scientific main sections and textual captions of the 2012 paper were read here. Images, specimens, the supplemental matrix and all later research have not been independently inspected or assembled. Wingspan, upper crest, diet and geographic origin retain their reconstruction or hypothesis conditions; reader-facing delivery remains unfinished.

context.zh: 返回记录父级的阅读入口，保留各出现与采集记录的范围。
context.en: Return to the recorded parent reading route, retaining occurrence and collection scope.

context.zh: 按研究年份对读头部与地理假说，不确认直接祖先。
context.en: Compare cranial and geographic interpretations by study date without establishing direct ancestry.

overview: Open [Caiuajara dobruskii](../../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Tapejarinae/Caiuajara/Caiuajara_dobruskii/page.en.md) and compare its downturned rostrum and crests with the longer Keresdrakon rostrum and unknown posterior crest condition. The 2019 description discusses shared bonebeds separately from diagnostic combinations. Nearby remains support locality association without making all adjacent bones one taxon or individual. Recorded parents continue to organize reading; coexistence does not establish closest relationships.

ecology.diet: Not assessed from occurrence counts or depositional setting.
ecology.habitat: Collection environments are not a species-wide habitat assessment.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed from this occurrence batch.

evidenceSummary:
The added text follows the original 2019 main article. Captions and measurement-table text were read, without independent inspection of images, fossils or thin sections, a matrix rerun or a complete collection of later material and revisions. Isolated-bone assignments, the minimum of three individuals, juvenile-to-subadult interpretation, comparative three-metre wingspan and ecological hypotheses retain their scopes. Fixed broad database ages do not resolve stratigraphic disputes. Growth, diet, behavior and species-wide coverage remain incomplete; a full monograph and reader-visible publication are pending.

The comparative route additionally uses the already-read 2019 shared-bonebed and 2020 dinosaur-histology main texts. Samples and models apply to their respective taxa; cross-links do not complete the site fauna or all developmental research.

title.zh: 沿头骨与孤立骨鉴别回看 Caiuajara
title.en: Return to Caiuajara through cranial and isolated-bone comparisons

text.zh: 打开 [Caiuajara dobruskii](../../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Tapejarinae/Caiuajara/Caiuajara_dobruskii/page.zh.md)，先比较其下弯吻部与冠饰，再回到本页较长的吻部及后方冠饰未知范围。2019 年原描述把两种翼龙的共同骨床和鉴别组合分别讨论；材料相邻支持地点关联，却不把所有邻近骨骼变成同一种或同一个体。原有父链继续组织资料，共存不是最近亲缘关系的证据。
text.en: Open [Caiuajara dobruskii](../../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Tapejarinae/Caiuajara/Caiuajara_dobruskii/page.en.md) and compare its downturned rostrum and crests with the longer Keresdrakon rostrum and unknown posterior crest condition. The 2019 description discusses shared bonebeds separately from diagnostic combinations. Nearby remains support locality association without making all adjacent bones one taxon or individual. Recorded parents continue to organize reading; coexistence does not establish closest relationships.

title.zh: 翼龙切片与恐龙年龄模型各有尺度
title.en: Pterosaur sections and dinosaur age models use different scales

text.zh: 继续到 [Vespersaurus paranaensis](../../../../../../../Dinosauromorpha/Dinosauriformes/Dinosauria/Theropoda/Neotheropoda/Averostra/Ceratosauria/Noasauridae/Noasaurinae/Vespersaurus/Vespersaurus_paranaensis/page.zh.md) 的成长资料，比较作者怎样从生长停滞线、骨重塑和外层组织推断成熟。本种两件组织样本没有给出同样的完整年龄反推序列；Vespersaurus 的假定新生尺寸与股骨／胫骨分歧也只属于那项取样。两页都应先区分保存组织与成长解释，再看生态假说。
text.en: Continue to the growth evidence of [Vespersaurus paranaensis](../../../../../../../Dinosauromorpha/Dinosauriformes/Dinosauria/Theropoda/Neotheropoda/Averostra/Ceratosauria/Noasauridae/Noasaurinae/Vespersaurus/Vespersaurus_paranaensis/page.en.md) and compare how growth marks, remodeling and outer tissue inform maturity. The two Keresdrakon samples do not supply the same age-retrocalculation series. Vespersaurus neonatal assumptions and femoral–tibial disagreement belong to its own sample. In both pages, distinguish preserved tissue from developmental interpretation before considering ecology.

title.zh: 关联正模与散开的其他材料
title.en: An associated holotype among dispersed remains

text.zh: 2019 年原始描述将 CP.V 2069 指定为 Keresdrakon vilsoni 正模，收藏于巴西 CENPALEO，来自 Cruzeiro do Oeste 遗址的骨床 C。它保存头骨前部、接近完整的下颌、部分颈背椎、胸骨、肩带、骨盆和不完整四肢。除上下颌仍相接外，骨骼以关联但未关节连接的状态发现；其他归入材料多为孤立骨骼。作者据头骨和翼指第一节指骨识别至少三个个体，这个下限不是全部化石数量，也不是同时生活的种群规模。
text.en: The 2019 description designates CP.V 2069, housed at Brazil’s CENPALEO, as the holotype of Keresdrakon vilsoni from bonebed C at Cruzeiro do Oeste. It preserves the anterior skull, an almost complete lower jaw, selected cervical and dorsal vertebrae, sternum, shoulder and pelvic elements and incomplete limbs. Apart from the upper and lower jaws, the bones were associated but disarticulated. Most additional referred material comprises isolated elements. Skulls and first wing phalanges support an author-reported minimum of three individuals, neither a count of every fossil nor the size of a contemporaneous population.

title.zh: 长而无齿的颌部与未保存的冠饰范围
title.en: Long toothless jaws and limits on crest reconstruction

text.zh: 已描述颌部无齿，头骨较低，吻部细长、末端尖，闭合时上下颌之间不形成 Tapejarinae 那样的间隙。前上颌骨在鼻眶前孔前缘之前没有保存矢状冠，但头骨后部不完整，作者无法确定更后方是否有冠饰。下颌联合腹侧具有较小而厚的齿骨冠；背侧靠后的一条短钝脊则进入原始诊断。喙形、冠饰缺失范围与完整头部复原应分别阅读，不把缺失头骨画成已知无冠。
text.en: The described jaws are toothless, with a low skull and a long pointed rostrum. Occlusion leaves no gap of the kind described for tapejarines. No premaxillary sagittal crest is preserved in front of the anterior margin of the nasoantorbital opening; the incomplete posterior skull leaves a more rearward crest unknown. A small thick dentary crest occurs below the mandibular symphysis, while a short blunt ridge near its posterior dorsal end contributes to the original diagnosis. Jaw shape, the observed extent without a crest and whole-head reconstruction have different limits.

title.zh: 鉴别依靠颌部、翼指和骨盆共同特征
title.en: Diagnosis combines jaw, wing-finger and pelvic features

text.zh: 原始诊断除了齿骨背侧短钝脊，还列出第四指第一节指骨近端关节腹面的前半部开孔，以及坐骨外侧面的开孔。头后比较又包含颈椎较大的侧气孔、肱骨近端气孔位置和乌喙骨不对称胸骨关节面。论文明确提醒，较大的 Caiuajara 亚成体与较小的 Keresdrakon 幼体在头后骨骼上可能难以区分，单凭尺寸不能可靠归属孤立骨。孔洞是否可见也受压缩影响，这些特征组合不能代替每件材料的具体鉴定。
text.en: Beyond the short blunt dorsal dentary ridge, the original diagnosis lists a foramen in the anterior half of the ventral proximal articulation of the first phalanx of digit IV, and a foramen on the lateral ischial surface. Postcranial comparisons also involve large lateral cervical pneumatic openings, the position of proximal humeral foramina and the asymmetric sternal articulation of the coracoid. The paper warns that larger subadult Caiuajara and smaller juvenile Keresdrakon can be difficult to distinguish postcranially. Size alone cannot assign isolated bones, and compression can obscure openings.

title.zh: 气腔颈椎与身体材料的保存范围
title.en: Pneumatic cervical vertebrae and the preserved body

text.zh: 部分中段颈椎较长，神经棘较高，椎体侧面有大气孔；一枚破损颈椎显示内部为空腔，神经管包在由骨小梁支撑的骨管内。胸骨为薄板，正模还保存细的腹肋、骨盆和不完整股骨与胫骨。归入的翼指第一节指骨略弯，伸肌腱突没有与之融合；其中部分材料来自其他个体。气腔和关节形态可用于身体比较，保存材料尚不给出完整颈椎总数、软组织翼面、飞行速度或确切步态。
text.en: Some mid-cervical vertebrae are elongate, with tall neural spines and large lateral pneumatic openings. One broken element exposes a hollow interior with the neural canal enclosed in a bony tube supported by trabeculae. A thin sternal plate, slender gastralia, pelvis and incomplete femora and tibia supplement the holotype. Referred first wing phalanges are slightly curved and lack a fused extensor tendon process; some belong to other individuals. These structures support anatomical comparison without supplying the full neck count, soft-tissue wing outline, flight speed or exact gait.

title.zh: 骨骼融合支持尚未完全成熟
title.en: Skeletal fusion supports incomplete maturity

text.zh: 正模前上颌骨、部分颌骨和保存中段颈椎的椎体与神经弓已经融合；肩胛骨与乌喙骨、右肱骨远端及骨盆材料仍未融合。2019 年作者把它放在所用翼龙发育阶段 OS2 与 OS3 之间，将材料解释为较晚幼体至亚成体。发育阶段标签来自比较框架，不能直接换算成年龄、性别或性成熟，也不能由一件正模代表全种成体骨骼。
text.en: The holotype has fused premaxillae, some jaw elements and the centra and neural arches of preserved mid-cervicals. Its scapula and coracoid, distal right humerus and pelvic elements remain unfused. The 2019 authors place it between OS2 and OS3 in their pterosaur developmental framework, interpreting the material as late juveniles to subadults. Comparative stage labels do not directly establish age in years, sex or reproductive maturity, and one holotype does not represent the species’ adult skeleton.

title.zh: 两件骨切片揭示生长而非完整年龄表
title.en: Two bone samples reveal growth without a complete age series

text.zh: 原研究对尺骨 CP.V 2077 与暂释为翼指第一节指骨的残段 CP.V 2374 取骨干切片。两者主要为纤维板层骨组织，骨膜侧开放血管与缺乏成熟重塑迹象支持尚在生长；尺骨被解释为幼体但非新生个体，另一残段有一条深部生长标记。作者认为组织与较快生长相符，却明确不能仅凭血管排列判定 Keresdrakon 和 Caiuajara 谁长得更快。两件样本不足以建立完整生长曲线，单条生长标记也没有在本页换算成确定岁数。
text.en: The study sections the shafts of ulna CP.V 2077 and incomplete CP.V 2374, tentatively interpreted as a first wing phalanx. Both mainly show fibrolamellar tissue; open periosteal vascular canals and the absence of advanced remodeling support ongoing growth. The ulna is interpreted as juvenile but not neonatal, while the other fragment has one deep growth mark. The authors associate the tissue with rapid growth but explicitly cannot rank Keresdrakon and Caiuajara growth rates from vascular arrangement alone. Two samples do not establish a complete growth curve, and a single mark is not converted here into a definite age.

title.zh: 约三米翼展为比较估计
title.en: An approximately three-metre wingspan is comparative

text.zh: 作者以肱骨长度与 Tupuxuara、Caupedactylus 等已知材料比较，估计研究中的 Keresdrakon 翼展约三米。它并非一件完整翼膜从尖到尖的直接测量，作者又认为材料尚未完全成熟。因此本页保留估计来源，不把三米写成物种最大成体尺寸，也不由较大翼展推导飞行距离或猎物上限。
text.en: Comparison of humeral length with known Tupuxuara and Caupedactylus material yields the authors’ estimate of an approximately three-metre wingspan. This is not a tip-to-tip measurement of a complete preserved wing, and the material is interpreted as immature. The estimate does not establish the species’ maximum adult size, flight range or prey-size limit.

title.zh: 反复同层关联支持共存解释
title.en: Repeated same-bed association supports coexistence

text.zh: 2019 年研究报告骨床 A、B、C 均有 Keresdrakon、Caiuajara 与 Vespersaurus 材料紧密关联，作者以这种重复同层模式支持它们同时存在。骨骼多已散开，论文提出先在绿洲周边死亡、暴露，继而由高能事件累积的埋藏模型。层位与共同保存比仅在同一组出现提供更具体的关联，但共同保存不自动证明同一时刻死亡、相互捕食或所有骨骼属于同一个体。
text.en: The 2019 study reports closely associated Keresdrakon, Caiuajara and Vespersaurus material in bonebeds A, B and C. The repeated same-bed pattern supports the authors’ coexistence interpretation. Most bones are disarticulated, motivating a model of death and exposure around an oasis followed by accumulation during high-energy events. Shared horizons offer more specific association than presence in the same formation, without automatically demonstrating simultaneous deaths, predation or assignment of all nearby bones to one individual.

title.zh: 食腐、捕食与独居保留为假说
title.en: Scavenging, predation and solitary behavior remain hypotheses

text.zh: 长而侧扁的吻部、较少化石以及同遗址动物构成，使作者提出 Keresdrakon 可能机会性捕食小动物或食腐，并可能不像 Caiuajara 那样群居。文中把可能摄食尸体、卵或幼体明确放在生态推测范围。这些不是已保存胃内容物或直接行为观察；数量少也不能排除采样、归属与埋藏影响。因此本文没有把复原图中的食物网、独居或专性食腐写成确定生活方式。
text.en: The long laterally flattened rostrum, relatively scarce fossils and associated fauna motivate hypotheses that Keresdrakon was an opportunistic predator or scavenger and less gregarious than Caiuajara. Proposed consumption of carcasses, eggs or young animals belongs to the paper’s ecological speculation. These are not preserved gut contents or direct behavioral observations, and scarcity retains sampling, identification and taphonomic limits. A reconstructed food web therefore does not establish solitary behavior or obligate scavenging.

title.zh: 亲缘结果与地层争议各保留出处
title.en: Relationships and stratigraphic disputes retain their sources

text.zh: 原始分析在既有矩阵中加入 Keresdrakon，得到六棵最简树，并将其恢复为 Tapejaridae 的姐妹类群，即 Tapejaromorpha 中的非 Tapejaridae 分支。这是 2019 年特定分析的结果，不是本页独立重算或全部后续方案的共识。同文又主张遗址为 Goio-Erê 的局部出露，讨论其与地图上的 Rio Paraná 归属分歧，以及早白垩世与晚白垩世年代方案。本页保留固定 PBDB 父链与宽年代区间，并将这些论文解释单列，不静默统一年代或分类。
text.en: Adding Keresdrakon to an existing matrix yields six most-parsimonious trees and recovers it as sister to Tapejaridae, a non-tapejarid branch within Tapejaromorpha. This is a result of a particular 2019 analysis, without an independent rerun or a claim of consensus across later studies. The paper also argues for a local Goio-Erê exposure, discusses disagreement with mapped Rio Paraná assignment, and retains competing Early and Late Cretaceous ages. The fixed PBDB parent and broad age bracket remain separate from these published interpretations.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Keresdrakon vilsoni 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Keresdrakon。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Keresdrakon vilsoni is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Keresdrakon. This guide uses 1 eligible species-level occurrence record from 1 collection and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Cemitério dos Pterossauros Quarry（Paraná），地区代码 BR，地层名称 Goio-Erê；数据库年代范围 121.4–72.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Aptian、晚端时段 Campanian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Cemitério dos Pterossauros Quarry (Paraná), region code BR, stratum name Goio-Erê; database age bracket 121.4–72.2 Ma, early interval Aptian and late interval Campanian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 121.4–72.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 121.4–72.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Cemitério dos Pterossauros Quarry 的采集环境标签为 interdune；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Cemitério dos Pterossauros Quarry has collection-environment label interdune; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: 数据库保留 Kellner et al.（2019）、ref:71269 的原署名。新增共享引文列出原始描述五位作者，按原文保留姓名缩写、2019-08-19 发表日期与 DOI。本次已读取官方 XML 全部九个正文章节、测量表文字和图注；图像、骨切片实物、参考矩阵及后续研究没有独立检查。
text.en: The database retains Kellner et al. (2019), ref:71269. A shared original-description reference records all five authors with source-preserved initials, the 2019-08-19 publication date and DOI. All nine body sections, measurement-table text and figure captions in the official XML were read; image pixels, physical thin sections, the referenced matrix and later studies were not independently inspected.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: 仅来源所述材料和数据库记录范围。
scope.en: Only material and database-record scope described by this source.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: 所选有引文、年代和地点的无疑问限定种级记录；不是全种生态或形态综合。
scope.en: Selected cited species-level records without uncertain qualifiers, with ages and locality context; not whole-species ecology or morphology.

title.en: Paleobiology Database Data Service 1.2 — occurrence field documentation
title.zh: Paleobiology Database Data Service 1.2 — occurrence field documentation

scope.zh: 解释数据库出现、采集、年代与层位字段，不替代原论文或标本复核。
scope.en: Interpret database occurrence, collection, age and strata fields; not a substitute for original papers or specimen review.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: PBDB 接受名、外部 OID 和记录父链；不与 COL 概念等同，不裁决系统发育。
scope.en: PBDB accepted name, external OID and recorded parent chain; no equivalence with COL or phylogenetic adjudication.

title.zh: A new toothless pterosaur (Pterodactyloidea) from Southern Brazil with insights into the paleoecology of a Cretaceous desert
title.en: A new toothless pterosaur (Pterodactyloidea) from Southern Brazil with insights into the paleoecology of a Cretaceous desert

scope.zh: 2019 年原始描述正文的标本、形态、成长、同层共存与生态假说；未独立检查图像、标本或系统发育矩阵。
scope.en: Original 2019 main-text guide to material, anatomy, growth, same-bed coexistence and ecological hypotheses; no independent image, specimen or matrix inspection.

title.zh: A new toothless pterosaur (Pterodactyloidea) from Southern Brazil with insights into the paleoecology of a Cretaceous desert
title.en: A new toothless pterosaur (Pterodactyloidea) from Southern Brazil with insights into the paleoecology of a Cretaceous desert

scope.zh: 2019 年地层、描述、组织学与讨论的共同骨床、孤立材料鉴别和生态假说；图像与标本未独立检查。
scope.en: 2019 stratigraphy, description, histology and discussion of shared bonebeds, isolated-bone diagnosis and ecological hypotheses; no independent image or specimen inspection.

title.zh: Osteohistology and growth dynamics of the Brazilian noasaurid Vespersaurus paranaensis Langer et al., 2019 (Theropoda: Abelisauroidea)
title.en: Osteohistology and growth dynamics of the Brazilian noasaurid Vespersaurus paranaensis Langer et al., 2019 (Theropoda: Abelisauroidea)

scope.zh: 2020 年五件股骨与六件胫骨研究的取样、成熟差异与年龄反推前提；不能移植为翼龙成长资料。
scope.en: 2020 sampling of five femora and six tibiae, maturity differences and age-retrocalculation assumptions; not transferable as pterosaur growth data.

readerLimitations.zh:
新增正文依据 2019 年原始描述主文；图注和测量表文字已读，但没有独立检查图像、化石或骨切片，未重算参考矩阵，后续材料与修订尚未汇齐。孤立骨归属、至少三个个体下限、幼体至亚成体解释、约三米比较翼展及生态假说各保留原范围。地层与年代争议不由固定数据库宽区间裁决；成长、食性、行为及全种范围仍不完整。本文不计完整物种专论或读者端发布完成。

比较路线另复用已读 2019 年共同骨床与 2020 年恐龙组织学主文；其取样和模型仅用于相应成员，没有据横向链接完成全部遗址动物或所有成长研究。
readerLimitations.en:
The added text follows the original 2019 main article. Captions and measurement-table text were read, without independent inspection of images, fossils or thin sections, a matrix rerun or a complete collection of later material and revisions. Isolated-bone assignments, the minimum of three individuals, juvenile-to-subadult interpretation, comparative three-metre wingspan and ecological hypotheses retain their scopes. Fixed broad database ages do not resolve stratigraphic disputes. Growth, diet, behavior and species-wide coverage remain incomplete; a full monograph and reader-visible publication are pending.

The comparative route additionally uses the already-read 2019 shared-bonebed and 2020 dinosaur-histology main texts. Samples and models apply to their respective taxa; cross-links do not complete the site fauna or all developmental research.

context.zh: 返回记录父级的阅读入口，保留各出现与采集记录的范围。
context.en: Return to the recorded parent reading route, retaining occurrence and collection scope.

context.zh: 对读共同骨床中的材料、成长证据与生态假说，保留每项来源的取样限制。
context.en: Compare shared-bonebed material, growth evidence and ecological hypotheses while retaining each source’s sampling limits.

overview: The 2023 revision compares Yixian Formation Eopteranodon lii with Sinopterus material from the younger, overlying Jiufotang Formation, retaining distinction from S. dongi and Huaxiadraco corollatus. This is a named reassessment of holotype BPV 078, without treating the older directory parent chain as the only phylogeny or establishing direct ancestry from stratigraphic position.

ecology.diet: Not assessed from occurrence counts or depositional setting.
ecology.habitat: Collection environments are not a species-wide habitat assessment.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed from this occurrence batch.

evidenceSummary: Existing sections guide PBDB occurrences dated 2026-10-02; added prose reads the 2023 revision, while a complete monograph remains unfinished. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled; The Eopteranodon account and textual captions and both phylogenetic-analysis sections were read here. Original 2005/2006 full papers, images, specimens and supplementary matrices were not independently inspected, and the entire 2023 paper has not been read. Source interpretations are not independent identification, measured performance; reader-facing delivery remains pending.

title.zh: 从正模重识别读曙翼龙
title.en: Read Eopteranodon through reassessment of its holotype

text.zh: 2023 年修订把义县组 Eopteranodon lii 与较晚上覆九佛堂组的中国翼龙材料比较，保留本种与 S. dongi、Huaxiadraco corollatus 的区别。它是对正模 BPV 078 的具名重评，不把旧目录父链当作唯一亲缘结果，也不由地层位置确认直接祖先。
text.en: The 2023 revision compares Yixian Formation Eopteranodon lii with Sinopterus material from the younger, overlying Jiufotang Formation, retaining distinction from S. dongi and Huaxiadraco corollatus. This is a named reassessment of holotype BPV 078, without treating the older directory parent chain as the only phylogeny or establishing direct ancestry from stratigraphic position.

title.zh: 上下颌原有识别被作者互换
title.en: The authors revise the original identification of skull and jaw remains

text.zh: 作者指出 BPV 078 原有头骨与下颌残片识别曾互换；重评辨认出下折吻部和前上颌骨冠，支持其古神翼龙科性质。主板、对板与头部细节分别出现在文字图注中。本页未独立检查图片或实物，因此将重识别明确归给作者，不把它写成新的直接观察。
text.en: The authors report that skull and mandibular remains in BPV 078 were originally identified the wrong way round. Reassessment recognizes a downturned rostrum and premaxillary crest, supporting a tapejarid interpretation. Textual captions distinguish the main part, counterpart and cranial details. Images and specimens were not independently inspected here, so the reinterpretation remains explicitly attributed to the authors.

title.zh: 相似眼眶与颈椎之外还有比例差异
title.en: Similar orbits and cervicals coexist with different proportions

text.zh: 专节记述本种与 S. dongi 都有近方形眼眶、约 160 度方骨后倾及最长的第四颈椎；区别包括较短高的鼻眶前孔，长高比约 2.5，翼骨与尺骨长度比约 0.56，第四翼指节与第一节比约 0.45，以及第一跖骨短于第二跖骨。这是具名材料的比较组合，不能仅用一个比例鉴定全部残片或推出实测飞行性能。
text.en: The account describes similarities to S. dongi in a subquadrangular orbit, roughly 160° quadrate reclination and the fourth cervical being longest. Differences include a stouter nasoantorbital fenestra with length/height near 2.5, pteroid/ulna length near 0.56, wing phalanx four/one near 0.45 and metatarsal one shorter than two. This is a comparative character combination from named material, rather than a single-ratio identification rule for every fragment or measured flight performance.

title.zh: 修订支持近亲关系，仍保留取样条件
title.en: The revision supports close relationship under its sampling

text.zh: 2023 年研究用更新矩阵、等权性状与 TNT 搜索，得到三棵最短树；严格共识把 E. lii 与 S. dongi 组成一支，再与 H. corollatus 为姊妹群。作者同时强调距离聚类的相似性不能替代系统发育证据。本页没有重算矩阵，也未以这项结果覆盖更早朝阳翼龙科等解释或重写固定目录。
text.en: Using an updated matrix, equal character weights and TNT searches, the 2023 study obtained three minimum-length trees. Its strict consensus groups E. lii with S. dongi, with H. corollatus sister to that pair. The authors also distinguish similarity-based clustering from phylogenetic evidence. The matrix was not rerun here, and this result does not overwrite earlier interpretations such as chaoyangopterid affinity or the fixed directory.

title.zh: 较早出现不等于已证直接祖先
title.en: Earlier occurrence does not establish direct ancestry

text.zh: 形态接近且地层先后，使作者提出 E. lii 与 S. dongi 可能属于连续演化中的时间种。这个提议没有在本页变成已证祖先后代链：还需要完整取样与层位、变异和后续研究。义县与九佛堂的相对位置也不把数据库宽年代压成精确标本日期，更不说明两者一定同时共栖。
text.en: Morphological proximity and stratigraphic succession lead the authors to propose that E. lii and S. dongi could be chronospecies along an anagenetic continuum. This is not an established ancestor–descendant chain here; complete sampling, stratigraphy, variation and later studies remain necessary. Relative formation positions neither narrow database age brackets to exact specimen dates nor establish simultaneous coexistence.

title.zh: 按头骨、翼骨和分类方法连续阅读
title.en: Follow skulls, wing elements and taxonomic methods

text.zh: 先读 [Sinopterus dongi](../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Sinopterus/Sinopterus_dongi/page.zh.md) 的正模和成长方法，再读 [corollatus](../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Huaxiapterus/Huaxiapterus_corollatus/page.zh.md) 的翼骨比例与新属处理。把形态相似、地层先后和亲缘结果分别比较，不由此确定共同食谱。2005／2006 年原始全文、完整新增材料、组织学和食性仍未读齐。
text.en: Read the holotype and growth methods in [Sinopterus dongi](../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Sinopterus/Sinopterus_dongi/page.en.md), then wing proportions and the new-genus treatment in [corollatus](../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Huaxiapterus/Huaxiapterus_corollatus/page.en.md). Compare similarity, stratigraphic succession and phylogenetic results separately, without establishing a shared diet. Original 2005/2006 full papers, complete additional material, histology and diet remain incompletely read.

Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled; The Eopteranodon account and textual captions and both phylogenetic-analysis sections were read here. Original 2005/2006 full papers, images, specimens and supplementary matrices were not independently inspected, and the entire 2023 paper has not been read. Source interpretations are not independent identification, measured performance; reader-facing delivery remains pending.

ecology.habitat: Collection environments are not a species-wide habitat assessment.

evidenceSummary: This page adds the original-description author manuscript and the 2023 Leptostomia account. Figures 2 and 7 and table 1 were inspected; other images, supplemental matrices, raw XCT and specimens remain incomplete. Upper/lower-jaw species referral, maturity, relationships, probing and sensory ability retain their separate inference limits; missing lengths are not measurements of complete jaws. Database counts, ages, parent chains and review states remain, without remeasurement, independent reruns. Complete biology and reader delivery remain pending.

title.zh: 两段颌骨支持同种归属，不是关联头骨
title.en: Two jaw fragments support a species referral, not an associated skull

text.zh: Leptostomia begaaensis 的正模 FSAC-KK 5075 是缺少尖端的前部上颌吻部；副模 FSAC-KK 5076 是前部下颌联合的一段，也缺少尖端。两件材料存于卡萨布兰卡 Université Hassan II 的 Faculté des Sciences Aïn Chock 收藏。原始描述据相近尺寸、长低轮廓、厚壁半圆截面、骨孔分布及相对应的嵴与沟支持同种归属；2023 年明确说没有理由认为它们来自同一个体。这里没有完整头骨或关联身体骨骼。
text.en: Holotype FSAC-KK 5075 is a partial anterior rostrum missing its tip; paratype FSAC-KK 5076 is part of the anterior mandibular symphysis, also missing its tip. Both are held at the Faculté des Sciences Aïn Chock, Université Hassan II, Casablanca. The original description supports referral to one species from similar size, long low outlines, thick-walled semicircular sections, foramina and a corresponding ridge-and-groove complex. The 2023 account explicitly gives no reason to regard them as one individual. Neither a complete skull nor an associated body skeleton is available.

title.zh: 48 与 67 毫米是保存长度
title.en: 48 and 67 mm are preserved lengths

text.zh: 原始稿件与表 1 记录，上颌片段保存长 48 毫米，下颌片段保存长 67 毫米。作者假定颌部均匀收尖，分别推算前方还缺约 70 毫米、35 毫米；这两个数字是缺失段估计，不是保存长度或已经量得的完整喙长。上颌在鼻眶前孔之前折断，下颌后端未达两支分叉。下颌近尖端的弯曲还受到修补影响，不能把全部曲度当作原始形状。
text.en: The manuscript and table 1 record 48 mm of preserved rostrum and 67 mm of preserved mandible. Assuming an evenly tapering tip, the authors estimate about 70 mm and 35 mm missing anteriorly, respectively. Those are missing-length estimates, not preserved lengths or measurements of a complete beak. The rostrum breaks anterior to the nasoantorbital fenestra; the mandible stops before the rami diverge. Repair also accentuates curvature near the mandibular tip, so the entire observed curve cannot be treated as original anatomy.

title.zh: 低夹角、中央嵴与对应的下颌沟
title.en: Low angles, a median ridge and a corresponding groove

text.zh: 上颌咬合面有沿保存段延伸的中央嵴，下颌则由前部较平的表面过渡到后部浅中央沟。作者结合侧面夹角差异区分上下颌；2023 年比较给出约 2.5° 与 2.0°。两者背腹扁平、截面近半圆，厚骨壁包围较小内部空腔，并有细长裂隙状骨孔。这些是一组形态比较依据；嵴沟相配不能证明两段实物曾连接，也不直接保存取食动作。
text.en: A median ridge extends along the preserved upper-jaw occlusal surface. The lower jaw changes from a flatter anterior surface to a shallow posterior median groove. The authors distinguish upper and lower jaws partly by lateral-angle differences, given as about 2.5° and 2.0° in the 2023 comparison. Both are dorsoventrally flattened, approximately semicircular in section, and have thick cortices around reduced cavities with elongate slit-like foramina. This character combination informs comparison; a corresponding ridge and groove do not prove that the fragments were joined or directly preserve feeding behavior.

title.zh: XCT 描述的是骨内空腔与通道
title.en: XCT describes internal cavities and canals

text.zh: 作者对正模 FSAC-KK 5075 进行 X 射线计算机断层成像，并用软件去除基质、构建三维模型。稿件描述沿吻部延伸的扁平中央空腔、局部跨越空腔的薄骨小梁，以及通向外部细长骨孔的通道。图像与模型是研究内部构造的方法，不是保存的神经或感受器；本页未重新处理原始扫描数据，也没有把骨通道转换成直接测得的感觉能力。
text.en: The authors used X-ray computed tomography on holotype FSAC-KK 5075, digitally removing matrix and constructing a three-dimensional model. The manuscript describes a flattened central void extending along the rostrum, thin trabeculae crossing it locally, and canals opening into elongate external foramina. Imaging and models reveal internal architecture rather than preserved nerves or sensory receptors. Raw scans have not been reprocessed here, and the canals are not converted into directly measured sensory ability.

title.zh: 小尺寸不等于已确定的幼体
title.en: Small size does not establish a juvenile

text.zh: 原始描述认为两件标本较平滑的骨表面支持骨骼成熟的推断。这个判断来自局部表面比较，不是精确年龄测定；材料仍然是两段颌骨，没有生长序列、完整翼部或性别证据。不能仅因保存段只有数厘米便将其写成幼体，也不能把成熟推断延伸为本种完整成年体型或固定翼展。
text.en: The original description interprets the relatively smooth surfaces of both specimens as suggesting osteological maturity. This comes from local surface comparison, not exact age determination. The material remains two jaw fragments, without a growth series, complete wings or sex evidence. Preserved lengths of only a few centimeters do not by themselves establish juveniles, and the maturity inference supplies neither complete adult proportions nor a fixed wingspan.

title.zh: 亲缘分析受少量可编码性状限制
title.en: Relationships are limited by few codable characters

text.zh: 原始稿件把无齿、细长骨孔与厚骨壁的组合视为更支持 Azhdarchoidea，同时保留科级归属未知。其系统发育分析采用既有数据集并增加五个性状；作者报告可编码性状有限、相似性状重复演化，导致无序与不同有序处理的结果未解或相互冲突，另有与 ctenochasmatids、Lonchodectes 接近的结果。2023 年介绍继续保留科级位置未定。这里没有独立核查全部矩阵或重跑分析，不把目录父链当作唯一亲缘树。
text.en: The original manuscript favors Azhdarchoidea from the combination of toothlessness, elongate foramina and thick cortices, while leaving family attribution unknown. Its phylogenetic analysis adds five characters to an existing dataset. The authors report few codable characters and homoplasy, yielding unresolved or conflicting results under unordered and differently ordered treatments, including alternatives near ctenochasmatids and Lonchodectes. The 2023 account continues to leave the family position indeterminate. All matrices have not been independently inspected or rerun here, and the directory parent chain is not the only phylogenetic hypothesis.

title.zh: 探入沉积物取食是形态支持的假说
title.en: Sediment probing is a morphological hypothesis

text.zh: 原始描述把细长、狭窄、背腹扁平的颌部与加强的骨壁，同现生探食鸟类作功能比较，提出 Leptostomia 可能把喙探入泥土或沉积物获取小型无脊椎动物。作者也认为 Kem Kem 的淡水至半咸水沉积背景与这个假说相容。鸟类类比、骨形与环境的一致性不是本种胃内容物、直接取食观察或专属足迹；文中提到的蠕虫、甲壳类、软体动物是潜在猎物，不能写成已经确认的食谱。
text.en: The original description compares the long, narrow, dorsoventrally flattened jaws and strengthened cortices with probing birds, proposing that Leptostomia inserted its beak into soil or sediment to obtain small invertebrates. The authors consider the freshwater-to-brackish Kem Kem setting compatible with this hypothesis. Bird analogies, bone form and environmental consistency are not stomach contents, direct feeding observations or tracks assigned to this species. Worms, crustaceans and molluscs discussed as potential prey cannot become a confirmed menu.

title.zh: 缺少喙尖，远距触觉仍是可检验预测
title.en: Missing tips leave remote touch as a testable prediction

text.zh: 某些探食鸟类可以借喙尖感受结构察觉隐蔽猎物引起的振动或水压变化。作者讨论这种“远距触觉”作为 Leptostomia 的可能适应，但明确指出正模与副模都没有前端，无法确定喙尖是否有集中骨孔支持这一能力。他们把发现更多标本作为检验途径。保存段的骨孔与内部通道不等于保存了感受器，也不能证明它具有某种固定触觉精度。
text.en: Some probing birds detect vibrations or pressure changes from hidden prey through sensory structures near the bill tip. The authors discuss this remote-touch ability as a possible adaptation in Leptostomia but explicitly state that both type specimens lack their anterior tips, preventing assessment of concentrated tip foramina that might support it. Additional specimens could test the prediction. Foramina and canals in the preserved fragments are not preserved receptors and establish no fixed tactile sensitivity.
