text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 125.77–121.4 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 125.77–121.4 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Yaverland bed 38 的采集环境标签为 crevasse splay；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Yaverland bed 38 has collection-environment label crevasse splay; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Yaverland bed 38 的数据库引文署名为 Martill et al.（2020），编号 ref:80131。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Yaverland bed 38 carries database reference attribution Martill et al. (2020), identifier ref:80131. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: 仅来源所述材料和数据库记录范围。
scope.en: Only material and database-record scope described by this source.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: 所选有引文、年代和地点的无疑问限定种级记录；不是全种生态或形态综合。
scope.en: Selected cited species-level records without uncertain qualifiers, with ages and locality context; not whole-species ecology or morphology.

title.en: Paleobiology Database Data Service 1.2 — occurrence field documentation
title.zh: Paleobiology Database Data Service 1.2 — occurrence field documentation

scope.zh: 解释数据库出现、采集、年代与层位字段，不替代原论文或标本复核。
scope.en: Interpret database occurrence, collection, age and strata fields; not a substitute for original papers or specimen review.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: PBDB 接受名、外部 OID 和记录父链；不与 COL 概念等同，不裁决系统发育。
scope.en: PBDB accepted name, external OID and recorded parent chain; no equivalence with COL or phylogenetic adjudication.

readerLimitations.zh: 本批是 2026-10-02 PBDB 出现记录导读，不是完整物种专论。只纳入固定 276 项翼龙工作名录中，当前名称一致、父链可追到已记录 Pterosauria 存储锚点、且有可用无疑问限定种级出现记录的条目。数据库接受名可能连接旧组合；这种数据库对应关系不裁决实际标本鉴定或所有分类争议，也不与 COL 同名概念合并。采集地点、地层区间、沉积环境和集合保存方式各有不同含义：它们不能直接推出完整分布、起源或灭绝时刻、该物种的固定生态、生物数量或每件标本的保存状态。原始描述、重描述、形态、食性和行为材料尚未逐项补齐；。
readerLimitations.en: This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

context.zh: 返回记录父级的阅读入口，保留各出现与采集记录的范围。
context.en: Return to the recorded parent reading route, retaining occurrence and collection scope.

overview: GP/2E 9266, described by Beccari and colleagues in 2021, is a nearly complete, largely articulated skeleton of Tupandactylus navigans, preserving the skull, postcranial skeleton and soft-tissue traces. It is referred material, not the species holotype SMNK PAL 2344. At publication, it supplied the first postcranial material unambiguously assigned to the genus, connecting body anatomy with known skull morphology. That historical advance does not mean every specimen has now been reviewed.

ecology.diet: Not assessed from occurrence counts or depositional setting.
ecology.habitat: Collection environments are not a species-wide habitat assessment.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed from this occurrence batch.

evidenceSummary: This page adds a bilingual guide to selected passages of the 2021 associated-skeleton study and retains fixed PBDB occurrences. Exact specimen locality and horizon are unknown. The geological setting says Aptian, whereas the systematic horizon line says Albian; that internal discrepancy is not silently harmonized or used to revise database age brackets. Previously unread anatomical subsections were read here; original descriptions, images and supplements remain incompletely assembled or inspected. No independent specimen inspection, measurement, scanning or matrix reanalysis was performed. Diet, flight, sexual dimorphism and maturity retain the authors’ inferential scope; a full monograph remain pending. This batch adds girdles, forearm, wrist/metacarpus, pelvis, legs/feet and measurement tables without independent scan inspection or remeasurement. The Table 4 wing-phalanx side discrepancy remains unresolved; reader-facing delivery is pending. This batch inspects selected headers, relevant taxon rows, character definitions and commands in the two official supplemental matrices. A complete matrix audit, tree rerun and raw CT inspection remain pending; unresolved branching and missing scores do not establish resolved species relationships.

title.zh: 先区分两次分析的取样
title.en: Separate the samples in the two analyses

text.zh: 2021 年研究的第一套形态矩阵包含 64 个分类单元、150 个离散性状，以 GP/2E 9266 补充 T. navigans 的身体资料。作者曾把正模 SMNK PAL 2344 单独编码，未发现与新标本冲突的性状编码，随后以新标本编码分析本种的位置。第二次分析把头后材料 MN 6588-V 作为独立单元加入；补充文件的表头相应为 65 个单元、150 个性状。这些单元包括比较类群，不能当作本种的标本数或全属种数。
text.en: The first 2021 morphological matrix contains 64 taxonomic units and 150 discrete characters, using GP/2E 9266 to add body data for T. navigans. The authors initially coded holotype SMNK PAL 2344 separately, reporting no conflicting character scores with the new specimen before using the latter to place the species. A second analysis adds postcranial material MN 6588-V as a separate unit; its supplement header gives 65 units and 150 characters. The units include comparative taxa, so they are neither a specimen count for this species nor a species count for the genus.

title.zh: 多棵最简树与未解分叉
title.en: Multiple shortest trees and unresolved branching

text.zh: 第一套分析报告 132 棵最简树、各 371 步；加入 MN 6588-V 后报告 469 棵、各 373 步。严格共识把 T. navigans 放在 Tapejarinae 内，与 T. imperator、Tapejara wellnhoferi、Europejara olcadesorum 和 Caiuajara dobruskii 形成未解的多分叉；第二套分析的 MN 6588-V 也落入这组分叉。树数和步数属于该矩阵与搜索的报告结果，不能转成物种数量、亲缘概率，或证明两个 Tupandactylus 种互为最近姐妹群。
text.en: The first analysis reports 132 most-parsimonious trees of 371 steps; adding MN 6588-V yields 469 trees of 373 steps. The strict consensus places T. navigans in Tapejarinae in an unresolved polytomy with T. imperator, Tapejara wellnhoferi, Europejara olcadesorum and Caiuajara dobruskii. MN 6588-V also joins that polytomy in the second analysis. Tree counts and lengths are results of this matrix and search, not species counts or relationship probabilities, and do not establish the two Tupandactylus species as closest sisters.

title.zh: 缺失编码不等于共享解剖
title.en: Missing scores do not establish shared anatomy

text.zh: 补充矩阵分别列出 T. imperator、T. navigans，以及第二套分析中的 MN 6588-V；这些行含有缺失编码，T. imperator 的头后部分尤其缺少资料。正文讨论两个种已知编码之间没有差异，不能据此说它们的全部身体结构相同，或已经证实为同种的不同性别。矩阵还对部分性状指定有序处理；这套分析的结论取决于取样、性状定义、可编码材料与搜索设置。这里没有逐项重编全部性状或重新运行树搜索。
text.en: The supplements list T. imperator and T. navigans separately, with MN 6588-V added in the second matrix. Their rows contain missing scores, particularly for the postcranial anatomy of T. imperator. The paper discusses an absence of differences in known scores between the species; this does not demonstrate identical complete bodies or confirm different sexes of one species. Some characters are designated ordered. Interpretation depends on sampling, character definitions, scorable material and search settings; the complete matrix has not been recoded or its tree search rerun here.

title.zh: 扫描与数字模型提供不同层次的观察
title.en: Scans and digital models provide different observations

text.zh: 作者用医学 CT 观察仍藏在围岩中的骨骼，方法报告数据体素尺寸 0.976 毫米、重叠 0.33 毫米。切片经分割、重采样生成网格，随后经过平滑等处理，用于展示关联骨骼。重采样与平滑不能恢复原扫描未分辨的细节；数字骨架也不能填补缺失骨骼、撤销侧压变形，或直接给出完整活体姿态。原始 CT 仓储在论文中给出，本文未独立检查扫描切片。
text.en: Medical CT exposes bones still embedded in matrix; the methods report a data voxel size of 0.976 mm and overlap of 0.33 mm. Segmentation and resampling produce meshes that are subsequently smoothed for presentation. These operations cannot recover detail unresolved in the original scan. The digital skeleton does not replace missing bones, remove lateral deformation or directly establish a complete living posture. The paper identifies a raw CT repository, whose slices have not been independently inspected here.

title.zh: 融合肩带仍须与裂缝区分
title.en: Fused shoulder elements require distinguishing fractures

text.zh: 两侧肩胛乌喙骨均保存，左侧较好，肩胛与乌喙骨无可见骨缝而成一体。作者明确左乌喙骨近端横裂不是两骨之间的骨缝；右肩胛末端保留与背椎联合体连接的关节面。胸肩结构提供骨架支撑资料，不把裂缝当成未融合，也不从融合直接确定个体岁数或起飞性能。
text.en: Both scapulocoracoids are preserved, with the left better retained and no visible scapula/coracoid suture. The authors explicitly distinguish a transverse proximal coracoid fracture from the interbone suture; the right scapular end preserves an articular surface for the notarium. These document skeletal support without treating a fracture as nonfusion or deriving exact age or launch performance from fusion.

title.zh: 左右肱骨保存不同，肌肉嵴不是实测肌力
title.en: Different humeral preservation does not measure muscle force

text.zh: 左肱骨压扁并缺少部分远端，右肱骨完整，近端与三角胸肌嵴部分埋在基质中，由 CT 资料观察。作者记述较宽的肌肉嵴和气孔；肱骨与股骨长度比约 0.78 是本件比例，不能当作每个个体固定值。骨嵴大小不是保存肌肉体积或直接量得的飞行功率。
text.en: The left humerus is flattened and lacks part of its distal end; the right is complete, with proximal and deltopectoral regions partly embedded and assessed through CT. The authors describe broad muscle-attachment crests and pneumatic openings. A humerus/femur length ratio near 0.78 is a specimen proportion rather than an invariant for every individual; crest dimensions are not preserved muscle volume or directly measured flight power.

title.zh: 腕掌结构把短手指与翼指分开
title.en: Wrist and metacarpal anatomy separates small fingers from the wing

text.zh: 腕部有近、远端融合腕骨及翼骨等元素。第一至第三掌骨细长，却不接腕部，只约到第四掌骨近端一半；第四掌骨支撑翼指，右翼骨长度超过尺骨一半。左右手的暴露方式不同，右侧部分通过 CT 观察。这些骨骼关系不直接保存完整翼膜，也不确认某种攀爬或飞行方式。
text.en: The wrist includes proximal and distal syncarpals and the pteroid among its elements. Slender metacarpals one to three do not reach the wrist, extending only about halfway along metacarpal four, which supports the wing finger; the right pteroid exceeds half the ulna’s length. Exposure differs between sides, with parts of the right hand assessed by CT. These relationships do not preserve a complete membrane or establish particular climbing or flight behavior.

title.zh: 骨盆保留成熟线索与未完全发育的信号
title.en: The pelvis combines maturity indicators with incomplete development

text.zh: 骨盆近完整，缺耻骨前骨及少量部分；骨间缝未清楚显露。髂骨长前突可能受侧向压缩而旋转，不把保存朝向直接当作活体姿态。作者同时指出坐耻骨板似未达到最大发育程度：这与其他融合支持的成熟解释并列，不能由无可见骨缝就确定繁殖年龄、性别或全类群融合顺序。
text.en: The pelvis is nearly complete but lacks the prepubis and minor portions, with interbone sutures not discernible. The long preacetabular ilium may have rotated under lateral compression, so preserved orientation is not automatically living posture. The authors also note apparently incomplete ischiopubic-plate development. This accompanies maturity inferred from other fusion, without making invisible sutures establish reproductive age, sex or a whole-clade fusion sequence.

title.zh: 长后肢与四趾足不是奔跑速度记录
title.en: Long hindlimbs and a four-digit foot do not record running speed

text.zh: 股骨与胫骨均保存，胫骨约比股骨长一半；腓骨较短。足部有四个带指节的趾，爪比手爪短，右足远端不完整。腿长和足部结构可用于比较负重与运动假说，但不是已量得的速度或食谱。本页未重算原文腓胫比例，也未用趾节式裁决全部形态争议。
text.en: Femora and tibiae are preserved, with tibiae approximately half again as long as femora and shorter fibulae. The foot has four phalange-bearing digits, with shorter claws than the hand; the right foot is incomplete distally. Limb lengths and pedal anatomy inform support and locomotor hypotheses without measured speed or diet. The reported fibula/tibia ratio was not recalculated here, and the phalangeal formula is not used to adjudicate all morphological disputes.

title.zh: 2.7 米翼展属于这件骨架的估计
title.en: The 2.7 m wingspan is a specimen estimate

text.zh: 作者用肱骨、尺骨、第四掌骨及翼指节长度估计 GP/2E 9266 翼展约 2.7 米。表格还列左右肢骨不同的保存尺寸，不把比较表混成同一个理想完整个体。第四翼指节的侧别在表 4 与正文保存描述之间有差异，仍待核对图像与实物；估计不作全种最大翼展或直接飞行性能。
text.en: The authors estimate a wingspan near 2.7 m from humerus, ulna, metacarpal four and wing-phalanx lengths in GP/2E 9266. Tables also give differently preserved dimensions from each side; comparative tables are not combined into one ideal intact individual. Wing phalanx four has a side discrepancy between Table 4 and the preservation account, requiring image/specimen checks. The estimate is not maximum species wingspan or direct flight performance.

title.zh: 把关联身体与孤立头部对读
title.en: Compare an associated body with isolated cranial material

text.zh: 对读 [Huaxiapterus corollatus](../../Huaxiapterus/Huaxiapterus_corollatus/page.zh.md) 的掌骨与末端翼指节，再读 [Europejara olcadesorum](../../../../../Europejara/Europejara_olcadesorum/page.zh.md) 仅头部材料的翼展缩放。关联骨架可提供直接肢骨比例，孤立头部则依赖近亲比较；两者都不等于现场飞行观察。原始描述、后续研究与原 CT、图像和补充材料仍未独立核齐。
text.en: Compare metacarpals and terminal wing phalanges in [Huaxiapterus corollatus](../../Huaxiapterus/Huaxiapterus_corollatus/page.en.md), then skull-based wingspan scaling in [Europejara olcadesorum](../../../../../Europejara/Europejara_olcadesorum/page.en.md). Associated skeletons supply limb proportions while isolated heads depend on relative comparisons; neither is a direct flight observation. Original descriptions, later research, raw CT, images and supplements remain incompletely assembled or independently checked.

title.zh: 一件骨架把头冠与身体连接起来
title.en: One skeleton connects the crest with the body

text.zh: Beccari 等在 2021 年描述的 GP/2E 9266 是一件近完整、基本保持关节连接的 Tupandactylus navigans 骨架，连同头骨、身体骨骼和软组织痕迹保存。它是新归入本种的材料，不是本种正模 SMNK PAL 2344。研究发表时，这件材料首次让作者能够明确把本属的头后骨骼与已知头骨形态联系起来；这项历史进展不等于今天所有标本都已复核。
text.en: GP/2E 9266, described by Beccari and colleagues in 2021, is a nearly complete, largely articulated skeleton of Tupandactylus navigans, preserving the skull, postcranial skeleton and soft-tissue traces. It is referred material, not the species holotype SMNK PAL 2344. At publication, it supplied the first postcranial material unambiguously assigned to the genus, connecting body anatomy with known skull morphology. That historical advance does not mean every specimen has now been reviewed.

title.zh: 六块石板与不均匀的保存
title.en: Six slabs and uneven preservation

text.zh: 标本保存在六块能够拼合的石灰岩板中，切割线穿过骨骼与冠饰；入藏前，一些破裂石板已用细金属条连接。不同骨骼的压扁、风化和缺损程度不同，左翼缺少第四翼指节，右足末端也不完整。因此，“近完整”描述的是关联材料的丰富程度，并非每个部位都无损。作者据围岩岩性归入 Crato 组，但精确采集地点和层位未知，不能把本页数据库中的 Nova Olinda 采集记录直接当作这件标本的确切出处。
text.en: The fossil occupies six matching limestone slabs, with cuts crossing bones and crest tissue. Some broken slabs had been joined with thin metal bars before accession. Compression, weathering and loss vary across the skeleton: the left fourth wing phalanx is missing, and the right foot is incomplete distally. Nearly complete therefore describes abundant associated material, not undamaged preservation throughout. The authors identify Crato Formation provenance from the matrix, while the precise locality and horizon remain unknown. The retained Nova Olinda database collection is not a demonstrated exact locality for this specimen.

title.zh: 骨性支架与软组织共同形成头冠
title.en: Bone and soft tissue together form the crest

text.zh: 头冠前缘由细长、近于垂直的前上颌骨上突支撑，后部顶骨冠短而圆；这些特征用于把新标本归入 T. navigans。保存的软组织冠有腹侧纤维区和背侧较平滑区，向上高出头骨很多，但最高端未完整显露。作者还借扫描观察到被围岩覆盖的骨冠前向扩张。这些观察能说明支架与组织的相对位置；化石上的深浅色差可能与氧化有关，不能直接画成活体颜色，也不能由冠饰单独确定性别。
text.en: A slender, nearly vertical supra-premaxillary process supports the anterior crest, while the parietal crest is short and rounded. These features help assign the new specimen to T. navigans. Preserved soft tissue comprises a ventral fibrous region and a smoother dorsal region rising far above the skull, although the uppermost extent is not fully exposed. CT also reveals an anterior expansion of the bony crest hidden beneath matrix. These observations describe tissue and support geometry; dark and light fossil patches may reflect oxidation and do not directly establish living colors or sex.

title.zh: 无齿颌与保存的喙鞘
title.en: Toothless jaws and a preserved beak sheath

text.zh: 上下颌无齿，吻端向下弯曲；组织鞘覆盖吻端与下颌前部，并延伸到深而呈刀片状的下颌冠。作者将其解释为角质喙鞘。标本中上下喙之间的间隙让完全闭合的复原受到限制。论文讨论了处理小食物或较硬植物材料的可能性，但这些属于功能解释；本页没有胃内容物或直接取食观察可据此确定完整食谱。
text.en: The jaws are toothless and the rostral tip turns downward. Tissue sheaths cover the rostrum and anterior lower jaw, extending onto the deep, blade-shaped dentary crest; the authors interpret them as a keratinous rhamphotheca. A gap between the upper and lower beak constrains reconstructions of complete closure. Handling small food items or hard plant material is discussed as a possible function, rather than a demonstrated diet. This guide has no stomach contents or direct feeding observations establishing a complete menu.

title.zh: 颈椎、背椎融合与个体成熟度
title.en: Neck anatomy, fused dorsals and individual maturity

text.zh: 标本保存九枚颈椎，寰椎与枢椎融合；中段颈椎较长，后段较短，部分关节突侧面有纵沟。前五枚背椎的椎体融合成背椎联合体（notarium），但各神经棘的融合程度并不相同。作者综合这一结构与翼指伸肌腱突的融合，把个体解释为成熟；胫跗部未融合则保留了相反信号。由于本类群的发育序列仍不充分，成熟判断不能换算为确切年龄，单件标本也不能给出全种生长曲线。
text.en: Nine cervical vertebrae are preserved, including a fused atlas-axis complex. Mid-neck vertebrae are elongated, posterior ones shorter, and some postzygapophyses bear lateral longitudinal grooves. The centra of the first five dorsal vertebrae form a notarium, with unequal fusion of their neural spines. Combining this structure with fusion of the wing extensor tendon process, the authors interpret the individual as mature. An unfused tibiotarsus supplies a contrasting signal. Incomplete knowledge of tapejarid development prevents converting this assessment into an exact age or a species growth curve.

title.zh: 带爪的手指与延长的翼指
title.en: Clawed fingers beside the elongated wing finger

text.zh: 左手前三指完整，指节式为 2–3–4；弯曲的末节爪还保留角质组织外缘。第四指形成延长的翼指，其左右保存并不对称：左侧末节缺失，右侧各翼指节可以观察。手爪形态提供了抓握结构的资料，尚不能独自证明攀树或某一种取食方式。研究中的 CT 分割帮助查看埋在围岩中的骨骼；经过平滑处理的数字模型属于观察与展示结果，不会补回原本缺失的骨头。
text.en: The first three left manual digits are complete, with phalangeal formula 2–3–4 and curved unguals retaining a keratinous tissue outline. Digit IV forms the elongated wing finger. Preservation differs between sides: its terminal left phalanx is missing, while the right wing phalanges are observable. Claws document grasping anatomy without independently proving tree climbing or a particular feeding behavior. CT segmentation exposes bones embedded in matrix; smoothed digital meshes are observation and presentation products, not replacements for missing fossil elements.

title.zh: 飞行与地面觅食仍需力学检验
title.en: Flight and ground foraging need mechanical assessment

text.zh: 论文把背椎联合体、胸肌附着区域和四肢比例与飞行及四足起飞的可能性联系起来，也提出地面觅食解释。较长颈部与巨大冠饰又使早先把冠饰直接当作空气动力结构的设想受到限制。作者讨论过短距离飞行的可能性，同时明确表示需要进一步生物力学研究。因此，这件骨架没有直接给出飞行速度、航程、起飞次数或固定地面生活习性。
text.en: The paper relates the notarium, pectoral muscle attachment region and limb proportions to flight and possible quadrupedal launch, and discusses terrestrial foraging. The long neck and large crest also constrain earlier proposals treating the crest as an aerodynamic device. Short-distance flight is considered, with further biomechanical work explicitly needed. The skeleton does not directly provide flight speed, range, launch frequency or an established ground-dwelling lifestyle.

title.zh: 种间差异与亲缘结果保留未决部分
title.en: Species differences and relationships retain uncertainty

text.zh: 2021 年的矩阵把 T. navigans 放在 Tapejarinae 内，与 T. imperator 等形成未充分解析的多分支；这不是证实本属两种必为最近姐妹群。作者比较了冠饰方向、下颌冠等差异，也提出两种可能代表性二型形态，但没有检验或正式解决这一假说。另件头后骨骼 MN 6588-V 只被作者归入 Tupandactylus sp.，没有可靠归到 T. navigans。本页因此保留既有名录的两种入口，不合并名称，也不把属级标本计为本种新发现。
text.en: The 2021 matrix places T. navigans within Tapejarinae in an unresolved polytomy with T. imperator and other taxa, rather than establishing the two named species as closest sisters. The authors compare crest orientation and dentary crest morphology, while raising an untested possibility that the species represent sexually dimorphic forms. A separate postcranial specimen, MN 6588-V, is assigned only to Tupandactylus sp., not confidently to T. navigans. This page retains the two working-roster species entries without merging names or counting genus-level material as a new species occurrence.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Tupandactylus navigans 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Tupandactylus。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。其中 1 条保留旧鉴定名称或名称组合与数据库接受名的对应，原字符串另存，不把重组名当作新的独立发现。
text.en: Tupandactylus navigans is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Tupandactylus. This guide uses 1 eligible species-level occurrence record from 1 collection and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts. In one record, the original identification or combination is connected to the database accepted name. Original strings are retained; recombination does not become a new independent discovery.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Nova Olinda quarries（Ceara），地区代码 BR，地层名称 Crato；数据库年代范围 119.57–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Late Aptian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Nova Olinda quarries (Ceara), region code BR, stratum name Crato; database age bracket 119.57–113.2 Ma, early interval Late Aptian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 119.57–113.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 119.57–113.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Nova Olinda quarries 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，源标注 large（lacustrine - large）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、黄铁矿置换、褐铁矿置换（body,replaced with pyrite,replaced with limonite）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Nova Olinda quarries has collection-environment label lacustrine - large; collection preservation-mode label body,replaced with pyrite,replaced with limonite. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: 既有采集行保留 Frey et al.（2003）、ref:32116；2021 年六位作者共享引文与新旧读阅范围分别绑定。本批补读此前未读的解剖分节，2003 年原始描述、图像、原 CT 和补充矩阵仍未独立核齐，没有重新鉴定或复量标本。
text.en: The retained collection row keeps Frey et al. (2003), ref:32116. The six-author 2021 shared citation binds earlier and new reading scopes separately. Previously unread anatomical subsections were read here; the 2003 original description, images, raw CT and supplementary matrix remain incompletely assembled or independently checked, without specimen reidentification or remeasurement.

readerLimitations.zh: 本页新增 2021 年关联骨架研究的选段双语导读，并保留固定 PBDB 出现资料。所用标本精确地点与层位未知；论文地质背景写 Aptian，系统描述的层位行写 Albian，这一内部差异未被静默统一，也未改写数据库年代区间。本批补读此前未读的解剖分节；原始描述、图像与补充材料仍未核齐，未独立检查标本、测量、扫描或重算矩阵。食性、飞行、性二型和成熟度各保留作者推断范围；完整物种专论仍待完成。 本批新增肩带、前臂、腕掌、骨盆、腿足与尺寸表导读，未独立检查扫描或复量；表 4 翼指侧别与正文差异保留，读者端交付尚未完成。 本批选读两套官方补充矩阵的表头、相关分类行、部分性状定义与命令；未审计全部矩阵、复算树或检查原始 CT，不能把未解分叉及缺失编码改写为已确定的种间关系。
readerLimitations.en: This page adds a bilingual guide to selected passages of the 2021 associated-skeleton study and retains fixed PBDB occurrences. Exact specimen locality and horizon are unknown. The geological setting says Aptian, whereas the systematic horizon line says Albian; that internal discrepancy is not silently harmonized or used to revise database age brackets. Previously unread anatomical subsections were read here; original descriptions, images and supplements remain incompletely assembled or inspected. No independent specimen inspection, measurement, scanning or matrix reanalysis was performed. Diet, flight, sexual dimorphism and maturity retain the authors’ inferential scope; a full monograph remain pending. This batch adds girdles, forearm, wrist/metacarpus, pelvis, legs/feet and measurement tables without independent scan inspection or remeasurement. The Table 4 wing-phalanx side discrepancy remains unresolved; reader-facing delivery is pending. This batch inspects selected headers, relevant taxon rows, character definitions and commands in the two official supplemental matrices. A complete matrix audit, tree rerun and raw CT inspection remain pending; unresolved branching and missing scores do not establish resolved species relationships.

evidenceSummary: This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. evidenceSummary: The existing collection sections guide PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, while the added account reads the 2023 revision; together they remain short of a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled; The 2023 front matter, Introduction, Methods through nomenclatural acts, two holotype accounts, statistical results, species interpretations and Tables 4–5, crest sections, Nemicolopterus comments, phylogenetic results, systematic accounts and Conclusions were read. Other specimen accounts, detailed anatomical-variation discussion and part of Methods remain unread. Images, specimens, supplementary measurements and matrices were not independently inspected or recalculated. Original 2003 descriptions, complete life history, diet remain incomplete; synonymy, juvenile size and identification retain their sources.

title.zh: 从未成熟正模读身体与种名
title.en: Read anatomy and names from an immature holotype

text.zh: Sinopterus dongi 的正模 IVPP V 13363 在 2023 年修订中被判断为幼体。修订结合头骨与肢骨比较，把多项旧种名归到本种，并另认 Huaxiadraco corollatus。这里先读材料与方法，再读种名解释；目录中的历史入口不直接表示这些名称都是独立生物物种。
text.en: The 2023 revision regards the Sinopterus dongi holotype IVPP V 13363 as a juvenile. Cranial and limb comparisons place several older names within this species while recognizing Huaxiadraco corollatus separately. Read material and methods before name interpretations; historical catalogue entries do not establish that all names represent separate biological species.

title.zh: 诊断使用头骨、颈椎与肢骨组合
title.en: Diagnosis combines skull, neck and limb features

text.zh: 修订的本种组合包括轻度下折吻部、较长鼻眶前孔、近四边形眼眶、较直的鼻骨下降突、第四颈椎长于第五颈椎，以及较长第一掌骨。作者另列翼膜支骨短于尺骨一半、第一跖骨不短于第二跖骨等鉴别特征。正模有部位位移，部分比例依赖复位；组合用于材料比较，不将单个角度当作全部个体恒定值。
text.en: The revision’s combination includes a gently downturned rostrum, elongate nasoantorbital fenestra, approximately quadrangular orbit, near-vertical descending nasal process, fourth cervical longer than the fifth, and elongate first metacarpal. Further diagnostic features include a pteroid shorter than half the ulna and a first metatarsal at least as long as the second. Displacement in the holotype makes some proportions reconstruction-dependent; the combination guides comparisons rather than making one angle invariant across individuals.

title.zh: 骨骼融合提供相对成长顺序
title.en: Fusion supplies a relative developmental sequence

text.zh: 正模的肩胛与乌喙骨、肱骨骨端、腕骨、第一翼指节的伸肌腱突和胫跗骨等仍未融合，作者据与同组更成熟材料对比判断幼体。约 1.2 米翼展是该标本的估计，不是成体最大值；研究用肱骨长度比较体型，以骨融合排相对阶段，没有给出本种每阶段的确定岁数。
text.en: Unfused scapula and coracoid, humeral epiphysis, carpals, first wing-phalanx extensor tendon process and tibiotarsus support a juvenile assessment relative to more mature specimens in the group. The roughly 1.2 m wingspan estimates this specimen, not maximum adult size. Humeral length provides a size proxy and fusion orders relative stages, without establishing exact ages for each stage.

title.zh: 先排除成长信号，再比较形态群
title.en: Separate growth signals before comparing morphotypes

text.zh: 作者先用肱骨长度作为体型代理，检查 21 项测量的大小相关与异速生长，再以较少受成长影响的比例做聚类与主成分分析。缺失值分别用均值和迭代补值；材料不全的 BPV-077 与极幼小的 Nemicolopterus 标本没有进入这组形态数据。排除不全材料限制了模型适用范围，也不能把未显著相关写成已经证明完全不受成长影响。
text.en: Using humeral length as a size proxy, the authors examine size correlations and allometry in 21 measurements before clustering and principal-component analyses of proportions judged less affected by growth. Missing values are treated by mean and iterative imputation. Incomplete BPV-077 and the very young Nemicolopterus specimen are excluded from this morphometric dataset. Exclusions limit model scope, and a nonsignificant correlation does not prove complete independence from growth.

title.zh: 两组形态支持作者的两种解释
title.en: Two morphotypes support the authors’ two-species interpretation

text.zh: 作者的定量与定性比较划分两个形态群，把第一组解释为 S. dongi、第二组解释为 H. corollatus。2023 年把 S. gui、Huaxiapterus jii、S. lingyuanensis 和 H. atavismus 列为 S. dongi 的异名。聚类反映相似性，不是亲缘树；作者另用系统发育分析决定属级归属。本页没有重新鉴定或复算矩阵，也没有合并固定数据库的出现记录。
text.en: Quantitative and qualitative comparisons recover two morphotypes, interpreted as S. dongi and H. corollatus. The 2023 work treats S. gui, Huaxiapterus jii, S. lingyuanensis and H. atavismus as junior synonyms of S. dongi. Clustering describes similarity rather than genealogy; a separate phylogenetic analysis informs genus assignment. Specimens and matrices were not independently reassessed here, and fixed database occurrences were not merged.

title.zh: 冠的有无、大小和形状回答不同问题
title.en: Crest presence, size and shape answer different questions

text.zh: 修订把最小幼体缺少前上颌骨冠与成长联系起来；同一形态群内较大材料的冠大小仍变动，可能还受个体或性别差异影响。冠的形状则与两组身体特征对应：S. dongi 的有冠型呈隆起轮廓，H. corollatus 的有冠型较梯形。这是作者的样本解释，不是给任何单件标本确定雌雄，也不是所有翼龙都遵循同一冠饰规律。
text.en: The revision links absent premaxillary crests in the smallest juveniles to growth. Crest size still varies among larger specimens within a morphotype, potentially reflecting individual or sexual variation. Shape corresponds to the body-character groups: a heaped outline in crested S. dongi versus a more trapezoidal crest in H. corollatus. This interprets the sample without determining an individual’s sex or imposing one crest rule on all pterosaurs.

title.zh: 地层重叠尚不能确定同地点共栖
title.en: Stratigraphic overlap does not establish shared localities

text.zh: 修订认为两种的地层分布重叠，可能曾在同一时期存在，但明确说尚未从完全相同地点发现两者。部分材料只知来自朝阳，具体层位控制不足。生态位分化需要更细沉积与地点证据，不能从两个形态群推出已知食物分工、群体行为或确定的共同栖地。
text.en: The revision interprets stratigraphic overlap as possible temporal coexistence, while explicitly noting that both species are not known from the exact same localities. Some material is only localized to Chaoyang, with poor bed control. Niche partitioning needs finer locality and sedimentary evidence; two morphotypes do not establish food partitioning, group behavior or a known shared habitat.

title.zh: 幼体模型中的名称需要随研究年份阅读
title.en: Read juvenile-model identities with their study date

text.zh: 2021 年飞行研究把 IVPP V-14377（Nemicolopterus 正模）解释为 S. dongi 的近出壳幼体；2023 年修订认为其过于幼小，无法可靠归到 S. dongi 或 H. corollatus，保留为 Sinopterinae 未定材料。因此 2021 年以此名称给出的模型不是本种已经无争议的幼体性能。可对读 [S. gui](../Sinopterus_gui/page.zh.md) 的保存与异名问题，再看 [Pterodaustro guinazui](../../../../../../Lophocratia/Pterodaustro/Pterodaustro_guinazui/page.zh.md) 的另一组模型输入。
text.en: The 2021 flight study interprets IVPP V-14377, the Nemicolopterus holotype, as a near-hatching S. dongi. The 2023 revision regards its youth as preventing reliable assignment to either S. dongi or H. corollatus and retains it as indeterminate Sinopterinae. Models published under the 2021 name therefore do not establish an uncontested species-specific hatchling performance. Compare preservation and synonymy in [S. gui](../Sinopterus_gui/page.en.md), then the other model inputs in [Pterodaustro guinazui](../../../../../../Lophocratia/Pterodaustro/Pterodaustro_guinazui/page.en.md).

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Sinopterus dongi 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Sinopterus。本页导读 2 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 2 个采集记录和 2 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Sinopterus dongi is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Sinopterus. This guide uses 2 eligible species-level occurrence records from 2 collections and 2 reference identifiers. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Lamagou, Dongdadao, Chaoyang（Liaoning），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Jiufotang；数据库年代范围 121.4–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Aptian。采集记录 Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY)（Liaoning），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Jiufotang；数据库年代范围 121.4–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Aptian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Lamagou, Dongdadao, Chaoyang (Liaoning), region code CN, stratum name Jiufotang; database age bracket 121.4–113.2 Ma, early interval Aptian. Collection Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) (Liaoning), region code CN, stratum name Jiufotang; database age bracket 121.4–113.2 Ma, early interval Aptian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 121.4–113.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 121.4–113.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Lamagou, Dongdadao, Chaoyang 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存、软组织（body,adpression,soft parts）。Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存（body,adpression）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Lamagou, Dongdadao, Chaoyang has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression,soft parts. Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Lamagou, Dongdadao, Chaoyang 的数据库引文署名为 Wang and Zhou（2002），编号 ref:31347。Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) 的数据库引文署名为 Lü et al.（2006），编号 ref:31355。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Lamagou, Dongdadao, Chaoyang carries database reference attribution Wang and Zhou (2002), identifier ref:31347. Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) carries database reference attribution Lü et al. (2006), identifier ref:31355. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

title.zh: 这个入口保留一个有修订争议的历史种名
title.en: This entry retains a historically named, revised species concept

text.zh: Sinopterus gui 是当前固定 PBDB 工作名录的接受名，而 2023 年原研究将其正模 BPV-077 归入 S. dongi，并列 S. gui 为异名。本页保留数据库入口以追溯原记录，同时明确标本解释；两个目录入口不能直接计为两个已经证明独立的生物物种。
text.en: Sinopterus gui is an accepted name in the fixed PBDB working roster, while the 2023 study refers its holotype BPV-077 to S. dongi and treats S. gui as a junior synonym. This entry retains the database record for traceability alongside the specimen interpretation. Two catalogue entries do not directly establish two separate biological species.

title.zh: 破碎骨面限制可观察的身体细节
title.en: Damaged bone surfaces limit observable anatomy

text.zh: 2023 年记述 BPV-077 骨面破损、受压，头骨主要呈左侧视，后部另有破裂与转位。吻部没有前上颌骨冠、下颌联合有很浅的冠；可辨的翼指只有第一指节，掌骨比例与部分颈椎细节无法可靠评估。因此本页没有用缺失后段重建完整翼形或精确头骨姿势。
text.en: The 2023 account describes damaged, crushed bone surfaces in BPV-077. The skull is mainly exposed from the left, with breakage and displacement posteriorly. The rostrum lacks a premaxillary crest and the mandibular symphysis has a shallow crest; only the first wing phalanx is preserved, and metacarpal proportions and some cervical details cannot be reliably assessed. Missing portions do not supply a complete wing shape or exact skull posture.

title.zh: 未融合支持幼体判断，翼展估计仍有分歧
title.en: Unfused bones support youth while wingspan estimates differ

text.zh: 腭与后头骨、背椎椎体与神经弓、肩胛与乌喙骨、骨盆以及胫腓骨未融合，支持很幼小的个体解释。该标本专节引用约 64 厘米翼展，另一正模比较段却写约 0.8 米；本页保留同文估计差异，不选一个作为确定翼展。作者讨论中也纠正早期所称背椎融合，未由旧诊断断定成体。
text.en: Unfused palatal and posterior skull bones, dorsal centra and neural arches, scapula and coracoid, pelvis and tibia/fibula support a very young individual. Its specimen account cites roughly 64 cm wingspan, while another holotype-comparison passage gives about 0.8 m. This internal difference is retained without choosing a definitive body size. The discussion also rejects the earlier claim of fused dorsals rather than using that old diagnosis to infer adulthood.

title.zh: 归入 S. dongi 不等于本标本参加了全部统计
title.en: Referral to S. dongi does not mean inclusion in every analysis

text.zh: 修订认为 BPV-077 与 S. dongi 的差异主要可由成长解释，尤其是缺少前上颌骨冠，因而维持异名处理。但 BPV-077 因不完整没有进入形态测量数据集；它的归属依赖定性比较与整体解释，不能写成统计模型对本件进行了全部直接测量或单独证明其种级身份。
text.en: The revision interprets differences from S. dongi, especially the absent premaxillary crest, as compatible with growth and maintains synonymy. BPV-077 was excluded from the morphometric dataset because of incompleteness. Its referral therefore relies on qualitative comparison and the broader interpretation, rather than every statistical model directly measuring or independently proving this specimen’s species identity.

title.zh: 按标本、保存和研究归属追读
title.en: Follow specimen, preservation and study-specific referral

text.zh: 先读 BPV-077 的保存和融合情况，再进入 [Sinopterus dongi](../Sinopterus_dongi/page.zh.md) 的身体组合与 2023 年异名解释。原始 2003 年描述尚未独立读齐，固定数据库的 PROXY 采集行也不是重新检查过的正模产地档案。这里没有根据异名把所有旧记录合并、重算分布或断定食性。
text.en: Read BPV-077 preservation and fusion first, then the anatomical combination and 2023 synonymy account in [Sinopterus dongi](../Sinopterus_dongi/page.en.md). The original 2003 description has not been independently assembled in full, and the fixed database PROXY collection row is not a newly checked holotype locality archive. Synonymy does not merge all old records, recalculate distribution or establish diet here.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Sinopterus gui 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Sinopterus。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Sinopterus gui is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Sinopterus. This guide uses 1 eligible species-level occurrence record from 1 collection and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY)（Liaoning），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Jiufotang；数据库年代范围 121.4–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Aptian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) (Liaoning), region code CN, stratum name Jiufotang; database age bracket 121.4–113.2 Ma, early interval Aptian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 121.4–113.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 121.4–113.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存（body,adpression）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) 的数据库引文署名为 Li et al.（2003），编号 ref:31354。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) carries database reference attribution Li et al. (2003), identifier ref:31354. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: 仅来源所述材料和数据库记录范围。
scope.en: Only material and database-record scope described by this source.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: 所选有引文、年代和地点的无疑问限定种级记录；不是全种生态或形态综合。
scope.en: Selected cited species-level records without uncertain qualifiers, with ages and locality context; not whole-species ecology or morphology.

title.en: Paleobiology Database Data Service 1.2 — occurrence field documentation
title.zh: Paleobiology Database Data Service 1.2 — occurrence field documentation

scope.zh: 解释数据库出现、采集、年代与层位字段，不替代原论文或标本复核。
scope.en: Interpret database occurrence, collection, age and strata fields; not a substitute for original papers or specimen review.

title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: PBDB 接受名、外部 OID 和记录父链；不与 COL 概念等同，不裁决系统发育。
scope.en: PBDB accepted name, external OID and recorded parent chain; no equivalence with COL or phylogenetic adjudication.

title.zh: A taxonomic revision of the Sinopterus complex (Pterosauria, Tapejaridae) from the Early Cretaceous Jehol Biota, with the new genus Huaxiadraco
title.en: A taxonomic revision of the Sinopterus complex (Pterosauria, Tapejaridae) from the Early Cretaceous Jehol Biota, with the new genus Huaxiadraco

scope.zh: 2023 年修订的正模、成长、形态组合、异名与幼体鉴定边界；固定目录身份单独保留。
scope.en: Holotypes, growth, anatomical combinations, synonymy and juvenile-identification limits in the 2023 revision; fixed catalogue identity remains separate.

readerLimitations.zh: 既有采集章节导读 2026-10-02 PBDB 出现记录，新增正文另读 2023 年修订；合起来仍不是完整物种专论。只纳入固定 276 项翼龙工作名录中，当前名称一致、父链可追到已记录 Pterosauria 存储锚点、且有可用无疑问限定种级出现记录的条目。数据库接受名可能连接旧组合；这种数据库对应关系不裁决实际标本鉴定或所有分类争议，也不与 COL 同名概念合并。采集地点、地层区间、沉积环境和集合保存方式各有不同含义：它们不能直接推出完整分布、起源或灭绝时刻、该物种的固定生态、生物数量或每件标本的保存状态。原始描述、重描述、形态、食性和行为材料尚未逐项补齐；。 本批实际读取 2023 年修订前页、导言、方法至命名行为、两个正模条目、统计结果、种级解释与表 4–5、冠饰、Nemicolopterus、亲缘结果、系统描述和结论；其他标本条目、详细身体变异讨论与部分方法未全部读齐。图像、标本、补充测量表和矩阵未独立检查或复算。2003 年原始描述、完整生活史、食性仍未完成；异名、幼体尺寸与鉴定均保留来源。
readerLimitations.en: The existing collection sections guide PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, while the added account reads the 2023 revision; together they remain short of a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled; The 2023 front matter, Introduction, Methods through nomenclatural acts, two holotype accounts, statistical results, species interpretations and Tables 4–5, crest sections, Nemicolopterus comments, phylogenetic results, systematic accounts and Conclusions were read. Other specimen accounts, detailed anatomical-variation discussion and part of Methods remain unread. Images, specimens, supplementary measurements and matrices were not independently inspected or recalculated. Original 2003 descriptions, complete life history, diet remain incomplete; synonymy, juvenile size and identification retain their sources.

context.zh: 返回记录父级的阅读入口，保留各出现与采集记录的范围。
context.en: Return to the recorded parent reading route, retaining occurrence and collection scope.

context.zh: 对读该物种的具名采集地、地层区间与原引文；不是完整生态比较。
context.en: Compare this species’ named collections, stratigraphic brackets and original reference links; not a complete ecological comparison.

overview: The 2025 Araripe review records holotype MN 4726-V as a nearly complete skull and lower jaw accompanied by a scapula, coracoid, sternum, humerus, part of the right first phalanx of digit IV and rib fragments. This is an incomplete skeleton. The review retains the original study’s adult interpretation, which supplies neither an exact age or sex nor a species-wide growth series.

ecology.diet: Not assessed from occurrence counts or depositional setting.
ecology.habitat: Collection environments are not a species-wide habitat assessment.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed from this occurrence batch.

evidenceSummary: This batch reads all main sections of the 2024 palatal study and the complete genus/species account plus paragraphs naming the genus in the 2025 review. Only publication information and the abstract of the 2013 original description were obtained. Later matrices, the underlying 2021 bite-force study, images, scans, specimens and complete development remain independently unexamined. Conditional referrals, horizon discrepancies and classification revisions remain unresolved. A full monograph and reader-facing delivery are pending.

title.zh: 一件近完整头骨与有限的身体材料
title.en: A nearly complete skull with limited body material

text.zh: 2025 年 Araripe 翼龙综述记录 Caupedactylus ybaka 正模 MN 4726-V：接近完整的头骨与下颌，加上肩胛骨、乌喙骨、胸骨、肱骨、右侧第四指第一节指骨的一部分和肋骨碎片。它并非完整骨架。综述把原始研究的成年个体解释保留下来，但这一判断不提供确切岁数、性别或全种成长序列。
text.en: The 2025 Araripe review records holotype MN 4726-V as a nearly complete skull and lower jaw accompanied by a scapula, coracoid, sternum, humerus, part of the right first phalanx of digit IV and rib fragments. This is an incomplete skeleton. The review retains the original study’s adult interpretation, which supplies neither an exact age or sex nor a species-wide growth series.

title.zh: 向下弯的吻部与沿前后延伸的骨冠
title.en: A downturned rostrum and a crest extending lengthwise

text.zh: 综述转述的诊断将沿前后方向延伸的前上颌骨矢状冠、下弯吻部和轻微凹入的头骨腹缘结合起来；闭合时前端上下颌之间没有间隙。颧骨泪骨突向后倾斜，方骨相对头骨腹缘约呈 150°。这些是所述标本的形态组合；骨冠形态并未直接证明性别、展示行为或体温调节功能。
text.en: The diagnosis reproduced in the review combines a premaxillary sagittal crest extending anteroposteriorly, a downturned rostrum and a mildly concave ventral skull margin. The anterior jaws leave no gap in closure. The jugal’s lacrimal process inclines posteriorly, and the quadrate lies at about 150° to the ventral skull margin. This specimen-based combination does not directly establish sex, display behavior or a thermoregulatory role for the crest.

title.zh: 腭孔名称随骨界解释而改变
title.en: Palatal opening names depend on interpreted bone boundaries

text.zh: 2024 年研究用其他翼龙的 CT 与层析成像重新解释上颌骨、腭骨、翼骨和外翼骨的边界。作者把前人称作某些腭骨或外翼骨的结构重新归属，并建议相应调整孔窗名称；Caupedactylus 的旧图也进入比较。读到旧诊断中的狭缝状 postpalatinal fenestra 时，需要核对该作者采用的骨界，不能只凭孔名认定不同论文描述了同一孔窗。
text.en: The 2024 study uses CT and laminography of other pterosaurs to reinterpret boundaries among the maxilla, palatine, pterygoid and ectopterygoid. Reassigned elements lead to proposed changes in opening names, with earlier Caupedactylus illustrations included in comparison. The slit-like postpalatinal fenestra in an older diagnosis must therefore be read against that author’s bone boundaries; matching names alone do not establish matching openings.

title.zh: 本种参与比较，但没有被新扫描
title.en: Included in comparison without a new scan

text.zh: 2024 年表 1 列出 MN 4726-V，却没有把它标为该研究新扫描的标本；图注说明本种腭部图改自早期出版物。作者认为它可能具有 Y 形腭骨，并讨论其较大的翼骨孔窗及后移的后鼻孔后缘。这些是该研究的比较解释，不能称为本种新 CT 揭示的内部骨缝。本页没有查看原始扫描、三维模型或图像像素。
text.en: Table 1 of the 2024 paper lists MN 4726-V without marking it as newly scanned, and the caption identifies the Caupedactylus palatal illustration as modified from earlier literature. The authors suggest a possible Y-shaped palatine and discuss its larger pterygoid openings and posteriorly displaced choanal rear margin. These are comparative interpretations, not newly revealed internal sutures from a Caupedactylus CT scan. Raw scans, 3D models and figure pixels were not inspected for this page.

title.zh: 潜在归入材料仍有条件
title.en: Possible referrals remain conditional

text.zh: 2025 年综述讨论了一件 2009 年拍卖、现下落不明的完整头骨，以及腭部残片 MPSC R 859。后者在后鼻孔前方平坦的腭面上与正模相似，但破碎程度使作者无法确定归属。综述又把 SMNK PAL 6410 与本种比较，并指出 KPMNH DL 84 需要详细重评。这些讨论并未把所有材料确认为本种；不能据此累计确定个体数或扩大全种分布。
text.en: The 2025 review discusses a complete skull auctioned in 2009 whose whereabouts are unknown, and palatal fragment MPSC R 859. The latter resembles the holotype in having a flat palate anterior to the choanae, but fragmentation prevents a firm referral. The review also compares SMNK PAL 6410 with this species and calls for detailed reassessment of KPMNH DL 84. These discussions do not confirm all material as this species and cannot support a definite individual count or an expanded species distribution.

title.zh: 后续亲缘方案与固定目录并列阅读
title.en: Read later relationship proposals beside the fixed directory

text.zh: 原始研究把本种视作较早分化的 tapejarid；2025 年综述汇总后续分析，将它与 Aymberedactylus cearensis 放入 Caupedactylia。综述讨论下颌联合背侧阶状隆起的缺失及齿骨窝平坦表面等比较特征。当前目录的 Tapejarinae 父链来自固定数据库记录，不能代表所有后来研究的结论。本页呈现综述方案，未重跑其所引矩阵，也未自行解决可能涉及较早名称的同物异名问题。
text.en: Originally interpreted as an early-diverging tapejarid, the species is placed with Aymberedactylus cearensis in Caupedactylia by later analyses summarized in the 2025 review. Comparative features include the absence of a step-like dorsal eminence of the mandibular symphysis and a flat dentary-fossa surface. The directory’s Tapejarinae parent chain is a fixed database record rather than the conclusion of every later study. This page presents the review’s scheme without rerunning cited matrices or adjudicating possible synonymy involving an earlier name.

title.zh: 地面取食的泛食者是模型解释
title.en: A ground-feeding generalist is a model-based interpretation

text.zh: 综述汇总 2021 年咬合力研究，把 Caupedactylus ybaka 解释为可能在地面取食的泛食者；与专食坚硬植物材料的 Tapejara 假说相比，其颌部特征和较低的肌肉机械优势支持不同功能解释。本页没有独立读完该项 2021 年研究或重算咬合力，因此明确保留综述转述的层级。它不是胃内容物、直接进食观察、确定食谱或已经验证的生态位分工。
text.en: The review summarizes a 2021 bite-force study interpreting Caupedactylus ybaka as a possible ground-feeding generalist. Jaw features and reduced muscular mechanical advantage support a different functional interpretation from the hard-plant diet proposed for Tapejara. The underlying 2021 study was not independently read in full or recalculated here, so this remains a review-mediated model interpretation rather than gut contents, an observed meal, a fixed menu or demonstrated niche partitioning.

title.zh: 论文层位与数据库层名仍不一致
title.en: Paper horizon and database stratum remain discrepant

text.zh: 2025 年综述将正模层位列为 Romualdo 组，并明确说具体地点未知；2013 年原始论文标题也指向 Romualdo。当前固定数据库出现行却记录 Crato，使用 119.57–113.2 Ma 区间。两者并列保留，尚未核对原采集档案以解决差异。数据库采集条目不能补出论文未知的正模地点，这个宽区间也不是本种起源、灭绝或正模直接测年。
text.en: The 2025 review assigns the holotype to the Romualdo Formation and explicitly lists its locality as unknown; the 2013 original paper’s title also names Romualdo. The fixed database occurrence instead records Crato and a 119.57–113.2 Ma bracket. Both are retained pending collection-record reconciliation. A database collection entry does not establish the holotype locality missing from the paper, and its broad bracket is neither an origin or extinction estimate nor a direct holotype date.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Caupedactylus ybaka 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Caupedactylus。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。

title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Between Nova Olinda and Santana do Cariri（Ceará），地区代码 BR，地层名称 Crato；数据库年代范围 119.57–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Late Aptian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Between Nova Olinda and Santana do Cariri (Ceará), region code BR, stratum name Crato; database age bracket 119.57–113.2 Ma, early interval Late Aptian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 119.57–113.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Between Nova Olinda and Santana do Cariri 的采集环境标签为 陆相沉积环境，类型未定（terrestrial indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、原磷酸盐成分（body,original phosphate）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Between Nova Olinda and Santana do Cariri has collection-environment label terrestrial indet.; collection preservation-mode label body,original phosphate. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

text.zh: 数据库采集记录的简略引文为 Kellner（2013），编号 ref:48270。本批取得原始描述的出版信息与摘要：作者 Alexander W. A. Kellner，DOI 10.1017/S1755691013000327，标题指向 Romualdo 组；原始全文仍未取得。正文新增解释主要据实际读取的 2024 年研究与 2025 年综述。数据库原行与采集 ID 继续保留，尚未独立复核标本或解决层位差异。
text.en: The database collection carries the abbreviated attribution Kellner (2013), reference ref:48270. This batch obtained publication information and the abstract of the original description: Alexander W. A. Kellner, DOI 10.1017/S1755691013000327, with Romualdo in the title. Its full text remains unavailable. Added interpretation chiefly uses the actually read 2024 study and 2025 review. Database rows and collection IDs remain retained; specimens and the horizon discrepancy have not been independently resolved.

Conditional referrals, horizon discrepancies and classification revisions remain unresolved. A full monograph and reader-facing delivery are pending.

overview: After the bonebed and crest-growth sections, continue to [Keresdrakon vilsoni](../../../../../../Tapejaromorpha/Keresdrakon/Keresdrakon_vilsoni/page.en.md) for long jaws, anatomical diagnosis and histological samples. evidenceSummary:
This page combines the principal 2014 original-description text, selected 2022 cranial passages and fixed PBDB occurrences. The original age discussion depends on stratigraphic correlations of its time and is not narrowed to an exact age or used to revise the broad database bracket. All supplements, the full 2022 anatomy, later histology and all taxonomic literature remain unread. No independent specimen inspection, individual recount or matrix rerun occurred. Aggregation, juvenile flight, sexual dimorphism, diet and mortality retain inference limits; a full monograph remain pending.

The comparative route additionally uses the already-read 2019 shared-bonebed and 2020 dinosaur-histology main texts. Samples and models apply to their respective taxa; cross-links do not complete the site fauna or all developmental research.

title.zh: 从多阶段骨床转向另一种翼龙
title.en: Move from a growth-series bonebed to another pterosaur

text.zh: 读完本种骨床与冠饰成长后，进入 [Keresdrakon vilsoni](../../../../../../Tapejaromorpha/Keresdrakon/Keresdrakon_vilsoni/page.zh.md) 的长颌、骨骼鉴别和组织样本。2019 年研究把两者在 A–C 骨床的反复关联作为共存依据，同时提醒较大 Caiuajara 与较小 Keresdrakon 的孤立头后骨可能难以区分。比较时先看诊断部位与保存状态，不能只用骨骼大小决定归属。
text.en: After the bonebed and crest-growth sections, continue to [Keresdrakon vilsoni](../../../../../../Tapejaromorpha/Keresdrakon/Keresdrakon_vilsoni/page.en.md) for long jaws, anatomical diagnosis and histological samples. The 2019 study uses repeated association in bonebeds A–C to support coexistence, while warning that isolated postcranial bones of larger Caiuajara and smaller Keresdrakon can be difficult to distinguish. Compare diagnostic regions and preservation before using size to assign material.

title.zh: 把形态成长与年龄反推分别比较
title.en: Compare morphological development separately from retrocalculated ages

text.zh: 再读 [Vespersaurus paranaensis](../../../../../../../../../../Dinosauromorpha/Dinosauriformes/Dinosauria/Theropoda/Neotheropoda/Averostra/Ceratosauria/Noasauridae/Noasaurinae/Vespersaurus/Vespersaurus_paranaensis/page.zh.md) 的股骨与胫骨组织学。本种冠饰和融合序列、Keresdrakon 的两件组织样本、恐龙的十一件后肢骨，所记录的身体部位和取样方法不同。恐龙研究假定的新生骨尺寸及股骨／胫骨年龄分歧不能移入本种；三页也没有被合并为同一个遗址的统一成长曲线。
text.en: Then read the femoral and tibial histology of [Vespersaurus paranaensis](../../../../../../../../../../Dinosauromorpha/Dinosauriformes/Dinosauria/Theropoda/Neotheropoda/Averostra/Ceratosauria/Noasauridae/Noasaurinae/Vespersaurus/Vespersaurus_paranaensis/page.en.md). Caiuajara crest and fusion sequences, the two Keresdrakon histological samples and eleven dinosaur hind-limb bones use different body regions and sampling methods. The dinosaur’s assumed neonatal dimensions and femoral–tibial age disagreement are not transferred to Caiuajara, and the three pages do not form one site-wide growth curve.

title.zh: 一处骨床提供多个成长阶段
title.en: A bonebed preserves several growth stages

text.zh: Caiuajara dobruskii 来自巴西 Paraná 的 Cruzeiro do Oeste。2014 年原始描述以部分骨架 CP.V 1449 为正模，并利用同地点大量颅骨与身体材料比较大小不同的个体。骨床因此能提供超出单件头骨的成长资料，但多数骨骼混杂，不能把每一根骨头都还原到一个确定个体。2022 年研究加入头骨 CP.V 8175 等材料，继续检视头骨保存与变异。
text.en: Caiuajara dobruskii comes from Cruzeiro do Oeste, Paraná, Brazil. The 2014 original description designates partial skeleton CP.V 1449 as holotype and compares abundant cranial and postcranial material from the locality across different sizes. This provides growth evidence beyond one isolated skull, although most bones are mixed and cannot be allocated to particular individuals. A 2022 study adds skull CP.V 8175 and other material to examine cranial preservation and variation.

title.zh: 聚集记录包含多次埋藏与搬运
title.en: The accumulation includes repeated burial and transport

text.zh: 2014 年论文报告数百块骨骼，依据前上颌骨估计至少 47 个个体；该下限与数据库的一条出现行不是同一计数单位。材料来自多个相邻层位，有些保持关节连接，大多散开混杂，部分在埋藏前已断裂。作者还识别出水动力分选的迹象。骨床因此不能简单画成同一瞬间死亡的完整群体，最少个体数也不是古种群总规模。本文引用的是正文报告，没有独立重计补充清单。
text.en: The 2014 paper reports hundreds of bones and a minimum of 47 individuals based on premaxillae, a different unit from one database occurrence row. Material occurs at several nearby levels: some remains are articulated, most are disassociated and mixed, and some bones broke before burial. The authors also identify evidence of hydraulic sorting. The deposit cannot simply be reconstructed as one intact group dying simultaneously, and its minimum individual count is not total population size. The number is quoted from the main text without independently recounting the supplementary list.

title.zh: 无齿吻部与颅骨鉴别特征
title.en: A toothless rostrum and diagnostic cranial features

text.zh: 本种吻端向下弯曲，前上颌骨形成高冠，并有骨性扩张伸入鼻眶前孔。下颌咬合面的圆形凹陷也是原始诊断的一部分。前上颌骨上的小孔让作者推测存在类似鸟喙的角质覆盖；这不是保存了完整喙鞘的直接证据。骨性扩张的功能未明，形态诊断也不能独自确定水果或其他食物在食谱中的比例。
text.en: The toothless rostrum bends downward, with a tall premaxillary crest and a bony expansion projecting into the nasoantorbital fenestra. A rounded depression on the mandibular occlusal surface also forms part of the original diagnosis. Premaxillary foramina lead the authors to infer a birdlike horny covering, rather than directly documenting a complete preserved sheath. The bony expansion has no established function, and diagnostic morphology alone does not determine the share of fruit or other foods in the diet.

title.zh: 冠饰随生长改变，仍有个体差异
title.en: Crests change with growth and retain individual variation

text.zh: 2014 年样本中，小个体前上颌冠较小并向后倾，较大个体的冠更高、更陡；下颌冠也随较大的成长阶段更加发达。作者把这组差异主要解释为发育变化。2022 年又比较相近尺寸个体的冠后背缘，指出薄厚与形状并不完全一致，讨论了性二型可能性，也提醒尚未完全发育的个体可能与另一性别成体相似。因此，冠饰存在、大小或外形都不能直接当作个体性别标签，尺寸也不是精确年龄。
text.en: In the 2014 sample, small individuals have smaller, backward-inclined premaxillary crests; larger individuals have taller, steeper crests and more developed dentary crests. The authors mainly interpret this sequence as development. Comparing similarly sized individuals in 2022, researchers also find differences in the thickness and shape of the posterodorsal crest margin. They discuss possible sexual dimorphism while warning that immature individuals may resemble adults of another sex. Crest presence, size or shape therefore cannot directly label sex, and size is not an exact age.

title.zh: 身体比例与骨骼融合共同记录成长
title.en: Body proportions and fusion record different aspects of growth

text.zh: 原始描述中的肱骨和多数身体骨骼从小到大大体保持相似形状，但骨化、胸骨、前耻骨与乌喙骨仍有成长差异；成体肩胛骨与乌喙骨融合，幼体中未融合。论文没有发现背椎联合体。作者据较早出现的身体比例推测幼体可能很早具备飞行能力，但没有观察幼体起飞或测定首次飞行年龄。不能把“比例相似”改写成全部组织在各阶段都已经成熟。
text.en: Humeri and most postcranial elements retain broadly similar shapes across sizes in the original description, while ossification, sternum, prepubis and coracoid still vary with development. The scapula and coracoid fuse in adults but remain separate in juveniles; no notarium is reported. Early establishment of body proportions leads the authors to suggest flight at a young age, without observations of juvenile launch or an age at first flight. Similar proportions do not establish that every tissue is already mature.

title.zh: 群居解释与死亡原因各有边界
title.en: Social behavior and mortality retain different uncertainties

text.zh: 2014 年作者把密集、反复出现的材料解释为沙漠内陆湖附近的群居翼龙，也考虑过迁徙造访；长期居留是其偏好的方案。风暴搬运、干旱或风暴致死都被讨论，实际死因未确定。2022 年导言还记录同一地点有 Keresdrakon 等其他脊椎动物，不能把整个遗址说成只有一种动物。群体聚集不是亲代照护的直接观察，沙丘间沉积背景也不能自动证明完整生活史或食谱。
text.en: The 2014 authors interpret dense, repeated accumulations as gregarious pterosaurs around an inland desert lake. They also consider migratory visits, preferring longer residence. Storm transport, drought and storm mortality are discussed, but the actual causes of death remain unknown. The 2022 introduction records other vertebrates at the site, including Keresdrakon, so the whole locality is not a single-species assemblage. Aggregation does not directly document parental care, and an interdunal depositional setting does not establish a complete life history or diet.

title.zh: 后续头骨研究补充下颌联合诊断
title.en: Later cranial work adds a symphyseal diagnosis

text.zh: 2022 年 CP.V 8175 保留部分连接的头骨、下颌与手部材料，骨骼虽有立体保存，仍有风化、下颌压裂和眼眶周围骨骼分离。作者借 CP.V 5703 等对照材料指出，两侧齿骨在三个位置相接，形成带内部开口的联合结构，并把它加入诊断。新材料有助于重读旧标本，不等于每个细节都来自一件无损头骨；本页只读了该研究的选定材料、诊断与讨论，完整头骨分节尚未覆盖。
text.en: CP.V 8175 in the 2022 study preserves a partly articulated skull, lower jaw and manual material. Three-dimensional preservation coexists with weathering, mandibular cracking and separation around the orbit. Using comparisons including CP.V 5703, the authors identify dentaries meeting at three positions, forming a symphyseal shelf with internal openings, and add this to the diagnosis. New material helps reinterpret older fossils without making every feature an observation from one undamaged skull. This guide covers selected material, diagnosis and discussion passages, not the full anatomical description.

title.zh: 亲缘位置取决于矩阵与取样
title.en: Relationships depend on matrix and taxon sampling

text.zh: 2014 年矩阵将 Caiuajara 放在 Tapejarinae 内的多分支中；剔除两个信息较少的类群后，才得到与 Tupandactylus 的姐妹群关系。这说明该结果对取样有依赖，不能只保留较清楚的树而隐藏未解析结果。本页沿固定 PBDB 路径保存目录，未重算原矩阵，也没有宣称解决全部 Tapejarinae 亲缘或分类争议。
text.en: The 2014 matrix places Caiuajara in a Tapejarinae polytomy. A sister relationship with Tupandactylus appears after removing two less completely known taxa. This dependence on sampling prevents presenting only the more resolved tree while omitting the unresolved result. The directory retains its fixed PBDB path, without rerunning the original matrix or claiming to resolve all Tapejarinae relationships and taxonomic disputes.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Caiuajara dobruskii 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Caiuajara。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Caiuajara dobruskii is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Caiuajara. This guide uses 1 eligible species-level occurrence record from 1 collection and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Cemitério dos Pterossauros Quarry（Paraná），地区代码 BR，地层名称 Goio-Erê；数据库年代范围 121.4–72.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Aptian、晚端时段 Campanian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Cemitério dos Pterossauros Quarry (Paraná), region code BR, stratum name Goio-Erê; database age bracket 121.4–72.2 Ma, early interval Aptian and late interval Campanian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 121.4–72.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 121.4–72.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Cemitério dos Pterossauros Quarry 的采集环境标签为 interdune；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Cemitério dos Pterossauros Quarry has collection-environment label interdune; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: 数据库继续保留 Manzig et al.（2014）、ref:52235 的原署名。现已实际读取 2014 年原始描述主要正文，并以独立共享引文记录全部十位作者；另记录 2022 年头骨重描述六位作者及选读范围。补充标本清单、矩阵、图像与后续研究仍未读齐，没有独立检查或重新鉴定标本。
text.en: The database retains its original Manzig et al. (2014), ref:52235 attribution. The principal main-text sections of the original description have now been read, with all ten authors in a separate shared reference. A further reference records six authors and the selected scope of the 2022 cranial revision. Supplementary specimen lists, matrices, images and later studies remain incompletely read, without independent inspection or reidentification.

readerLimitations.zh:
本页结合 2014 年原始描述主要正文、2022 年头骨研究选段与固定 PBDB 出现资料。论文按当时地层对比讨论年龄争议，未在这里压缩为精确年代或改写数据库宽区间。未读齐全部补充资料、2022 年解剖分节、后续骨组织学与所有分类文献，也未独立检查标本、重计个体或重算矩阵。群居、幼年飞行、性二型、食性和死因各有推断限制；完整专论仍未完成。

readerLimitations.en:
This page combines the principal 2014 original-description text, selected 2022 cranial passages and fixed PBDB occurrences. The original age discussion depends on stratigraphic correlations of its time and is not narrowed to an exact age or used to revise the broad database bracket. All supplements, the full 2022 anatomy, later histology and all taxonomic literature remain unread. No independent specimen inspection, individual recount or matrix rerun occurred. Aggregation, juvenile flight, sexual dimorphism, diet and mortality retain inference limits; a full monograph remain pending.

The comparative route additionally uses the already-read 2019 shared-bonebed and 2020 dinosaur-histology main texts. Samples and models apply to their respective taxa; cross-links do not complete the site fauna or all developmental research.

overview: The 2016 description designates MN 7596-V, housed at Museu Nacional/UFRJ, as the holotype. evidenceSummary: All five scientific main sections and textual figure captions of the 2016 description, plus the complete genus account in the 2025 review, were read. Images, physical specimens, supplementary matrices and later primary relationship studies were not independently examined. A full monograph and reader-facing delivery are pending.

title.zh: 近完整下颌是已知身体的起点
title.en: A nearly complete mandible anchors the known anatomy

text.zh: 2016 年原始描述指定 MN 7596-V 为正模，收藏于巴西国家博物馆／里约热内卢联邦大学。它是一件三维保存、长约 270 毫米的下颌，缺左侧关节后突与部分齿骨冠；没有与之关联的上颌、头后骨架或完整翼部。2025 年综述没有列出归入标本，因此不能由一个下颌推成完整身体或多年龄样本。
text.en: The 2016 description designates MN 7596-V, housed at Museu Nacional/UFRJ, as the holotype. It is a three-dimensionally preserved mandible about 270 mm long, lacking the left retroarticular process and part of the dentary crest. No associated upper jaw, postcranial skeleton or complete wing is known. The 2025 review lists no referred specimens, so this single mandible cannot supply a complete body or an age series.

title.zh: 无齿、较宽而呈 Y 形的下颌
title.en: A toothless, relatively broad Y-shaped mandible

text.zh: 两侧齿骨在前部融合，下颌联合约占全下颌长度的一半。联合后方的下颌支突然向两侧展开，形成明显 Y 形；作者报告宽长比约 0.34，两支夹角约 30°。这些比例来自所述标本及论文测量口径。虽然三维保存减少了某些压扁问题，作者仍指出背腹压缩可能减小吻端原有的向下弯曲程度。
text.en: The dentaries fuse anteriorly into a symphysis about half the total mandibular length. The rami expand abruptly behind it, producing a pronounced Y shape. The authors report a width-to-length ratio of about 0.34 and an angle near 30° between the rami, under their stated measurement conventions. Three-dimensional preservation does not remove all distortion: dorsoventral compression may have reduced the original downward curvature of the tip.

title.zh: 长关节后突与夹骨上的粗糙凹窝
title.en: An elongated retroarticular process and a rugose splenial fossa

text.zh: 原始诊断列出两个自衍征：关节后突约占全下颌长的 7%，以及夹骨上浅凹窝内独特的细粗糙纹理。较深的下颌联合后方平台、短浅的齿骨窝和全长凹入的联合背面共同补充诊断。齿骨窝腹缘破损，作者无法完整测定其原始长度；这些特征的缺损范围也要随鉴别一起阅读。
text.en: The original diagnosis identifies two autapomorphies: a retroarticular process about 7% of mandibular length and a shallow splenial fossa with distinctive fine rugosity. A deep symphyseal shelf, short shallow dentary fossa and continuously concave dorsal symphyseal surface complete the combination. Damage to the dentary fossa’s ventral margins prevents assessment of its entire original length.

title.zh: 浅冠与角质喙都有推断边界
title.en: A shallow crest and horny covering have inferential limits

text.zh: 齿骨冠大部破损，作者依据保留的前后腹缘和断裂基部宽度推断它较浅；这不是保存完整的冠高。下颌联合后背侧的小神经血管孔则被解释为可能有角质鞘覆盖。标本并未直接保存本种完整喙鞘或头顶冠饰，因此不能补出确定的颜色、轮廓或软组织结构。
text.en: Much of the dentary crest is damaged. Preserved anterior and posterior ventral edges and the widths of broken bases suggest a shallow crest rather than a directly measured complete height. Small posterodorsal neurovascular foramina suggest a possible horny sheath. Neither a complete beak covering nor a crest on the skull roof is preserved for this species, leaving color, full outline and soft-tissue architecture unknown.

title.zh: 骨缝支持亚成体，翼展来自比较
title.en: Sutures support a subadult; wingspan comes from comparison

text.zh: 2016 年作者依据齿骨与上角骨、夹骨与隅骨之间仍可见骨缝，以及关节表面的未完全骨化迹象，把正模解释为较晚亚成体。常用于翼龙成长判断的头后特征在本种未知。约 2 米翼展是以其他类群下颌比例缩放得到的估计，不是直接保存的双翼尺寸，也不是全种成年最大翼展。
text.en: Visible dentary–surangular and splenial–angular sutures, together with incomplete ossification interpreted at the joint surface, led the 2016 authors to regard the holotype as a late subadult. Postcranial maturity criteria are unavailable. The estimate of roughly 2 m wingspan is scaled from other taxa’s mandibles, rather than measured from preserved wings or established as the species’ adult maximum.

title.zh: 开口控制与弱咬合是功能假说
title.en: Jaw-opening control and weak biting are functional hypotheses

text.zh: 作者认为细薄联合、展开的下颌支和较小的肌肉附着凹窝不利于承受摇晃、扭转或处理较大且挣扎的猎物。较长关节后突则提示下颌降肌可能较发达，支持较好的开口控制。这些解释来自骨形和比较解剖，不是本种肌肉的直接保存、实测咬合力或进食观察；无齿也不能单独确定专食水果。
text.en: The authors infer that the thin symphysis, spread rami and small muscle-attachment fossae would limit resistance to shaking and torsion or handling large struggling prey. The long retroarticular process suggests a relatively developed jaw-depressor muscle and better control of opening. These are bone-based comparative interpretations rather than preserved muscles, measured bite force or an observed meal. Toothlessness alone does not establish obligate fruit eating.

title.zh: 原始位置对矩阵修改有依赖
title.en: The original placement depends on matrix changes

text.zh: 2016 年把新种加入原矩阵时，结果是与 Tapejarinae、Thalassodrominae 并列的未定成员；修改下颌比例性状并增加宽度性状后，五棵最简约树的严格共识把它置于较早分化的 Tapejarinae。作者还纠正了无齿类群锯齿性状的误编码。页面保留修改前后的区别，未独立检查补充矩阵或重跑分析；原文对比例性状编号有不一致，不在此自行裁决。
text.en: Adding the species to the original matrix left it in an unresolved relationship with Tapejarinae and Thalassodrominae. After modifying symphyseal proportions and adding jaw width, the strict consensus of five most parsimonious trees placed it as an early-diverging tapejarine. The authors also corrected serrated-tooth miscoding in toothless taxa. This distinction is retained without independently checking the supplementary matrix or rerunning analyses; inconsistent proportion-character numbering in the text is not adjudicated here.

title.zh: 与 Caupedactylus 对读后续分类
title.en: Compare later classification with Caupedactylus

text.zh: 2025 年综述保留本种有效性，指出它与 Tupandactylus 的关节后突长度和联合背侧阶状隆起不同，并汇总与 [Caupedactylus ybaka](../../Caupedactylus/Caupedactylus_ybaka/page.zh.md) 的姐妹群关系。该方案把本种置于非 tapejarid 的 tapejariform 范围，区别于 2016 年论文和当前固定目录的 Tapejarinae。综述并未把亚成体身份当作缺少阶状隆起的充分解释；本页未独立读完所引后续矩阵。
text.en: The 2025 review retains the species as valid, distinguishes it from Tupandactylus by retroarticular length and the symphysis’s dorsal step, and summarizes a sister relationship with [Caupedactylus ybaka](../../Caupedactylus/Caupedactylus_ybaka/page.en.md). Its non-tapejarid tapejariform scheme differs from the 2016 paper and the fixed directory’s Tapejarinae placement. The review rejects subadult status as a sufficient explanation for the missing step. Later cited matrices were not independently read in full here.

title.zh: 近采石场的来源与未给出的坐标
title.en: Quarry-area provenance without precise coordinates

text.zh: 原研究说标本来自 Nova Olinda 城附近采石场，以捐赠方式进入馆藏，研究没有进行新野外采集，也没有精确坐标。论文层位为 Crato 组，2025 年综述进一步指出基质类型与颜色符合 Nova Olinda 段，但精确地点未知。当前数据库的 119.57–113.2 Ma 区间继续作为记录边界；沉积水体、个体生活环境和起源地点不能互相替代。
text.en: The original study reports donation of a specimen found near Nova Olinda’s quarries, without new fieldwork or precise coordinates. It assigns the material to the Crato Formation; the 2025 review notes matrix type and coloration typical of the Nova Olinda Member while keeping the exact locality unknown. The database’s 119.57–113.2 Ma bracket remains a record boundary. Depositional waters, living habitat and geographic origin are distinct questions.
