title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 119.57–113.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 119.57–113.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Nova Olinda quarries 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，源标注 large（lacustrine - large）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、黄铁矿置换、褐铁矿置换（body,replaced with pyrite,replaced with limonite）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Nova Olinda quarries has collection-environment label lacustrine - large; collection preservation-mode label body,replaced with pyrite,replaced with limonite. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references

text.zh: 数据库采集行简略署名 Pegas et al.（2016），编号 ref:63770。本批另接入原始描述的完整三位作者与 DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0162692，并实际读取主文；标本、图像和补充矩阵没有独立复核。原出现行、采集 ID 与引文 ID 继续保留。
text.en: The database collection uses abbreviated attribution Pegas et al. (2016), reference ref:63770. This batch separately supplies the original description’s three-author list and DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0162692 and reads its main text. Specimens, images and the supplementary matrix were not independently inspected. Original occurrence rows, collection IDs and reference IDs remain retained.

evidenceSummary: This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled; The added account reuses the 2023 revision and previously read passages, with complete ZMNH M813, BXGM V0011 and D2525 specimen accounts additionally read here. Images, specimens, original 2006/2007 descriptions, other newly reported specimens, supplementary measurements, histology and diet remain incompletely read or independently checked. Referral and maturity are author interpretations; fixed parent chains, occurrence counts and ages remain intact. Complete monographs and reader-facing delivery remain unfinished.

title.zh: BXGM V0011 在修订中成为归入材料
title.en: BXGM V0011 becomes referred material in the revision

text.zh: 固定 PBDB 名称 Huaxiapterus benxiensis 保留这项旧种名记录。2023 年研究认为其正模 BXGM V0011 与 H. corollatus 不可可靠区分，将旧种名列为 Huaxiadraco corollatus 的异名。新增正文按这件材料的保存和成长说明证据，不把目录中两项名称重复计为两种独立生物。
text.en: The fixed PBDB name Huaxiapterus benxiensis retains the older named record. The 2023 study finds its holotype BXGM V0011 insufficiently distinct from H. corollatus and treats the older name as a junior synonym of Huaxiadraco corollatus. The added account follows this specimen’s preservation and development without counting two catalogue names as two independent biological species.

title.zh: 身体近完整但躯干与肱骨细节受损
title.en: A nearly complete body retains damaged trunk and humeral details

text.zh: BXGM V0011 近完整，躯干中的颈后脊柱、胸骨、肋骨及肩带却受损或被遮挡，两件肱骨也残缺。头骨骨面破坏限制细节，后部骨尚未完全融合。不能把“近完整”转成所有骨都完整，也不据采集集合的软组织标签声称本件保存全部翼膜。
text.en: BXGM V0011 is nearly complete, but post-cervical vertebrae, sternum, ribs and shoulder girdle are damaged or obscured, and both humeri are incomplete. Surface damage limits cranial detail and posterior skull bones remain unfused. Near-completeness does not mean every bone is intact, and a collection-level soft-tissue label does not establish preservation of the entire membrane in this specimen.

title.zh: 下折吻、鼻突与短翼骨支持比较
title.en: Rostral deflection, nasal process and short wing elements support comparison

text.zh: 修订记述约 20 度下折吻、向前倾的鼻骨下降突与较高梨形眼眶，第一掌骨约为第四掌骨四成，第四翼指节约为第一节两成。冠虽破损仍似梯形，组合接近 corollatus 正模。冠的较大尺寸或后部棘较长没有被当成已经证明的独立种差异；具体比例受保存和测量条件限制。
text.en: The revision describes roughly 20° rostral deflection, a forward-inclined descending nasal process and a tall piriform orbit, with metacarpal one about 40% the length of metacarpal four and wing phalanx four about 20% of phalanx one. The broken crest still appears trapezoidal, matching the corollatus combination. Larger crest size or a longer posterior spine does not establish a separate species, and proportions retain preservation and measurement limits.

title.zh: 残缺肱骨重评改变原有比例
title.en: Reassessment of an incomplete humerus changes the reported proportion

text.zh: 原描述把肱骨记为仅股骨长度的约 55%，2023 年作者认为依据的是不完整右肱骨；重识别左肱骨两端后，得到约 80% 的比较值。这个改动展示残损可能如何制造异常比例。本页引用作者的重评，未亲自测量或看原图；不能从旧异常比例推断特有飞行能力。
text.en: The original description gives a humerus only about 55% of femoral length. The 2023 authors attribute that value to an incomplete right humerus and identify damaged ends of the left humerus, giving a comparison near 80%. This illustrates how damage can create an anomalous proportion. The reassessment is cited without independent measurement or image inspection here; the older anomaly does not establish distinctive flight ability.

title.zh: 更多融合表示相对较成熟
title.en: More extensive fusion indicates relative maturity

text.zh: 肱骨骨端、腕骨、第一翼指节伸肌腱突和胫跗骨已融合，后头骨仍未完全融合；肩胛乌喙骨因损伤无法观察。作者判断为较晚亚成体，约 1.6 米翼展属于该标本估计。融合顺序来自同组比较，不把这件较成熟个体指定为已知年龄、性别或成体最大尺寸。
text.en: Fused humeral epiphyses, carpals, first wing-phalanx extensor tendon process and tibiotarsus contrast with still-unfused posterior skull bones; damage prevents assessment of scapula/coracoid fusion. The authors infer an advanced subadult with a specimen wingspan estimate near 1.6 m. Within-group fusion comparison does not establish exact age, sex or maximum adult size.

title.zh: 沿两件材料追到异名与保存问题
title.en: Follow both specimens into synonymy and preservation

text.zh: 先比较 BXGM V0011 与 [H. corollatus](../Huaxiapterus_corollatus/page.zh.md) 的保存、掌骨与末端翼指节，再对读 [S. dongi](../../Sinopterus/Sinopterus_dongi/page.zh.md) 的成长与形态分组方法。原始 2007 年描述尚未独立读齐；固定出现行与现代归入解释分别保留，未合并地点、年代或数量。
text.en: Compare BXGM V0011 with [H. corollatus](../Huaxiapterus_corollatus/page.en.md) in preservation, metacarpals and terminal wing phalanges, then growth and morphotype methods in [S. dongi](../../Sinopterus/Sinopterus_dongi/page.en.md). The original 2007 description remains incompletely read. Fixed occurrences and later referrals retain separate sources without merging sites, ages or counts.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Huaxiapterus benxiensis 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Huaxiapterus。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Huaxiapterus benxiensis is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Huaxiapterus. This guide uses 1 eligible species-level occurrence record from 1 collection and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Lianhe Town（Liaoning），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Jiufotang；数据库年代范围 121.4–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Aptian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Lianhe Town (Liaoning), region code CN, stratum name Jiufotang; database age bracket 121.4–113.2 Ma, early interval Aptian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 121.4–113.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 121.4–113.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Lianhe Town 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，源标注 large（lacustrine - large）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存、软组织（body,adpression,soft parts）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Lianhe Town has collection-environment label lacustrine - large; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression,soft parts. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Lianhe Town 的数据库引文署名为 Lü et al.（2007），编号 ref:30686。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Lianhe Town carries database reference attribution Lü et al. (2007), identifier ref:30686. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

scope.en: Preservation, anatomy, relative growth and 2023 referral of ZMNH M813, BXGM V0011 and D2525; older catalogue records retained.

title.zh: 旧组合入口通向 Huaxiadraco 的修订
title.en: An older combination leads into the Huaxiadraco revision

text.zh: Huaxiapterus corollatus 是固定 PBDB 工作记录的名称；2023 年研究将正模 ZMNH M813 置于新属，称 Huaxiadraco corollatus。它还把 H. benxiensis 列为此种异名。这里以正模与归入材料读身体、成长及鉴别，保留旧入口以追溯数据库记录，不把三个旧属下入口当作统一生物学组。
text.en: Huaxiapterus corollatus names the fixed PBDB work record. The 2023 study assigns holotype ZMNH M813 to a new genus as Huaxiadraco corollatus and treats H. benxiensis as its junior synonym. Read anatomy, growth and diagnosis through the holotype and referred material, retaining the older entry for database traceability rather than treating all three entries under the older genus as one biological group.

title.zh: 近完整正模仍有受损和遮挡区域
title.en: A nearly complete holotype still has damaged and obscured regions

text.zh: ZMNH M813 近完整，但后头骨、颈后脊柱和足部尤其受损。前臂骨覆盖第四、第五颈椎，妨碍直接比较它们的长度；鼻眶前孔后端与比例也部分依赖下颌关节位置复原。近完整不意味着每个骨骼特征都能可靠测量，本页未独立看图像或实物。
text.en: ZMNH M813 is nearly complete, but the posterior skull, post-cervical vertebrae and feet are especially damaged. Forearm bones cover cervicals four and five, preventing a direct length comparison; the posterior extent and proportions of the nasoantorbital fenestra partly depend on reconstruction from the jaw joint. Near-completeness does not make every character measurable, and images or specimens were not independently inspected here.

title.zh: 头骨组合包括下折吻与梯形冠
title.en: The skull combination includes a downturned rostrum and trapezoidal crest

text.zh: 作者记述正模有梯形前上颌骨冠、浅下颌冠和较强下折吻部，鼻眶前孔较短；上下颌闭合时仍有间隙。约 21 度的吻部角度与孔长高比约 2.2 属于本件描述及部分复原，不是全种每个个体的固定量。修订结合其他骨骼特征鉴别，不能只凭冠大或冠形确定性别、食物或独立种。
text.en: The holotype account describes a trapezoidal premaxillary crest, shallow mandibular crest, more strongly downturned rostrum and shorter nasoantorbital fenestra, with a gap between closed jaws. Roughly 21° rostral deflection and a fenestra length/height ratio near 2.2 describe this specimen with some reconstruction, rather than invariant values for every individual. Diagnosis combines further skeletal traits; crest size or shape alone does not establish sex, food or a separate species.

title.zh: 短第一掌骨与末端翼指节共同参与鉴别
title.en: A short first metacarpal and terminal wing phalanx inform diagnosis

text.zh: 正模第一、第二掌骨没有延伸到腕部，约为第四掌骨长度的三分之一；第四翼指节约为第一翼指节的五分之一。这一组合与 S. dongi 的较长第一掌骨、较长末端翼指节不同，也是作者保留另一形态群的依据。骨骼比例不是完整翼膜复原，不能由它直接给出最高速度或拍翼方式。
text.en: The holotype’s first and second metacarpals do not reach the wrist and extend roughly one-third the length of metacarpal four; wing phalanx four is about one-fifth the length of the first. This differs from the longer first metacarpal and terminal wing phalanx in S. dongi, helping support a separate morphotype. Skeletal proportions do not reconstruct a complete wing membrane or directly determine maximum speed or flapping style.

title.zh: 部分融合使正模被判断为亚成体
title.en: Partial fusion supports a subadult interpretation

text.zh: 后头骨、肩胛与乌喙骨以及第一翼指节伸肌腱突未融合，右胫跗骨已融合，腕骨也似已形成近端、远端融合块；肱骨骨端状态因保存差无法评估。作者解释为亚成体，翼展估计约 1.56 米。该判断是同组相对成熟比较，不是确定岁数、性别或全种成体最大翼展。
text.en: Posterior skull bones, scapula/coracoid and the first wing-phalanx extensor tendon process remain unfused, while the right tibiotarsus is fused and carpals appear to form proximal and distal fused units. Poor preservation prevents assessment of humeral epiphyses. The authors infer a subadult with an estimated wingspan near 1.56 m: relative maturity within the group rather than exact age, sex or maximum adult wingspan.

title.zh: 无头骨的 D2525 改由肢骨组合归入
title.en: Skull-less D2525 is referred through limb combinations

text.zh: D2525 缺头骨和部分脊柱，原来以 S. dongi 报道；2023 年因短第一掌骨、短第四翼指节及跖骨比例把它归入 H. corollatus。它约两米翼展且多处融合，被认为较成熟。无头骨材料不能独立证实冠形，归入也不把它与正模组合成一件完整骨架；此件估计不作为全种最大值。
text.en: D2525 lacks its skull and parts of the vertebral column and was originally reported as S. dongi. The 2023 revision refers it to H. corollatus using its short first metacarpal, short fourth wing phalanx and metatarsal proportions. An approximately two-metre wingspan and extensive fusion support greater maturity. Skull-less material cannot independently confirm crest shape, referral does not combine it with the holotype into one complete skeleton, and its estimate is not a species maximum.

title.zh: 先比两件旧正模，再比另一形态群
title.en: Compare the two older holotypes before the other morphotype

text.zh: 对读 [H. benxiensis](../Huaxiapterus_benxiensis/page.zh.md) 的受损肱骨重评和较成熟融合情况，再读 [Sinopterus dongi](../../Sinopterus/Sinopterus_dongi/page.zh.md) 的身体组合、成长方法和冠饰解释。两种可能地层共存不等于已知同地点共栖或食物分工。原始 2006 年描述、全部新增标本与食性资料仍未读齐。
text.en: Compare damaged-humerus reassessment and more advanced fusion in [H. benxiensis](../Huaxiapterus_benxiensis/page.en.md), then anatomy, growth methods and crests in [Sinopterus dongi](../../Sinopterus/Sinopterus_dongi/page.en.md). Possible temporal coexistence does not establish shared localities or dietary partitioning. The original 2006 description, all newly reported specimens and dietary evidence remain incompletely read.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Huaxiapterus corollatus 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Huaxiapterus。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Huaxiapterus corollatus is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Huaxiapterus. This guide uses 1 eligible species-level occurrence record from 1 collection and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY)（Liaoning），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Jiufotang；数据库年代范围 121.4–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Aptian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) (Liaoning), region code CN, stratum name Jiufotang; database age bracket 121.4–113.2 Ma, early interval Aptian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 121.4–113.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 121.4–113.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存（body,adpression）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) 的数据库引文署名为 Lü et al.（2006），编号 ref:31366。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY) carries database reference attribution Lü et al. (2006), identifier ref:31366. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

scope.en: Preservation, anatomy, relative growth and 2023 referral of ZMNH M813, BXGM V0011 and D2525; older catalogue records retained.

readerLimitations.zh: 既有章节导读 2026-10-02 PBDB 出现记录，新增正文另读 2023 年修订，合起来仍不是完整专论。只纳入固定 276 项翼龙工作名录中，当前名称一致、父链可追到已记录 Pterosauria 存储锚点、且有可用无疑问限定种级出现记录的条目。数据库接受名可能连接旧组合；这种数据库对应关系不裁决实际标本鉴定或所有分类争议，也不与 COL 同名概念合并。采集地点、地层区间、沉积环境和集合保存方式各有不同含义：它们不能直接推出完整分布、起源或灭绝时刻、该物种的固定生态、生物数量或每件标本的保存状态。原始描述、重描述、形态、食性和行为材料尚未逐项补齐；。 新增依据复用 2023 年修订共享引文及已读选段，本批另完整读取 ZMNH M813、BXGM V0011 和 D2525 三项标本条目。图像、实物、原始 2006／2007 描述、其他新增标本与补充测量、组织学和食性仍未读齐或独立复核。归属与成熟为作者解释，不改固定父链、出现计数和年代；完整专论、外审及读者端交付尚未完成。
readerLimitations.en: Existing sections guide PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, while the added account reads the 2023 revision; a complete monograph remains unfinished. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled; The added account reuses the 2023 revision and previously read passages, with complete ZMNH M813, BXGM V0011 and D2525 specimen accounts additionally read here. Images, specimens, original 2006/2007 descriptions, other newly reported specimens, supplementary measurements, histology and diet remain incompletely read or independently checked. Referral and maturity are author interpretations; fixed parent chains, occurrence counts and ages remain intact. Complete monographs and reader-facing delivery remain unfinished.

title.zh: 旧种名入口与修订后的异名
title.en: An older named entry and revised synonymy

text.zh: 固定 PBDB 条目 Huaxiapterus jii 保留旧名称及其来源；2023 年修订维持正模 GMN-03-11-001 与 Sinopterus dongi 不可区分的处理，将 jii 作为其异名。这里沿同一标本读保存、比例和相对成长，数据库名称不另计为已确认独立生物种。
text.en: The fixed PBDB entry Huaxiapterus jii retains its older name and provenance. The 2023 revision maintains that holotype GMN-03-11-001 is indistinguishable from Sinopterus dongi and treats jii as its junior synonym. Follow preservation, proportions and relative development through this specimen; the database name does not establish another independent biological species.

title.zh: 近完整身体不等于完整头骨和足部关节
title.en: A nearly complete body retains incomplete cranial and pedal information

text.zh: 正模身体近完整，头骨后部却已脱节且损坏。只能看到两件脱节颈椎，无法判断完整颈椎长度序列；足骨也完全脱节，不能判断各跖骨的相对长度序列。鼻眶前孔约三倍长高比依据部分颧骨位置估计，不能当作保存完整孔缘的直接测量。
text.en: The holotype is nearly complete, but its posterior skull is disarticulated and damaged. Only two disarticulated cervicals are visible, preventing assessment of the cervical length sequence; entirely disarticulated pedal elements prevent assessment of metatarsal proportions. An estimated nasoantorbital fenestra length/height ratio near three uses the partly preserved jugal, rather than direct measurement of an intact opening.

title.zh: 较大的冠饰仍须结合身体比较
title.en: Larger crests require comparison with the rest of the body

text.zh: 作者记述吻部相对后部腭面下折约 14 度，前上颌骨冠与 S. dongi 正模一样呈抛物线轮廓，但更大；下颌冠也更大。左颧骨部分保存，呈三叉形。原始鉴别侧重冠饰深度，缺少精确量化对照；修订没有仅凭冠更大维持独立种，也未因此确认性别或食物。
text.en: The account describes roughly 14° rostral deflection relative to the posterior palatal plane. The premaxillary crest has a parabolic outline like the S. dongi holotype but is larger, as is the mandibular crest. A partly preserved left jugal is triradiate. Original diagnosis emphasized crest depth without precise quantitative comparison; the revision does not retain a separate species merely for larger crests or establish sex or food from them.

title.zh: 长第一掌骨和末端翼指节支持同组比较
title.en: A long first metacarpal and terminal wing phalanx support comparison

text.zh: 第一掌骨至少达到第四掌骨长度的九成，并延伸至腕部；第四翼指节与第一节长度比约 0.30。修订把这两项与 S. dongi 共有的特征，和 corollatus／benxiensis 材料的较短第一掌骨、末端翼指节区分。翼骨比例最接近 S. dongi 正模，仍不能直接重建完整翼膜或推出实测飞行速度。
text.en: Metacarpal one extends at least 90% the length of metacarpal four and reaches the wrist; wing phalanx four is about 0.30 the length of phalanx one. The revision identifies these as shared with S. dongi, contrasting with shorter first metacarpals and terminal wing phalanges in corollatus/benxiensis material. Wing proportions are closest to the S. dongi holotype, without directly reconstructing a complete membrane or measured flight speed.

title.zh: 两件幼体仍可处于不同相对阶段
title.en: Two juveniles can differ in relative development

text.zh: 后头骨、肩胛乌喙骨、肱骨骨端、腕骨、第一翼指节伸肌腱突与胫跗骨未融合。背椎椎体和神经弓却部分融合，骨缝仍可见，比 S. dongi 正模一些完全未融合、脱节的背椎更成熟。作者仍将两件正模视为幼体，jii 略较发育；这不是确定年龄、性别或完整成年形态。
text.en: Posterior skull elements, scapula/coracoid, humeral epiphyses, carpals, the first wing-phalanx extensor tendon process and tibiotarsus remain unfused. Dorsal centra and neural arches are partly fused with visible sutures, unlike some entirely unfused, disassociated dorsals in the S. dongi holotype. The authors consider both juveniles, with jii slightly further developed; this does not establish exact age, sex or complete adult morphology.

title.zh: 标本尺寸不作全种最大翼展
title.en: Specimen dimensions do not define maximum wingspan

text.zh: 2023 年条目给 GMN-03-11-001 肱骨长度 79 毫米、翼展 1602 毫米，比 S. dongi 正模大。两件材料均未成熟，较大尺寸与较大冠须同融合状态一起阅读。本页引用作者数值，没有独立复量或反推体重，也不将约 1.6 米写为全种成体最大翼展。
text.en: The 2023 account gives GMN-03-11-001 a 79 mm humerus and a 1,602 mm wingspan, larger than the S. dongi holotype. Both are immature, so larger size and crests require reading alongside fusion states. These are cited author values without independent measurement or inferred body mass; roughly 1.6 m is not a species maximum adult wingspan.

title.zh: 把身体证据带回两种形态群
title.en: Carry specimen evidence into the two morphotypes

text.zh: 先对读 [Sinopterus dongi](../../Sinopterus/Sinopterus_dongi/page.zh.md) 的正模、成长方法和幼体鉴定，再比较 [corollatus](../Huaxiapterus_corollatus/page.zh.md) 的短掌骨、末端翼指节与不同冠形。2005 年原始描述全文、图像、补充测量和完整成长序列仍未独立读齐；本页不裁决全部历史分类方案。
text.en: First compare the holotype, growth methods and juvenile identification in [Sinopterus dongi](../../Sinopterus/Sinopterus_dongi/page.en.md), then shorter metacarpals, terminal wing phalanges and different crests in [corollatus](../Huaxiapterus_corollatus/page.en.md). The original 2005 full description, images, supplementary measurements and a complete growth sequence remain incompletely read or independently inspected; this page does not adjudicate every historical taxonomy.

Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. evidenceSummary: This page adds the 2002 original-paper text, selected 2007 modelling methods and discussion, and selected author-uploaded 2018 redescription text. All figures, supplemental matrices, specimens and later revisions remain incomplete; flume, flight and phylogenetic analyses have not been rerun. Crest functions and feeding remain hypotheses, with older model material and geometry retained. Shared citations record access versions. Database counts, ages, parent chains and maturity states remain; complete biology and reader delivery are pending.

title.zh: 1.42 米包含头冠，不是完整身体长度
title.en: The 1.42 m length includes the crest, not the body

text.zh: 2002 年正模 DGM 1476-R 是产于巴西 Araripe 盆地 Romualdo 沉积的近完整头骨和下颌，存于里约热内卢 Museu de Ciências da Terra；MN 6678-V 是其模型。论文的头骨总长 1420 毫米包含头冠，另列鳞骨至前上颌尖端约 798 毫米；下颌保存长 635 毫米、估计完整长 710 毫米。这些是不同测量起止点与保存／复原长度，不能混成身体长度。正模缺部分头骨腹侧和下颌尖端，并非完整动物骨架。
text.en: The 2002 holotype DGM 1476-R is a nearly complete skull and mandible from Romualdo deposits in Brazil’s Araripe Basin, held at Museu de Ciências da Terra, Rio de Janeiro; MN 6678-V is its cast. The reported total skull length of 1,420 mm includes the crest, while squamosal-to-premaxillary-tip length is about 798 mm. Mandibular length is 635 mm preserved and 710 mm estimated. These use different endpoints and distinguish preservation from reconstruction; none is body length. Parts of the ventral skull and mandibular tip are missing, and this is not a complete animal skeleton.

title.zh: 大而轻的骨质头冠
title.en: A large but lightly built bony crest

text.zh: 原始描述的矢状头冠从吻部前端延伸至枕部后方，由前上颌骨、额骨、顶骨及参与后下缘的上枕骨构成；内部有骨小梁支撑。2018 年重描述继续认为头冠巨大但轻薄，只有左侧外表暴露，右侧被石灰质基质覆盖。后端 V 形的边缘保留在基质中，作者据此区分自然轮廓与采集时其他 V 形破口；不能把每条破边都当作原始头冠形状。
text.en: The original sagittal crest runs from the rostral tip to beyond the occiput and involves premaxillae, frontals, parietals and a supraoccipital contribution to its posteroventral edge, with internal trabecular support. The 2018 redescription likewise describes a huge but lightly built crest: only its left external side is exposed, while matrix covers the right. Bone margins of the posterior V-shaped ending remain enclosed in matrix, leading the authors to distinguish that natural outline from other V-shaped collection breakages. Not every broken edge represents original crest form.

title.zh: 血管印痕支持讨论，不直接测得散热
title.en: Vascular impressions inform a hypothesis, not measured cooling

text.zh: 2002 年把头冠表面的分支通道解释为血管印痕，提出它可能帮助散去代谢热，也可能参与展示、同种识别和空气动力学。2018 年借现生巨嘴鸟的喙作功能比较，继续讨论多种用途，同时指出需要更多标本判断性别相关差异，并需物理实验量化头冠对飞行的影响。化石骨面没有直接保存血流、体温、颜色或求偶行为；散热效率与性别不能据一个头冠确定。
text.en: The 2002 paper interprets branching surface channels as vascular impressions and proposes heat dissipation alongside display, recognition and aerodynamic roles. The 2018 discussion uses living toucan bills as functional comparisons and continues to consider multiple roles, while calling for more specimens to assess possible sex-linked variation and physical experiments to quantify aerodynamic effects. Bone surfaces do not directly preserve blood flow, temperature, color or courtship. One crest establishes neither cooling efficiency nor sex.

title.zh: 重新清修揭露结构，不是新增正模
title.en: Further preparation reveals structures, not a new holotype

text.zh: 2018 年研究是在同一正模 DGM 1476-R 进一步清修后进行重描述；新增可见区域包括腭部与枕部。作者记录骨骼融合、没有开放骨缝，作为成体推断的依据；融合也限制单块骨的识别。论文报告约一半腭面保存，并将小而卵圆的腭后孔、扩大的板状外翼骨侧区等列入修订诊断。这个重描述扩大了可观察范围，没有提供精确死亡年龄、另一只完整个体或全部缺失区域。
text.en: The 2018 study redescribes the same holotype DGM 1476-R after further preparation exposed regions including the palate and occiput. Fused bones and the absence of open sutures support an adult interpretation, while also limiting identification of individual bones. The paper reports approximately half of the palatal surface preserved and includes small ovoid postpalatine fenestrae and an enlarged plate-like lateral ectopterygoid region in the revised diagnosis. Preparation expands observation without supplying an exact age at death, another complete individual or every missing region.

title.zh: 2002 年的掠水解释与后来的检验
title.en: The 2002 skimming interpretation and later tests

text.zh: 2002 年依据无齿、刀片状的吻端和颌部配合，与现生剪嘴鸥 Rynchops 比较，提出飞行时将下颌探入水面捕食的解释。论文还借其他材料比较估计翼展约 4.2–4.5 米；这是比较复原，不是正模翼骨实测。2007 年对掠水的阻力和能量要求进行检验，2018 年仍将取食方式列为未解问题。因此属名“海上奔跑者”和最初的形态类比，都不能当作本种已确认的捕食观察。
text.en: The 2002 paper compares toothless blade-like rostral ends and jaw configuration with living Rynchops skimmers, proposing capture with the lower jaw immersed during flight. It also estimates a wingspan of about 4.2–4.5 m by comparison with other material, rather than measuring wings from the holotype. The 2007 study tests skimming drag and energy demands, and the 2018 revision still treats feeding as unresolved. The genus name meaning “sea runner” and the original analogy therefore do not establish observed hunting behavior.

title.zh: 水槽实验测的是模型颌部阻力
title.en: Flume trials measure model-jaw drag

text.zh: 2007 年作者把鸟喙模型与翼龙颌部模型悬挂在水槽上方拖行，用应变计估计阻力；翼龙模型包括当时归为 Thalassodromeus 的一段颌骨。实验先采用与鸟喙相同的 4 厘米入水深度，再用流体模型调整翼龙入水比例，并结合翼展、体重和翼面积回归估计飞行成本。真实化石的颌形、角质覆盖和体重仍影响结果；这里引用论文方法，没有重新制造模型、运行水槽或重算全部方程。
text.en: The 2007 authors towed suspended bill and jaw models above a water flume and estimated drag from strain gauges. Pterosaur models included a jaw fragment then attributed to Thalassodromeus. Trials first used the same 4 cm immersion depth as the bird bill, followed by hydrodynamic adjustment of proportional immersion and flight-cost estimates using regressions for wingspan, mass and wing area. Fossil jaw geometry, keratinous covering and mass still affect interpretation. This page records the method without rebuilding models, repeating flume trials or recalculating all equations.

title.zh: 模型反对常规掠水，不给出替代菜单
title.en: Models challenge habitual skimming without identifying another diet

text.zh: 在所用颌形、入水与飞行功率假设下，2007 年作者认为 Thalassodromeus 无法满足持续掠水取食的能量要求；解剖比较也认为它没有剪嘴鸥那组高度特化结构。2018 年讨论陆地捕食等替代解释时，仍说明还需生物力学支持。反对一种取食方式不能自动证明另一种方式，也不能给出猎物种类、猎食频率或完整食谱。
text.en: Under their jaw-shape, immersion and flight-power assumptions, the 2007 authors find that Thalassodromeus cannot meet the energetic demands of sustained skimming. Their anatomical comparison also finds no equivalent suite of highly specialized Rynchops structures. The 2018 discussion considers alternatives such as terrestrial predation but still calls for biomechanical support. Evidence against one feeding mode does not establish another or identify prey species, hunting frequency or a complete diet.

title.zh: 旧模型与后续颌骨修订各保留材料范围
title.en: Keep older model material separate from later jaw revisions

text.zh: 2007 年模型论文把颌骨片段记为 DGM 1476-M、当时归入 T. sethi，并把其尺寸用于本种正模模型；它不是对正模每个颌部尺寸的直接测量。2018 年研究 NMSG SAO 251093 的模型 MN 4703-V，将这件曾归入本种、又命名为 Banguela oberlii 的颌骨解释为另一种 Thalassodromeus oberlii。两篇论文的标本号按来源分别保留，本页未独立核实这些不同编号是否指向同一实体。旧归属和尺寸借用不能当作本种正模直接测量；旧模型结论需连同材料、几何假设与后续修订阅读，全部矩阵及后续分类仍未核齐。
text.en: The 2007 model paper records its jaw fragment as DGM 1476-M, then referred to T. sethi, and applies its dimensions to the holotype model rather than directly measuring every holotype jaw dimension. In 2018, examination of cast MN 4703-V of NMSG SAO 251093 leads the authors to interpret that previously referred jaw, later named Banguela oberlii, as a separate species, Thalassodromeus oberlii. Both papers’ specimen numbers are retained; this page has not independently established whether the different identifiers refer to one physical object. Older referrals and borrowed dimensions are not direct holotype measurements. Read model conclusions with their material, geometry and later revisions; all matrices and subsequent taxonomy remain incomplete.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 119.57–113.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 119.57–113.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

evidenceSummary: Selected 2023 passages on jaw identity, material and classification are added alongside dated earlier descriptions. Sources disagree over upper/lower-jaw interpretation, treatment in an earlier analysis and the Xericeps type horizon; those differences remain visible. All images, supplements, specimens, matrices and subsequent studies have not been inspected, and no reidentification, remeasurement or classification adjudication occurred. Fixed database counts, ages and parent chains remain;

title.zh: 2023 年新增归入的一段下颌
title.en: An additional lower jaw referred in 2023

text.zh: 2023 年介绍仍把 FSAC-KK 10700 记为部分下颌联合，并新增归入部分下颌 FSAC-KK 5203。介绍沿用上弯轮廓、连续腹侧中线沟及后部成对骨嵴等鉴别形态。新增归入材料不是新正模，也没有提供与完整头骨或翼骨关联的个体；这项文献归属本身不能建立本种体型范围、年龄系列或种群数量。
text.en: The 2023 account retains FSAC-KK 10700 as a partial mandibular symphysis and newly refers partial mandible FSAC-KK 5203. Its diagnosis retains the upcurved profile, continuous ventral midline sulcus and paired posterior occlusal ridges. The newly referred material is not a new holotype or an individual associated with a complete skull and wings. That referral alone establishes neither a species size range nor an age series or population count.

title.zh: 同一正模的产层记录存在来源分歧
title.en: Sources differ on the horizon of the same type

text.zh: 2020 年 Xericeps 介绍把 Aferdou N’Chaft 的正模来源记为 Douira Formation；2023 年介绍则写为 Ifezouane Formation，并保留 ?Albian—Cenomanian 的年代表述。两文谈的是同一件 FSAC-KK 10700，不应因地层解释改变而另计一次发现。这里按年份列出来源差异，保留问号；没有据此改写固定数据库的采集行或 100.5–93.9 Ma 宽年代范围，也没有自行裁决精确产层。
text.en: The 2020 Xericeps account places the Aferdou N’Chaft type in the Douira Formation. The 2023 account instead lists the Ifezouane Formation and retains the age wording ?Albian–Cenomanian. Both concern FSAC-KK 10700, so a changed stratigraphic interpretation does not count as another discovery. The dated difference and question mark remain visible without changing the fixed database collection row or its broad 100.5–93.9 Ma bracket, or adjudicating a precise horizon.

title.zh: 细分亲缘和未知上颌仍待解决
title.en: Finer relationships and an unknown upper jaw remain open

text.zh: 2023 年作者质疑仅凭上弯下颌或广泛分布的骨孔特征来确定更细亲缘，并谨慎地把 Xericeps 保留为非 tapejarid 的 Azhdarchoidea 未定。他们讨论的颌部形态型 C（FSAC-KK 5200、5201、5202）有多种可能：Apatorhamphus 的下颌、Xericeps 的上颌，或另一个类群。备选解释不能写成已确认的 Xericeps 上颌。2020 年提出的与 Alanqa 可能异名也没有由本页裁决；本文没有重查相关分析的全部矩阵。
text.en: The 2023 authors question finer placements based on an upturned mandible or broadly distributed foramina and cautiously retain Xericeps as an indeterminate non-tapejarid azhdarchoid. They discuss several alternatives for jaw morphotype C, FSAC-KK 5200, 5201 and 5202: an Apatorhamphus lower jaw, a Xericeps upper jaw, or another clade. Those alternatives cannot become a confirmed Xericeps upper jaw. This page also does not adjudicate the possible synonymy with Alanqa raised in 2020 or inspect all matrices behind the relationship hypotheses.

title.zh: 正模是一段下颌，不是完整头骨
title.en: The type is part of a lower jaw

text.zh: Xericeps curvirostris 的正模 FSAC-KK 10700 是一段齿骨联合，存于卡萨布兰卡 Université Hassan II 的 Aïn Chock 地质古生物收藏。2018 年描述记录当地工人在 Aferdou N’Chaft 矿点发现，作者于 2017 年 1 月在现场购得；2020 年把来源记为 Douira Formation。下颌材料没有关联头骨或完整翼骨，不能从正模直接读出整个动物的身体比例。
text.en: Holotype FSAC-KK 10700 is a partial dentary symphysis held in the Aïn Chock geological/palaeontological collection of Université Hassan II, Casablanca. The 2018 description records discovery by local workers at Aferdou N’Chaft and purchase at the mine site in January 2017; the 2020 study places its provenance in the Douira Formation. The lower-jaw material lacks an associated skull or complete wing bones, so it does not directly supply whole-body proportions.

title.zh: 173 毫米保存长度与约 200 毫米复原
title.en: Preserved and reconstructed jaw lengths

text.zh: 正模前端缺失，后端在下颌分成两支之前附近折断。2018 年稿件报告保存长度 173 毫米；假设前端收成尖点并延长颌缘，重建长度约 200 毫米。这不是 200 毫米实物长度或缺失部分的长度。材料大体未压扁，但有轻微裂缝与侧向错移；去除砂岩后可观察立体表面，仍没有完整颌部或其他关联身体骨骼。
text.en: The anterior tip is missing, and the posterior break lies near the expected division into mandibular rami. The 2018 manuscript reports 173 mm preserved length; extending the margins to an assumed pointed tip yields about 200 mm reconstructed length. That is neither a 200 mm preserved fragment nor the length of the missing portion. The specimen is largely uncrushed but has slight fractures and lateral displacement. Removing sandstone reveals its three-dimensional surface without providing a complete jaw or associated body skeleton.

title.zh: 上弯颌缘与连续腹侧沟
title.en: An upcurved jaw and continuous ventral groove

text.zh: 侧面看，正模咬合缘微凹、腹缘微凸，形成轻微上弯；腹侧中线的纵沟贯穿保存段，是原描述强调的鉴别特征。后部咬合面两条骨嵴界定较宽的中沟，侧面和咬合面还有细长孔。作者比较这些形态与其他无齿翼龙，支持 Azhdarchoidea 的归属；沟与孔不是保存的食物、完整喙鞘或直接观察到的取食动作。
text.en: In lateral view, the slightly concave occlusal margin and convex ventral margin produce a gentle upward curve. A longitudinal ventral midline groove extends along the preserved fragment and is emphasized in the original diagnosis. Two posterior occlusal ridges bound a broader central groove; elongate foramina occur on lateral and occlusal surfaces. Comparisons with other toothless pterosaurs support an azhdarchoid attribution. The grooves and foramina are not preserved food, a complete beak sheath or direct feeding observations.

title.zh: 骨表面只支持有限的成熟判断
title.en: Bone surface supports a limited maturity inference

text.zh: 2018 年作者据肉眼平滑、放大镜下略纤维状的骨表面，提出个体在死亡时骨骼成熟或接近成熟。两条后部骨嵴的来源也未确定：稿件讨论可能是夹板骨，或下颌自身的突起，没有可见骨缝来裁决。单段颌骨的表面与局部融合不能给出准确年龄、性别、成熟翼展或整个物种的生长过程。
text.en: The 2018 authors interpret a surface smooth to the naked eye but slightly fibrous under magnification as suggesting skeletal maturity or near-maturity at death. The origin of the posterior ridges also remains uncertain: they discuss splenials or mandibular outgrowths, without a visible suture resolving the alternatives. Surface texture and local fusion in one jaw fragment do not establish exact age, sex, adult wingspan or a species growth series.

title.zh: 尺寸类别与翼展估计分别阅读
title.en: Separate size categories from wingspan estimates

text.zh: 原诊断把个体描述为中到大型，用约 3–8 米说明翼龙的宽泛尺寸类别，并认为更接近低端；这不是本种已有多个个体覆盖的翼展范围。2020 年比较给正模至少约 3–4 米的翼展估计，依赖更完整近缘材料。没有完整翼部或独立复量，不能把类别的 8 米上界写成已确认的本种最大翼展。
text.en: The original diagnosis calls the animal medium to large, using roughly 3–8 m to explain a broad pterosaur size category and favoring its lower end. This is not a wingspan range sampled across individuals of this species. The 2020 comparison estimates at least about 3–4 m for the type from more complete related material. Without complete wings or independent remeasurement, the category’s 8 m upper bound cannot become a confirmed species maximum.

title.zh: 与 Alanqa 的关系仍是待解问题
title.en: The relationship to Alanqa remains unresolved

text.zh: 2018 年作者确认非 tapejarid 的 azhdarchoid 归属，但把更细关系留作未决；同文已提出 Alanqa 正模可能是吻部，以及两名可能对应同种或近缘种上下颌的解释。2020 年继续提出可能异名，并要求更完整材料确认或否定。形态相似与同一地层出现不能证明是同一个体或同种；本页保留固定 PBDB 名称和父链，不合并两种记录。
text.en: The 2018 authors support a non-tapejarid azhdarchoid attribution while leaving finer relationships unresolved. They already discuss the possibility that the Alanqa type is a rostrum and that the two names represent upper and lower jaws of one or closely related species. The 2020 study retains possible synonymy and requires more complete material to confirm or reject it. Similar morphology and occurrence in the same deposits establish neither one individual nor one species; fixed PBDB names and parent chains are retained without merging records.

title.zh: 对读颌部形态，不把沉积环境当作食谱
title.en: Compare jaws without turning depositional setting into diet

text.zh: 对读 [Alanqa saharica](../../../Azhdarchidae/Alanqa/Alanqa_saharica/page.zh.md) 的笔直颌缘与正模改释，再看 Xericeps 的上弯与腹侧沟。2018 年论文把大陆沉积背景、不同颌形与可能地面取食联系起来，但明确说碎片颌部难以确定食性，生态角色需要更完整材料。具名采集和宽年代区间仍从本页数据库记录分别阅读，不把现代发现地的沙漠或名称词源写成古代栖地。
text.en: Compare the straight margins and type reinterpretation of [Alanqa saharica](../../../Azhdarchidae/Alanqa/Alanqa_saharica/page.en.md) with the upcurve and ventral groove of Xericeps. The 2018 paper relates continental deposition and differing jaws to possible terrestrial feeding, while explicitly stating that fragmentary jaws cannot readily establish diet and that ecological roles need more complete remains. Read collection names and broad ages separately in the retained database records; the modern desert and name etymology do not establish the ancient habitat.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 100.5–93.9 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 100.5–93.9 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Aferdou N'Chaft 的采集环境标签为 河流沉积环境，类型未定（fluvial indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Aferdou N'Chaft has collection-environment label fluvial indet.; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

text.en: The Aferdou N’Chaft database citation retains Martill et al. (2018), ref:64004. This batch adds the four-author original-description citation, separating its 2017 online date, 2018 volume date and 29-page accepted manuscript, plus the 2020 selected account. Original rows and collection IDs remain unchanged; not all later studies or specimens have been reviewed.

evidenceSummary: This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

V 4064 preserves an articulated skull and mandible; other material has different damage or compression. evidenceSummary: All five scientific main sections from 2020 and seven from 2024, textual tables and figure captions were read. Images, raw CT, models, specimens and the original 1964/1973 descriptions were not independently inspected. Revised boundaries, soft tissues, diet, maturity, sex and same-horizon coexistence retain their inferential scopes; database rows were not individually matched to scans. A full species monograph, complete geographic and growth material and reader-facing delivery remain pending.

title.zh: 多件头骨共同提供腭部证据
title.en: Several skulls contribute palatal evidence

text.zh: 2020 年研究重新描述旧藏与后来采集的 Dsungaripterus weii 头骨材料，以腭部保存最完整的 IVPP V 4063 为主体，并参照 V 4064、V 4065 及多件头骨和腭部残片。V 4064 保存相连的头骨和下颌，其他材料有不同缺损或压缩。这里的组合描述来自多件标本，不能把所有结构拼成同一个体的完整骨架。
text.en: The 2020 study redescribes earlier and later-collected skull material, primarily using IVPP V 4063 for its well-preserved palate, with V 4064, V 4065 and additional skull or palatal fragments for comparison. V 4064 preserves an articulated skull and mandible; other material has different damage or compression. The combined description draws on several specimens rather than a complete skeleton belonging to one individual.

title.zh: 上翘无齿的前端与后方膨大的齿区
title.en: Upturned toothless tips and an expanded tooth-bearing region

text.zh: 头骨有显著矢状冠，眶较小、位置高；上颌和下颌前端无齿而上翘。后方上颌骨膨大区承载四至五颗牙齿，牙基宽而近椭圆。论文所列头骨大多每侧有十四至十五颗上颌牙，但 V 4065 右侧为十三颗。保存齿数的个体差异不宜压成一个全种固定值，前端无齿也不等于整个口腔无齿。
text.en: The skull has a prominent sagittal crest and relatively small, high-set orbit. The upturned anterior upper and lower jaw tips are toothless. A posterior maxillary expansion bears four or five teeth with broad, roughly oval bases. Most tabulated skulls have fourteen or fifteen upper teeth per side, but V 4065 has thirteen on the right. Observed variation should not become a fixed species-wide count, and toothless tips do not make the entire jaw edentulous.

title.zh: 磨耗与骨形支持硬物取食假说
title.en: Wear and bone shape support a hard-food hypothesis

text.zh: V 26256 的牙齿有平滑磨耗面，配合粗壮牙齿、无齿前端和可能的喙鞘，2020 年作者支持取食硬物的解释。以钳状前端探取或拨出贝类、硬壳昆虫的行为来自此前比较假说，并非直接保存的进食过程。本页没有把它写成确定食谱、专食贝类、实测咬合力或来自所有采集地的统一生态。
text.en: Smooth tooth wear surfaces in V 26256, together with robust teeth, toothless tips and a possible beak covering, support the 2020 authors’ hard-food interpretation. Probing or dislodging shellfish or hard-shelled insects with pincer-like tips comes from earlier comparative hypotheses rather than a preserved feeding event. It does not establish a fixed menu, obligate shellfish diet, measured bite force or common ecology across all collections.

title.zh: 相应的上下颌沟槽可能记录喙鞘边缘
title.en: Corresponding jaw grooves may record a horny sheath

text.zh: 上下颌外侧存在相互对应的沟槽。上颌部分沟槽位于预期骨缝附近，下颌前方沟槽却不能按同样方式解释为骨缝；作者因而提出它们可能留下角质覆盖边缘的印迹。冠基条纹、小孔和沟槽也参与比较。这些骨面迹象支持软组织假说，却没有直接保存完整喙鞘，不能确定其厚度、颜色或全部边界。
text.en: Corresponding grooves run along the outer upper and lower jaws. Some upper grooves lie near expected sutures, whereas the anterior lower groove cannot be interpreted in the same way. The authors therefore propose impressions of a horny covering’s edge, also considering crest-base striae and small foramina. These bone-surface clues do not directly preserve a complete sheath or establish its thickness, color or entire boundary.

title.zh: CT 把表面难辨的骨缝带入内部观察
title.en: CT reveals sutures obscured at the surface

text.zh: 2024 年研究扫描了 V 4063、V 26257 和 V 26258。作者在较厚腭骨内部识别出不规则、相互嵌合的骨缝边界，以区别于裂纹，并用分割重建判断骨的接触关系。这里转述的是论文报告的扫描结果；本页未查看原始切片、操作分割模型或独立核对骨缝。扫描三件材料也不等于覆盖本种所有已知标本。
text.en: The 2024 study scans V 4063, V 26257 and V 26258. Irregular interlocking boundaries inside thick palatal elements distinguish sutures from fractures, and segmented reconstructions identify contacts. This page reports the paper’s findings without inspecting raw slices, operating segmentation models or independently identifying sutures. Three scanned specimens do not cover every known specimen of the species.

title.zh: Y 形腭骨连接多块骨与多个孔窗
title.en: A Y-shaped palatine connects bones and openings

text.zh: 按 2024 年重建，腭骨有两条背腹扁平的分支，形成 Y 形。前支与上颌骨腭突接触，侧支联系腭外缘并向内变薄，与翼骨背面接触；两侧腭骨在后方相接，组成后鼻孔后缘。小腭骨孔位于与翼骨接触区域，因为腹侧受到覆盖，须从后背方向才能观察。此处的 Y 形指腭骨，不是整副下颌的外形。
text.en: In the 2024 reconstruction, two dorsoventrally flat rami form a Y-shaped palatine. The anterior ramus contacts the maxilla’s palatine process. The lateral ramus reaches the outer palate, thins medially and contacts the pterygoid dorsally. The opposing palatines meet posteriorly to form the choanal rear margin. A small palatine foramen at the pterygoid contact is hidden ventrally and visible from behind and above. This Y shape belongs to the palatine rather than the outline of the lower jaw.

title.zh: 旧称翼骨侧突的部分被重新归为外翼骨
title.en: Part of the former lateral pterygoid process becomes ectopterygoid

text.zh: 2020 年描述强调两部分组成的翼骨侧突；2024 年 CT 重建把此前这样命名的结构重新解释为外翼骨。其内侧部分扁平、弯曲并带孔，外侧部分为较细的弧形骨条，与颧骨接触，分隔后腭窗和下颞窗。形状观察与骨归属修订需要分别追溯，不能把新名称当成另一块新增骨或把两篇诊断直接混用。
text.en: The 2020 description emphasizes a two-part lateral pterygoid process. The 2024 CT reconstruction reinterprets the structure previously given that name as the ectopterygoid: an inward flat curved portion with foramina and a slender outer curved bar contacting the jugal and separating the postpalatine and subtemporal openings. Shape observations and revised element identity must be traced separately; the new name does not represent an extra bone.

title.zh: 孔窗名称随参与骨的边界修订
title.en: Opening names change with revised bone boundaries

text.zh: 2024 年把后鼻孔外侧最前方的孔窗称为上颌腭窗，理由是前缘为上颌骨、后缘为腭骨；一些旧描述将它称为 postpalatine fenestra。作者据此调整其后孔窗的名称，并把本种后鼻孔后方的小翼骨孔与其他类群较大的翼骨窗区分。阅读旧图注时，先核对位置和组成骨，避免只凭相同或不同名称比较孔的数目。
text.en: The 2024 paper calls the most anterior opening lateral to the choana the maxillopalatine fenestra because the maxilla borders it anteriorly and the palatine posteriorly; some earlier descriptions called it the postpalatine fenestra. Subsequent opening names are adjusted accordingly, and the species’ small pterygoid foramen is distinguished from larger pterygoid fenestrae in other taxa. Position and bounding bones must be checked before comparing opening counts by name.

title.zh: 头骨融合提供有限的成长线索
title.en: Skull fusion provides limited maturity evidence

text.zh: 2020 年作者因头骨骨块高度融合，将 V 4063 判断为至少亚成体，并转述旧研究对 V 4064 成体及其他标本相对成熟程度的解释。这些判断不提供实际岁数、繁殖状态或完整成长曲线。V 26256 较细的吻部曾被提出可能与性别有关，但没有本页独立性别证据，不能把它列为已经确认的雌性。
text.en: The 2020 authors interpret V 4063 as at least a subadult because its skull elements are strongly fused, while reporting earlier adult and relative-maturity interpretations for other specimens. These do not establish age in years, reproductive status or a complete growth curve. A thinner rostrum in V 26256 was proposed as possibly sex-related, but without independent sex evidence here it is not identified as a confirmed female.

title.zh: 同一地区出现尚不足以确认同层共存
title.en: Regional association does not establish same-horizon coexistence

text.zh: 论文将研究材料置于新疆 Urho–Delunshan 的早白垩世 Tugulu 群，也讨论准噶尔盆地东侧材料。Dsungaripterus 与 Noripterus 在相同地点的记录提示可能共存，但 2020 年作者明确要求进一步野外工作，以查明是否同一层位。当前数据库另有三个采集记录；不能将其与扫描材料逐件对应，也不能直接推导竞争、共食谱或同时死亡。
text.en: The study places its material in the Early Cretaceous Tugulu Group of Urho–Delunshan, Xinjiang, and discusses material from the eastern Junggar Basin. Records of Dsungaripterus and Noripterus at the same localities suggest possible coexistence, but the 2020 authors explicitly call for fieldwork to establish whether they occur in the same horizon. The three selected database collections are not matched individually to scanned specimens and do not establish competition, a shared menu or simultaneous death.

title.zh: 沿骨界修订与 Caupedactylus 对读
title.en: Compare revised bone boundaries with Caupedactylus

text.zh: [Caupedactylus ybaka](../../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Tapejarinae/Caupedactylus/Caupedactylus_ybaka/page.zh.md) 也参与两篇论文的腭部比较。先看本种真正新扫描的材料，再看 Caupedactylus 从早期图像进入的比较，最后核对两种研究中翼骨孔窗及腭骨归属的措辞。2020 年相似性支持作者所引用的亲缘解释，2024 年着重修订骨界；本页没有重跑系统发育矩阵，也不把腭部相似写成已确定的姐妹群关系。
text.en: [Caupedactylus ybaka](../../../Neoazhdarchia/Tapejaroidea/Tapejaridae/Tapejarinae/Caupedactylus/Caupedactylus_ybaka/page.en.md) contributes to both papers’ palatal comparisons. Read the newly scanned Dsungaripterus material first, then Caupedactylus comparisons based on earlier illustrations, and compare pterygoid openings and palatine identities. Similarities in 2020 support the authors’ cited relationship interpretation, while 2024 revises bone boundaries. No matrix was rerun here, and palatal resemblance is not presented as an established sister relationship.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Dsungaripterus weii 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Dsungaripterus。本页导读 3 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 3 个采集记录和 2 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Dsungaripterus weii is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Dsungaripterus. This guide uses 3 eligible species-level occurrence records from 3 collections and 2 reference identifiers. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Wuerho, IVPP site 64041（Xinjiang），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Lianmuqin；数据库年代范围 137.05–100.5 Ma，早端地质时段 Valanginian、晚端时段 Albian。采集记录 Wuerho, IVPP site 64045（Xinjiang），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Lianmuqin；数据库年代范围 137.05–100.5 Ma，早端地质时段 Valanginian、晚端时段 Albian。采集记录 Tatal bonebed（Uvs），地区代码 MN，地层名称 Tsagaantsav；数据库年代范围 137.05–121.4 Ma，早端地质时段 Valanginian、晚端时段 Barremian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Wuerho, IVPP site 64041 (Xinjiang), region code CN, stratum name Lianmuqin; database age bracket 137.05–100.5 Ma, early interval Valanginian and late interval Albian. Collection Wuerho, IVPP site 64045 (Xinjiang), region code CN, stratum name Lianmuqin; database age bracket 137.05–100.5 Ma, early interval Valanginian and late interval Albian. Collection Tatal bonebed (Uvs), region code MN, stratum name Tsagaantsav; database age bracket 137.05–121.4 Ma, early interval Valanginian and late interval Barremian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 137.05–100.5 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 137.05–100.5 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Wuerho, IVPP site 64041 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。Wuerho, IVPP site 64045 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。Tatal bonebed 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Wuerho, IVPP site 64041 has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body. Wuerho, IVPP site 64045 has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body. Tatal bonebed has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Wuerho, IVPP site 64041 的数据库引文署名为 Young（1973），编号 ref:13383。Wuerho, IVPP site 64045 的数据库引文署名为 Young（1973），编号 ref:13383。Tatal bonebed 的数据库引文署名为 Lü et al.（2009），编号 ref:30777。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Wuerho, IVPP site 64041 carries database reference attribution Young (1973), identifier ref:13383. title.en: Age bounds of these records

text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 72.2–66 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata

Collection Cambridge Greensand [non-specific locality data] (England), region code UK, stratum name West Melbury Marly Chalk; database age bracket 106.3–100.5 Ma, early interval Late Albian. Collection Horningsea (England), region code UK, stratum name West Melbury Marly Chalk; database age bracket 106.3–100.5 Ma, early interval Late Albian. evidenceSummary: Existing classification, named occurrences and age brackets retain their database-source limits. This batch adds selected 2013 primary text on comparative material, histology and wingspan. The cf. identification, unknown exact site, missing elements and comparative estimates remain explicit. The 1987 original description, all images, later research and supplements are not fully assembled or read; specimens and models have not been remeasured or rerun. A full monograph and reader-facing delivery remain pending. Figures 1–3 and their captions were inspected here, distinguishing preserved regions from reconstructed outlines; all images, the whole paper and specimens have not been audited.

title.zh: 灰色保存区域与完整重建轮廓
title.en: Grey preserved regions within a complete reconstructed outline

text.zh: 2013 年图 1 展示头部和下颌的分离骨块；图 2 绘出头骨重建轮廓，灰色明确标示实存部分。读者应先看灰色区域再看轮廓，不能把补绘的吻端、开孔边界或牙列当作全部实际保存。图 3 的箭头标出骨面沟槽，图注将它们解释为血管印痕；照片支持观察沟槽，血管及散热功能仍分别属于解释层次。本页未按比例尺重新测量。
text.en: Figure 1 in the 2013 study shows separate cranial and mandibular fragments; Figure 2 reconstructs a skull outline with preserved parts explicitly in grey. Read the grey areas before the outline rather than treating reconstructed rostral tips, opening margins or teeth as entirely preserved. Figure 3 arrows identify surface channels interpreted in the caption as vascular impressions. The photograph documents channels while vascular attribution and cooling remain interpretive steps. No new measurements were taken from the scale bars.

title.zh: 大型标本为何仍用 cf. 限定
title.en: Why the large specimen retains a cf. identification

text.zh: 2013 年研究将 MN 6594-V 记为 Tropeognathus cf. T. mesembrinus：颅部特征支持与该种比较，但 cf. 保留鉴定的不确定性。作者讨论头冠差异可能涉及个体变化或生长阶段，现有材料不能排除其他解释。原模式标本主要为头部，不能提供同一个体的肢骨比例；本页保留物种阅读入口，却不把这件比较标本写成无疑问的新种级出现记录。
text.en: The 2013 study identifies MN 6594-V as Tropeognathus cf. T. mesembrinus. Cranial features support comparison with the species, while cf. retains uncertainty. The authors discuss individual variation or growth as possible explanations for crest differences without excluding other interpretations. The original holotype is principally cranial material and supplies no associated limb proportions. This species guide retains the comparative identification rather than creating an unqualified species occurrence.

title.zh: 结核保存没有恢复确切采集点
title.en: Concretion preservation does not recover the exact collecting site

text.zh: MN 6594-V 的头颌、部分脊柱、肩带、胸骨、骨盆和翼部保存在结核中，后肢只保留一根股骨。标本早年由当地人采集，确切地点未知；结核特征支持来自 Romualdo 地层，Santana do Cariri 一带是作者提出的可能来源。方解石脉、风化和压缩使骨骼局部错位或变形，头部前端等部位缺失。可能来源不能转成精确坐标，结核也不等于完整无变形的三维身体。
text.en: MN 6594-V preserves cranial and mandibular material, part of the vertebral column, girdles, sternum, pelvis and wing elements in concretions, with only one femur representing the hindlimbs. Local people collected it earlier and its precise site is unknown. Nodule characteristics support a Romualdo origin, with the Santana do Cariri area proposed as a probable source. Calcite veins, weathering and compression displaced or deformed parts, and the rostral tip is missing. A probable origin does not supply coordinates or an intact, undeformed three-dimensional body.

title.zh: 头冠与牙槽保留形态，功能仍是解释
title.en: Crests and alveoli preserve form while function remains interpretive

text.zh: 前上颌骨冠的倾斜程度与模式标本不同，低钝的额顶骨冠、枕部方向和腭部隆起也参与作者的鉴定比较。骨面沟槽被解释为血管留下的痕迹，散热作用是功能假说；它们没有直接保存温度调节行为。头部破损使开孔和牙列不完整，可见牙槽数不能直接当作全口牙数，也不能仅据头冠和牙槽确定食谱。
text.en: Premaxillary-crest inclination differs from the holotype, while a low blunt frontoparietal crest, occipital orientation and palatal ridge contribute to the authors’ comparison. Surface grooves are interpreted as vascular impressions, with cooling a functional hypothesis rather than preserved thermoregulatory behavior. Cranial damage leaves openings and tooth rows incomplete; visible alveoli do not establish a complete tooth count or diet.

title.zh: 身体保存揭示支撑，也留下缺失骨段
title.en: The preserved body records support and missing segments

text.zh: 作者记录十二枚背椎，其中五枚椎体融合成背椎联合体；部分神经棘仍未融合。五枚骶椎与髂骨结合，肩胛与乌喙骨融合，腕骨系列也呈融合。肱骨与前臂骨缺少部分骨干，翼掌骨只存近端，骨盆也不完整。这些观察支持比较关节与躯干支撑，不能拼成全部直接测量的翼骨链，也不能从所有融合状态推定同一发育顺序。
text.en: The authors record twelve dorsal vertebrae, including five centra fused into a notarium while some neural spines remain unfused. Five sacrals join the ilium; the scapula and coracoid and carpal series are fused. Humeral and forearm shafts are incomplete, only the proximal wing metacarpal remains, and the pelvis is incomplete. These observations inform comparisons of joints and trunk support without supplying a wholly measured wing-bone chain or a universal developmental sequence.

title.zh: 局部组织学支持接近生长终点
title.en: Sampled histology supports growth approaching cessation

text.zh: 组织切片取自 MN 6594-V 第一翼指节的远端部分，部分结构被方解石遮蔽。作者描述外周基础系统、平行环周排列的骨组织以及生长标记，认为该个体已停止生长或接近停止；这与某些轴向结构尚未完全融合同时存在。局部组织学不是整个身体的连续生长记录，生长标记数量不直接等于确切年龄，也不能确定全种的最大成体尺寸。
text.en: Histology samples the distal portion of the first wing phalanx of MN 6594-V, with calcite obscuring some structures. The authors describe an external fundamental system, parallel circumferential tissue and growth marks, interpreting growth as ceased or close to cessation despite incomplete fusion in some axial structures. A local section is not a continuous whole-body growth record; growth marks do not establish exact age or maximum adult size for the species.

title.zh: 8.70 米翼展包含比较补全
title.en: The 8.70 m wingspan includes comparative reconstruction

text.zh: 研究以保存的骨端尺寸和其他翼龙的肢骨比例补估缺失骨段，再将翼骨、腕骨与肩带长度组合。作者所称“最大翼展”平均约 8.70 米，“正常翼展”约 8.26 米：后者使用研究提出的 5% 缩减系数，模拟关节弯曲。这是标本的模型估计，不是从完整翼尖直接测得，也不是全种最大值；比较骨架的身份和比例假设会影响结果，5% 不应成为所有翼龙的通用规则。
text.en: The study reconstructs missing segments from preserved bone-end dimensions and limb proportions of other pterosaurs, combining wing, carpal and girdle lengths. Its mean “maximized wingspan” is about 8.70 m and “normal wingspan” about 8.26 m, the latter using a proposed 5% reduction for joint flexion. These are specimen model estimates rather than measurements between intact wingtips or a species maximum. Comparator identities and proportional assumptions affect the result; 5% is not a universal rule for pterosaurs.

title.zh: 其他大翼骨仍是科级未定材料
title.en: Other large wing bones retain family-level uncertainty

text.zh: 同文的 MCT 1838-R 是孤立肱骨远端，MPSC R 1395 是部分左翼；二者保留 Anhangueridae 未定鉴定，不能因为尺寸大而归入 Tropeognathus mesembrinus。MPSC 材料的翼指伸肌突尚未融合，作者据此讨论未成熟状态。不同保存部位和生长阶段不能合并成一个理想成体，也不据其中最大估值扩展本种的体型范围。
text.en: MCT 1838-R is an isolated distal humerus and MPSC R 1395 a partial left wing in the same study. Both retain indeterminate Anhangueridae identifications rather than becoming Tropeognathus mesembrinus because of size. An unfused wing-finger extensor process in MPSC material informs the authors’ discussion of immaturity. Different preserved elements and growth stages cannot be assembled into an ideal adult or extend this species’ size range using the largest estimate.

title.zh: “冈瓦纳最大”保留 2013 年比较范围
title.en: The Gondwana size claim retains its 2013 comparison scope

text.zh: 论文题名中的“冈瓦纳最大飞行爬行动物”属于 2013 年材料和比较背景。文中以超过 7.4 米作为“巨型”的操作性界线，作者明确这一选择带有任意性；它不是独立生物类群或至今已核齐的世界纪录。少数巨型材料的保存与采集情况，也不能代表当时种群数量或沿海栖息偏好。
text.en: The title’s largest flying reptile from Gondwana claim belongs to the 2013 material and comparison context. The paper uses a wingspan over 7.4 m as an operational giant threshold and explicitly acknowledges its arbitrary choice. This is neither a biological clade nor a current independently checked record. Preservation and collection of a few large specimens do not establish population abundance or coastal habitat preference.

title.zh: 从具名出现转向比较标本
title.en: From named occurrences to comparative specimens

text.zh: 本页下方保留模式描述相关的采集记录、年代区间和数据库引文；2013 年 MN 6594-V 的确切地点未知，且使用 cf. 限定，应作为另一条材料证据阅读。返回 [Tropeognathus 属](../page.zh.md) 对照这两条路线，再查原始描述和后续鉴定。此次只读部分原文与选定图表，未复量实物、重算翼展或完成所有后续研究综述。
text.en: The retained sections below provide collection, age and database-reference context associated with the original description. MN 6594-V has an unknown exact site and a cf. qualifier, forming a separate material-evidence route. Return to [Tropeognathus](../page.en.md) to compare the routes, then consult original descriptions and later identifications. This pass reads selected primary text and figures without specimen remeasurement, a wingspan rerun or a complete review of later research.

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 83.6–72.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 83.6–72.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Bob's Vacation Site 的采集环境标签为 "floodplain"；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Bob's Vacation Site has collection-environment label "floodplain"; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

text.en: Bob's Vacation Site carries database reference attribution Varricchio (2002), identifier ref:7156. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

readerLimitations.zh: 本批是 2026-10-02 PBDB 出现记录导读，不是完整物种专论。只纳入固定 276 项翼龙工作名录中，当前名称一致、父链可追到已记录 Pterosauria 存储锚点、且有可用无疑问限定种级出现记录的条目。数据库接受名可能连接旧组合；这种数据库对应关系不裁决实际标本鉴定或所有分类争议，也不与 COL 同名概念合并。采集地点、地层区间、沉积环境和集合保存方式各有不同含义：它们不能直接推出完整分布、起源或灭绝时刻、该物种的固定生态、生物数量或每件标本的保存状态。原始描述、重描述、形态、食性和行为材料尚未逐项补齐；。
readerLimitations.en: This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

evidenceSummary: Selected 2003 description passages and a 2018 hyoid comparison are added. Original text was accessed through a third-party book OCR mirror because the publisher PDF was inaccessible; original images, layout and specimens were not inspected, and OCR readings are not independent remeasurement. Plant identity, a gular pouch, ingestion and cause of death retain inference limits; hyoids are not a complete preserved tongue. Later classification and additional referrals remain incomplete. Fixed database counts, ages, parent chains and review states remain; complete content and reader delivery remain pending.

title.zh: 正模是一件带下颌的头骨
title.en: The type is a skull with a mandible

text.zh: 2003 年命名论文以 SMNK PAL 3828 为正模，存于德国 Karlsruhe 的 Staatliches Museum für Naturkunde。材料是石灰岩板上的近完整头骨与下颌，许多骨骼仍相接、牙齿仍在齿槽中；原始介绍提供的是颅部材料，不能据此量得完整身体比例。原始描述的标本单位与下方数据库的一条出现记录分别阅读，不能互换为种群数量。
text.en: The 2003 naming paper designates SMNK PAL 3828, held at the Staatliches Museum für Naturkunde Karlsruhe, Germany, as the holotype. It is a nearly complete skull and mandible on a limestone slab, with many bones articulated and teeth retained in their sockets. It does not provide an associated body skeleton with complete proportions in this account. Read the described specimen separately from the database occurrence below; neither unit is a population count.

title.zh: 压扁与石材切割限制头冠复原
title.en: Compression and stone cutting limit crest reconstruction

text.zh: 作者记录头骨侧向压扁并有明显裂隙，舌骨也已向右旋转。后方向头冠保存了基部，但末端在采石场处理石材时被切去，发生在博物馆精细准备之前。因此保存的头冠存在与完整头冠形状是不同问题；不能从残存轮廓确定全部长度、面积、软组织外缘或空气动力学作用。
text.en: The authors record lateral compression, substantial fractures and rightward rotation of the hyoids. The posterior crest retains its base, but its distal portion was cut away in the stoneyard before museum preparation. Presence of the preserved crest and its complete outline are different questions. The remaining contour does not supply total length or area, a soft-tissue margin or demonstrated aerodynamic function.

title.zh: 产地来自商业来源，地层另有支持
title.en: Reported commercial provenance has separate stratigraphic support

text.zh: 原始描述说明标本来自商业渠道，所获产地信息是巴西 Ceará 的 Nova Olinda 附近采石场。作者把石灰岩基质与同板的小型 Dastilbe 鱼类作为 Nova Olinda Member、Crato Formation 来源的支持，并沿用 Aptian 的年代解释。这不是作者亲自发掘并逐层记录的发现。本页保留数据库的具名采集地和宽年代范围，不由岩板反推精确坐标或个体年龄。
text.en: The original description states that the specimen came through a commercial source, reported as quarries near Nova Olinda in Ceará, Brazil. The authors use the limestone matrix and small Dastilbe fish on the slab to support attribution to the Nova Olinda Member of the Crato Formation, retaining an Aptian age interpretation. This is not an excavation with a bed-by-bed record made by the authors. The named database collection and broad age bracket remain without deriving exact coordinates or an individual age from the slab.

title.zh: 后方向头冠与牙齿同时存在
title.en: A posterior crest occurs together with teeth

text.zh: 原始描述强调向后延伸、侧向扁平的顶枕头冠，以及圆弧状、没有上颌吻部头冠的吻背。颌前端有较大的弯曲牙齿，后方牙齿较小；牙齿的存在使“像 Pteranodon”只是部分外形类比，不能把它写成无齿翼龙。作者还比较眼眶内的泪骨突起和骨孔等形态。单一头冠与牙形不直接确认性别、食谱、飞行方式或完整亲缘树。
text.en: The original description emphasizes a posteriorly directed, laterally flattened parieto-occipital crest and a rounded rostral dorsum lacking a premaxillary crest. Larger curved teeth occur near the front of the jaws, with smaller teeth farther back. Dentition makes resemblance to Pteranodon a partial shape analogy rather than an identification as a toothless pterosaur. The authors also compare a lacrimal projection into the orbit and other cranial openings. Crest and tooth form alone establish neither sex, diet, flight mode nor a complete relationship tree.

title.zh: 颌间叶片没有被鉴定为 Yucca
title.en: The leaf between the jaws is not identified as Yucca

text.zh: 准备标本时发现一片细长、渐尖、具有粗平行纤维的叶片穿过两支下颌之间；下颌腹侧的叶片末端有物理损伤与散开的纤维。作者把形态同 Cordyline、Yucca 或 Agave 的现生叶片作类比，并说明这种化石叶尚未正式描述。相似性不是植物分类鉴定，也不表明 Ludodactylus 通常吃叶，更不能据此确定古代植被全部组成。
text.en: Preparation revealed an elongate, tapering leaf with coarse parallel fibers passing between the mandibular rami. Its ventral end shows physical damage and fraying. The authors compare its appearance with living Cordyline, Yucca or Agave leaves and note that the fossil leaf form had not been formally described. Resemblance is not botanical identification and does not establish habitual leaf eating by Ludodactylus or the full composition of ancient vegetation.

title.zh: 误吞与死亡经过保留为解释
title.en: Accidental ingestion and the death sequence remain interpretations

text.zh: 作者提出叶片可能被误当猎物吞入、卡在口腔软组织或可能的喉囊，并把散开的纤维解释为尝试移除时的损伤。他们以现生鹈鹕卡住异物作类比，讨论无法进食、衰弱或感染导致死亡的可能经过。岩板上保存叶片的位置与损伤是观察依据，误吞动作、喉囊、饥饿和败血症则没有被逐项直接保存；不能把这段叙述写成已经确诊的死因。
text.en: The authors propose that the leaf was mistaken for prey and lodged in soft tissues or a possible gular pouch, interpreting fraying as damage from attempts to remove it. They compare pelicans trapping debris and discuss inability to feed, weakness or infection as a possible route to death. Preserved position and damage provide observations; ingestion behavior, a pouch, starvation and sepsis are not each directly preserved. The narrative cannot become a confirmed diagnosis of cause of death.

title.zh: 舌骨比较支持功能推断，不是保存的舌头
title.en: Hyoid comparisons inform function without preserving a tongue

text.zh: 2018 年 Li、Zhou 与 Clarke 的研究将 Ludodactylus 列为角鳃骨较延长的翼龙例子，S1 表对应的是同一正模 SMNK PAL 3828，并指向 Frey 等的 2003 年描述。作者通过现生动物的骨骼、肌肉与功能比较讨论舌部活动能力；不能把研究中对现生鸟类或鳄类的染色 CT 方法写成本化石保存了肌肉。舌骨的形态可以约束推断，却不直接给出完整舌长、活动幅度、吞咽动作或特定猎物。
text.en: Li, Zhou and Clarke’s 2018 study includes Ludodactylus among pterosaurs with elongated ceratobranchials. Its S1 Table points to the same holotype, SMNK PAL 3828, and Frey and colleagues’ 2003 description. Comparisons of living-animal bones, muscles and function inform tongue-mobility hypotheses. Contrast-stained CT of living birds and crocodilians in that study is not evidence for muscles preserved in this fossil. Hyoid form constrains inference without directly supplying full tongue length, movement range, swallowing behavior or specific prey.

text.zh: Anhanguera robustus 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Anhanguera。本页导读 2 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 2 个采集记录和 2 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。其中 2 条保留旧鉴定名称或名称组合与数据库接受名的对应，原字符串另存，不把重组名当作新的独立发现。

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Chapada do Araripe [Romualdo Fm.] (general)（Ceará），地区代码 BR，地层名称 Romualdo；数据库年代范围 119.57–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Late Aptian。采集记录 Santana do Cariri (general)（Ceará），地区代码 BR，地层名称 Romualdo；数据库年代范围 119.57–113.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Late Aptian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。

Collection Santana do Cariri (general) (Ceará), region code BR, stratum name Romualdo; database age bracket 119.57–113.2 Ma, early interval Late Aptian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 119.57–113.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 119.57–113.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat

text.en: Chapada do Araripe [Romualdo Fm.] (general) has collection-environment label lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal; collection preservation-mode label body,concretion,soft parts. Santana do Cariri (general) has collection-environment label lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal; collection preservation-mode label body,concretion. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references

text.zh: Chapada do Araripe [Romualdo Fm.] (general) 的数据库引文署名为 Wellnhofer（1987），编号 ref:32258。Santana do Cariri (general) 的数据库引文署名为 Fastnacht（2001），编号 ref:32266。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Chapada do Araripe [Romualdo Fm.] (general) carries database reference attribution Wellnhofer (1987), identifier ref:32258. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.
