title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Austriadactylus cristatus 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Austriadactylus。本页导读 2 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 2 个采集记录和 2 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Austriadactylus cristatus is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Austriadactylus. This guide uses 2 eligible species-level occurrence records from 2 collections and 2 reference identifiers. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Austriadactylus type locality near Ankerschlag（Tyrol），地区代码 AT，地层名称 Seefelder Schichten；数据库年代范围 211.18–205.7 Ma，早端地质时段 Sevatian。采集记录 S. church Madonna Peraries, Rio Seazza valley（Friuli-Venezia Giulia），地区代码 IT，地层名称 Dolomia di Forni；数据库年代范围 215.38–205.7 Ma，早端地质时段 Alaunian、晚端时段 Sevatian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Austriadactylus type locality near Ankerschlag (Tyrol), region code AT, stratum name Seefelder Schichten; database age bracket 211.18–205.7 Ma, early interval Sevatian. Collection S. church Madonna Peraries, Rio Seazza valley (Friuli-Venezia Giulia), region code IT, stratum name Dolomia di Forni; database age bracket 215.38–205.7 Ma, early interval Alaunian and late interval Sevatian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 215.38–205.7 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 215.38–205.7 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Austriadactylus type locality near Ankerschlag 的采集环境标签为 潟湖或受限浅潮下沉积环境（lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存（body,adpression）。S. church Madonna Peraries, Rio Seazza valley 的采集环境标签为 盆地沉积环境，碳酸盐类（basinal (carbonate)）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Austriadactylus type locality near Ankerschlag has collection-environment label lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression. S. church Madonna Peraries, Rio Seazza valley has collection-environment label basinal (carbonate); collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Austriadactylus type locality near Ankerschlag 的数据库引文署名为 Dalla Vecchia et al.（2002），编号 ref:19667。S. church Madonna Peraries, Rio Seazza valley 的数据库引文署名为 Dalla Vecchia（2009），编号 ref:31587。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Austriadactylus type locality near Ankerschlag carries database reference attribution Dalla Vecchia et al. (2002), identifier ref:19667. S. church Madonna Peraries, Rio Seazza valley carries database reference attribution Dalla Vecchia (2009), identifier ref:31587. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh: Pterodactylus kochi 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Pterodactylus。本页导读 2 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 2 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。
text.en: Pterodactylus kochi is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Pterodactylus. This guide uses 2 eligible species-level occurrence records from 2 collections and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh: 采集记录 Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection)（Bayern），地区代码 DE，地层名称 Solnhofener Plattenkalk；数据库年代范围 149.2–145.06 Ma，早端地质时段 Early Tithonian。采集记录 Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection)（Bayern），地区代码 DE，地层名称 Solnhofen；数据库年代范围 149.2–145.06 Ma，早端地质时段 Early Tithonian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。
text.en: Collection Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection) (Bayern), region code DE, stratum name Solnhofener Plattenkalk; database age bracket 149.2–145.06 Ma, early interval Early Tithonian. Collection Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection) (Bayern), region code DE, stratum name Solnhofen; database age bracket 149.2–145.06 Ma, early interval Early Tithonian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 149.2–145.06 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 149.2–145.06 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh: Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection) 的采集环境标签为 潟湖或受限浅潮下沉积环境（lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal）；集合保存方式标签为 mold/impression、压印保存、软组织（mold/impression,adpression,soft parts）。Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection) 的采集环境标签为 潟湖或受限浅潮下沉积环境（lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal）；集合保存方式标签为 mold/impression、压印保存（mold/impression,adpression）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection) has collection-environment label lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal; collection preservation-mode label mold/impression,adpression,soft parts. Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection) has collection-environment label lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal; collection preservation-mode label mold/impression,adpression. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection) 的数据库引文署名为 Wellnhofer（1970），编号 ref:32120。Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection) 的数据库引文署名为 Wellnhofer（1970），编号 ref:32120。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection) carries database reference attribution Wellnhofer (1970), identifier ref:32120. Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection) carries database reference attribution Wellnhofer (1970), identifier ref:32120. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

Collection Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection) (Bayern), region code DE, stratum name Solnhofen; database age bracket 149.2–145.06 Ma, early interval Early Tithonian. title.en: Age bounds of these records

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 149.2–145.06 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 149.2–145.06 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat

Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection) has collection-environment label lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal; collection preservation-mode label mold/impression,adpression. title.en: Age bounds of these records

evidenceSummary: This page combines a short guide to selected original-description passages with fixed PBDB records. Complete text, images and supplementary matrices were not read in full. Fossils were not independently inspected, scanned or measured. Full body reconstruction, diet, behavior, life history and all phylogenetic hypotheses still need evidence.

title.zh: 正模由三块相连骨板组成
title.en: Three adjoining blocks preserve the holotype

text.zh: NHMUK PV R37110 是部分骨架，保存胸带、翼与后肢材料；七枚椎骨中两枚无法可靠识别。缺失部位不能从复原图补为实存骨骼。
text.en: Holotype NHMUK PV R37110 is a partial skeleton in three adjoining blocks, with shoulder, wing and hindlimb material. Two of seven vertebrae remain uncertain. Reconstructions do not supply preserved evidence for missing bones.

title.zh: 扫描显露仍包在围岩中的骨骼
title.en: Scanning reveals bones still embedded in matrix

text.zh: 作者用微 CT 分割仍包在围岩内的骨骼。数字显露提供观察路径，没有补全缺失材料。
text.en: Micro-CT segmentation reveals embedded bones; digital preparation does not supply missing anatomy.

title.zh: 诊断集中于胸带与骨盆
title.en: Diagnosis focuses on shoulder and pelvis

text.zh: 作者以乌喙骨上波状边缘的骨翼，以及髂骨后部被低嵴分开的凹陷鉴别 Ceoptera。形态诊断不直接确定食性。
text.en: The diagnosis identifies a wavy coracoid flange and a posterior iliac depression divided by a low ridge. These do not determine diet.

title.zh: 达尔文翼龙类结果仍有支持边界
title.en: Darwinopteran placement retains support limits

text.zh: 作者得到达尔文翼龙类单系结果，但支持度中低，Ceoptera 附近分辨率差。目录父链不是独立重算。
text.en: The analysis recovers monophyletic Darwinoptera with moderate-to-low support and poor resolution near Ceoptera; the stored classification is not an independent reanalysis.

readerLimitations.zh: 本批是 2026-10-02 PBDB 出现记录导读，不是完整物种专论。只纳入固定 276 项翼龙工作名录中，当前名称一致、父链可追到已记录 Pterosauria 存储锚点、且有可用无疑问限定种级出现记录的条目。数据库接受名可能连接旧组合；这种数据库对应关系不裁决实际标本鉴定或所有分类争议，也不与 COL 同名概念合并。采集地点、地层区间、沉积环境和集合保存方式各有不同含义：它们不能直接推出完整分布、起源或灭绝时刻、该物种的固定生态、生物数量或每件标本的保存状态。原始描述、重描述、形态、食性和行为材料尚未逐项补齐；。
readerLimitations.en: This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. Entries belong to the fixed 276-item pterosaur working roster, retain the current same name and a complete parent chain to the recorded Pterosauria storage anchor, and have usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. Database accepted names can connect older combinations; that database correspondence does not decide specimen identifications or all taxonomic disputes and is not merged with same-name COL concepts. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation modes have distinct meanings. They do not directly establish complete range, origin or extinction time, fixed species ecology, biological abundance or the condition of every specimen. Original descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet and behavior remain incompletely assembled;

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 152.21–149.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 152.21–149.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.en: Brunn Quarry layer 6 has collection-environment label lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh: Brunn Quarry layer 6 的数据库引文署名为 Hone et al.（2012），编号 ref:42228。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。
text.en: Brunn Quarry layer 6 carries database reference attribution Hone et al. (2012), identifier ref:42228. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

overview: Holotype NMS G.2021.6.1—4 comes from the Upper Lonfearn Member of the Lealt Shale Formation on Scotland’s Isle of Skye. The 2025 account distinguishes the main slab, skull block, ventral counterslab and separate wing-phalanx block within one associated skeleton. Delicate palatal, hyoid and neurocranial elements survive, the cervical series is complete and the right hand is particularly well preserved. Dorsals and ribs are disarticulated; pelvis, tail and hindlimbs are poorly preserved. Hard limestone obscures many surfaces, so three-dimensional preservation does not make the entire body observable.

evidenceSummary: This page combines selected main-text sections of the 2025 holotype study with fixed PBDB records. Complete anatomy, original images and the 2022 description with its wingspan regressions and histology were not independently read in full. Scans, measurements and phylogenetic matrices were not rerun. Muscles, feeding and climbing are hypotheses from bone landmarks, teeth and comparisons rather than direct behavior. Life history, full species boundaries and later research remain unfinished.

title.zh: 三维骨架仍受硬石灰岩限制
title.en: A three-dimensional skeleton still constrained by limestone

text.zh: Dearc sgiathanach 的正模 NMS G.2021.6.1—4 来自苏格兰斯凯岛 Lealt Shale Formation 的 Upper Lonfearn Member。2025 年详述研究把它分为主骨板、头骨块、腹面对应骨板和单独翼指节块，均属同一关联骨架。头骨保留细小腭部、舌骨与神经颅材料，颈椎系列完整，右手保存尤其好；背椎与肋架已散开，骨盆、尾部和后肢保存较差。硬石灰岩遮住许多表面，三维保存并不意味着全身每处均可观察。
text.en: Holotype NMS G.2021.6.1—4 comes from the Upper Lonfearn Member of the Lealt Shale Formation on Scotland’s Isle of Skye. The 2025 account distinguishes the main slab, skull block, ventral counterslab and separate wing-phalanx block within one associated skeleton. Delicate palatal, hyoid and neurocranial elements survive, the cervical series is complete and the right hand is particularly well preserved. Dorsals and ribs are disarticulated; pelvis, tail and hindlimbs are poorly preserved. Hard limestone obscures many surfaces, so three-dimensional preservation does not make the entire body observable.

title.zh: CT 与骨面痕迹提供不同层次的资料
title.en: CT and bone landmarks provide different kinds of evidence

text.zh: 作者用微 CT 读取分离头骨块，并手动分割内部空间。吻部骨与围岩对比度较好，后部头骨则较低，分割更困难；脑腔和内耳空间较清晰。肌肉位置另由骨面嵴、凹陷与纹理结合现生鳄类、鸟类的系统发育括限推断。扫描获得的空腔、骨面形态和复原肌肉应分别阅读：化石没有直接保存这一套活动中的肌肉，也没有记录真实飞行。
text.en: The authors micro-CT scanned the detached skull block and manually segmented internal spaces. Bone–matrix contrast is better in the rostrum and lower in the posterior skull, making segmentation harder there; brain and ear cavities are clearer. Muscle placement is separately inferred from ridges, depressions and textures using an extant phylogenetic bracket of crocodilians and birds. Scanned cavities, bone morphology and reconstructed muscles are distinct evidence: the fossil does not directly preserve this functioning muscle system or record actual flight.

title.zh: 两类牙齿与磨损支持食性假说
title.en: Two tooth forms and wear support a feeding hypothesis

text.zh: 保存牙齿包括前部较长、弯曲的尖牙与后部短直的棱柱状牙，前端牙齿受侵蚀尤其明显，部分只剩根或中段。后牙可见牙冠缺口、釉质开裂与剥落；作者与 Dorygnathus 等比较，提出它能处理较硬猎物的解释。紧密交错的前牙也被讨论为抓取鱼类的可能结构。这里没有胃内容物或被捕食动物的直接记录，不能据牙齿把鱼类写成全部食谱，或给出固定猎物比例。
text.en: Preserved teeth include longer, recurved anterior fangs and short, straight, prism-like posterior teeth. Erosion particularly affects the front teeth, some surviving only as roots or mid-sections. Posterior crowns show chips, enamel cracking and spalling. Comparisons with Dorygnathus and other pterosaurs lead the authors to infer an ability to handle harder prey. Interlocking front teeth are also discussed as a possible fish-grabbing structure. No stomach contents or directly consumed animal is reported here; teeth do not establish an exclusively fish-based diet or fixed prey proportions.

title.zh: 肱骨嵴与胸骨扩充诊断
title.en: Humeral crests and sternum extend the diagnosis

text.zh: 2025 年作者新增两项自衍征解释：三角胸肌嵴向近端扩展且高于尺侧嵴，胸骨前缘向前突出。胸骨为薄而宽的板，可能尚未在后部完全骨化；比较还受其他翼龙胸骨保存差限制。左右肱骨显露方向不同，局部压扁与裂缝会改变曲度，因此不能把左右差异直接当作活体不对称。嵴的形态可支持分类和肌肉附着比较，但不直接给出肌肉质量或拍翼功率。
text.en: The authors propose two additional autapomorphies in 2025: a proximally expanding deltopectoral crest higher than the ulnar crest, and an anteriorly projecting sternal margin. The sternum is a thin, broad plate whose posterior part may not have fully ossified; poor preservation of other pterosaur sterna limits comparison. The humeri are exposed differently, and local flattening and fractures affect curvature, so left–right differences do not directly demonstrate living asymmetry. Crest morphology supports diagnostic and muscle-attachment comparisons without directly measuring muscle mass or flapping power.

title.zh: 飞行肌肉复原仍是待研究假说
title.en: Reconstructed flight muscles remain a hypothesis

text.zh: 作者把发达三角胸肌嵴与胸肌附着联系起来，将肱骨上的其他凹陷和骨面痕迹与背阔肌、喙肱肌等比较，提出飞行可能较依赖肱骨内收与前伸。其形态与 Rhamphorhynchus 的区别提示相近体型翼龙未必有同一种拍翼机制，但作者明确将此作为未来肌骨计算模型可研究的假说。肩胛乌喙骨与掌骨保存不佳，许多附着关系不清楚；体型效应、亲缘与趋同也尚未分开。
text.en: The authors associate the expanded deltopectoral crest with pectoralis attachment and compare other humeral landmarks with latissimus dorsi and coracobrachialis attachments. They suggest flight may have relied more on humeral adduction and protraction. Differences from Rhamphorhynchus indicate that similarly sized pterosaurs need not share one flapping mechanism, but the authors explicitly present this as a hypothesis for future musculoskeletal modeling. Poor scapulocoracoid and metacarpal preservation leaves many attachments unclear; size effects, ancestry and convergence remain difficult to separate.

title.zh: 弯曲手爪提供攀爬可能性
title.en: Curved hand claws suggest possible climbing

text.zh: 右手第一至第三指完整，第四翼指只保留部分；爪骨带发达屈肌附着部，另有籽骨。作者将二维爪骨曲度与现生攀爬、栖枝鸟类比较，提出抓握或攀爬以及可能辅助捕食的解释。爪骨不是完整角质爪，比较动物的功能也不能直接转成 Dearc 的活动记录；树栖频率、攀爬基质和是否用爪捕食都尚未直接确定。原文爪长数字与随后“第三爪最长”措辞不一致，本页不据此建立尺寸排序。
text.en: Digits I–III of the right hand are complete, while only part of wing digit IV survives. Unguals have developed flexor attachments and associated sesamoids. Comparing two-dimensional curvature with climbing and perching birds, the authors propose grasping or climbing and possibly a supplementary predatory role. Ungual bone is not a complete keratinous claw, and comparator functions do not directly record Dearc behavior. Frequency of tree use, climbing substrate and predatory claw use remain undetermined. Numerical lengths conflict with a later claim that the third ungual is longest, so no size ranking is imported.

title.zh: 目录位置与新的亲缘方案并列
title.en: The stored placement and newer hypotheses coexist

text.zh: 2025 年论文沿用 2022 年提出的 Angustinaripterini 名称讨论，但介绍中同时记录另一项含 Skiphosoura 的研究把 Dearc 放得更接近 Monofenestrata。相对较长的颈椎等特征可能体现模块演化或与体型有关的趋同；“过渡”并不表示它是已证明的直接祖先。本站保留固定 PBDB 父链用于资料编排，论文提到的替代方案保持年代和作者归属。本批没有重算矩阵，也未独立通读 2022 年原始描述或所引 Skiphosoura 论文。
text.en: The 2025 paper retains the Angustinaripterini terminology of the 2022 description while reporting another study including Skiphosoura that places Dearc closer to Monofenestrata. Relatively elongate cervicals and other traits may reflect modular evolution or size-related convergence; “transitional” does not establish direct ancestry. The fixed PBDB parent chain continues to organize these pages, with alternative hypotheses retaining their dates and attribution. Matrices were not rerun, and the 2022 original description and cited Skiphosoura paper were not independently read in full in this batch.

readerLimitations.en: This batch is a guide to PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02, not a complete species monograph. title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh: 本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 143.1–137.05 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。
text.en: Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 143.1–137.05 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat

text.zh: Jucaigou 的采集环境标签为 陆相沉积环境，类型未定（terrestrial indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。
text.en: Jucaigou has collection-environment label terrestrial indet.; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references

text.en: Jucaigou carries database reference attribution Lu et al. (2015), identifier ref:54088. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

geography: Late Jurassic lithographic limestones of Bavaria, Germany
overview: A Late Jurassic avialan known from a small Bavarian specimen series; it lies outside crown Neornithes and is not presented as the direct ancestor of living birds.

ecology.diet: Not resolved by the cited flight and systematic studies
ecology.habitat: Solnhofen-archipelago carbonate environments represented by Bavarian lithographic limestones
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial and aerial capacities; flight style is inferred from bone geometry rather than observed behaviour
ecology.bodySize: Small-bodied paravian
ecology.guild: Unresolved; no single feeding guild is assigned from the cited evidence

traits: Asymmetrical flight feathers associated with skeletal specimens
Toothed jaws and a long bony tail
Pectoral geometry compatible with short-burst active flight in a biomechanical comparison
evidenceSummary: The oldest referred specimen extends the genus into the earliest Tithonian Painten Formation and documents substantial anatomical variation; synchrotron comparisons support active flight capacity but not modern crown-bird flight performance.

geography: Antarctica and Europe for the two Maastrichtian fossil tests highlighted here
overview: The crown group defined by the common ancestor of living birds and all descendants; this boundary excludes Archaeopteryx and keeps Cretaceous fossil membership tied to explicit phylogenetic analyses.

ecology.diet: Highly diverse; the highlighted Vegavis skull supports underwater prey capture for that fossil only
ecology.habitat: Global across marine, freshwater and terrestrial environments today
ecology.locomotion: Predominantly volant, with multiple independently flight-reduced or flightless lineages
ecology.bodySize: Extremely diverse

traits: Crown membership is defined relationally, not by one universally diagnostic fossil character
Vegavis skull anatomy combines an avian beak and crown-like neuroanatomy with a specialized feeding apparatus
Asteriornis preserves a different late Maastrichtian galloanseran character combination
evidenceSummary: A 2025 skull analysis strengthens crown-waterfowl placement for older Vegavis, but the study explicitly records its earlier contested placements; younger Asteriornis also shifts among near-crown positions under different analyses.

geography: Pekin Formation, Chatham County, North Carolina, United States
overview: A Carnian crocodylomorph represented here by partial, skeletally immature holotype NCSM 21558 and referred humerus NCSM 21623; its basal placement and predator-guild role are results of the cited analyses, not direct ancestry or behaviour.

ecology.diet: Faunivory is inferred from serrated, recurved teeth rather than directly observed feeding
ecology.habitat: Terrestrial Pekin Formation assemblage in the study's reconstruction
ecology.locomotion: Treated as terrestrial in the cited comparison; locomotor performance was not directly tested
ecology.bodySize: Approximately 3 m in the study's reconstruction, with an immature femur-length estimate of 354–441 mm
ecology.guild: Top-tier terrestrial predator in the sampled Pekin Formation assemblage, as interpreted by the study

traits: NCSM 21558 preserves parts of the skull, vertebral column, ribs and left humerus
The reconstructed skull is slender and ornamented, with an estimated length greater than 50 cm
Premaxillary teeth are elongate, serrated and slightly recurved
evidenceSummary: The holotype anatomy, Chatham County horizon and approximately 231 Ma age are direct specimen and geological records; total length, body-mass proxy, guild assignment and basal crocodylomorph placement remain bounded analytical interpretations.

overview: A latest Maastrichtian bird represented by CT-imaged holotype NHMM 2013 008; the original analyses place it near crown Galloanserae but disagree on its exact branch, so the profile does not use it as a universal crown-bird first appearance.

ecology.diet: Not resolved by the cited description
ecology.habitat: A possible littoral ecology inferred from the marine depositional context, not a directly observed habitat preference
ecology.locomotion: Not resolved by the cited description
ecology.bodySize: Mean body-mass estimate of 394 g from the study's skeletal scaling model
ecology.guild: No feeding or locomotor guild is assigned from the cited evidence

traits: A nearly complete, three-dimensionally preserved skull is associated with fragmentary postcranial elements
The skull combines galliform-like and anseriform-like features in the authors' comparison
Parsimony and tip-dated Bayesian analyses recover different near-galloanseran positions
evidenceSummary: NHMM 2013 008, the 66.8–66.7 Ma horizon, CT anatomy and 394 g model estimate are source-bounded; crown position, possible littoral ecology and biogeographic implications remain analysis-dependent.

title.en: A genus introduced through its type specimen
title.zh: 从模式标本认识一个属

text.en: This route introduces genus Asteriornis through NHMM 2013 008, the holotype of A. maastrichtensis. It comes from the Maastricht Formation at Belgium’s CBR-Romontbos quarry; the cited 2020 study constrains its horizon to 66.8–66.7 Ma. CT imaging reveals a nearly complete three-dimensional skull and associated postcranial bones. This named fossil is the starting material, rather than a complete sample of variation across the genus.
text.zh: Asteriornis 属在本阅读路径中由 A. maastrichtensis 的正模 NHMM 2013 008 引入。材料来自比利时 CBR-Romontbos 采石场的 Maastricht 组，所引2020年研究将层位限定为6680万至6670万年前。CT 成像揭示近完整三维头骨及相关头后骨骼；这里阅读的是具名化石材料，不是整个属的完整变异样本。

title.en: Follow anatomy, relationships and inference limits
title.zh: 沿解剖、亲缘关系与解释边界继续阅读

text.en: Continue to the Asteriornis maastrichtensis species page: distinguish preserved cranial features from the authors’ landfowl and waterfowl comparisons, then compare the parsimony and tip-dated Bayesian placements. The 394-g body mass is a skeletal-scaling estimate; littoral ecology is a tentative depositional-context interpretation. The occurrence age establishes neither a global crown-bird first appearance nor direct ancestry.
text.zh: 接着读 Asteriornis maastrichtensis 的种级页：先区分保存下来的头骨特征与作者的鸡形类、雁形类比较，再看简约法与尖端定年贝叶斯分析为何给出不同位置。体重394克来自骨骼尺度估计；滨岸生态只是沉积背景所支持的可能解释。标本出现的年龄不能替代冠群鸟类全球首现，也不确立直接祖先关系。

title.en: Field et al. (2020), Asteriornis holotype anatomy and competing phylogenetic analyses
title.zh: Field 等（2020），Asteriornis 正模解剖与竞争系统发育分析

scope.en: NHMM 2013 008 and its quarry/horizon provenance; Figures 1–3, Extended Data Figures 7–9 and the cited description. Existing research claims delimit anatomy, competing topology results, the skeletal-scaling mass estimate and tentative littoral interpretation. These locators do not establish a complete global range, feeding behaviour, flight performance, direct ancestry of this guide.
scope.zh: NHMM 2013 008 及其采石场和层位来源；图1–3、扩展数据图7–9及所引描述。既有研究 claims 限定解剖观察、竞争拓扑、骨骼尺度体重估计和暂定滨岸解释。这些定位不确立完整全球分布、取食行为、飞行性能、直系祖先关系。

readerLimitations.en: This genus route is limited to a named holotype and its cited study, without a complete genus range, ecology or variation account. The route’s 66.8–66.7 Ma interval applies to the cited sample; a global species range and first and last appearances remain unresolved. Recorded database placement and atlas navigation do not independently resolve competing phylogenetic results. This bilingual guide.
readerLimitations.zh: 这是单一具名正模及其所引研究的属级阅读入口，不能外推完整属级分布、生态或种内变异。本阅读路径中的6680万至6670万年前限定到已有样本，不表示已经证实全球首现与末现；种级整体范围仍缺少充分来源。数据库所录分类位置与图谱导航不能独立解决不同分析间的分支差异。。

title.en: A specimen from a constrained Belgian horizon
title.zh: 比利时限定层位中的具名标本

text.en: Holotype NHMM 2013 008 comes from the Maastricht Formation at the CBR-Romontbos quarry in Belgium. Field et al. (2020) constrain its source horizon to 66.8–66.7 Ma. This is a locality/horizon constraint, not the species’ complete duration or global first and last appearances. The collection number connects anatomy and phylogenetic interpretations to the same material; the locality does not identify the geographic origin of crown birds.
text.zh: 正模 NHMM 2013 008 出自比利时 CBR-Romontbos 采石场的 Maastricht 组。Field 等（2020）给出的6680万至6670万年前是该来源层位的年龄约束，不是本种完整存续期、全球首现或全球末现。馆藏号把后续解剖与系统发育解释连接到同一材料；出现地点也不确定冠群鸟类的地理起源。

title.en: What the fossil preserves
title.zh: 化石保存了什么

text.en: The specimen preserves a nearly complete three-dimensional skull with associated postcranial elements, studied through CT imaging and digital segmentation. In the authors’ comparison, its cranium combines galliform-like and anseriform-like features. These observations belong to the preserved material and comparison; the combination does not make it a modern chicken or duck or reveal unpreserved soft tissues and behaviour.
text.zh: 标本保存近完整、三维保存的头骨及相关头后骨骼，头骨经CT成像与数字分割研究。作者比较中，头骨呈现鸡形类样与雁形类样特征的组合。保存性状和比较结果是可限定到这件标本的证据；这种组合不表示它就是现代鸡或鸭，也不意味着未保存的软组织和行为已经确定。

title.en: Two analyses, two nearby placements
title.zh: 两种分析与两种相近位置

text.en: The study’s parsimony analysis recovered it as sister to crown Galloanserae. Its tip-dated Bayesian analysis instead placed it as the stemward-most member of Pangalliformes. Both concern its relationships near galloanserans, but they do not agree on the exact branch. This page reports the method-dependent results together; recorded database placement and atlas navigation do not independently resolve these competing results.
text.zh: 研究中的简约法把它恢复为冠群鸡雁类的姐妹群；尖端定年贝叶斯分析则把它放在全鸡形类最靠干群的位置。两项结果都关联近鸡雁类的比较，却并不一致地解决具体分支。本页并列报告这些方法依赖结果，数据库所录分类位置与图谱导航不能独立解决这些竞争结果。

title.en: A model estimate and a tentative habitat
title.zh: 模型体重与暂定环境解释

text.en: The reported mean body-mass estimate of 394 g is a skeletal-scaling model result, not a measured living animal. Small size and marine depositional context led the authors to suggest possible littoral ecology; burial setting does not directly establish habitat preference. The cited description does not resolve species-specific diet, locomotor performance or a feeding guild.
text.zh: 论文报告的平均体重估计为394克，是骨骼尺度模型结果，不是对活体的称量。小体型与海相沉积背景使作者提出可能的滨岸生态，但沉积地点不能直接证明动物的栖地偏好。所引描述没有确定本种食性、运动性能或摄食功能群；这里保持这些问题开放。

title.en: Field et al. (2020), Asteriornis holotype anatomy and competing phylogenetic analyses
title.zh: Field 等（2020），Asteriornis 正模解剖与竞争系统发育分析

scope.en: NHMM 2013 008 and its quarry/horizon provenance; Figures 1–3, Extended Data Figures 7–9 and the cited description. readerLimitations.en: These sections are limited to NHMM 2013 008 and the description, comparisons and models in Field et al. (2020). A global range and first and last appearances remain unresolved for lack of sufficient provenance. Diet, flight or other locomotor performance, soft tissues and population variation remain unsupported in this batch. The horizon age does not close the range gap, and competing placements do not establish direct ancestry. This bilingual guide.

overview: Dinosauria is an atlas route from early fossil samples through living birds. Its displayed 233.2–0 Ma span is a navigation composite: the older end is anchored by a named Late Triassic assemblage, not a demonstrated global first appearance or continuous fossil record. The route keeps that specimen evidence, changing family-tree hypotheses and later fossil examples distinct.

ecology.diet: Diet varied across lineages; no single group-wide diet is inferred here.
ecology.habitat: The page links terrestrial fossil samples with the living-bird continuation; it does not define one habitat for Dinosauria.
ecology.locomotion: Locomotor anatomy and behaviour differ across included lineages; the examples below are not a group-wide performance model.
ecology.bodySize: Body size varied widely across the lineage; no single size estimate is derived from the selected fossils.
ecology.guild: Diverse terrestrial and aerial lineages; no single ecological guild is assigned to the whole group.

traits: The route includes the sampled Late Triassic holotype ULBRA-PVT280 and living birds.
Early dinosaur relationships remain sensitive to matrix coding and taxon sampling.
evidenceSummary: ULBRA-PVT280 and its Candelária Sequence context are documented specimen evidence. Its age does not set a global dinosaur first appearance. Published morphology matrices recover competing early topologies, and the Yutyrannus integument example is limited to three named skeletons; neither should be generalized beyond its study scope.

title.en: A named specimen anchors the early fossil route
title.zh: 具名标本锚定早期化石路径

text.en: The holotype ULBRA-PVT280 comes from an approximately 233.2 Ma assemblage in the Candelária Sequence of southern Brazil. It preserves a partial skull, axial skeleton, forelimb and nearly complete left hind limb. This is a well-described local sample; it does not establish a global dinosaur first appearance or make Buriolestes a direct ancestor of later dinosaurs.
text.zh: 正模 ULBRA-PVT280 出自巴西南部 Candelária Sequence 中约 2.332 亿年前的生物组合。标本保存部分头骨、轴骨骼、前肢和近乎完整的左后肢。这是有详尽描述的局地样本，不能确立全球恐龙首现，也不能说明 Buriolestes 是后续恐龙的直接祖先。

title.en: Why dinosaur family trees can differ
title.zh: 为何恐龙系统树会出现分歧

text.en: A 74-taxon, 457-character analysis recovered Theropoda and Ornithischia together as Ornithoscelida. A published reanalysis that rescored characters and added taxa recovered the traditional ornithischian–saurischian split. These are competing matrix results: character coding and sampling affect the inferred early branches, and neither analysis directly observes ancestry.
text.zh: 一项包含 74 个分类单元和 457 项性状的分析，将兽脚类与鸟臀类恢复为共同组成 Ornithoscelida。随后发表的重分析对性状重新编码并增加分类单元，恢复了传统的鸟臀类—蜥臀类分支。这些是彼此竞争的矩阵结果：性状编码与取样会影响推断的早期分支，任何一项分析都不是对祖先关系的直接观察。

title.en: What three Yutyrannus skeletons preserve
title.zh: 三件羽王龙骨架保存了什么

text.en: Three nearly complete Yutyrannus skeletons from the Lower Cretaceous Yixian Formation preserve long filamentous integument. The specimens document those structures in this tyrannosauroid sample; they do not establish complete body coverage, its function, or the integument of every dinosaur lineage.
text.zh: 来自早白垩世义县组的三件近乎完整羽王龙骨架保存了细长丝状体表结构。这些标本记录的是这一组暴龙超科样本中的结构；它们不能确立全身覆盖、具体功能，或所有恐龙谱系的体表状况。

title.en: Cabreira et al. (2016), the Buriolestes assemblage
title.zh: Cabreira 等（2016），Buriolestes 生物组合

scope.zh: 对 ULBRA-PVT280 正模和 Candelária Sequence 生物组合的一手描述；局地年代背景不能确立全球恐龙首现。

title.en: Baron et al. (2017), a dinosaur relationships matrix
title.zh: Baron 等（2017），恐龙亲缘关系矩阵

scope.en: The 74-taxon, 457-character analysis recovered Ornithoscelida; this is a matrix topology rather than observed ancestry.
scope.zh: 这项包含 74 个分类单元、457 项性状的分析恢复 Ornithoscelida；这是矩阵拓扑结果，而非观察到的祖先关系。

title.en: Langer et al. (2017), dinosaur tree reanalysis
title.zh: Langer 等（2017），恐龙系统树重分析

scope.zh: 重新编码并增加分类单元后，研究恢复传统的鸟臀类—蜥臀类分支，显示结果受矩阵组成与编码影响。

title.zh: Xu 等（2012），羽王龙骨架与体表结构

scope.en: Three nearly complete Yixian Formation skeletons preserve filamentous integument; function and full-body coverage are not direct observations.
scope.zh: 三件义县组近乎完整骨架保存了丝状体表结构；其功能与全身覆盖并非直接观察所得。

readerLimitations.en: This atlas concept is marked unresolved and has no fixed PBDB taxon ID. The page follows a selected fossil sample into the atlas's living-bird navigation; 233.2–0 Ma is not an uninterrupted occurrence interval. The cited specimens and topology analyses do not form a complete dinosaur ecology or evolutionary history.
readerLimitations.zh: 本图谱概念标记为未解决，且没有固定 PBDB 分类单元 ID。页面从精选化石样本延伸至图谱中的现生鸟类导航；2.332 亿年前至今不是连续的出现记录。所引标本与拓扑分析不能构成完整恐龙生态或演化史综述，。
